rows.name: String Theory
rows.short_description: String Theory is a colorful puzzle game about matching a given pattern by building it out of different colored shapes.String theory has 60+ handcrafted puzzles, daily challenges, free play modes, and a level editor, making for hours of fun.
rows.description_html: Draw lines between pegs to create loops. The loops fill in with a different color depending on how many pegs they touch. Any loop that touches either three pegs or six pegs turns green. Any loop that touches either four pegs or eight pegs turns purple. Any loop that touches either five pegs or seven pegs turns spotted purple. Replicating the given pattern with as few loops as possible requires strategic placement and overlapping of loops. With dozens of handcrafted patterns to match, and thousands additional free play patterns, String Theory is a mind-bending game filled to the brim with tricky puzzles to get the gears turning!

Collect the coins for score or eat the burgers to regain life. Look out for the birds because they will kill you
rows.description_html: Welcome to FoxRun, the game that was created as a result of a novice tipping their toes into game development. This game was made in 5 days with total dev time of ~24 hours across those 5 days. The full videos of the whole dev process are available on Youtube playlist FoxRun is an autorunner game, you play as a fox and you must run for that is all that you know. Collect the coins to amass wealth in the ratrace of life while you also must keep an eye on your health and collect the burgers to replenish it. The birds are vicious government agents that are out for your wealth and will destroy you for it. Can you survive in the dystopian future of FoxRun or will you fail in the race as all the rest?

rows.name: Observance of Homeland
rows.short_description: A minimalistic free-exploration metroidvania with quick, responsive movement and an extremely diverse cast of bosses.
rows.description_html: Play as the noble air elemental Furl and traverse the chaotic Incarnae realm known as Homeland.  In her sojourn she'll subdue troublesome beasts, spar with other elemental champions and confer with the powerful deities known as the Primordials.  Ultimately, will the clarity she seeks be found in the council of others, or in her own past, in her confrontation with the one she trusted most...? Observance of Homeland is a minimalistic, open-ended metroidvania.  Explore the vast world of Homeland and the surrounding territories with few artificial barriers.  Challenge 20 extremely diverse bosses and take their powers for your own. Features Quick, responsive controls with exceptional freedom of movement A vast array of powerups and abilities to discover and collect Extensive optional content, explore the treacherous Shining Peak or dare to plunge into the depths of Hell Every boss comes with an optional True Form, face these challenge-mode versions at your peril! Complete content access, re-fight any boss as many times as you'd like Never take a detour to find a save point, the game saves every room transition and every checkpoint

rows.name: HyperBody
rows.short_description: Dive into HyperBody dungeons: an experimental VR walking simulator blending architectural ruins, cult themes, sensorial vibes, and queer narratives. Navigate mysterious realms and affective tales, and immerse in a psychedelic, rhythm-fueled cosmos. Experience a meditative, aestheticised trance!
rows.description_html: Welcome to HyperBody dungeons, an experimental open-world VR game space with six intense gameplay levels: Pinkray, Seventeen/Sixty-One, Vampire Squid, Stratholme.GoStop, Typhoon Lionrock, and Garden Portal. Immerse yourself in an aesthetised trance world that showcases the anime, comics, games, and novels of European and Asian fandoms. The VR experience is 'passive', requiring only basic movements such as walking, flying, rotating, and touching. It will help if you search for the portal with a shining eye shape that will take you to a new level. The experiment encourages players to use their entire bodies to explore the VR space and provide feedback on its aesthetics, movement, and overall feelings! Are you ready to embark on this psychedelic, rhythm-fueled adventure and imagine an alternative VR cosmos? PLAYER INSTRUCTIONS For HyperBody's experimental nature, please check system requirements first, view the quick reference and start playing. If you are interested, browse the manual and join our Discord community! LEVEL 1: PINKRAY Pinkray is a result of a collaborative effort that celebrates queer 'tuning' through vidding, shipping, interviews, and architectural mods. It showcases a new 'game-fandom' that constantly emerges as 'intra-actions'. It features non-collision NPCs, architectural ruins, visual novels with 3D animated texts, and affective NPC dialogues! LEVEL 2: SEVENTEEN/SIXTY-ONE Seventeen/Sixty-One is co-created through research and interviews with Chinese science fiction writer Tang Fei. It offers an alternative vision of queer, feminine, and technology in the Chinese science fiction world. It features 2D illustrations, animations and 3D texts as interactive paths, accompanied by various soundscapes and atmospheric objects. LEVEL 3: VAMPIRE SQUID Vilem Flusser's book of the same name inspires the abstract cosmos of Vampire Squid. Explore multiple worlds created by remixing 3D scans of spaces, cartographies, and surfaces from London and Berlin. This complex spatial autoethnographic archive showcases Flusser's ideas on skin, space, and sexuality. It features non-collision 3D-scanned architectural ruins on a cosmic scale and surreal NPCs. LEVEL 4: STRATHOLME.GOSTOP Stratholme.GoStop presents a unique combination of physical and virtual elements based on my best childhood friend, Boxiao's short novel. It has modding and crossover elements between a Chinese post-industrial ordnance factory welfare zone and the Warcraft 3: The Frozen Throne universe. It features visual novels based on dodecahedron objects and various Chinese urban space 3D-scanned ruins. rows.about_html: Welcome to HyperBody dungeons, an experimental open-world VR game space with six intense gameplay levels: Pinkray, Seventeen/Sixty-One, Vampire Squid, Stratholme.GoStop, Typhoon Lionrock, and Garden Portal. Immerse yourself in an aesthetised trance world that showcases the anime, comics, games, and novels of European and Asian fandoms. The VR experience is 'passive', requiring only basic movements such as walking, flying, rotating, and touching. It will help if you search for the portal with a shining eye shape that will take you to a new level. The experiment encourages players to use their entire bodies to explore the VR space and provide feedback on its aesthetics, movement, and overall feelings! Are you ready to embark on this psychedelic, rhythm-fueled adventure and imagine an alternative VR cosmos? PLAYER INSTRUCTIONS For HyperBody's experimental nature, please check system requirements first, view the quick reference and start playing. If you are interested, browse the manual and join our Discord community! LEVEL 1: PINKRAY Pinkray is a result of a collaborative effort that celebrates queer 'tuning' through vidding, shipping, interviews, and architectural mods. It showcases a new 'game-fandom' that constantly emerges as 'intra-actions'. It features non-collision NPCs, architectural ruins, visual novels with 3D animated texts, and affective NPC dialogues! LEVEL 2: SEVENTEEN/SIXTY-ONE Seventeen/Sixty-One is co-created through research and interviews with Chinese science fiction writer Tang Fei. It offers an alternative vision of queer, feminine, and technology in the Chinese science fiction world. It features 2D illustrations, animations and 3D texts as interactive paths, accompanied by various soundscapes and atmospheric objects. LEVEL 3: VAMPIRE SQUID Vilem Flusser's book of the same name inspires the abstract cosmos of Vampire Squid. Explore multiple worlds created by remixing 3D scans of spaces, cartographies, and surfaces from London and Berlin. This complex spatial autoethnographic archive showcases Flusser's ideas on skin, space, and sexuality. It features non-collision 3D-scanned architectural ruins on a cosmic scale and surreal NPCs. rows.reviews_html: “Your VR game Queer Maximalism HyperBody, for me, is a performative declaration of being unapologetically queer, maximalist, and body-centric.” Rhizome “A performative practice that creates new forms of intra-action of culture, technology, and queerness, resulting in new modes of intimacy, affect, and subjectivity.” CURA. “In HyperBody Qiang develops a strategy for revitalisation in order to create discourse around resistance and the rebuilding of worlds — a needed political gesture within our present political moment.” transmediale

rows.name: I commissioned some invisible people 0
rows.short_description: I paid more artists to hide invisible people in 5 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.
rows.description_html: You may also like About the Game A hidden object game where you must find all the invisible people to complete each level. If you look really carefully, you might see them. Release date: April 1st (but the display varies depending on what region you're in). Key features: 🖼️ 5 Unique artworks 👤 Hundreds of invisible people to find 💡 ∞ Unlimited hints if you get stuck ♻️ Hide a small number of hidden people so you can find them again! 🎵 Music and ambiance for each artwork ⌨️ Use your keyboard to move/zoom in if you have no scroll wheel 💾 5x save slots 🗑️ Reset progress entirely and play again 🕒 Timer included to show how long you took to complete each level Context: The brief was simple. I commissioned artists to create a fantasy world, and hide as many invisible people as they can inside it. Now it’s your job to find them all! With 5 art pieces to choose from, you will have a lot of searching to do. Controls: Use your mouse to move around the image and zoom in / out. When you find a hidden person, click and they will appear. You can also use WASD to move and the arrow keys to zoom. Difficulty: A full range of difficulty is included, but all levels start unlocked, your progress is saved as you play, and you can use hints if you get stuck. Get immersed: Each painting has its own music and ambiance to help you connect with the world, as you search for everyone. Replayable You can restore a small number of invisible people back into a painting so you can find them again! It’s much harder when there are only a few invisible people left (especially randomly). You can also use up to 5 save slots so you can replay without progress loss. Alternatively, you can reset your progress for the entire game if you’d like to start over.

rows.name: Void Whispers
rows.short_description: Assume the role of a broadcast engineer in a tranquil city. All seems peaceful until the sky above starts to reveal something deeply unsettling.
rows.description_html: What if the reason for our universe being so vast and yet so silent is darker than we think? What if we are destined to perish, hunted by an ancient civilization that destroys every new life that thrives and attempts to reach out to the cosmos? In Void Whispers you play as Mike, a newcomer to Cosmo City working as a broadcast engineer. Your task is to master the use of radio equipment to broadcast the latest news to the town folks, all while mysterious events unfold in the sky. Key features: 30 to 40 minutes of gameplay 3 different endings to discover Work as a broadcast engineer, learning how to operate all the machines, interact with the public, play some old music, and more. Intriguing narrative Immersive sound design A true horror experience Aliens (but not the gray one)

rows.name: Devils Wind Mine
rows.short_description: Devil's Wind Mine is a game where you play as an engineer controlling the pumps, seeking to save the son of a desperate mother. You are the decider of this story. It is your duty, as an engineer, to save as many miners as possible, or just one; the devil waits to be fed inside these passages.
rows.description_html: The Devil's Wind Mine is an indie minigame where you play an engineer from the mine's pump control room, seeking to save the son of a desperate mother. You are the decider of this story, inspired by Baldomero Lillo's tale. In 1904, the Lota coal mine in Chile captured the attention of the country's miners. Because food was scarce, and their needs were increasing, entire families sacrificed their lives inside the mine. In this game, you have a second chance at redemption, by twisting the fate of those who passed. It is your duty, as an engineer, to save as many miners as possible, or just one; the devil waits to be fed inside these passages. Features Radar, pumps, electricity; all that to let you decide the miners fate Four different scenarios to play and re-play to save them all The full short story of “El Chiflón del Diablo” shown through telegrams Baldomero Lillo portrayed the atrocities of the mine, telling stories that came from inside the earth's core. “El Chiflón del Diablo” narrates life and death stained with coal, a mother's love and hope, exploitation, and collapses.

rows.name: Geisterbahnhof
rows.short_description: Geisterbahnhof promises to deliver a chilling adventure, where every step into the unknown could be your last. Are you brave enough to face the darkness?
rows.description_html: What is it that defines the dreams that truly terrify us and then haunt us long after waking up? Is it a situation we cannot escape? Perhaps it is being surrounded by a place that is isolated and alienating? Could it be the feeling of being exposed to something or someone that seeks inflict unimaginable torments on us? One example that captures all of this is the place you will be taken to, should you choose to accept this challenge. As the player you will take on the role of an unsuspecting commuter taking the subway who gets side-tracked from their mundane activity and wanders into a part of the system that has been abandoned. However, this is no accident, this is a place to which you have been lured, the Geisterbahnhof, or ghost station. Your task is to survive and escape, but in order to do so you will need to move carefully through the endless tunnels evading your pursuer and seeking out the items that you will depend upon for your escape. Even so, the items alone will not be enough, you will also need to employ your memory and all your concentration and of course you will need to keep your nerve. Features: Player is immersed in continuous atmospheric tension, interrupted by jump scares from a pursuer who can strike at any time. The player must begin solving puzzles that utilize the subway’s dilapidated infrastructure to provide clues. They then must harness their memory to navigate their way to freedom. Replayable- the station maps are procedurally generated in a number of different styles varying the experience with each play Geisterbahnhof promises to deliver a chilling adventure, where every step into the unknown could be your last. Are you brave enough to face the darkness?

rows.name: Mokoko X: The First Date
rows.short_description: Nostalgic arcade gameplay remastered! Conquer the bigger portion of the screen and save the unlucky girls from the various absurd troublemakers.
rows.description_html: Buy Now About the Game Mokoko X: The First Date features the first chapter of Mokoko X for free! Gameplay The main goal is conquering the bigger portion of the screen. While you are in your own area, you are safe from the enemies until your shield depletes. You conquer new areas by drawing out of your area. Drawing, however, deactivates your shield and exposes you to danger. Your shield decreases constantly. If you do not conquer at a certain frequency, your shield will burn out and you will not be safe on your own areas as well. There are 3 difficulties in the game. The difficulty affects enemies, your shield, and the required conquered area percentage for the victory.

rows.name: Bud Masters - Peace Edition
rows.short_description: Bud Masters - 'Peace Edition' is a fun, easy to pick up nostalgic weed lifestyle card game. Free from deck building or any additional complexities, 'Peace Edition' is a casual, chill, yet challenging card game with no additional accounts, no micro-transactions or in game purchases required.
rows.description_html: WHAT IS THE PEACE EDITION? Bud Masters - 'Peace Edition' is the free 'NO DECK BUILDING' edition of my somewhat nostalgic indie weed lifestyle deck building card game. It is for casual card game players who like fun card games and weed, without the complexities and time that it takes for 'Building Decks' Draw cards, and play your cards to deplete your opponent's bud bowl while defending your own bud bowl. The Bud Masters - 'Peace Edition' is a easy to pick up and play card game with all cards included. All other unlocks are earned through playing the game. There are no in-game purchases or micro-transactions of any kind. Choose to play against a stoned (yet surprisingly adept AI), or engage in PvP with a (probably) stoned human opponent.... No additional developer or publisher game accounts or sign ups required. The core game on Steam is all you need to find / connect / play with your pals. I hope you enjoy my first card game as a game designer / solo-developer. Do let me know if you have fun!

rows.name: Animal Shelter 2: Prologue
rows.short_description: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of Animal Shelter 2: Prologue! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!
rows.description_html: Animal Shelter 2: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Our four-legged friends need your help! Animal Shelter Simulator 2: Prologue comes with more animals that need your help. You will need to provide them with a clean, safe environment, as well as food and water and, most importantly, lots of love. Thankfully, you won’t be alone this time! Grow your shelter with new employees! Managing a whole shelter by yourself is a tough job! Good thing you’ve got the help of skilled workers that can take on some of the responsibilities. Remember – managing people is not easy either! Play with your friends in co-op! Everything is always more fun with friends! Invite your friends to work on your shelter and find the perfect homes for your animals together! Emote, interact and have fun, all the while being surrounded by beautiful scenery and cute animals. Help animals find their forever homes! The adoption process requires a lot of patience. It is important to pick the correct pet for the right person, and vice versa! In Animal Shelter Simulator 2: Prologue, the potential adopters will be able to visit the shelter and see the pets for themselves before they make up their mind about them. Remember that a lot of things can impact the chance of an adoption: the animal’s traits, their current state, and even the state of the shelter itself! Maintain the shelter and enjoy its beauty! Your shelter is located in a picturesque little town surrounded by the forest and mountains. Make sure that it fits right in among the beautiful scenery – keep it clean and upgrade its features regularly! Enjoy the view of it both during the day and at night! Meet your new furry friends Pet them, play with them, even dress them up! The Animal Shelter is back and its residents are full of life and always eager to interact with you. Make sure that all their needs are met and that they are healthy, and they will repay you with lots of love!

It leads him to a saloon in a near-deserted ghost town, where the remaining patrons offer opportunities to bring this gunslinger to justice. But along the way, it becomes less clear who the real outlaw is... Features: A quick 15-minute snack of a game Drenched in spaghetti-western atmosphere Dark humorous tone Hand-drawn 2D characters Navigate quirky dialogues and shoot pesky locks Multiple ways to achieve your goal Full keyboard and controller support Cast: Dylan Nagel as the Coyote Antonio Mena as the Desperado​ Aimee Smith as Eleonor Sean Chiplock as the Bartender Edwyn Tiong as the Mysterious Stranger

rows.name: SoundKilla
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of Caribbean sound clash culture with SoundKilla. In this dynamic multiplayer experience, you and your crew will battle for sonic supremacy in the ultimate test of rhythm, strategy, and style.
rows.description_html: 🏝️ SoundKilla: RUN DI PLACE Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of Caribbean sound clash culture with SoundKilla . In this dynamic multiplayer experience, you and your crew will battle for sonic supremacy in the ultimate test of rhythm, strategy, and style.​ 🎮 Game Overview RUN DI PLACE is the heart-pounding multiplayer control mode where two teams compete to dominate the dancehall. Capture and hold key zones, unleash powerful dubplates, and outmaneuver your rivals in fast-paced matches that demand both coordination and creativity.​ 🌍 Key Features Dynamic Multiplayer Battles : Engage in matches where teamwork and timing are crucial to control. Authentic Caribbean Vibes : Experience a vibrant world inspired by the rich traditions of Caribbean music and culture, from bustling urban streets to serene island landscapes.​ Customizable Sound Systems : (COMING SOON) and upgrade your own sound system, tailoring your setup to match your playstyle and dominate the competition.​ Strategic Gameplay : (COMING SOON) Utilize unique abilities and power-ups to gain an edge over your opponents, turning the tide of battle in your favor.​ Immersive Story Mode : (COMING SOON) Embark on a compelling journey to help your mother save your family home, collecting rare dubplates and facing formidable bosses along the way.​  🎧 Join the SoundKilla Community Whether you're a seasoned selector or new to the scene, SoundKilla offers an exhilarating blend of music, competition, and culture. Step into the arena, rally your crew, and prove you've got what it takes to RUN DI PLACE.

rows.name: Shrineflow
rows.short_description: Shrineflow is a multiplayer (1 vs 1) hide-and-seek game between a Kitsune and a Ninja. The Kitsune uses her magical abilities to track down her opponent. The Ninja uses his stealth skills to stay undetected while he collects enough to coins to break into the treasure trove.
rows.description_html: Enter the Yokai Realm Shrineflow is a multiplayer (1 vs 1) hide-and-seek game between a powerful Kitsune and a stealthy Ninja in a Japanese-inspired Yokai arena. The Kitsune uses her magical abilities to interact with the arena and track down her opponent. The Ninja uses his stealth skills and trickery to stay undetected while searching the arena for golden coins that will grant him access to the Kitsune’s treasure trove. No round is like any other, as both characters have multiple abilities to choose from at the start of each game. Will you storm through your realm as the Kitsune, determined to catch the intruder? Or will you evade and outwit a stronger opponent like the Ninja? Enter the arena and outplay your friends in Shrineflow! A Student Team A student team pitched, planned, and developed this project as a capstone (thesis) project at the BYU Center for Animation. This game was accomplished from start to finish in a single year, and we’re incredibly proud of our work. However, please keep in mind this project was completed quickly by students, and you will probably encounter bugs and other hiccups because of this. Most of our amazing team members are moving on to jobs or other coursework, meaning any updates after release are very unlikely. We appreciate your understanding, look forward to your feedback, and hope you enjoy experiencing the world we’ve created.

A Student Team A student team pitched, planned, and developed this project as a capstone (thesis) project at the BYU Center for Animation. This game was accomplished from start to finish in a single year, and we’re incredibly proud of our work. However, please keep in mind this project was completed quickly by students, and you will probably encounter bugs and other hiccups because of this. Most of our amazing team members are moving on to jobs or other coursework, meaning any updates after release are very unlikely. We appreciate your understanding, look forward to your feedback, and hope you enjoy experiencing the world we’ve created.

rows.name: Turmoil
rows.short_description: Turmoil is a 3D isometric top-down action roguelike game. Inspired by a dieselpunk aesthetic, navigate a winding factory space filled with environmental hazards and hostile robot workers with the goal of survival. Rise from the ashes! Show the boss that a worker is more than their mechanical parts.
rows.description_html: A 3D isometric top-down dieselpunk-inspired, roguelike game. The world of Turmoil is set in an alternate history where humans developed machines that run on oil to automate society. Eventually, machines began making more machines to boost productivity while safety was disregarded. As the last human left in the esteemed factory of Geargrave Automations, Harry suffers a life-threatening injury to the only thing keeping him a valuable asset to the company. Now, with an injured mechanical arm leaking oil, sitting in the trash, Harry realizes he won't survive unless he fights. He must rise from the ashes, learning how to survive with nothing but his leaking arm and a general knowledge of mechanics. His goal is to avenge the humans who were disposed of in the past by defeating the boss, Kornelius Rayburn Geargrave, and shutting down the factory. Geargrave only values efficiency, output, and profit, so when hearing of Harry's retaliation, all robots are set to go hostile when in the presence of deviant employees. Navigate through three different procedurally generated levels of the factory, fighting hostile robots for survival, collecting their oil to continue forward as there is no choice but to persist. Collect blueprints and scrap around the factory to upgrade Harry's mechanical arm. Collect oil canisters to keep him alive and utilize the hazardous environment to defeat attacking robots. Rise from the ashes! Show the boss that a worker is more than their mechanical parts.

rows.name: Hidden Arcade: Hundreds of Ghosts!
rows.short_description: Find and free the hidden Ghosts spread throughout distinct Arcade Game Worlds, and create your own ones!
rows.description_html: How did you get here? After befriending your first Ghost in the abandoned Arcade Hall, he asks you to retrieve any Ghosts that are trapped inside the Arcade Games! What do you do now? In order to retrieve the first 100 pieces, you must dive into the world of the Arcade Game Drama Llama and find every last fragment to free every soul. And if you feel up to it, you can dive into 2 distinct Arcade Game experiences and retrieve the last 200 Ghosts trapped in them. What then? You can compete against the whole world in global leaderboards by finding the 100 Ghosts exceedingly quicker! And after that? You can create your own levels or download user-created ones, including their own leaderboards! (Level Editor DLC sold separately for 0.99$. I would like to keep the entire game free, but I sadly have to make back thhe 100$ Steam Fee and get funny stuff like tax advisers that keep me out of jail.) Why would you do all that just to click Ghosts? Because it is just so much fun! Seriously. It is also cozy and relaxing. But most of all, every pop you hear from finding a Ghost releases a bit more dopamine. Thank you for reading this and have a great day! :)

rows.name: Invasion of the Mushroom Men of Planet Y!
rows.short_description: This is a quick, goofy game that lasts about ten minutes per play through-unless you choose wrongly-organ music, please! In addition to your choices, there is also the random element of chance that may affect your fate. Due to the constraints of the game engine, can only be viewed in windows mode.
rows.description_html: You've led a normal life-until this morning, that is! You wake up to discover the world is under attack! Evil Mushroom Men from the far reaches of space have come to conquer our world! What vile plans do they have for us, pitiful mammal? It's up to you to decide how you cope with this sudden attack by alien fungi. Choose to be a hero, a villain, or just some schmuck trying to survive and not get fried. Rescue your neighbor, or leave her to her fate. Try to escape the alien onslaught, heroically seek to end the threat they pose, or turn traitor and lead the Mushroom forces to victory. Remember, mammal, the Fate of the World is in your hands! Dum dum dummm!!! Invasion of the Mushroom Men of Planet Y! is a goofy, light hearted visual novel. In addition to making choices to decide where the story goes, a few key choices are dependent on a random luck factor (these points are heavily hinted at in the text).

rows.name: Ubermensch
rows.short_description: First-person mod of the Unreal Engine Lyra starter project
rows.description_html: Multiplayer notes You can host & join listen servers when launching the game using option 1 -- this will open a popup in your default browser to link your Epic Games account. If you launch with option 2 to play offline against bots only, be sure to also change the in-game network setting to 'offline' at the map selection screen. About the Game Movement: • Dash: press a directional key + [shift] by default • Boost: while moving forward and aiming up, press the dash key • Slide: press [ctrl] by default Weapons: • Luger: starting in slot 1, accurate hipfire and no damage dropoff • Gewehr 43: starting in slot 2, high damage with shorter maximum range • StG 44: placed around each of the maps Maps: • Envy: capture 2 of the monuments within each of the 3 main temples to win points • Will to Power: TDM, control the pickups in the central building • Eternal Recurrence: TDM with health in nooks along edges of the map

rows.name: Go! Go! Hamster Chef!
rows.short_description: Help Hamster Chef cook yummy dishes and deliver them to his animal pals in this short, colorful, and definitely-not-spooky adventure.
rows.description_html: All of Hamster Chef’s friends are hungry! Only YOU can satisfy their craving. In Go! Go! Hamster Chef! you take the role of Hamster Chef, a plucky young entrepreneur who’s out to make and deliver food to all the animals in the village. Find ingredients, cook dishes, and deliver them to your hungry friends! It’s completely innocent! Your village overflows with the bounty of nature! Fresh ingredients are yours for the taking. Just pop them into your cheek pouches and take them home to your kitchen. I don’t think you’ll ever run out of yummy ingredients to find! Take, take, take, Hamster Chef! Your kitchen is the envy of the town! Use your state-of-the-art appliances and transform your ingredients into dishes that are sure to make your friends’ mouths water! Get the recipe right, Hamster Chef! You’d better not make any mistakes! Hop on your radical scooter and book it to your friends’ homes. You have hungry mouths to feed! Stay on the roads for maximum speed. You’d better not wander off if you know what’s good for you, Hamster Chef! Go! Go! Hamster Chef! was created for an N64-style game jam in just 45 days. Since then, it’s been streamed and recorded by over 300 content creators and gathered over 5 million views! For this Steam release, we’ve rolled out a number of fixes and improvements and also created brand new end-game content! Now’s your chance to experience the definitive version of Go! Go! Hamster Chef!

rows.name: 攻城与召唤 Siege and Summons 【5分钟一局 策略竞技 】
rows.short_description: Siege and Summon is an online turn-based competitive card game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Players can use soldier cards and skill cards to build a deck of cards to challenge powerful players in the world of the tk. NPCs can also fight against other players and form teams to challenge dungeons.
rows.description_html: Siege and Summon is an online turn-based competitive card game set in the Three Kingdoms era. Players can use soldier cards and skill cards to build a deck of cards to challenge powerful players in the world of the Three Kingdoms. NPCs can also fight against other players and form teams to challenge dungeons. Game features ◆ Card deck: Players can use soldier cards and skill cards to build their own deck for battle. Soldier cards are divided into: ordinary, elite, and hero. Two ordinary cards can be put into battle; other cards can be put into battle one. The deck can contain up to 30 cards, which can include soldier cards and skill cards. ◆How to play: Players use their respective decks to fight on a 3*10 field. The enemy and we take turns taking action until the opponent's general or our general is defeated. ◆ Profession: Players can freely choose among 4 professions: Swordsman, Dharma Lord, Taoist Saint, and Divine Arrow; each deck can only use the same profession card. ◆ Push pictures: After building a deck, players can engage in push battles to fight against NPC decks with their own characteristics; push pictures to obtain protagonist experience, copper coins and various treasure chests; and only push pictures can obtain advanced professional cards. ◆Competition: After the arena is opened, you can compete with other players, and it is endless fun to fight with others; the arena is settled quarterly, and each quarter is based on the player's points ranking. The top players can get the soldier card that will be launched next season. ◆ Team formation: After the team dungeon is opened, you can form a team with other players to challenge high-difficulty dungeons; the dungeons are divided into three difficulty levels: simple, normal, and difficult. The higher the difficulty, the greater the benefits.

rows.name: Clue For Your Thoughts
rows.short_description: Sift through the evidence to find out who did it.
rows.description_html: In this murder mystery game, you are a detective tasked with solving the weird, strange and the weirder. Read through the general description, witness interviews, case facts, chat logs and sift through the evidence to figure out who did it. Once you've come to your conclusion, You can accuse who did it. Be careful, everyone has something to hide, but only one person did it. Leave no stone unturned, one small clue may be all you get. Investigate love triangles, discover hidden motives and question fashion decisions on your journey through 12 unique cases in Clue For Your Thoughts!

The Chits Represent Small Arms , Squads and AFVs. you have Leaders that improve units they are near to. There is terrain effects modifiers, Leader Bonuses, Armor and Anti-Armor weapons. There is a good Line of sight system and walls so you can karal enemy units to say a building. the editor is great allows you to set everything and create victory points, on the main game screen I added copy and paste of units so modules are easy to create. The big thing that shines in this game is a great A.I. and opfire. the userstuff folder you can add your own graphics for officers or tanks.

rows.name: Warfare : Battleground™
rows.short_description: Join Warfare: Battleground, an arcade multiplayer first-person shooter! Fight in a variety of modes using a large arsenal of weapons and destroy your opponents with helicopters and air strikes. Are you ready for battle?
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in a world of dynamic battles in the new indie game Warfare: Battleground. Play on exciting maps, including a variety of locations. Use a variety of weapons and unique equipment to summon reinforcements and deal devastating damage. Take part in familiar childhood modes such as Point Control or Team Battle, with support for up to 16 players. The map size will adjust for each mode accordingly, creating continuous tension. Night maps add atmosphere and necessitate the use of flashlights, however they are not available for every weapon, which will force players to not get used to one weapon. The complex shooting and weapon control mechanics will require you to have fast reaction times and extreme accuracy. Gather in co-op and destroy enemies together. Join the development of the game together with the community. Speak your ideas, participate in the community, and you will help the developers to make the game better.

rows.name: Distant
rows.short_description: Imagine yourself diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. How would you see the world? What emotions would you experience? What would your symptoms look like? Answer these questions yourself by playing in the shoes of someone with the disease, first-person.
rows.description_html: Imagine yourself diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. How would you see the world? What emotions would you experience? What would your symptoms look like? Distant aims to answer these questions by putting you in the shoes of someone with Alzheimer's disease. In this first-person 10-minute experience, you will experience some of the symptoms that those with Alzheimer's face every day. With some simple puzzles and games, you can expect to gain an understanding of: - The fears - Auditory hallucinations - and disorientation that those with Alzheimer's may suffer from. You will also gain an understanding of some of the safety precautions that one can take to ensure a safe environment for those with Alzheimer's.

rows.name: Sorcerer Smackdown
rows.short_description: In Sorcerer Smackdown, joining the fight is simple: grab a friend, choose a character, and let the match begin! Unleash both physical and magical attacks using the keyboard for commands, mixing and matching moves to craft devastating combos to prevail against your opponent!
rows.description_html: Open Alpha's premiere local 2D fighting experience tears its way into the ring! Use both muscles and magic to beat down your opponents and prove yourself as the mightiest mage in the arena! Meet the fantastic fighters: - Boodini is the spookish spectre of an unspecified magician, back from the dead to try his hand at a different kind of performance-- physical performance! Along with him is his dutiful assistant, the Metaldead, a necromatic musician always eager to hype up her now ghostly partner! This duo isn't just undying, it's post-dying, too! - Stone Cold is a frosty, frigid fighter... an ever-cold elemental... a bone-chilling brawler. This cryogenic character likes to use a cool combination of wintry wandwork and freezing fisticuffs to defeat its foes. - Lurking in the comments of nearly every online forum is a valiant keyboard warrior known throughout the interwebs as u/Grand-Magician29. Despite being a mere mortal, this basement-dweller fancies himself quite the magic aficionado (just ask the five magic-related subreddits he moderates). But whatever you do, don't insult his waifu 4 laifu, or he'll have no choice but to unsheath his (totally authentic) katana and defend her honor! - Don't let his flimsy fairy wings fool you: Rock Hard is packing! A punch, that is. His rippling muscles will intimidate any foe who dares draw near, but all he really needs is his tiny pink wand to vanquish them. When you're up against Rock Hard, you're in between him and a hard place!

rows.short_description: you just climbed out of the machine only to realize it's a lot bigger then you imagined, you meet an older gummy that seems familiar, there are enemies trying to track you down, find collectibles, use the furnaces to melt the robots and consume the gummy bear enemies.
rows.description_html: You just emerged from the depths of the colossal machine, only to find that its vastness far exceeds your wildest imagination. The metallic walls tower over you, casting long shadows that shift ominously as you explore your surroundings. As you take in the intricate machinery around you However, time is not on your side. you must act swiftly and decisively. Scattered throughout the environment are hidden collectibles that can aid you in your quest for survival. Each item you find could provide crucial advantages in your battles ahead. As you progress, the tension mounts, culminating in an epic boss fight that will determine your fate. Will you harness the knowledge from the items you’ve collected to emerge victorious, or will you fall to the relentless foe that pursues you? In this treacherous world, every choice matters, and survival is just the beginning of your journey.

rows.name: Event Horizon
rows.short_description: Event Horizon is an action-adventure sci-fi shooter with the heart of souls-like utilizing gun modification and first-person scanning to explore the unknown depths of the cosmos.
rows.description_html: An amnesiac astronaut wakes up disoriented after an unscheduled landing in an unknown location among the cosmos. Who are you? Where are you? And why are you here? Something calls, the star of the void awaits... Descend into the depths of the event horizon with the assistance of The Motherboard, an artificial intelligence that miraculously survived the crash. Regain the memories of the astronaut as you fight through the deserted Outer, the lush Inner, and the crystalized Center. Wield the state-of-the-art Nexus-BHG , or Nexus-Black Hole Gun, a powerful hunk of metal capable of harnessing and condensing a black hole's power into a single burst. When all else fails, the astronaut may upgrade their standard-issued blaster to make an attempt at rivaling the Nexus-BHG's strength. Anomalies Unidentified alien lifeforms who inhabit the dark crevices of the event horizon, varying from humanly familiar to formlessly obscure. The astronaut must find and scan these creatures to learn more about them. Are they intelligent? Why can they speak? One will watch the astronaut walk by while the other clings to the astronauts legs. These multi-classed enemies will vary in threat level and the astronaut must dispose of them as they see fit. Be warned. The Omniscanner A device attached to the astronaut’s gauntlet allows them to scan all life forms found in the event horizon and give real-time analysis of the objects scanned. All data is tracked in the Logbook, and information is secretly sent back to Earth without the astronaut knowing it. The Logbook (LOG) The Logbook, also called The LOG, is a device attached to the astronaut that is an extension of The Motherboard. This device stores and retrieves data on everything the astronaut has scanned with the Omniscanner. Additionally, it allows the astronaut to tap into the functions of The Motherboard without being directly on the spacecraft. The Logbook is programmed to send information back to The Motherboard and keep track of the astronaut's health. The Quantum Stabilizer A device that can stabilize The ███████████, and prevent it from growing or consuming nearby matter. This device is a container that has the ability to capture, manipulate and utilize quantum forces. The Tachyon Translocator A radar device that allows the astronaut to track pulses of high-frequency electromagnetic waves that are reflected off the object back to the source. The astronaut may utilize this device to to track rifts in time and space, allowing for travel between layers of the black hole through The Motherboard's systems. The ███████████ An unknown entity known to be “the center of space and time.” Local anomalies do not know much about this being other than the fact that it exists and resides deep within the layers of the event horizon. The ███████████ is also rumored to hold cosmic powers, including the ability to reverse time.

rows.name: Sector Unknown - Prologue
rows.short_description: Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free demo of the story-rich, isometric RPG Sector Unknown. Start on the desolate planet of Maku, establish a stronghold, ally with or dominate local factions, and combat a tyrannical organization set on ruthlessly exploiting the sector's resources and inhabitants.
rows.description_html: Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free introductory version of the full-game Sector Unknown . Sector Unknown - Prologue is an immersive isometric RPG that draws inspiration from classics like Fallout 2 , Knights of the Old Republic , Fallout: New Vegas , as well as more modern titles such as Wasteland 3 , Encased , Colony Ship , Trudograd , and Pathfinder: Kingmaker . Every decision, every nuance in character development has tangible consequences. Alongside combat, the game equally emphasizes alternative strategies for progression, inviting players to leverage their character's unique abilities to navigate through the narrative creatively and diplomatically. Story In Sector Unknown - Prologue , your saga begins as a prisoner aboard a transport ship from which you escape in a commandeered escape pod, crash-landing on Maku, a forsaken world veiled within a remote and uncharted region of space. This planet becomes the foundation of your odyssey as you convert it into a stronghold and base of operations. From there, you will set forth into space, exploring distinct worlds and locations, each teeming with its own factions and unique stories. In your quest, you will confront the shadowy dealings of Star Frontier, the powerful mega-corporation that once imprisoned you. Operating unchecked in the hidden 'null sector'—now absent from all official star charts—Star Frontier has established a tyrannical reign of terror and destruction. Your mission becomes to unite the sector's backwater and forsaken planets, through either force or diplomacy, and overthrow their oppressive rule once and for all. Sector Unknown - Prologue weaves themes of exploration, discovery, conflict and greed, crafting an epic tale of adventure and rebellion in the boundless expanse of space. With the Prologue version of the game, the entire first planet of Maku will be available for players. Choose Your Path In Sector Unknown - Prologue , every choice you make shapes your journey. As you traverse through null sector, your interactions with characters and factions on each planet will uniquely influence the narrative. Your decisions determine not only the outcome of each planetary story arc but also the fate of the entire sector. From forging alliances to making tough moral choices, your path is yours to define. Whether through diplomacy, strategy, or combat, your story will unfold in a way that reflects your personal play-style and decisions, culminating in a truly bespoke gaming experience where you are the architect of your destiny. Sector Unknown - Prologue is a free introductory version of the full-game Sector Unknown.

rows.name: Star-Wired
rows.short_description: Repair the circuitry of your Starship and clear out the intrusive programs in a cute and casual puzzle game. Plug in cables, activate moving objects, and dodge malicious entities on your quest for success!
rows.description_html: A Game Design Capstone Project - By DePaul University Students! After returning from a star-dust-scavenging trip, Bit, our little starling captain, finds his Ship commandeered by an intergalactic militia, the Infestors. To save his home, he ventures within the circuits of his Starship friend, to rewire damage done by the Infestors and rid the circuits of malware. PHYSICS BASED CABLE GAMEPLAY! Star-Wired is a whimsical, endearing, top-down puzzle game, with a focus on plugging in cables to power level mechanics! The cables can be pushed, tangled, pulled, wrapped around, and swung to complete circuits and open the exit door of each level. DEV TEAM Liv Baughman: art lead, environment, and 2D art Maeve Butler: 3D art and animation Brandon Ehrman: 3D art Tyler Ackerman: level design and gameplay programming Catherine Simmons: producer, social media manager Kai Langevin: lead programmer Jake Arthur: designer, prototype SOUND TEAM Beth Sawltz: sound design, music Collin Wittlich: cutscene sound effects, music

rows.name: Dwarven Realm
rows.short_description: Explore an epic fantasy medieval world where dwarves fight for survival in a hostile universe. Guide your colony of dwarves through unique challenges, tough moral choices, and unforgettable encounters. Explore, mine, build, trade to ensure the prosperity of your people.
rows.description_html: Dwarven Realm Explore an epic fantasy medieval world crafted on the Unreal Engine 5 where dwarves fight for survival in a hostile universe. In this captivating strategy/idle game , guide your colony of dwarves through unique challenges , tough moral choices, and unforgettable encounters. Explore , mine , upgrade , trade to ensure the prosperity of your people in a game where every decision matters. Are you ready to lead your own clan of dwarves? Dive into the adventure now! Gameplay In this game, with an RTS camera view, you will lead a colony of dwarves on a hostile mountain, where the survival of your clan depends on your wise choices. Extract precious resources , expand your colony , and evade the dangers of this fantastical world. With rich gameplay mechanics and strategic depth, each playthrough is a unique adventure that will test your management skills and ingenuity. Narration Dive into an immersive, choice-driven narrative where every decision shapes the destiny of your dwarf colony . In this captivating game, your leadership is put to the test as you guide your companions through an epic story. Get ready to embark on a narrative adventure where your decisions impact the world around you. Artistic Direction Dwarven Realm offers an immersive stylized 3D art direction that plunges you into the epic world of dwarves. From majestic mountain landscapes to intricate details of dwarven structures, with the assistance of Unreal Engine 5, every visual element is carefully crafted to capture players' imagination. Project Status Dwarven Realm is a student project developed from scratch in less than 3 months.

rows.name: Space Cats
rows.short_description: 'Space Cats': Zip around as a space cat dodging rockets and grabbing Catnip for double points and a trippy speed boost. A fresh, funny game with a nod to internet culture, blending challenge, humor, and nostalgia.
rows.description_html: Space Cats thrusts you into the fur of a daring space-faring feline with one simple mission: Don't. Hit. Rockets. The controls are straightforward, ensuring you'll pick up the gameplay in no time, but mastering it is a whole other story. Each session is a new adventure thanks to the procedurally generated obstacles that keep the challenge fresh and engaging. You aren't alone, however. Space cat aliens will randomly fly by. Should you collide with one, you'll get a healthy dose of Catnip. Encountering this cosmic phenomenon doubles your points but launches you into a high-speed, psychedelic state that turns the gameplay into a frenetic and visually wacky experience. It's a thrilling risk that tests your skills and reflexes to the extreme. Crafted for players who enjoy a blend of challenge, humor, and nostalgia, Space Cats draws inspiration from the quirky side of early internet culture. It's designed to be lighthearted and entertaining, perfect for those moments when you want to dive into a game that doesn't take itself too seriously but still offers a compelling gameplay experience. Whether you're aiming to crush your high score or just looking for a fun way to pass the time, Space Cats promises a delightful mix of classic gaming mechanics, modern challenges, and a good dose of early internet-era humor. Get ready to dodge, dash, and dive through the cosmos with the most adventurous cats in the galaxy!

rows.name: Glitch Maze.exe
rows.short_description: In this fast-paced arcade game, inspired by Pac-Man, you navigate through a dark maze, chasing the highest score. Avoid the lurking dangers, find secrets and game-changing power-ups as you explore the maze. And remember, even your failures can illuminate your path through the darkness.
rows.description_html: Glitch Maze.exe is a casual maze game, that draws inspiration from games like Pac-Man, while adding subtle horror elements. The game embraces the concept of using your past failures to progress: every time you die, you leave behind a small beacon of light that reveals parts of the maze and dangers lurking in it. Features Explore 18 handcrafted mazes Use your past failures to beat the maze or play cautiously Use power-ups to highlight or freeze the dangers Gather high scores to alter the dynamic on the level Find sercrets

rows.name: The Courage to be Disliked
rows.short_description: A Healing Journey to Find Yourself
rows.description_html: Depression,exhaustion ...... A young girl's life is full of pain, she doesn't understand why. One day, she came to a strange village where a sign at the entrance says: 'It is shameful to reject others.' In the village, there was no option to refuse others. The villagers each have their own unique stories and requests, some offering important insights while others needing help and understanding. She has to interact with the villagers, complete tasks and explore their stories. With such rules, how could she find a way to leave the village? What kind of insights would she gain on this journey?' In the game, you will explore a rich and colorful main map, encountering some cute but odd NPC characters, each with a unique personality. Completing their tasks not only progresses the story but also bring you unexpected rewards and revelations. In addition to interacting with the NPCs, you will also need to will also face challenges of puzzles , finding objects and battles, uncovering secrets hidden within the game world. This is a journey of inner healing exploration, hoping to convey the importance of finding courage and happiness through player experiences. Everyone will discover their own healing and revelations in this unique world because every adventure is a journey of inner growth and exploration. Are you ready to embark on your journey of the heart? This game is an older one previously made in RMXP with low resolution. The game flow takes about 40 minutes and there is only one ending. %% The game is using Arial fonts, If there is a problem displaying fonts please download Arial fonts file and put it in C:\Windows\Fonts folder. Here are some of the characters that appear in the game: The main role of the game, an ordinary girl The grumpy old lady. The talking frog. Don't kiss him. He won't turn into a prince. Cute kitten with magical powers The farmer with loud voice

rows.name: Evil Sinister
rows.short_description: You're a journalist investigating an abandoned house. Armed with only a flashlight, navigate its haunted halls to uncover its secrets. Beware, malevolent forces lurk, blurring reality and nightmare. Will you survive to reveal the truth, or become another victim of its sinister grasp?
rows.description_html: Several Episodes Join us into the abyss Evil Sinister will have several chapters , so stay informed by: And join: These smalls actions really help me a lot and you will get updates about the game release. About the Game Evil Sinister: Introduction In Evil Sinister you are an independent journalist thrust into the heart of darkness as you lead a daring investigation into an infamous abandoned house. Whispers of malevolent forces and chilling disturbances have plagued the neighboring community, beckoning you to uncover the truth behind the sinister secrets lurking within. Feel the fear Armed with only your determination and a flickering flashlight, you embark on a harrowing journey into the depths of the abandoned abode. Every creaking floorboard and ominous shadow sends a shiver down your spine as you navigate the foreboding halls, piecing together the fragmented remnants of the house's grim history. But beware, for you are not alone in your pursuit of the truth. Sinister entities and otherworldly apparitions haunt the corridors, determined to thwart your progress and drive you to the brink of madness. As you delve deeper into the darkness, the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur, and you must rely on your keen investigative skills to survive the onslaught of supernatural horrors. Find the thruth Evil Sinister is a pulse-pounding psychological horror game, that will test your courage and resilience in the face of unspeakable evil. Will you uncover the chilling secrets of the abandoned house, or will you become just another victim of its malevolent grasp? The answers lie within, waiting to be discovered by those brave enough to confront the darkness head-on.

rows.name: Speakeasy
rows.short_description: An isometric shoot 'em-up minigame set in an underground bar in 1930s Chicago. Speakeasy combines historical charm with edge-of-your-seat action for a gaming experience that’s as thrilling as it is unique.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Speakeasy,  a fast-paced 2D shoot'em up adventure set against the backdrop of 1930s Chicago. In Speakeasy, you're the last line of defense for an iconic speakeasy against a relentless mafia onslaught. They're not just any enemies; they're creditors turned attackers, determined to settle scores because of the debts you owe. Your mission? Protect your sanctuary using wit, strategy, and firepower at all costs.  As you navigate through wave after wave of enemies, Speakeasy offers a frenetic gameplay experience that captures the essence of the era with a modern, dynamic twist. It's not just a game; it's a test of resilience and quick thinking, where every shot counts, and every decision could be your last. Prepare to defend your speakeasy, outsmart the mafia, and immerse yourself in the excitement of 1930s Chicago. Speakeasy combines historical charm with edge-of-your-seat action for a gaming experience that’s as thrilling as it is unique. Controls WASD or Arrow Keys to Move Horizontally . Spacebar to Crouch . F Key (and hover mouse) to Fix Obstacles . Left Mouse Click to Shoot . Credits Ella Andersson: Sound Design, SFX Artist, Game Design and Documentation. Juan F. Gutierrez: Game Direction, Creative Direction, Programming, Sound and VFX Direction, Lead Programming, UI/UX Lead Designer, Lead Game Design, Project Management Support, and Lead Sound Design. Kasper G. Hellqvist: Game Design and Programming Associate. Ladan Roohian: Art Direction, Lead Artist, Environmental Artist, Animation Artist and Game Design. Martin Pritula: Creative Direction, Head of Production, Scrum Master, Release Manager, Marketing Manager & Artist, UI Consulting and Lead Game Design. In Speakeasy, you're the last line of defense for an iconic speakeasy against a relentless mafia onslaught. They're not just any enemies; they're creditors turned attackers, determined to settle scores because of the debts you owe. Your mission? Protect your sanctuary using wit, strategy, and firepower at all costs.  As you navigate through wave after wave of enemies, Speakeasy offers a frenetic gameplay experience that captures the essence of the era with a modern, dynamic twist. It's not just a game; it's a test of resilience and quick thinking, where every shot counts, and every decision could be your last. Prepare to defend your speakeasy, outsmart the mafia, and immerse yourself in the excitement of 1930s Chicago. Speakeasy combines historical charm with edge-of-your-seat action for a gaming experience that’s as thrilling as it is unique. Controls WASD or Arrow Keys to Move Horizontally . Spacebar to Crouch . F Key (and hover mouse) to Fix Obstacles . Left Mouse Click to Shoot . Credits Ella Andersson: Sound Design, SFX Artist, Game Design and Documentation. Juan F. Gutierrez: Game Direction, Creative Direction, Programming, Sound and VFX Direction, Lead Programming, UI/UX Lead Designer, Lead Game Design, Project Management Support, and Lead Sound Design. Kasper G. Hellqvist: Game Design and Programming Associate. Ladan Roohian: Art Direction, Lead Artist, Environmental Artist, Animation Artist and Game Design. Martin Pritula: Creative Direction, Head of Production, Scrum Master, Release Manager, Marketing Manager & Artist, UI Consulting and Lead Game Design. Vera Jeukendrup: Art Direction, Lead Character Artist, Character Animation, and Game Design. Music Used Win Screen Lose Screen

rows.name: The New Sheriff
rows.short_description: A shooter where you won't have to shoot everything, presented in black and white like classic westerns.
rows.description_html: A new sheriff, with memory problems, has arrived in town, robberies and silence are rampant; Hunt down the bandits, find their leader, protect the citizens. As the new sheriff you will have to patrol the city, find the wanted people and eliminate them, foil robberies, challenge the bosses to a duel. You can arm yourself at the emporium, receive expert care from the doctor, visit the saloon, play cards at the table with the cheaters and much more. The New Sheriff is a bullet hell western game with roguelike elements, all seasoned with a pinch of luck... Features Procedurally created city maps Procedurally created wanted faces Over 10 enemies' type with very nice AI Over 10 NPCs to interact with Different types of guns Various items, special places and surprises 1 minigame in the lounge

rows.name: Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition
rows.short_description: Builder Edition is all about using various physic game mechanics, like gravity, bouncy blocks, bombs and more to safely get the Stars to the ground floor to solve Physics-based Puzzle levels. Play the 150+ included levels and then try your hand at making your own and sharing them with the community!
rows.description_html: Gameplay Objective: Get the Star safely to the Ground Click on other Blocks to remove them or interact with them Let Gravity and Physics do its work Success! Level Editor & Online Levels: Multiple Level Sizes and Visual Styles Various fun Game Mechanics (Hazards, Bombs, Moving Platforms, Portals & More) Make fun, creative and exciting levels Upload and Share your level with others online Play levels made by others! Features: 100 Starter Levels to play - Giving you chance to learn the mechanics and have some fun. 50 of them will be remixed from the original game with 50 brand new ones made for Builder Edition. 50 Bonus Levels - Even more free levels to enjoy Level Editor: Create and share your own unique levels with friends Block Database: Play more levels online from around the world from strangers and friends Can be played locally with friend with 2 controllers for puzzle co-op solving Leaderboards Achievements Cloud Saves - Sync up your levels across devices as well as with the Main Version Want More? Check Out The Full Game! Enjoyed making custom Levels or playing the Online Levels and want more? Your custom levels you made will be synced between both games so you can pick back up where you started!

rows.name: redroom
rows.short_description: A fast-paced one-versus-one FPS where a single hit means instant death. Destroy opponents in seconds, dashing around tightly-constructed arenas with an ultra-powerful shotgun. Configure *everything* in an extensive in-game console menu. There are two colors - alive and red.
rows.description_html: redroom is a fast-paced one-versus-one fighting game where a single hit means death. Maneuver around your opponent using dashes, slams, and wall jumps in order to hit them before they can hit you. Use snappy movement abilities to outmaneuver your opponent. Duel on over 30 different procedural map arrangements. Play a variable amount of rounds or until one person gets too far ahead. Join your friends or play with randoms through an integrated server finder. Use the Menu Console to completely customize your experience. Recolor absolutely everything. Note: Some users may find the menus difficult to use as they rely on a command-line format.

rows.name: Thing & Fist
rows.short_description: Team up with a friend and play as either the artful wizard Thing or the stalwart golem Fist to pull off the heist of the century in this couch co-op top-down brawler!
rows.description_html: Thing & Fist is an isometric couch co-op brawler where two players battle their way through the city of St. Avalon as they work to pull off the heist of the century. St. Avalon is a shady city that is home to gangsterism and sorcery in equal measure, and players will need to work together if they hope to stand a chance against the nefarious baddies that lurk around every corner. As Thing, players can zap enemies from a distance using powerful bolts of lightning while keeping the hordes of goons guessing by swiftly dashing around, behind, and even through them! For those that prefer a more direct approach to trouncing foes, playing as Fist will allow players to make short work of opponents with powerful punches and a dash attack that bulldozes anything in their way. When the throngs of opponents seem like too much to handle, players can stun crowds of enemies with a powerful slam as Fist or conjure a convenient bribe as Thing to direct their attention elsewhere. Players can also support their partner in crime with their character's unique shield ability to ensure that Thing & Fist will be able to pull through each chaotic brawl they find themselves in on their quest to become filthy rich! As they make their way through the two unique levels of the game, players will find themselves going up against numerous different enemies including slime cops, gunslingers, walking cauldrons, and shadow hands; each of which has their own methods of attack that players will need to work together to outmaneuver. Starting in downtown St. Avalon, players will make their way through the city streets, break in and out of the bank, and scurry towards the escape raft with the cash!

rows.name: Giresun
rows.short_description: This is a 3rd person shooter game that you can play 1v1, 2v2, 4v4, 5v5 mods against bots.
rows.description_html: This is a 3rd person shooter game created with Unreal Engine 5 There is Elimination mode and Control mode in game that you can play 1v1, 2v2, 4v4, 5v5 versions. In Elimination mode, you are defeating enemy and when a team reach enough points, wins. In Control mode, there will be 3 areas, you can capture an area and defend it. If you control 2 or more areas, you will start to collect points and when a team reach enough points, wins. This is not an online multiplayer game. You are playing against bots. It is a free game and there is no marketplace in it. In 2024 we are planning to add new maps like Giresun Island and Giresun Castle and much more maps with new mods. Have Fun !

rows.name: Dreadrun
rows.short_description: DreadRun is a top-down bullet hell with roguelike elements. Where you must explore and gather various forms of loot  such as guns, potions, and perks in a limited period of time in order to evade and shoot  hordes of various enemies  while escorting a payload to safety.
rows.description_html: In DreadRun, the game kicks off with the Exploration Phase, where you explore the island , gathering valuable items to gear up for what’s ahead. This phase sets the stage for the Payload Phase, the bullet hell action of the game, where you face a fast-paced, action-packed challenge, navigating through a horde of bullets, while trying to escort a payload till the end, to emerge victorious. In the Exploration Phase of DreadRun, your goal is to quickly gather a variety of potions, superior weapon, and upgrades before time runs out. Your adventure leads you through numerous randomly located rooms on a vast island, with each session presenting new rooms and loot. The upgrades you come across are random each time, making every game a distinct and exciting challenge. Utilize every second as efficiently as possible so that you will be prepared for what's ahead After gearing up in the Exploration Phase, the Payload Phase of DreadRun is where the intense bullet hell action unfolds. In this phase, you’re challenged with fighting off a swarm of enemies and simultaneously escorting the payload to its end goal. As you advance, you’ll encounter various enemy types that will try to block your path and make your mission tougher. It’s a thrilling test of your combat skills and strategy as you push through to the end. The Team This game is a college project made in less than 3 months by a team of passionate 6 developers, Avinash Prabhu, Somno, Hassan Abusalih, Dev Trivedi, Armaan Takyar and Armaan Sheikh

rows.name: Cursedville
rows.short_description: A party game for 4-10 players. Play as a peasant or werewolf, cooperate with your friends and survive or hunt before all the nights are over.
rows.description_html: Cursedville is a party game that can be played between 4-10 people with two roles. Try to co-operate with other players with positional voice chat. Werewolves hunt peasants at night, while peasants try to survive the night and collect gold. The werewolf is the villain of the game. The werewolf can transform into wolf form at any time during the night. The werewolf's goal is to hunt down all the villagers before the blood moon ends. The peasants are the innocent role of the game. Peasants must try to survive until the bloody moon ends. They can earn gold by killing monsters that appear on the map at night. With gold they can buy new and more powerful items from merchants in the morning and fight against werewolves. Features Day Cycle: The game has 3 day states, each with different features Night: Werewolves can transform. Creatures appear in their territory. Morning: Werewolves can't leave human form. Merchants are activated. Creatures do not spawn. Bloody Moon: Werewolf can't leave wolf form. Creatures do not spawn. Creatures: There are two types of creatures in the game. These creatures can harm peasants. Gold or items can be earned by killing creatures. It has a spawn and attack area depending on the creature type. Skeleton: Drops a small amount of gold. Deals a small amount of damage. Does not drop items. Golem: Drops a good amount of gold. Deals a large amount of damage and throws the player he hit. It drops the lightning potion, the most powerful potion in the game. Lightning potion can only be obtained this way. Merchants: Weapons and potions can be purchased from merchants using gold. Merchants are only open in the morning. These items have various properties and tactics can be created with different combinations.

rows.name: Deepest World
rows.short_description: Deepest World is a coding sandbox MMORPG where you can automate your character with JavaScript. Explore a 3D open world, hunt monsters, gather resources, craft deep builds and items, acquire programming skills, grind 24/7.
rows.description_html: Deepest World is a coding sandbox MMORPG where you can write your character's AI with JavaScript. Explore a 3D open world, hunt monsters, gather resources, craft deep builds and items, acquire programming skills, grind 24/7. The main goal is to program a bot that plays the game for you. To do so, we provide you with a client-side web API which exposes data objects that represent your surroundings, API call functions to communicate with the server, and some utility functions. Early Access The game is still in the relatively early stages of development, and many features are being designed, implemented, and tested. As such, you may encounter bugs, unfinished content, or changes to gameplay mechanics. Your feedback and bug reports are always welcome and greatly appreciated. Thank you for your understanding and support as the game continues to be improved. Feature Overview Scripting with Deepest World JavaScript API A non-instanced procedurally generated 3D open world A single server that can support hundreds of concurrent players Procedurally generated skills and gear Single and group PVE Crafting, farming and gathering professions Uncapped levels Missions

rows.name: Hidden Among Thieves
rows.short_description: Gather loot and hide from other players.
rows.description_html: The game is free to play with no in-app purchases. It is a social multiplayer shooter/strategy game, but can be played offline. It can be played with a gamepad or keyboard . keyboard: Space bar to use gun, mouse to aim & shoot. AWSD or arrows to move. mouse: Touch gun or player for gun. Touch arrows to move. gamepad: - (a) for gun. analog stick to move. (x) or (y) for items. The main objective is to gather more loot than other players while avoiding detection. GREED and RAGE may get you more loot but make you stand out. CAUTION and STRATEGY will help you defeat your opponents. Each round becomes progressively longer and unveils more tantalizing secrets to help you gain an edge over opponents. Your actions dictate your worth to other players. Try to find all the different colored diamonds.

rows.name: Idle Hero TD - Tower Defense
rows.short_description: Endless idle tower defense game full of deep strategy and combat mechanics. Unlock and upgrade dozens of epic fantasy heroes to defeat an infinite swarm of enemy monsters. Strategize hero positions, synergies, and skills for an effective defense, then sit back and let the auto-battler do its thing!
rows.description_html: WEEKLY UPDATES WITH TONS OF NEW CONTENT ON THE WAY! If you're a fan of classic old-school tower defense strategy games or endless idle games where you deal impossibly large numbers of damage, then you will LOVE  Idle Hero TD ! Discover a fantasy world of epic heroes, monsters, and magic! Command a team of heroes to defend your base, and stop the evil creatures from capturing the tower! Although Idle Hero TD is an idle game that can mostly play itself (which is perfect for casual players without much time), it was also designed to be extremely strategic and rewarding for those who play actively and efficiently. The most powerful bonuses in the game revolve around optimizing the placements of your Heroes to activate their synergies and special abilities. A lot of planning and puzzle-solving is required to achieve the ideal build for your personal play style! This is an endless idle game, so if you enjoy grinding and watching numbers go up from big to impossibly huge - this is the game for you. IDLE TD GAMEPLAY Featuring non-stop, idle, and endless gameplay! Destroy endless swarms of evil monsters to bolster power, speed, and other stats - and the more monsters you obliterate, the more heroes you’ll unlock. Face off against Ultra Bosses such as the Ancient Shadow and Exotic Alien for the most powerful rewards. DOZENS OF UNIQUE HEROES Unlock 48 unique heroes, all of which have different skill sets that make tower synergy crucial to success. Determining the most effective combination of their skills and synergies will keep you entertained and speculating for weeks! Discovering new unique heroes is part of the fun. CONQUER MULTIPLE MAPS Unlock and complete several different maps, each with different perks and requiring different strategies to defend. Find the one that suits your current goals best, and conquer its challenges! COUNTLESS UPGRADES Collect various resources to unlock literally millions of upgrades, such as Research, Spells, Technology, Runes, and more! CROSS-PLAY & CROSS-PLATFORM Idle Hero TD fully supports cross-play and cross-platform functionality. Start the game on your PC, then load it up on your mobile device to continue your progress while out of the house. Compete against millions of others from around the world on Windows, Mac, Android, or iPhone! FEATURES: Easy to pick up and play - no previous experience is required! Idle offline resource gains and progress while the game is closed! Weekly PvP tournaments give this casual game a competitive edge. Complete numerous daily missions, achievements, and challenges. Cross-play and cross-platform support. Fantasy RPG-based world and classes. Fun, cute, and colorful artwork. Idle Hero TD is the perfect blend of the Idle and Tower Defense genres. The game is endless and can mostly play itself without much effort from you. However, an immense amount of strategy is required to play efficiently and place well against your peers on the leaderboards. Go on an epic never-ending quest, explore a fantastic world, battle heroes and monsters, and defeat epic bosses in Idle Hero TD!

rows.name: Rent A Car Simulator 24: Prologue
rows.short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers.
rows.description_html: This Prologue is a limited version of the full game to stop waiting and jump into running your Rent A Car Bussiness already. Don't forget to wishlist the full game version to continue your most fun Rent A Car experience. In Rent A Car Simulator 24, you start your car rental business by renting a single car and build a fleet of dozens of luxury cars. Each car will bring you daily income. Modify and repair cars to earn more. Buy new cars and grow your car rental business. You can drive your cars and speed up the road with them. Prologue Version Main Features: Renting your cars to customers and tracking their rental status. Buy new cars and grow your car rental business. Earn income by selling your cars. You can repair cars. You have a living map. There are in-game characters around with whom you can engage in dialogue.

rows.name: Yokai Rescue
rows.short_description: Ascend through a futuristic tower in this fast-paced action platformer. Use your Yokai abilities to move swiftly in the air and pierce through your enemies to defeat them. You are the last Yokai capable of saving your people and liberating your homeland from the Selvo robot control.
rows.description_html: Yokai Rescue is a short but intense experience where your reflexes are put to the challenge. Drag yourself into the air with your magical Yokai powers to ascend through the various levels of the tower. But beware, the Selvos are everywhere and will try to stop you. Your master has been captured along with other Yokais and you must rescue them. Master your powers Attach your energy rope onto rings and even enemies to drag yourself up and move in the air. Use your dash to evade attacks and adjust your trajectory with precise timing. Eliminate the Selvos with a single swift pierce to make your way up. Various environnement As you progress upward, you will reach new levels of the tower with each one having its own environment and challenges. Discover new enemies, obstacles and mechanics and test your mastery of the controller. Fast-paced combat You will encounter various enemies with very different behaviour and patterns. Learn how to evade their attacks, how to defeat them and survive during intense battles. A little story Uncover the story behind the invasion of the Selvos as you encounter new characters along the way.
