rows.name: Clash for Crust
rows.short_description: Clash for Crust is a 2-4 Player local multiplayer party brawler. Customize and take control of a Crazy Gull and fight using your Seagull Attacks and Power-Ups to grab the Golden Crust and to battle for the honor of becoming Top Gull.
rows.description_html: Gather around, Gather around! The Crusty Carnival is in town! Bringing with it lots of food and fun and the Crazy Gulls are here to indulge to their hearts content! Round up your friends for a 4-player local multiplayer brawl to see who among will receive the honor of Top Gull! Style your Gull These gulls are not only crazy, but they also possess a keen eye for fashion! Enter the pre-fight lobby and Style your gull with different Skins and Hats, with Skin options ranging from a dapper tuxedo to a vibrant rainbow plumage, and a variety of Hats including a bottle cap, cowboy hat, and a golden crown there are countless ways to customize your gull! Feeding Frenzy Crazy Gulls love to eat! Eating food and increasing their Calorie Count is the greatest measure of success for these gulls, and those who attain the highest Calorie count will be crowned Top Gull. Players will fight over the most Delicious and Calorie rich food item is the Golden Crust, and make use of other food items to help them in their clash, make use of special items such as burning your opponents with a spicy chill pepper or regurgitating a powerful rolling donut can help you stun gulls and clear a path to the Golden Crust. These Gulls got moves! Why use your power ups when you can just eat them up! Players can choose to swallow their food items to give them a boost in calories and fill their Shot Meter, when full your Gull can shoot out their “Shot” to create a puddle that slows and damages, in addition to the Shot, Players can also use Seagull Spin for AOE damage and Seagull Smash to dash their way to the Golden Crust stunning any Gull in their path. Multiple Maps Take your clash to one of three specialized maps, all of which include randomized obstacle placements, each with their own twist! The Crusty Carnival including a roller coaster with drop the Screw Shield powerup, The Beachside Boardwalk with a rising tide concentrates the battle to a small area, and Pirate Peak with crashing waves that sway the boat back and forth. Auspicious Awards Need extra Calories to secure your victory? Or perhaps your performance wasn’t up to snuff and you’re looking for a comeback! The awards ceremony has you covered, at the end of the game players will be granted up to 3 awards depending on how they played, from Manure Marksman to the Pity Party, these awards all award Calories which can turn the tides of victory!

rows.name: Seaside Racing
rows.short_description: Drive down a mountain with your friends in this chaotic cult classic kart racer!
rows.description_html: Experience the thrill of driving a soapbox car down a mountain in this chaotic cult classic kart racer, accidentally knocking your competitors into the sea or getting lost in green fields without as much as a road sign to help you find your way. Actual features Physics-based multiplayer kart racing! Up to 12 players over the Internet or local network 1-4 local players split screen (online or offline) Share-a-gamepad option for up to 4 players using 2 game pads Questionable features 3 large seaside maps (no more, no less) Randomly generated avatars (you can switch but not choose) Possible to get lost (the game doesn't even know where to go) Unpredictable respawn logic (that makes it possible to reach tricky places) No placement indicator Cult classic This is a remastered version of the original Seaside Racing that was released on Xbox Live Indie Games in 2010. The original game has a cult following among at least one group of friends in Indiana, USA, since its original release on Xbox Live Indie Games in 2010. Since publishing this, I’ve also been notified that there is a cult following in High Wycombe, England, UK in addition to the aforementioned cult following in the USA.

rows.name: Arcane Raiders
rows.short_description: Team up with your wizard friends to pillage the magic tower! Create elemental synergies, defeat powerful bosses and claim the tower's treasure in this rogue-like dungeon-raider.
rows.description_html: Wizards from across the land journey to the Arcane Tower in hopes of claiming its bounty. Do you and your mates have what it takes to reach the top? Arcane Raiders is a rogue-like dungeon-raider where you blast enemies with spells and maneuver through traps to pillage the Tower of its treasure. Tight dodging controls and powerful elemental synergies will help you in your quest to take down the Tower's fearsome bosses and make it out with as much gold as possible. Features Fast-paced dodge-and-strike combat Create powerful elemental synergies to decimate foes Face of against dangerous traps, enemies and bosses Randomized rooms and spell drops keeps each run fresh and exciting Local and online multiplayer to team up with friends

rows.name: Apocalypse Slave x Warlord
rows.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic setting where zombies, raiders, and military fascists have taken over, you can either take the role of a warlord or a slave and roleplay surviving. Depending on the route you choose, you'll have different goals and objectives.
rows.description_html: In a post-apocalyptic setting where zombies, raiders, and military fascists have taken over, you can either take the role of a warlord or a slave and roleplay surviving. Depending on the route you choose, you'll have different goals and objectives. As a slave, you'll do various labor for your mistresses as well as converse with other slaves and the guards keeping watch over you. Different groups will want different things that may impact your survival. Making deals and helping one group will have consequences that you need to take into account. Nothing is free, and even as a slave, you will need to buy food as well as manage your health and stress in any way you can, even if it means buying drugs. Your mistresses may also deign to play with you to relieve your stress in a more physical way, but this may affect your pride, which is another stat you have to maintain to prevent your character from losing his sense of self. As a warlord, you'll likewise be maintaining stats, but they take the form of things like manpower, income, authority, and settlement happiness. You'll need to maintain these stats to stay in power as well as to wage war against the other warlords that will want to take you out. Take prisoners, make them submit and work for you, as you seek to take over the entire city.

rows.name: Early Mellow
rows.short_description: A short walking sim game where after a car crash you wander into strange lands. Chop some cactus and turn an old mill into a concert hall. That's your life now.
rows.description_html: Early Mellow is an experimental puzzle-adventure game. You can walk, use an axe, pick up a radio and blast drum 'n' bass in an abandoned mill. It's short but it's made with love !

rows.name: Nine Realms Prologue
rows.short_description: Rule the god of thunder and challenge all the gods of the nine realms! In this Rogue-like, hack and slash game, develop your strategy and skills, subject all the gods who challenge you to your wrath, and become the only god of the universe.
rows.description_html: WHISLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game DESTROY ALL THE GODS! The body of the thunder god has been taken over by the most cunning god of the universe. Find the gods hidden in different realms and destroy them all until you are the only god left standing! YOU'RE THE VERY RAGNAROK ITSELF There's no hero's tale here. On the contrary, you will be the nightmare of heroes! Develop your strategy and unleash the cosmic calamity. EVERY DEFEAT IS A NEW BEGINNING Giving up is not in the nature of the thunder god. Each time you are defeated, warp time and start over with what you've gained. Embark on your next journey more experienced and powerful. CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER TO FIT YOUR STRATEGY Various weapons, armors, abilities, allies, and more have been specifically designed for you to develop your own strategy. Choose what suits you best and develop it permanently. You are free to choose whatever you want before you start fighting. REALMS, CHARACTERS, AND CREATURES TO DISCOVER With dynamic and voiced dialogues, realms offering different experiences and challenges, a vast bestiary, and dozens of characters you will get to know, Nine Realms presents a new universe and a deep story that tackles Norse Mythology in a different reality, waiting for you to discover. FATE BOWS BEFORE THE INEVITABLE Enjoy being the thunder god with detailed leveling and development systems, an immersive story, and realistic graphic quality! Remember, there are no rules here, you are here only to destroy.

rows.name: BalloonBreaker
rows.short_description: Welcome to Balloon Breaker, the addictive and exhilarating game that will keep you entertained for hours! Your mission is simple but challenging: inflate and pop as many balloons as possible using your trusty mouse. Enjoy your balloons!!!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Balloon Breaker, the addictive and exhilarating game that will keep you entertained for hours! Your mission is simple but challenging: inflate and pop as many balloons as possible using your trusty mouse. But be warned, this isn't your ordinary balloon-popping game. In Balloon Breaker, the more balloons you pop, the higher your score climbs! And if you're a true balloon-popping master, you can aim for special achievements, such as popping a certain number of balloons or popping within a specific time limit. Enjoy your balloons!!!

rows.name: Trash Pandamonium
rows.short_description: Get ready for Trash Pandamonium: the ultimate couch co-op party game! Control colorful raccoons, beat the trash out of opponents, and dominate dynamic maps full of hazards. Customize your raccoon, gather your crew, and prepare for pandamonium!
rows.description_html: Get ready to unleash the ultimate trash-tossing mayhem in Trash Pandamonium , the wild and fun couch co-op party game that turns garbage collection into an all-out brawl! Take control of 1 of 4 raccoons to beat the garbage out of your opponents, boost your stats, and compete in a high-stakes minigame gauntlet across unique and dynamic levels. With these interactive maps packed with environmental hazards and events, every match is uncharted territory! Customize your raccoon with all sorts of goofy hats and accessories to suit your style. Trash Pandamonium is pure chaotic fun. Simple controls make it a blast for players of any skill level, but mastering the deeper strategies will give you what it takes to come out on top of the trash heap! Whether you're gaming with your friends on the couch, or trying to dethrone rivals on Steam, get ready for an endlessly entertaining night of mayhem, laughs, and probably some spilled soda. The party doesn't start until the trash starts flying! Grab your controllers, gather your crew, and prepare for pandamonium! Features: - Couch Co-op Chaos: Enjoy hilarious multiplayer battles with friends in a local couch co-op setting. - Dynamic Maps: Navigate through interactive environments filled with hazards and surprises. - Mini-Game Gauntlet: Compete in a series of high-stakes mini-games for ultimate trash-tossing supremacy. - Customization Options: Personalize your colorful raccoons with a variety of fun hats and accessories. - Competitive Leaderboards: Climb the ranks and compete against friends and players locally to see who is the best Trash Panda. - Environmental Events: Experience random events and challenges that keep each match fresh and exciting. - Easy to Learn, Hard to Master: Simple controls make it accessible to all skill levels, but mastering the game requires strategy and skill. - Endless Fun: With countless ways to play and endless laughter, Trash Pandamonium promises non-stop entertainment for players of all ages. Trash Pandamonium was developed by students in the Division of Games at the University of Utah

rows.name: Ivorfall
rows.short_description: Ivorfall City is in danger and only you have what it takes to save it! Ivorfall is a Steampunk, roguelike, twin-stick shooter where you take up the mantle of Detective Flintlock who must face off against hordes of enemies in destructible environments.
rows.description_html: Ivorfall City is in danger and its up to you to risk it all to save it! Ivorfall is a steampunk, roguelike, twin-stick shooter where you play as the mysterious and capable Detective Flintlock tasked with taking out hordes of enemies to save Ivorfall city! Fight enemies, modify one of the three gun types in the game to discover a dozen ways to clear through the evil Raven's thugs. Move from level to level collecting weapon mods, spend money in the market on health upgrades, combat items, and weapon mods, and blast your way through boxes, crates, walls, and bank vaults in your quest to uncover the truth. Gameplay Features: -Weapon modifications allow for 12 distinct styles of play -Destructible environments allow players to take on combat challenges in unique ways -Environmental hazards such as traps put the player on the move -Variety of gameplay options and varying rarity in weapon mods add to replay-ability Ivorfall is produced by Inquiry Games LLC, a student game studio from the University of Utah Games program's class of 2024. We hope you enjoy Ivorfall, and that you will support us on our development journey! Play with Keyboard and Mouse or Xbox Controller!

rows.name: Five Nights at Silver Pine
rows.short_description: Fight for your life as the creature tries to turn you into their next meal.
rows.description_html: 'Five Nights at Silver Pine' is a fan made take of 'Five Nights at Freddy's'. Make sure you use your resources sparingly in order to survive. rows.short_description: Players take turns in a race against the clock, utilising an array of spells to defeat their opponents in battle! Victory is accomplished by becoming the 'last man standing' (or last team) after all other players have been reduced to zero hitpoints.
rows.description_html: Arcanists is a thrilling competitive + casual, multiplayer, turn-based, artillery game. Players take turns in a race against the clock, utilizing an array of spells to defeat their opponents in battle! Victory is accomplished by becoming the 'last man standing' (or last team) after all other players have been reduced to zero hitpoints. ------------------------------------- 100+ Achievements to Earn Achievements are given for completing certain challenges in Arcanists and unlock special awards such as new outfits to use within Character Creation. These award Orb Points and Orb Coins, some of which are needed for the Prestige requirements (see below re. Prestige). While some achievements are very easy to get, others are very difficult and could take several weeks to execute as one waits for the right circumstances to occur within the game! ------------------------------------- Character Creation Customise your very own Arcanist character, with over 100,000 costume combinations to choose from! ------------------------------------- Spell Selection Choose from a vast selection of 150+ extraordinary spells to bring in multiplayer battle! - There are a total of 15 uniquely themed spellbooks, each containing 12 magical spells. - Selecting all spells from one spellbook unlocks a 'Familiar' effect enabling use of a special ability/extra spells. - You're limited to just 16 spells in your book... so choose wisely and be sure to read the descriptions...! Map Environments Select one of 16 unique map arenas on which to battle and vanquish your opponents! Beware! Most maps have a powerful 'Armageddon' effect which initiates after a 10-turn countdown... ...Gradually destroying the map terrain, making it difficult for you to escape its destructive wrath! ------------------------------------- Gameplay Special Features Choose from a wide range of game options and decide how you want to play! - 24 Player Battles: Play with up to 24 players online in epic free for all's or team games! More players = crazier gameplay! - Play either Casual or Competitively: Play casual games in unranked with up to 24 players, or climb the rankings ladder in Ranked battles and climb the ladder to Rank #1! - Random Spells Mode: Unsure which spells to use? No problem! All players' spells become randomised by the game. RNG will decide your fate now! - Save your Custom Outfits & Spellbooks: As your game data is stored locally on your PC, you can save your costumes and spellbooks locally. Choose one of the presets in-game using a quick select menu! - On-Demand Gameplay Replay: Save replay files after spectating or playing a game and watch them whenever you like, on demand. Replay files can also be shared with others, accessible via the Main Menu! - Share Spellbooks & Outfits: Show off your custom outfit designs and spellbook creations with other players in the multiplayer lobby. - Design and Create Tutorials: Our tutorial framework enables you to create custom guides to help teach others how to become an Arcanists expert! -------------------------------------

rows.name: Armored of Doom
rows.short_description: 'Armored of Doom' is a TPS game with 'tank vehicle' + 'MOBA' gameplay. You will use famous active and retired tanks to compete on the battlefield. The game combines the strategic depth of traditional tank battles with the excitement of MOBA games, bringing an unprecedented gaming experience.
rows.description_html: ' Armored Of Doom ' is a fascinating TPS game with 'tank vehicle' + 'MOBA' gameplay. A variety of tank types are available for players to choose from, including light tanks, medium tanks, heavy tanks, anti-tanks, etc. The game takes diversified strategy combinations and teamwork as its core, providing players with a real and brutal battlefield fighting experience.   Players can choose from multiple different tank types, including light tanks, medium tanks, heavy tanks, anti-tanks, etc. Each tank has its own unique characteristics and positioning. Players can choose the right tank according to their personal style and tactical needs, and build a strong team with their teammates.   Techniques and tactics The game emphasizes personal skill and tactical resourcefulness. Players need to learn to target the enemy's weaknesses and use skills and buffs appropriately to cause maximum damage. At the same time, players need to master hiding skills and formulate response strategies by analyzing the opponent's tank type and tactical intentions.   Diverse game modes: Provides multiple game modes such as single player matching and team matching battles. Whether playing alone or in a team, players can enjoy a challenging and exciting gaming experience.   Personalized development system: In-game development: Players can obtain resources during battles and use them to upgrade different attributes of tanks to adapt to the changing battlefield environment. Outside development: Unlock new accessories, choose crew members, and customize tank capabilities according to your personal style to enhance combat effectiveness.   These features together constitute the unique gaming experience of 'Armored Of Doom', aiming to provide players with a rich gaming battlefield full of strategy and skills. Follow our development: 1.Discord: 2.Telegram: 3.Twitter: @ARMORED_OF_DOOM 4. VK: 872928465 Thank you for your continued support! We value all commanders' feedback.

rows.name: Gym Manager: Prologue
rows.short_description: Gym Manager: Prologue is a free simulation game where you can build, expand and manage your own Gym. To attract more clients - invest in new equipment, keep the room clean and sabotage your competitors.
rows.description_html: Gym Manager Prologue is a game where you get to manage, build, and expand your own gym. After being fired by the gym owner, you decided to get revenge and spend all your savings on opening a new gym, with the goal of making your former boss bankrupt. The Prologue version is limited to one hour of gameplay time and fewer game mechanics. As the main mechanic of the game, you will have to manage, build, and expand your gym. You can buy new equipment, upgrade existing ones and sell supplements. You can also expand your gym by demolishing walls, buying new decorations. Meanwhile, you must protect your gym from potential danger, keep the gym clean and manage your members. Outside of managing your gym, you can engage in various activities in town, including flirting with girls, sabotaging the competition gym, partying, doing illegal business with a shady guy in the backstreet and lockpicking and stealing from the town while avoiding the police.

rows.name: Daisy Dangerous
rows.short_description: A 2D puzzle and precision platformer based on the 1989's classic, Rick Dangerous.
rows.description_html: Daisy Dangerous is a short but captivating 2D puzzle and precision platformer that immerses players in a dark, treacherous world filled with intricate challenges, strongly based on the 1989 classic, Rick Dangerous. Players will guide Daisy through a series of perilous levels that require keen environmental awareness and precise movements to navigate successfully. Players must deftly maneuver through platforms, avoiding deadly traps such as rolling boulders, spikes, and other hidden hazards that demand quick reflexes and careful planning. Daisy is equipped with a rifle and limited supplies of bombs and bullets. This scarcity forces players to conserve ammunition and utilize it only when absolutely necessary. Much of the gameplay involves using the environment to outsmart and defeat enemies. Players must lure adversaries into traps or use the terrain to their advantage to progress, adding a layer of strategic depth to the platforming challenges. The game's limited resources and hazardous environments compel players to stay alert and adapt to each new challenge, making for a thrilling and immersive gaming experience.

rows.name: Demon Core
rows.short_description: Abandon hope and delve into the core of an old nuclear power plant in this psychological survival horror experience. Trust your map and radiation detector to navigate the irradiated plant... And be forced to discover the monstrous cause of its sudden reawakening.
rows.description_html: Going Free This is a notification to let you know Demon Core will be free to play shortly. If you were planning on buying the game, you may wish to wait a few weeks and download it for free. About the Game Abandon hope and delve into the core of an old nuclear power plant in this psychological survival horror experience. You must trust your map and radiation detector to navigate the bowels of the irradiated plant... And be forced to discover the monstrous cause of its sudden reawakening. There are no waypoints. Navigating the plant's interior is up to you. Demon Core is a short and intense semi-linear horror experience, focusing on atmosphere and player skill to provide a good scare. Confined in your radiation suit, there's no parkour chase sequences - only tension and release. Areas of the plant are heavily irradiated and nuclear waste litters the corridors. Pay attention to your geiger counter and plan your route to survive. Core Design Player Skill: No waypoints, navigation and survival relies on a paper map and geiger counter. Atmosphere: Detailed visuals, immersive sound design and frightening lore make the plant come to life. Stalking Horror: Something intelligent and highly irradiated stalks the plant... combat or escape is not an option. Confront the source of the horror confined in the bowels of Gray Bay Warning The game contains intense graphic imagery, death, and frequent frightening elements.

rows.name: Along the River During the Qingming Festival
rows.short_description: What if a game were made not for profit, but purely to spread culture and art? 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival' is such a game. The author approaches it with an academic attitude to study this masterpiece, aiming to let more people appreciate the folk customs of ancient China.
rows.description_html: This is a hidden object game with historical and cultural interpretations, attempting to carefully and seriously investigate and verify the intriguing stories expressed in 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival'. The main gameplay currently involves finding 352 objects or characters in the painting. Each item comes with annotations explaining its function and situation in the painting. Many objects and customs shown in the ancient painting no longer exist today and can only be guessed and inferred from existing books and experience. Naturally, there are some unsolved mysteries worth discussing and debating. Therefore, the game includes some unverified conjectures that may not align with mainstream views and are the author's personal interpretations, provided for reference only. 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival' mainly showcases the ships, bridges, houses, marketplaces, festive activities, and cultural customs of the Northern Song Dynasty. The details are so vivid it's as if the social landscape of that time was captured by a camera. On that wooden bridge with no pillars, whose manufacturing technique has long been lost, a crowd surges, with nearly a hundred merchants, officials, sailors, fishermen, and passersby filling the space. The streets are full of shops, signboards, and vendors, including fortune tellers, storytellers, bicycle repairmen, medicine sellers, doctors, barbers, touts, porters, sedan chair bearers, and gamblers - people from all walks of life. In terms of ships, it meticulously depicts the ship structure, detachable raise-and-lower stern rudder technology, anchor chain assembly, decoration styles of passenger and cargo ships, types of goods transported, and details of people's lives on boats such as cooking, worshiping, doing laundry, rowing, punting, sightseeing, and resting. Let's journey with Mr. Zhang Zeduan through the urban life of the Northern Song Dynasty 1100 years ago.

rows.name: Astrometica: Prologue
rows.short_description: Astrometica: Prologue is the free game about surviving in space. You need to use your skills and tools to stay alive. There are many challenges to face, and you need to fight to survive. You also need to build a new base in space.
rows.description_html: SURVIVE IN SPACE Dive into Astrometica Prologue, a free space survival adventure where you're tested against the cosmos's harshest environments. This prologue offers a taste of our full game, featuring innovative systems for battery management, vehicle operation, crafting, and research to enrich your gameplay. It's more than survival; it's about strategy, adaptation, and exploration in the vast unknown—now accessible for free. Welcome to your cosmic playground and battlefield. Embark on this journey and conquer the mysteries of space. 🌠COLLECT USEFUL RAW MATERIALS: In Astrometica Prologue, the cosmos is rich with resources waiting to be discovered. You'll venture into the vast recesses of space and abandoned bases to collect dozens of raw materials, each integral to your survival and progression. Elevate your resource gathering with advanced technology: deploy drills to bore into the heart of asteroids and set up automatic miners, sophisticated machines designed to autonomously extract raw materials. This intricate system of resource collection not only fuels your journey but also immerses you in the role of a space pioneer, strategizing the best ways to utilize these assets for survival, crafting, and beyond. Embark on this adventure, where the wealth of the cosmos is yours to claim—all in the free prologue of Astrometica. ⚙️ CRAFTING AND TOOLS: In Astrometica Prologue, crafting is at the core of survival and exploration. With the resources you gather from the depths of space, you have the power to craft essential tools for your journey. From drills that penetrate asteroid cores, to lasers that cut through the unknown, and base builders that allow you to establish your own corner in the cosmos—each tool is vital for survival. But it doesn’t stop there; modifications are available to enhance every tool’s efficiency and adaptability to the challenges you face. Moreover, your survival kit can be expanded with crafted items crucial for enduring the harsh space environment. Shield modules to protect against cosmic hazards, oxygen tanks for extended ventures, and a jetpack to navigate the zero-gravity realms with ease. Each crafted item is designed to boost your capabilities—whether it’s speeding across asteroid fields, bolstering your defenses against unforeseen dangers, or expanding your carry capacity to hoard more resources. Astrometica Prologue invites you to leverage these crafting opportunities to tailor your survival strategy. Strengthen your arsenal, optimize your gear, and ensure your survival in the sprawling universe of Astrometica. Your ingenuity and resourcefulness are your best allies in this grand space adventure. 🏗️ BASE BUILDING: Base building in Astrometica Prologue transcends mere survival—it's about creating a stronghold that reflects your strategic prowess and innovative spirit. Even in this free version, you are empowered to establish a robust base that serves not just as a shelter, but as your operations center against the backdrop of space's infinite challenges. Living quarters are just the beginning. Here, you can rest, plan your next moves, and safeguard your collected resources. Energy is a critical aspect of survival, and Astrometica Prologue allows you to harness the power of the cosmos through solar panels. These installations ensure your base remains operational, powering everything from life-support systems to research labs. A vehicle station adds another layer of depth to your base, serving as a hub for crafting, upgrading, and deploying vehicles essential for exploration and resource collection. It's not just about building a base; it's about creating a foundation for expansion, exploration, and domination of the cosmic frontier. In Astrometica Prologue, your base is more than a sanctuary—it's a testament to your journey, growth, and resilience in the vastness of space. 🔭 SIGNAL FOLLOWING: In Astrometica Prologue, your adventure is guided by the pursuit of signals and the exploration of enigmatic territories. Within this free version, two primary types of signals beckon you into the unknown, each promising new discoveries and challenges. These signals might lead you to resource-rich asteroids, abandoned outposts, or reveal new mysteries to unravel within the cosmic expanse. 🚀 SPACE SHIPS: In Astrometica Prologue, you'll have access to two types of spacecraft, each designed to enhance your exploration and survival in space. First, the fast space bike: sleek, agile, and perfect for quick reconnaissance or darting between asteroids and mysterious islands where gravity binds you to the surface. It's your go-to for speed and efficiency. The second is a more advanced ship, a versatile vessel equipped not only for travel but survival. It serves as a mobile base of sorts, providing a crucial source of oxygen and basic protection against the harshness of space. This ship is ideal for longer voyages, offering safety and sustenance as you delve deeper into the unknown of Astrometica Prologue. Your space survival odyssey is about to commence. The cosmos await you in Astrometica: Prologue - are you ready to venture into the unknown? 🚀

With the resources you gather from the depths of space, you have the power to craft essential tools for your journey. From drills that penetrate asteroid cores, to lasers that cut through the unknown, and base builders that allow you to establish your own corner in the cosmos—each tool is vital for survival. But it doesn’t stop there; modifications are available to enhance every tool’s efficiency and adaptability to the challenges you face. Moreover, your survival kit can be expanded with crafted items crucial for enduring the harsh space environment. Shield modules to protect against cosmic hazards, oxygen tanks for extended ventures, and a jetpack to navigate the zero-gravity realms with ease. Each crafted item is designed to boost your capabilities—whether it’s speeding across asteroid fields, bolstering your defenses against unforeseen dangers, or expanding your carry capacity to hoard more resources. Astrometica Prologue invites you to leverage these crafting opportunities to tailor your survival strategy. Strengthen your arsenal, optimize your gear, and ensure your survival in the sprawling universe of Astrometica. Your ingenuity and resourcefulness are your best allies in this grand space adventure. 🏗️ BASE BUILDING: Base building in Astrometica Prologue transcends mere survival—it's about creating a stronghold that reflects your strategic prowess and innovative spirit. Even in this free version, you are empowered to establish a robust base that serves not just as a shelter, but as your operations center against the backdrop of space's infinite challenges. Living quarters are just the beginning. Here, you can rest, plan your next moves, and safeguard your collected resources. Energy is a critical aspect of survival, and Astrometica Prologue allows you to harness the power of the cosmos through solar panels. These installations ensure your base remains operational, powering everything from life-support systems to research labs. A vehicle station adds another layer of depth to your base, serving as a hub for crafting, upgrading, and deploying vehicles essential for exploration and resource collection. It's not just about building a base; it's about creating a foundation for expansion, exploration, and domination of the cosmic frontier. In Astrometica Prologue, your base is more than a sanctuary—it's a testament to your journey, growth, and resilience in the vastness of space. 🔭 SIGNAL FOLLOWING: In Astrometica Prologue, your adventure is guided by the pursuit of signals and the exploration of enigmatic territories. Within this free version, two primary types of signals beckon you into the unknown, each promising new discoveries and challenges. These signals might lead you to resource-rich asteroids, abandoned outposts, or reveal new mysteries to unravel within the cosmic expanse. 🚀 SPACE SHIPS: In Astrometica Prologue, you'll have access to two types of spacecraft, each designed to enhance your exploration and survival in space. First, the fast space bike: sleek, agile, and perfect for quick reconnaissance or darting between asteroids and mysterious islands where gravity binds you to the surface. It's your go-to for speed and efficiency. The second is a more advanced ship, a versatile vessel equipped not only for travel but survival. It serves as a mobile base of sorts, providing a crucial source of oxygen and basic protection against the harshness of space. This ship is ideal for longer voyages, offering safety and sustenance as you delve deeper into the unknown of Astrometica Prologue. Your space survival odyssey is about to commence. The cosmos await you in Astrometica: Prologue - are you ready to venture into the unknown? 🚀

rows.name: Earth~Quack
rows.short_description: Journey your way through environments both peaceful and harsh, seeking to save the lost ducklings as you fend off wild beasts angered by constant disturbances. Exploit local ecosystems to craft means of protection as you seek to stop the source of the fabled 'Earth~Quacks'
rows.description_html: Earth~Quack is an adventure focused game with some survival elements where you play as a young boy on a mission to save a group of lost little ducklings and return them to their worried mother. As you journey through these lands you will encounter many things that will both help and hinder you in your quest to save the ducklings: Exploiting the Environment - As you travel you will need to harvest materials from the local environment in order to craft many tools that will aid you in your journey, ranging from hard hitting baseball bats, to long range sling-shots, to fancy flying boomerangs. Utilize Earth~Quack's inventory and crafting system to make tools both simple and complex. Furthermore, local flora can also be a bounty for many delicacies that may prove fruitful in tight situations. However, be careful, as it is not only you that might find these foods to be quite delicious. Fending off Wild Beasts - With your newfound tools, you will be able to face harder and harder foes. It may be simple at first with squirrels and bees being quite easy to fend off; however, as you progress you will encounter more and more difficult beasts. This may range from dangerous encounters with venomous snakes in the scorching sands of the desert to fending off ferocious alligators in the moss filled waters of the swamp, both of which may need stronger equipment to fend off. Save the Ecosystem - Your journey ultimately culminates in a final encounter with the mighty Mountain Goat, who resides at the tallest peak of the nearby mountain range, constantly ramming into the mountainside causing vicious earthquakes, or 'Earth~Quacks' as the locals refer to them, in the lands below. These constant disturbances spark fear and anger into the animals of the local ecosystems. Time and time again they are uprooted from their homes, taking out their frustration on the nearest thing to them. Your journey now becomes not only one of saving some little ducklings, but saving entire ecosystems.

rows.name: Scurri
rows.short_description: Scurri is an action-adventure indie game in which you play as a young squirrel who is searching for the means in which to save your family from certain peril, while you avoid peril yourself from the hunters that hide in the darkness around you!
rows.description_html: Careful! You are a small squirrel lost in the woods in the dead of winter. While searching for your missing family you spot them on a small island, trapped. You need to rescue them! You must now search your environment for five keys in the snow, all while avoiding the very hunters that captured your parents before they freeze to death in the cold. This is a small 2D puzzle game in which you are a small squirrel exploring a dimly lit and dreary environment in order to find five keys so that you can save your family from impending peril, all while avoiding the overwhelming hunters which trapped you parents originally. Key Features In this game you’ll: Explore an actively hostile environment. Search for several keys lost in the snow. Avoid the hunters and see as they slowly starve in the snow without their access to food Watch as the environment degrades with each collected key. Save your family from the desperate hunters! Thank You! Scurridaes is composed of a small group of developers who imagined, designed, and built this game in the span of twelve weeks, all while learning the basics of game design, scripting, and programming as university freshmen.

rows.name: Custom Party
rows.short_description: Custom Party is a free indie party-game. Players can use different powers (dash, explosion...) and have different stats based on their character customization. It introduces an innovative ranking system named «Take a Risk». The game allows everybody to play in the playstyle they want.
rows.description_html: Custom Party, the free indie online party game based on customization ! Custom Party is a party game for 2 to 8 players online . It contains a unique customization system and lots of mini-games to play ! Which makes this game a great experience to play with friends or even in competition! All elements of customization for your character are essential ! Choose your hats, shoes, tops, and colors wisely! All items affect your playstyle by changing stats or even powers ! Combined with the fact that it is a multiplayer game, this gives each playthrough a unique experience ! All hats, tops, bottoms and colors will not be paid for, all items are completely free. We are introducing an innovative new ranking system called « Take A Risk ! » ! It works by choosing a number of Ranking Points that you must stake in each game you play ! So this gives players who feel underranked a chance to face higher ranked players by taking a risk ! Additionally, it encourages cautious players to bet less, and slowly but surely progress to new ranks ! Everyone can play however they want !

rows.name: Day at the Office - Prologue
rows.short_description: Try to escape from the office, make your decisions carefully, and keep your cool to get home safe and sound... Do you hear that...? The phone is ringing, and it's for you.
rows.description_html: Roadmap Next Fest and Next Steps [Feedback Survey Open!] Next Fest has started and several people are already trying out the Day at the Office Prologue demo. I'm currently working on fixing bugs and adding the remaining content in preparation for releasing the full game on Halloween (at which point the Demo will no longer be available). Improvements I'm working on: Full controller support. Voice actors. Bug fixes (Graphics and gameplay issues such as dead ends). Design changes to some confusing puzzles. General UI improvements. Ending/Content expansion + 'Good' ending. Achievements. Just in case I'm leaving something out or just to take into account your opinion as players, I've created a short survey so that, if you have 5 minutes to spare, you can help me improve. Survey link available in the 'Discussions' section: Thanks to everyone who is trying out Day at the Office Prologue! Roadmap ABOUT THE FUTURE OF DAY AT THE OFFICE Scheduled for release on October, 'Day at the Office - Prologue' will offer an initial experience of the game in a Free to Play format. This is a free introduction to the series, future titles and content will be paid. About the Game 'Work is good for your health! Or so they say, right?' SYNOPSIS You wake up in the middle of the office, but... you shouldn't be there anymore. Try to escape from a maze of rooms that will test your wits while you answer the phone to a malicious entity that knows a lot about you. You don't have time to waste... the phone is already ringing. SURVIVE You will have to endure the stress in the office, but don't worry, you'll have some tools to help you: Anxiolytic Meds Gun Lighter 'Not too many resources, right? They wouldn't pay so much if it were easy...' FIGHT OR FLIGHT 'Does making decisions under pressure stress you out? That wasn't in your resume...' The sound of the phone won't be your only enemy. Facing horrors or running from them when possible is an important decision. Think fast and act, but remember... bullets are limited. DO YOUR JOB... OR NOT Each time you answer a call, the entity will try to learn more about what you think about your past, or perhaps test you. The only rule at work is to answer with a simple 'Yes' or 'No.' Picking up the phone or not, and the answer you give if you dare to answer, will change your fate within the office. INVESTIGATE 'I hope you're not one of those who takes sick leave over any little problem... Death doesn't mean the end.' The situations you face may have multiple solutions. Try different options, think again about that call, or thoroughly investigate the places you find, and who knows... maybe little by little you'll find a way to cheat your fate at work.

rows.name: Culling of Normality
rows.short_description: 'A very short psychological horror Visual novel. My first ever game made for a gamejam.'
rows.description_html: This game is a psychological horror VN set on a rural farm in middle-America. It is very short, taking only 15-20 minutes to read through once. It was made for the farmjam2024, and panic horror jam over the course of a month by a single person (myself). The theme of the game is really simple: What do you do when your memory seems to be unreliable, and not line up with what you can see in front of you?

rows.reviews_html: “I love how you crafted a story that can be so ambiguously interpreted. It really leaves it up to the viewer paint their own narrative with the context clues laid out in the story!” Itchio “This was a really nice read. I didn't know what to expect from it, but after getting what I think was all the endings it came full circle.” itchio “Wow, fantastic art! Makes me want to leave my job, pull a Stardew Valley, and move to the countryside right away. :) Of course, the peaceful opening tone makes... the twist that much more radical and gripping. I am ambivalent about the choice to speak about the player character in the third person. Most games would say 'I' or 'you.' Saying 'The Farmer' puts a little distance between the player and the player character.” itchio

rows.name: IKEV
rows.short_description: IKEV is a furniture assembling simulator in VR where the main antagonist is a lack of manuals! Be creative and resourceful, work through the incorrectly delivered orders, and stay diligent in furnishing your apartment.
rows.description_html: Lost your mind stamping a stool? Failed to understand the manual? Had to move back to your parents after these setbacks? Not anymore! IKEV is a simulator kindly designed to prepare you for the challenges of moving into your new home. Step into the 'Training Void', a virtual space where your modern apartment awaits, and encounter various tasks that mimic real-life moving scenarios. From dealing with incomplete orders to having no manuals, every aspect of the moving process is meticulously recreated to provide an immersive learning experience! Your assigned audio assistant will be your trusty guide throughout the simulation. Whether you need advice on organizing your belongings or assistance with troubleshooting definitely not purposefully created problems, your assistant is there to provide advice, encouragement, and even the occasional dose of... tough love? Ready to master the art of moving? Prepare yourself for the ultimate test in IKEV! Features Four fully interactable furniture pieces to build 🤩 Zero manuals to follow 🤑 Hidden extra hard puzzles to solve 🤯 Learning fake Norwegian to understand what you have to build 🇳🇴 A cute voice assistant!! 💁‍♀️

rows.name: Whispers of silence
rows.short_description: Dive into the haunting narrative of 'Whispers of silence' a first-person exploration game where every object tells a story and every note reveals a fragment of the past.
rows.description_html: Dive into the haunting narrative of 'Whispers of Silence,' a first-person exploration game where every object tells a story, and every note reveals a fragment of the past. You step into the shoes of a friend of Nolan Blackwood, guided by a cryptic invitation back to his home. With no one to greet you but the echoes of your footsteps, you engage in detailed interactions - opening doors, switching lights, inspecting objects, and reading through forgotten notes - to piece together the story of a family.

rows.name: Sunset Motel: Prologue
rows.short_description: Sunset Motel: Prologue is a free motel management game. Ensure customer satisfaction, renovate interiors, design entertainment spaces! Manage your motel in your own style and provide travelers with unforgettable experiences!
rows.description_html: Step into the enchanting embrace of the free version of Sunset Motel! A haven that caresses weary souls, and encourages travelers to pause and unwind. In this one-of-a-kind simulation experience, start on a journey to breathe life into dilapidated rooms and ensure the radiant smiles of your cherished guests. Building on Guest Satisfaction: Experience the stunning transformation of Sunset Motel's rooms! Use vibrant colors on walls, lay new tiles, and adorned with stylish furnishings for unparalleled guest comfort and blissful peace of mind. Use Your Own Creativity: Welcome to your motel! This game offers complete freedom in creating a unique space. You decide on every detail. The design of rooms, entertainment areas, and even the pool - all depends on your creativity. Take control and craft a motel that reflects only your unique visions! Manage your motel: The success of your motel is measured by the smiles of your guests. As a savvy business owner, skillfully manage your team to ensure the happiness of every customer. Let your motel shine like a star in the hospitality universe, creating a haven where satisfaction is the brightest constellation. Entertainment and Recreation Facilities: No more boredom in your motel! Craft your own vibrant entertainment spaces and a refreshing pool. Design areas where your guests can unwind, have fun and create unforgettable memories. Your motel, their playground – let the excitement begin! Create a place where your travelers are comfortable and want to return every time. At Motel Kingdom, we believe that there is a place where everyone can relax and have fun.

rows.name: Bob Fight
rows.short_description: BobFight is a hilarious party game for 2 to 4 players where you play as quirky characters in a series of chaotic mini-games. Take on your friends in uproarious challenges, earn crowns, and become the undisputed king of the party! Who will be the last Bob standing? Find out in BobFight!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Bob Fight, the hilarious combat game where you play as fearless Bobs engaging in epic battles for survival! In this wacky party game, up to 4 players can duke it out in arenas filled with traps and dangers. Face off against your friends in furious fights where anything goes! Use hilarious moves, wacky tactics, and anything you can get your hands on to eject your opponents from the arena. Whether it's throwing cream pies, jumping on unstable platforms, or engaging in bare-knuckle brawls, every round victory brings you one step closer to ultimate glory. Collect crowns by winning rounds and be the first to reach the required number of crowns to be crowned the Bob Fight champion! With colorful graphics, comedic movements, and frantic action, Bob Fight is the perfect game for wild nights with friends. Prepare for hours of hilarious chaos, laughter, and fierce competition in Bob Fight. Who among you will become the king of the Bobs? Key Features: Hilarious combat for up to 4 players: Battle your friends in whimsical arenas where anything can happen! Wacky moves: Use ludicrous fighting techniques to eject your opponents from the arena. Interactive arenas: Avoid traps and use the environment to your advantage! Crown collection: Win rounds to earn crowns and become the ultimate Bob Fight champion! Colorful graphics and comedic animation: Dive into a world full of hilarious characters and absurd situations. Join the madness of Bob Fight and show your friends who the real brawl king is!

rows.name: A Day in the Palace
rows.short_description: Travel to Poland in 1772, experience life as a servant, and solve a mystery at court!
rows.description_html: Experience a historical Polish palace A Day in the Palace is a historical visual novel where the player's choices drive the story. You play as Peter and Marysia, newly arrived siblings at the palace in Lidzbark Warminski in 1772. Here you must learn to navigate the court, perform servant duties, and finally solve a mystery regarding a missing silver spoon. Talk to the servants of the palace to get hints that let you catch the culprit. The game's backdrop and story are based on historical sources. Choose your game mode There are two different modes of play. The novel mode is a longer visual novel combined with interactive minigames. The minigames include polishing pewter, lighting a fireplace with flint and steel, and making hot chocolate in 1700s fashion. The minigame mode features a shorter story with more emphasis on the minigames and is suitable for a younger audience. Can you solve the mystery?

rows.name: Scrambled Eggs
rows.short_description: 'Why did the chicken cross the road? It didn't.' Try to stop the chicken hordes with vehicular combat. Compete for high scores against your friends.
rows.description_html: Scrambled Eggs is an action-packed chicken tower defense game, where we answer the age-old question 'Why did the chicken cross the road' . Take on the chicken hordes by sending wacky vehicles with interesting powers, to stop the clucking menace from attacking your corn crops. Some chickens you may encounter have been gifted strange abilities , that might throw a wrench in your mechanical mayhem. Collect the energy tokens that fuel your gasoline-guzzling Chariots . Place down heavy machinery to deal with the bird brains, with recharging ultimates . Fight through waves of chickens collecting cash to upgrade your capability to unleash more chicken carnage, with different vehicles, ultimate, and player upgrades to suit the best situations. Compete against your friends in our leaderboards to see who is the best at destroying these mother-cluckers .

rows.name: Steel Symphony
rows.short_description: Steel Symphony is a 2D Action-Strategy platformer where players craft combat sentinels by selecting components and balancing stats like integrity, mobility, and weapon capabilities. Chassis, weapons, and modules shape each sentinel's role with varied abilities for strategic customization.
rows.description_html: Join the community here: Inspired by JaGeX's Steel Sentinels , Steel Symphony is a 2D Action-Strategy platformer where players choose from an assortment of components to build their robot, or sentinel. The key to formidable customization is creatively balancing & optimizing statistics such as integrity, shielding, mass, weapon capabilities, modular arrange, and equipment carried. Chassis configuration, weapon loadout, and module selection constitute the essence of a sentinel: Chassis are selected archetypally dependent on class such as runner, jumper, flier, tank, colossus, etc... that are further configured to fill multiple roles. Weapons are chosen based on damage, range, rate of fire, energy dependency, area of effect, synergy with other weapons, and additional effects. Modules are delegated to give the sentinel protection, maneuverability, extra power, and/or more complex effects.

rows.name: Cosmotots
rows.short_description: A frantic third-person Team Deathmatch arena shooter. Flank your enemies using hidden teleporters, tunnels, and floating islands. First team to 30 takes the glory. Get your loadout ready, engage in intense matches, and conquer the stars!
rows.description_html: Get ready for an interstellar adventure like no other! COSMOTOTS: The ultimate third-person shooter team deathmatch. Step into the shoes of fearless toddler explorers as they face off against rival teams in thrilling arena battles. Experience stunning visuals, dynamic environments, and heart-pounding action as you immerse yourself in the whimsical yet dangerous world created by The Ministry of Cosmotots. With custom characters, diverse maps, and endless possibilities for epic showdowns, Cosmotots offers an exhilarating gaming experience that will keep you coming back for more. Arm yourself with an arsenal of futuristic weapons and gear designed specifically for our pint-sized heroes. Engage in intense multiplayer matches where teamwork and strategy are key to victory. Flank your opponents using hidden teleporters throughout the arena. Whether you're getting blasted or blasting the enemy, every match in Cosmotots is an adrenaline-fueled rush of excitement and chaos. Are you ready to join the Cosmotots and conquer the stars? Suit up, lock and load, and prepare for an adventure of astronomical proportions! rows.name: Startup Quest Bakery
rows.short_description: Embark on a brief entrepreneurial journey to establish and manage a socially responsible bakery. Obtain permits, prepare the space, choose your equipment, and produce various breads. Aim for profitability while positively impacting society and the environment.
rows.description_html: Dive into the world of social entrepreneurship with Startup Quest Bakery, a brief simulation game that challenges you to set up and run a bakery social enterprise successfully. This game serves as a dynamic introduction to startup operations, putting your strategic decision-making to the test. The Challenge You've made it to the final round of a prestigious European Union competition, contending for a grand prize by demonstrating your prowess in managing a socially responsible bakery. The ultimate test? Navigate a multi-area game simulation where your mission is to 'escape' by establishing a thriving business within 36 months. Explore dedicated rooms—Action, Knowledge, Skills, and Sustainable—to make informed decisions. Achieve profitability while making a positive social impact and minimizing environmental footprints. Getting Started Before the flour settles, you'll tackle critical steps like securing necessary permits and conducting market research to finely tune your product offerings to the community's needs. From selecting the perfect location to choosing sustainable energy options and the right bakery equipment—every decision counts. Strategic Choices Opt between essential business elements such as insurance and energy sources (like going solar). Your bakery’s success hinges on these decisions along with the selection of skilled bakers and salespersons. Their unique talents will significantly influence customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Operational Dynamics Once set up, take charge of monthly production decisions. Choose from an array of products including white bread, baguettes, whole grain bread, pretzels, and pita bread. Monitor your bakery's performance through straightforward financial reports, adjusting strategies as needed to ensure growth and sustainability. Social Entrepreneurship As a social entrepreneur, balance is key. Your role involves harmonizing economic viability with social responsibility and environmental stewardship. Embark on your Startup Quest Bakery adventure and show the world the impact a socially conscious bakery can make!

rows.name: Thorns: Police never sleeps
rows.short_description: Thorns. Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel about an alternative future. After global warming, cities were separated by a giant ocean. Our story begins in one of these cities.
rows.description_html: 'Tell me, do you sleep enough, Mr. Doe? The police never sleeps.' © Thorns: Police never sleeps is a kinetic visual novel that tells the tragic story of a young police officer. Ocean 17 is a city that makes no exceptions. It doesn't care how much money, friends or abilities you have. This is a city that is always ready to move forward towards a bright future, destroying and digesting millions of human lives in its belly. High-quality illustrations that will help you completely immerse yourself in the gloomy atmosphere of the game Sci-fi music SFX accompaniment And of course, a fascinating plot, which became the basis for creating a unique Thorns universe. We invite you to immerse yourself in the atmosphere of urbanism and cybernetic technology with the first game in the series. Duration Approximately 1.5 hours of story and 10+ backgrounds. Description of adult content 16+ Content in this product may not be appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work.

rows.name: Slime Mayhem
rows.short_description: You were created by a few scientists for a suicide mission. How long can you survive by clearing mutant slimes?
rows.description_html: Mutant Slimes, created to eat garbage waste in a mutant slime production laboratory called Slamus, got out of the control of scientists and began to eat people in the laboratory instead of garbage waste. A few scientists who managed to survive in the laboratory produced a new Slime to destroy these mutant slimes. Features You can carry 4 different weapons. Weapon types are Pistol, SMG, Shotgun, Automatic Rifle, Minigun. Destroy as many mutant slimes as you can while trying to survive waves lasting 20 to 90 seconds each. Collect chemicals to get items from the store to further survive and destroy waves of enemies.

rows.name: 3AM CORP: The Balbazar Resort
rows.short_description: Beware of Balbazar in this horror/psychological thriller adventure. Evade the enigmatic Balbazar, use your wits and homemade sleuth kit to capture proof that something ominous is happening, and make it out alive. Do not get caught. The cops aren't doing anything... perhaps there's a reason.
rows.description_html: 3AM CORP is an episodic horror/psychological thriller game series. This first episode, The Balbazar Resort , is free to play. More episodes are coming soon. Beware of Balbazar in this horror/psychological thriller adventure. Evade the enigmatic Balbazar, use your wits and homemade sleuth kit to capture proof that something ominous is happening, and make it out alive. Do not get caught. The cops aren't doing anything... perhaps there's a reason. Welcome to The Balbazar Resort! A solo mission into an abandoned, eccentric millionaire's passion project at 3am, what could possibly go wrong? Beware of Balbazar Some say he's derranged, some say he's just protecting his life's purpose and his sanity closed down with the resort. Some say he doesn't even exist. The Homemade Sleuth Kit Nothing beats a shoddy homemade sleuth kit for entering an abandoned resort at 3AM. Phanto's Polaroid Camera: Turning awkward moments into instant classics. Or for capturing evidence. Night Vision. For those who actually WANT to see in the dark. Nobody goes into an abandoned resort at 3am without a Flashlight . Even if it was borrowed from a questionable classmate years ago. And more! Keep your wits about you. ..And your eyes and ears wide open.

rows.name: Aliens and Asteroids
rows.short_description: The legendary journalist sets out to investigate an incident that occurred in a laboratory for the study of extraterrestrial technologies. But this trip is not complete without unexpected guests...
rows.description_html: Explore the laboratory complex, solve problems to move on, find secret documents and don't let the aliens catch you... Meteor shower A meteor shower that passes over the earth leads to the appearance of strange creatures. The meteorite impact sites were surveyed by employees of secret organizations and the fragments were taken to laboratories for study. Soon, workers leave one of these laboratories for unknown reasons. You are a legendary journalist who goes to this laboratory to find out where these asteroids came from and who these creatures are. Laboratory complex A secret laboratory was built deep in the forest for the purpose of studying alien technology. All the UFO debris was taken there and captured aliens were also kept there. Extraterrestrial technologies Study alien technologies located in the complex, such as lasers, teleports, bombs, to clear the way for yourself. Solve puzzles caused by laboratory accidents and try to get to the bottom of the truth... Aliens There are aliens in the laboratory and they are not at all harmless. Be careful and avoid contact with them, it will end badly.

rows.name: Hollow Survivors: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. Battle through hordes of horrific creatures as you hack and slash your way to the top of the Tower in this rogue-like dungeon crawler game. Choose from a variety of upgrades, new weapons, and save the Tower.
rows.description_html: Feature List About the Game The prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Hollow Survivors: Prologue  is a rogue-like dungeon crawler where you play as one of the few remaining sane Hollows. Slash through hordes of  horrific creatures and fight your way to the top of the Tower . Discover new weapons and upgrades, and confront the evil cult that turned you into a Hollow. FACE POWERFUL ENEMIES Unleash your fury, crush your enemies and triumph over menacing bosses that stand in your path. Nothing can stop you from achieving your goal. CHOOSE YOUR WEAPON Pick a weapon that best suits your combat style. Use a swift scythe to quickly cut down your enemies or wield a great axe to overwhelm them with power. GROW STRONGER Death is not the end in Hollow Survivors: Prologue. Utilize the souls you gather to purchase permanent upgrades from other Hollows, ensuring that you grow stronger with each run. BEFRIEND OTHER HOLLOWS Grow your relationships with other Hollows, uncover dark secrets, and rebuild the settlement. UNIQUE BUILD = UNIQUE LOOK Each soul-card you select directly influences your character's appearance . Every unique combination creates a distinct look for the player. CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER Buy cosmetic upgrades to craft a unique look for your character. From subtle tweaks to dramatic transformations, you have the freedom to customize your hero exactly how you envision. Experience an exciting action-packed adventure where your choices and skills determine your fate. Will you rise to the ultimate test ?

rows.name: Whimsical Wizardry
rows.short_description: Whimsical Wizardry is a multiplayer party game about casting spells at your friends. Turn eight maps and four game modes into a chaotic battlefield as you scramble for victory! Who will be the best worst wizard of them all?
rows.description_html: Whimsical Wizardry is a multiplayer party game about casting spells at your friends. Turn eight maps and four game modes into a chaotic battlefield as you scramble for victory! Who will be the best worst wizard of them all? Cast 20 unique spells at your friends and enemies, each with their own wacky effects! Customize your wizard before heading into battle. Whimsical Wizardry is developed by Silver Standard Studios, an independent game studio based out of Ottawa, Ontario.

rows.name: Super Hangman
rows.short_description: Super Hangman: the ultimate kids' word game! With colorful graphics and exciting challenges, it's a fun way to learn new words. Guess right, avoid the hangman, and expand your vocabulary across various topics. Let the word adventure begin!
rows.description_html: Introducing Super Hangman – the coolest hangman game made just for kids! Get ready for a super fun way to learn and play with words! In Super Hangman, kids get to go on a word-solving adventure filled with vibrant colors and awesome animations. It's like diving into a world where learning feels like a game! Guessing the secret word before the hangman appears is the name of the game. Every right guess gets you closer to victory, but watch out for those wrong ones – they add a dash of suspense to the excitement! From animals to sports, fruits to planets, Super Hangman covers tons of topics to keep the fun going. And with its easy-to-use setup, kids can jump right into the action without any hassle. Whether you're playing solo or challenging your friends, Super Hangman guarantees a blast while boosting your language skills. It's the ultimate combo of learning and entertainment! Join the adventure in Super Hangman – where words come to life and learning is always a thrill!

rows.name: Ghost For Hire
rows.short_description: Welcome to Ghost for Hire! As the newest hire for the Ghost Protection Management, your job is to drive off mortal trespassers from various protected properties. Use our state-of-the-art equipment to survey the environment, spook the intruders, and scare them into believing in the supernatural!
rows.description_html: It is a little known fact that ghosts have the option to pursue an occupation even after death. Under the Ghost Protection Management, ghosts will become agents that are tasked to maintain control over areas that are high in spiritual energy. The actions carried out by the Ghost Protection Management have not gone unnoticed by mortals, but they have been generally known as “hauntings” as mortals are not aware of the organization’s existence. After being given a contract, agents will be sent to the location they have been assigned to. Agents are tasked with surveying the personnel, progressively spooking them with efficiency, and scaring them out of the location. In accordance with company policy, agents are allocated funds to spend on gadgets to help them during missions. Step 1: Survey Surveillance and reconnaissance. You will learn the behavioral traits and weaknesses of your targets in order to think about how to deal with them, along with taking into account how to use the environment against them. Step 2: Spook Using all that you've learned from Survey, you will compile a list of abilities and use your knowledge of what to interact with in the environment in order to progressively spook your targets. Target behavior will be affected the more spooked they are and there will be numerous types of reactions. Step 3: Scare The targets believe in the supernatural and now your power is unstoppable. You can manifest yourself in front of the target causing them to run away from the protected properties in fear!

rows.name: Peter's Journey
rows.short_description: Embark on a journey of this text anime quest with RPG elements! Walk through beautiful locations, overcome challenges and make Peter’s dreams come true. Every step you take matters. And don’t forget to take the diary - you’ll need it!
rows.description_html: Peter is a young and very ambitious man. One day , he decided that he couldn’t wait any longer and had to hit the road because he had a dream! In this text-based RPG you will go on a journey and see the world through the Peter ’s eyes. You will meet other heroes, each of whom can influence the course of history. Will you rescue the beautiful stranger? Help a kind old lady? Fulfill a fellow traveler's request? It depends only on you whether Peter can overcome the challenges and fulfill his dream. Study the stories of heroes . Explore the heroes’ stories. Defeat bandits. Upgrade your characteristics. And don’t forget to take a diary: it will help you make the right choice. Our Team We are a small development studio specializing in VR and AR projects. 'Peter’s Journey' is our debut project in Steam and a new experience in creating 2D-games. The prototype of the game was developed by a studio employe while completing the task in the final of the second season of the All-Russian competition “Start the Game” in the competence of Unity Developer. The project is completely non-commercial, it is created for the purpose of gaining experience, knowledge and new emotions on pure enthusiasm. We will be very glad to receive any feedback, suggestions, criticism and comments!

Our Team We are a small development studio specializing in VR and AR projects. 'Peter’s Journey' is our debut project in Steam and a new experience in creating 2D-games. The prototype of the game was developed by a studio employe while completing the task in the final of the second season of the All-Russian competition “Start the Game” in the competence of Unity Developer. The project is completely non-commercial, it is created for the purpose of gaining experience, knowledge and new emotions on pure enthusiasm. We will be very glad to receive any feedback, suggestions, criticism and comments!

rows.name: Playing Kafka
rows.short_description: There are things that often fail on nothing but themselves. Is there even a way out? Playing Kafka is a narrative adventure full of impenetrable schemes, insidious plot twists and conversations that slip out of hand. Based on Kafka’s life and his work, developed with Kafka experts.
rows.description_html: The definitive Kafka videogame Although you did nothing wrong, you were arrested one morning. You arrived for work, but you don’t recognize your assistants. And your upbringing left you with a pervasive sense of guilt. Welcome to Playing Kafka, an adventure about the alienation of modern society as well as unresolved family issues. The game adapts three works of the famously absurdist writer and was created with leading Kafka experts. Can you manage to win an unfair trial? Is the job even real? Can you escape your father’s crushing presence? How do you move forward, when all solutions are obfuscated by a web of unclear rules and machinations… a fully voiced branching story, based on Kafka’s The Trial, The Castle and Letter To His Father atmospheric puzzles, fateful decisions and a drag and drop gameplay that makes characters and environments come alive approximately 1.5 hour of story in an ever-changing setting You face an opaque legal trial and are slowly sucked into a web of perplexing bureaucracy. It is up to you how to approach the vague, but insidious accusation – choose who to ask for help and how to talk to judges, procurators, and others as the judgment is slowly closing in on you. Does it even matter if you’re innocent? Drawing inspiration from Kafka's unsent confession to his father, this chapter delves into their tense relationship. Try to find the right words that helped Kafka come to terms with his upbringing. See Franz struggle to connect with his father in scenes from the past. Is there any hope of reconciliation? You arrive at a snow-laden village to work as a land surveyor, but you quickly find that nothing is as it seems – locals talk about the village Castle in hushed tones and each day brings more questions than answers. Will you ever be accepted by the forever out-of-reach Castle? The game was developed to commemorate the centenary of Kafka’s death and was developed in cooperation with the Goethe-Institut, Prague. ​The Chinese language version was initiated and supported by the Czech Centre Taipei.

rows.name: Ember Point
rows.short_description: Ember Point is a red-hot, combat-focused, third-person action game. Play as a disgraced defector, Gravitus, from a militaristic mega-corporation. He is stuck cleaning up the mess his former employers left behind — all while wielding a top secret “cure” for a gruesome disease.
rows.description_html: Support Ember Point requires the use of a GamePad controller. This game is compatible with computers operating on Windows systems. For the best experience, we recommend using headphones. About the Game A Combination of Melee and Shooting Experience gruesome combat against different enemy types. Switch between a heavy-hitting pickaxe and the Wave Gun to juggle the unrelenting attacks. An Over-Heated World In 2075, most humans migrated to a distant planet as Earth succumbs to the effects of The Overheating. Radiation exposure then caused a disease called Gradual Hyperthermia (GH) that slowly wiped out the remaining survivors on Earth. GH caused hallucinations, unexplained rage, hyper-strength, and emanating heat. Once it reaches its ember point, the survivors, once human, will become monstrous creatures simply waiting for its demise. Discover the Past Play as Gravitus, an ex-soldier and now researcher tasked by Katani Industry to return to Earth. His mission is to explore the possible GH cures, but he crash lands in a desolate town. Explore the ghost town, face the mutated, monster-like heat vacuums, and find out what happened to the townspeople. The Team Ember Point was a capstone game made by a group of eight undergrad students at the NYU Game Center. Bader AlQahtani Beck Mamus Carson Gilford Donovan Robinson Erna Balayan Ginele Tannis Juliana Soranno Yibing (Edith) Chen Contributors: Finn Connoly, Ryan Bevins, Hongke Luo, Peter Seo, Annie Dedas, Noa Kirschbaum, Draftsman79_

rows.name: Unfinished
rows.short_description: a game, in pixel art.
rows.description_html: a (horror style, not violent) game, in pixel art. Welcome to the world of Unfinished. It seems like a world without obstacles, without enemies, just everything as it is in reality. Or is it? Is there a chance of survival? Is there a way out? Can you unravel the secrets that symbolize this world? Or are you just alone in a world filled with monsters? Fear strengthens every monster, they know your every move! And you're just a woman trapped in a forest, longing for home! Does the path seem easy, or difficult? But are you even surprised if you die? Or are you surprised? In truth, there is no real truth about the monsters, but maybe they will be the fate of the world?! Perhaps you will be engulfed in infinite madness, or submerged?! The monsters are always ready to kill you, but you never know WhEn IT WIlL HAPPEN! You must survive every persecution that follows; surely there will be enemies (Because they are always needed, am I not right?) who will pursue you! But maybe something..., something wants to catch you. (Let's say each enemy wants to catch you). You must survive everything before the danger comes for you, you must not get too close to the monsters, for they will defeat you. Before you encounter any monster, you are at peace... (in theory) but maybe you never make it home, because that was actually your purpose. There's only one thing, there may be no way out! If you need to run, RUN! , Nothing stops survival, nothing at all. So, maybe you're not safe. But then again, maybe you are? 'Unfinished' tells a story where the monsters don't behave typically, their goals aren't ordinary either. Perhaps, in the end, you won't even uncover the secret that revolves around this game, as it forms the essence of the game's narrative. And if someone figures it out, they understand why each monster is the way it is. The main antagonist isn't just some hastily assembled entity; it's a significant monster with a twisted mind. What the monsters need is safety, peace, and human suffering. Typically, this is what people imagine when they create monsters, but for them, it's something else entirely. They don't need these things; they need their old lives back, before they became monsters. While you're trying to defeat the enemy, it won't matter who's who; you'll just be running from them. There are those who aren't hostile, and you might befriend them, but who knows if they can be trusted?

rows.name: MindMindMind
rows.short_description: A dark, psychological romance VN about a British ghost who has haunted you since childhood. When you get close to a new boy at college, he starts to get possessive, and the mind games begin! Voice acted with Live2D-style animated illustrations.
rows.description_html: 'I’ll love you no matter how messed up you are...' A man has stalked you ever since you were a child. You call him Geist. You're not sure who...or what he is, but he adores you, and he has never left your side. When you befriend a new boy at college, Geist will do anything to keep you in his grasp. Features 20k words, or around 1.5-2 hours of playtime Full voice acting for both love interests Live 2D-style animated illustrations Customizable name and pronouns for an immersive experience! One sunshine Hawaiian boy One (overly) affectionate British ghost
