rows.name: The Traveler
rows.short_description: Lost and alone in a cave, you start your adventure jumping and ducking your way through enemies and different environments. Collect coins to upgrade your player & unlock new abilities and cosmetics. Maybe then you will become the top traveler...
rows.description_html: In the Traveler, you find yourself lost and alone in a cave with what seems to be only 1 way to go. Jumping and ducking your way through enemies and exploring different environments, you can collect coins to upgrade your player and unlock new abilities & cosmetics. TRAVEL TO THE TOP OF THE LEADER-BOARDS Take a trip and try your best to travel to the top of several leader-boards like, distance, net-worth & more coming soon! GRIND FOR SOME COSMETICS! Save your coins and get your favorite cosmetics! You can stack as many on top of each other as you like so have fun! IMPROVE YOUR STATS! With an easy to access stat window you can always check how much better you are doing than everyone else in every single way possible! Tracking everything from time in game to how many jumps you have! UPGRADE YOUR PLAYER! Visit the shop and choose the way you want to play by upgrading your player stats in a variety of ways as well as getting some abilities to make your travels a little easier. MUCH MORE TO COME! Although I am the only person developing this game. I have lots of plans for updates and future content as well as new leader-boards and more to keep the game interesting. Support me and our journey making a cool game together! General Roadmap New Level Types More Dynamic Cosmetics Better rewards Recurring Challenge system More leader-boards for stats & new levels More player upgrades and abilities Power ups Background / Scene changes UI overhaul

rows.name: Owe Money Pay Money
rows.short_description: Big Chief embarks on a quest for justice & cold hard cash in this retro brawler. Packed with eye-popping pixel art, 8-bit bangers, & a Singaporean twist, it’s as bizarre as beat ‘em ups get. Welcome to Owe Money Pay Money (O$P$)!
rows.description_html: In the bustling streets of Shiokmenistan, where the scent of success once lingered, now stands Big Chief, a hoodie-clad enforcer with a score to settle. Fed up with being swindled and left high and dry by his elusive debtors, Big Chief embarks on a quest for justice... and cold hard cash! Welcome to Owe Money Pay Money (O$P$), a retro-infused brawl-fest like no other! Crafted by a plucky team of fresh-faced developers hailing from the heart of Singapore, this free-wheeling side-scroller is a love letter to pop culture, packed to the brim with puns, innuendos, and an electrifying 8-bit soundtrack that'll have your head bopping as you crack skulls. But O$P$ isn't just your run-of-the-mill beat 'em up - it's a wild ride through a world teeming with tongue-in-cheek nods to Singaporean culture and 80's nostalgia. With its eye-popping pixel art and toe-tapping chip tunes, players are thrust into a whirlwind of action as they pummel their way through barmy foes and face off against formidable bosses. Plus, with an array of wacky weapons and power-ups at their disposal, you can add a little spice to the mayhem. So grab your hoodie, dust off your fists, and join Big Chief on a quest for restitution in this offbeat adventure that's sure to leave you grinning from ear to ear. Owe Money Pay Money isn't just a game, it's cathartic! P/S: O$P$ clinched 'Best Video Game' at the inaugural Asian Academy Creative Awards for its captivating backstory and classic design.

rows.name: Myth Matrix
rows.short_description: A Turn-based strategic card battle game. Collect cards, develop your unique deck and strategy, and have a fun PvP match with players all over the world!
rows.description_html: I made this game all by myself. Yes, it is a real-time online PvP card battle game. I’ve finally managed to made it, congrats to myself 😊 Due to the love of traditional card battle games and to lower the learning curve, I adopted the very basic rules, and added lots of innovative and fun features and cards. For example, a board with slots, Terrain system, Trap mechanism, and fun keywords such as Spy, Melee, Ranged, Provoke, Thorn, etc. I’ll keep updating new and fun stuff (lots of works are planned). If you find this game enjoyable, please share with others. It’s very helpful to a real indie developer. Much obliged! If you’ve also fantasized new cards or gameplay features, you’re welcomed to share your imaginations and other feedbacks. Talk to me and find other players on discord or other SNS. (see links below) Shoutout for Komar, who’s helped me with Polish translation.

rows.name: 1306 Chapter 1: Reactors & Robots
rows.short_description: Join 1306, a little reactor maintenance robot, on a terrifying new adventure filled with robotic horrors! Get the rods. Fix the reactor. Prevent the meltdown! Most importantly, don't get disassembled.
rows.description_html: 1306 is a third-person story game where you play as a reactor maintenance bot labeled 1306, tasked with keeping the power plant from exploding. In this beginning chapter, it's up to 1306 to fix the reactor and prevent a total meltdown! However, they quickly learn that the task is more of a challenge than they initially thought... The reactor is somehow drained and missing all three coolant rods. It's up to you to retrieve the rods from the warehouse and place them in the reactor's base before it can be filled back up! Journey down to the warehouse to collect the rods! With the help of your trusty wrench, get the lights on! Keep a good balance on your way! Escape... Most importantly! Prevent the place from being wiped off the map! Good Luck, 1306! Total playtime(100% playthrough): 25-35 minutes Controls: W,A,S,D or Up, Left, Right, Down Arrow for Movement T: Equip Wrench/Battery E:  Interact with objects ​F: Flashlight Q: Objective Screen Spacebar: Skip cutscenes and dialog Numpad*: Go into freecam mode

rows.name: Knockout City - Private Server Edition
rows.short_description: Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where epic dodgeball battles settle the score in team-based multiplayer matches. Throw, catch, pass, dodge, and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance!
rows.description_html: Knockout City is now available in a Private Server Edition, inviting brawlers everywhere to keep the brawl going by hosting servers for their Crews. Team up and duke it out with rival Crews in Knockout City, where you settle the score with epic dodgeball battles. Brace yourself for outrageous fun and intense competition in an all-new take on team-based multiplayer games. Customize your character and form a Crew with friends to start your Knockout City takeover. Knock out opponents with trick shots and coordinated teamwork while dodging and catching balls flying across the map. No ball? No problem! You can literally ball up, roll into a teammate’s hands and become the ultimate weapon. A variety of outlandish ball types, locations and game modes keep it exciting. Plus, each season introduces new maps, ball types, rewards, events and challenges. Throw, catch, pass, dodge and tackle your way to dodgeball dominance. KEY FEATURES Frantic and Fun — Rule the city through lightning-fast multiplayer matches featuring mind-blowing dodgeball mechanics. Increase your attack by passing to power up dodgeballs, targeting your opponents with a variety of specialized balls or “balling up” at any time to get thrown by teammates. Crew Up — Assemble an all-star dodgeball Crew with your friends for multiplayer matches in a seamless cross-play experience. Together, knock out opponents in 3v3, 4v4 or free-for-all matches. Pass, throw and strategize as a team to dominate and unlock distinctive, Crew-only rewards. Define Your Style — Show off your status and unique look through character and Crew designs with expansive character creation options. Customize your appearance, gear and attitude — from body type and hairstyle to a custom glider and Crew vehicle to win, lose and taunt animations. Take On Knockout City — Battle it out with other Crews across dynamic maps all over the city. Each map’s special features make every match an intense, unexpected experience. Dodgeball thrives in back alleys with pneumatic tubes, on skyscraper rooftops, across busy streets and even at the local burger joint and construction sites. While you’re dodging dodgeballs, watch out for moving cars, rooftop drops, and even a wrecking ball or two. Strikingly Fresh Yet Familiar — It’s easy to pick up and play thanks to familiar controls, but practice is key to becoming a champion. On a level playing field, only the most skilled ballers stand out from the crowd. Use your knowledge to master the intricacies of the game for spectacular KOs.

KEY FEATURES Frantic and Fun — Rule the city through lightning-fast multiplayer matches featuring mind-blowing dodgeball mechanics. Increase your attack by passing to power up dodgeballs, targeting your opponents with a variety of specialized balls or “balling up” at any time to get thrown by teammates. Crew Up — Assemble an all-star dodgeball Crew with your friends for multiplayer matches in a seamless cross-play experience. Together, knock out opponents in 3v3, 4v4 or free-for-all matches. Pass, throw and strategize as a team to dominate and unlock distinctive, Crew-only rewards. Define Your Style — Show off your status and unique look through character and Crew designs with expansive character creation options. Customize your appearance, gear and attitude — from body type and hairstyle to a custom glider and Crew vehicle to win, lose and taunt animations. Take On Knockout City — Battle it out with other Crews across dynamic maps all over the city. Each map’s special features make every match an intense, unexpected experience. Dodgeball thrives in back alleys with pneumatic tubes, on skyscraper rooftops, across busy streets and even at the local burger joint and construction sites. While you’re dodging dodgeballs, watch out for moving cars, rooftop drops, and even a wrecking ball or two. Strikingly Fresh Yet Familiar — It’s easy to pick up and play thanks to familiar controls, but practice is key to becoming a champion. On a level playing field, only the most skilled ballers stand out from the crowd. Use your knowledge to master the intricacies of the game for spectacular KOs.

rows.name: Interweaver
rows.short_description: Embark on a hauntingly beautiful journey in Interweaver, a whimsical puzzle platformer. Play as the Weaver, a necromancy student on a quest to rescue familiars from the clutches of Sepultus Academia. Unravel mysteries and use magic to weave your way through captivating landscapes.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the whimsical world of Interweaver, where magic, mystery, and adorable creatures await! In this charming puzzle platformer game, players step into the shoes of the Weaver, a courageous necromancy student tasked with a final assignment that delves into the depths of darkness. Set amidst the shadowy corridors and mysterious chambers of Sepultus Academia, players will navigate through beautifully crafted isometric landscapes filled with both wonder and trepidation. As the Weaver, you possess a unique blend of magic and determination, using your powers to unravel the secrets of the world and your academy and its sinister practices. But while your fellow students seek to capture familiars through nefarious means, your compassionate nature drives you to protect these otherworldly creatures from harm. Armed with your abilities, you embark on a perilous journey to thwart the academy's malevolent intentions and free the familiars from their cruel fates. Throughout your quest, you'll encounter a myriad of puzzling challenges and obstacles that will test your wit and courage. rom navigating treacherous terrain to outsmarting cunning adversaries, every twist and turn of the journey is shrouded in mystery and excitement. Interweaver's hauntingly beautiful visuals, combined with its captivating storyline and immersive gameplay, create an unforgettable gaming experience that will send shivers down your spine. So prepare to unravel the mysteries of Sepultus Academia and embark on a journey where magic and danger intertwine in the most unexpected ways.

rows.name: WC Dream
rows.short_description: You are the KING of your own throne, capable of creating anything you desire. YOU are the KING!🏰
rows.description_html: P.S. From the developer: Hi. This game will take you back to childhood and make you the King of your imagination. You can build anything your imagination comes up with using basic items. There are no limits. I've tried to make it very simple and understandable for everyone. Enjoy the game, King. 🏰 Welcome to the exciting game 'WC Dream'✨! Here, every KING becomes a true architect of their own kingdom, where the only limitation is their imagination. You are the KING of your own throne, capable of creating anything you desire. Start by building your dream castle - a castle that embodies your wildest fantasies. Build it however you envision - the sky's the limit. Your throne will be a unique masterpiece of architecture. Create a throne that reflects your power and majesty. Sit upon it and enjoy the breathtaking view of your kingdom. Throughout the game, you will collect crowns to unlock new thrones and build anything the KING desires from basic materials. Game Features: There are 4 types of materials available: Water, Cement, Wood, Stone. Collect crowns to unlock Thrones. Explore the first level with stunning landscapes. Future Plans: Introduce new materials and shapes. Work on many new landscapes for construction: Mars, Winter, Caves, Forests, Space... Get ready for an exhilarating adventure in 'WC Dream'! Build, create, and rule your kingdom with immense satisfaction! YOU are the KING!

rows.name: THRILLKINGS
rows.short_description: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced Arena FPS with a set of weapons and movement inspired by games from the early 2000s. Compete in classic and new game modes, dominate your enemies through a variety of maps with unique traversal mechanics, and become the ultimate King.
rows.description_html: THRILLKINGS is a fast-paced arena first-person shooter, inspired by games from the early 2000s, where mastering your character's movement and controlling all available arsenal is the key to total dominance. Play on a variety of modes like classic Deathmatch and Team Deathmatch, plus new modes like King of The Thrill, where players compete to hold control of the 'Thrill', a capture point that serves also as a drivable combat vehicle and can be used and exploited as a deadly weapon. Move at full speed with classic mechanics like bunny hopping, strafe jumping, rocket jumps, and precise air control which allows total 360 ° vertical view rotation in first person. Jump and move even faster with the Impulse Rifle, which allows you to grab objects around your environment and use them as projectiles, and change trajectory in a matter of seconds. Enjoy playing competitive with friends Online, or with Local Area Network support for old school LAN parties. 8 weapons, 4 maps and 2 Thrills available on Early Access, with many more already in the pipeline and coming soon! The game is currently on Early Access with much more to come. Please join us on the development and get future updates through Steam and Discord!

rows.name: Sorelle
rows.short_description: Welcome to the magical world of Sorelle: a whimsical 3D puzzle-platformer that immerses you in the magical seaside town of Isola Chiara. Play as sisters Alessandra, Bella, and Capri as you explore the magic of sisterhood in a puzzle-solving adventure to restore magic and save the summer festival.
rows.description_html: Sorelle is a whimsical 3D puzzle-platformer that immerses you in the magical seaside town of Isola Chiara. Meet sisters Alessandra, Bella and Capri. Life in their seaside town goes astray when a violent storm destroys preparations for the annual summer festival and shatters the Duomo’s stained glass, scattering the magic of the town. The clock is ticking — the unrestrained magic seeks to return to the sea, the land, and the sky. Bestowed with fragments of this magic, the three sisters gain unique powers. Alessandra, the oldest and headstrong leader, harnesses the fluidity of the magic and gains the ability to levitate objects. Bella, the brash and brave middle sister, is granted strength to jump to new heights and break down obstacles. Capri, the curious and quiet youngest sister, is gifted with the ability to create light. The sisters realize it's up to them to save the summer festival and restore magic to the town. Swap between the three playable sisters and combine their unique powers to solve puzzles, explore the village, and strengthen the bonds of sisterhood. Includes three Charming Playable Protagonists. Dynamic puzzles that require creative use of every sisters’ power. Gorgeous and immersive Sicilian-inspired seaside scenery. A heartwarming and family-centric story. A whirling and magical original soundtrack.

In this thrilling pirate adventure, fight for your own glory, conquer islands with your alliance, embark on new adventures, and rule the seas! Step into a world where every wave holds a treasure and danger lurks around every corner. Gather your crew, customize your ship, and venture into dangerous waters in search of fortune and fame. Form alliances, join epic battles, and emerge as the most feared pirate captain of the seven seas. With stunning visuals and immersive gameplay, Atlas Online offers an unforgettable adventure for anyone brave enough to embark on the journey. rows.name: Digital Audio Wasteland
rows.short_description: In Digital Audio Wasteland, the apocalypse doesn't have to be bleak. In this comedic first person exploration game, you'll explore the wasteland, collect music from your surroundings, and mix it all together to bring bodacious beats back to the people-- all in the name of the GROOVE!
rows.description_html: In Digital Audio Wasteland, the apocalypse doesn't have to be bleak. In this comedic first person exploration game, you'll explore the wasteland, collect music from your surroundings, and mix it all together to bring bodacious beats back to the people-- all in the name of the GROOVE! As a member of the Monastic Order of the Groove, you will embark on an audacious adventure as a nameless acolyte of the GROOVE, a seeker of sonic treasures in a world on the brink. In Digital Audio Wasteland, the apocalypse isn't about survival—it's about throwing the ultimate rave amidst the ruins. Harness the power of music to reshape reality itself. Discover the hidden melodies of the world, whether they're natural harmonies or the beats you created, and wield them to craft radical tunes. These rhythms aren't just sounds—they're your companions, your tools, your ticket to revolutionizing the barren landscape around you in the form of musical magical little buddies. Encounter a cast of eccentric characters, each with their own stories and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Solve puzzles not with conventional means, but with the harmonious manipulation of sound itself, unlocking new beats as you explore. As you delve deeper into this quirky apocalypse, immerse yourself in a world where music reigns supreme. Your quest isn't just about throwing a party; it's about bringing hope, joy, and a sense of unity to a world content in its disarray by bringing joy back to the wasteland. Get ready to groove like never before, because the sickest party of the end times awaits. Are you prepared to be the maestro of the Digital Audio Wasteland? Made in the University of Utah's Games program.

rows.name: Echocalypse: The Scarlet Covenant
rows.short_description: Kemono Girl RPG has topped the free download list on App Store and Google Play in multiple countries or regions! Embark on a journey with 10 million players worldwide in a post-apocalyptic exploration, and stand alongside charming Kemono girls! Enjoy a time-saving and relaxing card battle!
rows.description_html: Kemono Girl RPG has topped the free download list on App Store and Google Play in multiple countries or regions! Embark on a journey with 10 million players worldwide in a post-apocalyptic exploration, and stand alongside charming Kemono girls! Download now and enjoy a time-saving and relaxing card battle! Hundreds Of Charming Kemono Girls Await Nearly a hundred charming Kemono girls are waiting for your dispatch. Each Kemono girl has her own proficient skill, choose the ones that suit your battle style! You can also boost the Kemono girls in multiple dimensions to improve their combat Attributes, making you invincible in battles. Have a romantic date with the Kemono girl you fancy, increasing Affinity while also enhancing character Attributes! Time-saving and Relaxing Card Battles The skip battle and quick blitz functions save you time. You can greatly shorten the battle duration and save time spent on battles by unlocking the automatic battle and skip battle functions. Not only do some Story stages support skipping battles, but there are also more daily gameplays that support quick blitz, helping you avoid repetitive battles. Also, the game will provide you with lineup combination suggestions to assist you in improving your battle efficiency. Massive In-game Rewards For Everyone The price of drawing cards is lower than 99% of card mobile games, offering free SSR characters and a massive amount of items. With a hundred draws of self-selection, there's even a chance to get six top-tier SSR characters in the first week of beta. Top-tier battle squads can be easily filled up! Every day, there are 10 free draws, supplemented by a large amount of resources, pushing through the end of the world, and let's see who is superior in the arena! Quick and Easy Character Leveling One-click level inheritance, quickly cultivate a lineup of Kemono girls! Each game character supports one-click lossless inheritance between character levels, allowing for instant switching and efficient lineup changes. Cultivate a team of Kemono girls once and for all! Explore Multiple Game Modes A leisure gameplay with high degree of freedom and diverse categories. If you love Expedition and Battle, you can choose to compete in the arena, or regularly go to the port to fight with mysterious BOSS for rewards. If you like a warm and lively home, you can also freely DIY and create a personalized dormitory for you and your Kemono girls! If you are actively sociable, you can also join the Syndicate to make friends, exchange gifts, and jointly Recharge the High-energy Reactor for high returns.

rows.short_description: Take the loot, pirates! Bounty Rush is a 4 vs 4 multiplayer team action game. Work with your team to capture the other teams' berries!
rows.description_html: Take the loot, pirates! - Victory rests on the berry in your hand! Bounty Rush is the first ONE PIECE 4 vs 4 multiplayer team action game. In this game, working with your team is the key to victory! Compete in real-time, with complete synchronization, against an enemy team and aim to steal their berries! - The world of ONE PIECE has been transformed into a 3D battlefield! The stages are filled with items that give you and your team an advantage, as well as obstacles that get in your way. Use whatever you can get your hands on and lead your team to victory! - Emerge victorious using distinctive ONE PIECE characters in Team Battle! In this mode, you can control popular ONE PIECE characters and battle against rival teams. Characters have different strengths too: those who excel at advancing the frontlines and those who are better at taking the defensive in the rear. Pick your playstyle and charge into battle!

rows.name: Roaches: The Birthday Party
rows.short_description: Game includes 7 funny roach birthday party pictures as puzzles. Each puzzle is available as 25, 49 or 100 pieces. There is no time limit, reference image is always available during assembling. Take your time, enjoy assembling and have a fun with roach party pictures!
rows.description_html: Game simulates assembling a jigsaw puzzle. 7 different puzzle images are available. Each image is available as 25, 49 or 100 pieces puzzle and each can be assembled independently. Process of assembling is saved for each image, so if you leave the level or the game it will not be lost and you can continue later. There is also no time limit. Player can see the complete image anytime by by using the icon toggle in the top right corner of the screen. After finishing assembling the image (or even during the process) puzzle pieces can be randomly shuffled again. Game does not challenge the player with any kind of limits, so it's enjoyable process without any kind of pressure. It has minimalistic and relaxing ambient music. Images are funny and fictional. They are about different aspects of imaginary roaches having a birthday party. Take your time, enjoy jigsaw puzzle assembling and have a fun with roaches birthday party pictures!

rows.name: SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded
rows.short_description: SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded fuses the best of Splitgate 1 & 2, bringing back that classic arena shooter feel. Play free now.
rows.description_html: No Factions. No Abilities. No Limits. SPLITGATE: Arena Reloaded fuses the best of Splitgate 1 & 2, bringing back that classic arena shooter feel. Play free now. The Arena Is Back: Hop into fast-paced matches with customizable loadouts or test yourself in Classic Arena with equal starts. Fight across fan-favorite modes like Team Deathmatch, King of the Hill, and Domination, or let loose in party modes like Gun Game and Shotty Snipers. Contest power-ups across the arena to gain temporary advantages and turn the tide of battle. Grind & Progress: Earn rewards with every match as you level up your Career, unlock weapons and cosmetics, and prove yourself on ranked leaderboards. Each weapon has its own progression path with unique camos to showcase mastery. Climb from Rookie to Prime across 1000+ levels to prove you are a master of the arena. New Maps, Weapons, & More: Experience 20 diverse arenas, including 5 new and remastered arenas. Battle aboard a moving land crawler on Hammerhead, navigate the massive irrigation complex of Terra13, or dominate classic maps like Oasis and Abyss. Customize your loadout with 18 different primary weapons and 9 unique secondaries, or pick up Power Weapons to dominate the arena. Portals With a Purpose: Utilize portals to outplay your opponents in ways no other shooter can match. Flank from impossible angles, escape certain death, or lock down key positions using Portal Overloading. Clear enemy portals with EMP Grenades and claim territory for your team.

rows.name: EOEOnline
rows.short_description: EOEOnline is a fantasy MMORPG in a vast world with quirky and humorous characters and a depth of unique lore and world building. The game takes place in a dynamic world we're in game events become canon and build onto the game's lore and world.
rows.description_html: EOEOnline is a fantasy MMORPG in a vast world with quirky and humorous characters and a depth of unique lore and world building. The game takes place in a dynamic world we're in game events become canon and build onto the game's lore and world. Players can explore multiple countries, realms all of which have unique histories and backstories. In typical mmorpg fashion game play consists of dungeon crawlers quests skills and levelling both combat and non combat. The game play focuses on freedom to do what you want and be who you want with no strict class system instead players can mix and match skill trees however they see fit. Most in game events come with unique weapons and armour and collectables and events that can be added to a player-built house. The story revolves around a growing military power collecting ancient powerful relics and mystical creatures with the player tasked to stop them while also contending with ancient evils uncovered from beneath the earth's surface and world beyond. The world has many mini games and collectables to be won. Find lore books and uncover the deep history of the world. Collect pets and give them unique hats Ride chickens and race hippos Fight in the area against npcs or friends Play minigame for unique rewards and build a house to show off your collections Multiple crafting methods and skills to build out your game play experience and unlock rewards and collectables including enchanting. Crafting alchemy and resource gathering. Join a pirate crew on an island hopping adventure or help the mages guild uncover ancient ruins.

rows.name: Dragon Spirits 2 : Prologue
rows.short_description: In this modern urban-themed RPG, you can collect 80+ different dragon spirits, experiment with skill setups, assemble teams, and devise strategies to build your dragon spirit squad. Adventure through the virtual spaces in Metapolis, and uncover the conspiracy behind it all.
rows.description_html: Dragon Spirits 2 is a creature-collecting RPG set in a modern urban environment. Players can explore a city filled with urban legends, venture into various otherworldly spaces, and form contracts with different dragon spirits. You can nurture these spirits, customize their abilities, strategize team compositions, and build a formidable dragon spirit squad. The difference between the prologue version and the full version: The prologue version unlocks 11 low-level maps. (That’s still plenty of content for a free game!) ◆Story Overview: Cognitive pollution in Metapolis◆ The protagonist is a game developer living in bustling Metapolis. Her ordinary life is disrupted when dragons from the game she developed appear in reality! Upon forming contracts with these dragon spirits, the protagonist realizes that the real world is being invaded by more dragons of unknown origin. The once vibrant city is no longer just a sleepless town of bright lights; people's minds are being increasingly contaminated, and the line between fiction and reality has blurred! The protagonist, also known as a pactsealer, embarks on a journey with dragons to uncover the mystery behind these events, restore the city to its former state, and form bonds with more dragon spirits. ◆80+ Dragon Companions◆ Assemble your dragon spirit team and command them in battle. But, before recruiting them as your new companions, you must fulfill their unique needs. ◆Create Your Unique Combat Style◆ Each dragon spirit has its strengths and team roles, requiring careful consideration when training and in battle. Analyze each dragon's abilities, tailor a unique combat strategy, and adjust their stats through skill setups and equipping items. ◆Explore the Boundary Between Virtual and Reality◆ Metapolis is a vibrant place, but the virtual world contamination has made it even more chaotic. Special zones known as Cocoon, scattered throughout the city, are responsible for breaking the boundary between virtual and reality. In the game, players will explore various Cocoons, each a chaotic vortex of unstructured information and lurking dangers. Of course, there are also wild dragon spirits and other enemies waiting. ◆Uncover the Dark Secrets of Metapolis◆ Apart from the Cocoons, there are plenty of regular areas in Metapolis. Navigate different parts of the city to uncover the mastermind behind this crisis. Along the way, you can also take a moment to enjoy the city's scenery and immerse yourself in Metapolis's everyday life. ◆Battles Between Pactsealers◆ Meet other pactsealers and their dragon spirits in side missions along the city. Enjoy battles against them, decipher their strategies, and deepen your bond with your dragon spirits, growing together into an unbeatable team.

rows.name: Clone War
rows.short_description: It's a simple roguelike game that gets stronger by winning a fight against clones.
rows.description_html: About This Game 'Clon War' is a game in which you have to survive a fight against an influx of clones. How long can you survive? Let's fight enemies and be strong The game is played in a roguelike genre, and as the stage progresses, the enemies become stronger. Clearing the stage will give you a reward and you will grow too. Let's dress ourselves up After the game, you can get the goods based on the results, which you can use when you visit the store. Let's decorate ourselves with individuality, not only the appearance of the character, but also accessories and effects. Let's keep a record You can check various records, such as the highest stage level and the number of enemies defeated. Some records will appear on the leaderboard for others to see, so aim for high scores. How to manipulate You can click the ? icon at the top of the title screen to see how to operate it. Language Settings You can change the language in the game from Option > Language. Steam Leaderboard On the Steam Library page, you can check the ranking by clicking View My Challenges > Full Ranking Table.

rows.name: Kana
rows.short_description: Start your Japanese learning journey by learning two of the writing systems in Japanese - Hiragana and Katakana!
rows.description_html: Master the fundamentals of the Japanese language with Kana ! In Kana, you get to learn and practice Hiragana and Katakana which are two of the writing systems in Japanese. Note: The game teaches through English! Hiragana and Katakana Charts for Learning Character Writing Practice Learn how to write each character with a stroke order visualizer. Typing Game Modes ENDLESS Practice recognizing characters by typing out Romaji (Japanese sounds represented by Roman alphabets) to match the characters. Competitive Match as much kana as you can to climb the leaderboard! Color Palettes! A selection of color palettes for users to customize the look of the game!

rows.name: Mereonozis 2D: The Kingdom of Gremlins
rows.short_description: A puzzle-bazed metroidvania. Help the robot to repair the station. But there are gremlins who will try to break everything you've just fixed!
rows.description_html: You will play for a robot who wakes up on an abandoned space station. To repair the station, you need to repair equipment and solve the puzzles. Beware of gremlins! They are not dangerous for you but they'll break everything you've repaired so far. They are also a part of a puzzle: you not only need to scare them away but you have to do it the right way! This is a metroidvania based on puzzles instead of battles. You open locations step by step. And you may freely navigate throught the unlocked locations. The station has a vast network of railcars. They will help you to move quickly between its compartments. On some levels you may try different machines: cranes, cable cars, manipulators etc. They may be controlled with special control panels in the bottom right corner. Sometimes you may see astonishing alien landscape behind the window or occasionally find forgotten diaries and documents in the underground compartments. They will not only help you to go through the puzzles but will also reveal the story behind the abandoned station.

rows.name: Tiny Ski
rows.short_description: Welcome to Tiny Ski Resort! Where pixel art, skiing, multiplayer races, and a beautiful story all come together.
rows.description_html: Hi! This is my first game <3 (I have no idea what I'm doing) Embark on an exhilarating journey down some frosty slopes in this heart-pounding adventure at Tiny Ski Resort! This 2D pixel art game invites players to carve through snowy landscapes, compete against friends online, and delve into an enthralling story mode with branching narratives leading to several different endings. Thrilling Online Races: Strap on your skis and challenge friends or rivals from around the globe in adrenaline-fueled online races. Feel the rush as you zip through meticulously crafted ski runs, navigating treacherous obstacles and striving for victory. Story Mode with Endless Possibilities: Dive into the captivating narrative of Tiny Ski's story mode, where your choices shape the outcome. With multiple unique endings to discover, every decision you make influences the fate of your character and the world around them. Will you conquer the mountains or succumb to the challenges ahead? Constant Updates: Stay tuned for regular updates and new content additions, including fresh ski runs, exciting events, and more. With ongoing support and community engagement, the adventure never ends in Tiny Ski!

rows.name: Project P
rows.short_description: Explore the maze, run for your life and aim your arrows carefully in this minimal top down survival game.Use the layout of the maze to sneak around, take your shot and run before you get spotted by the monster you are trying to take down.
rows.description_html: Project P is a straightforward minimalistic top down adventure game. Choose your class, enter the maze, kill the golem before it finds and kills you Key features 3 Different classes to choose from, each with their own skill Randomly generated levels : each run is different. Start by exploring the maze and remember the best places to pick a fight After every win, the golem grows stronger but so do you! Pick an upgrade after each level and reach the highest possible level Play with a precise visibility system to escape the golem and hit him when he cannot see you Listen carefully, the music may tell you if you are safe... or if you should run for your life!

rows.name: Is This A Platformer?
rows.short_description: Play a fast paced action platformer where you fight grapes and a banana to save your dump brother.
rows.description_html: Overview: Is This a Platformer? is a fast-paced action platformer that throws players into a hilariously absurd adventure filled with quirky characters, over-the-top obstacles, and laugh-out-loud moments at every turn. Step into the shoes of Kenzu, a young Japanese video game otaku, suddenly pulled into a bizarre digital world. His mission? Rescue his brother from the clutches of a mysterious creature in a universe where nothing makes sense—but everything is a challenge Art Style: Is This a Platformer? brings its vibrant world to life with charming, retro-inspired pixel art. Think chunky, colorful pixels reminiscent of classic platformers but polished with modern touches. The result? A visual feast that blends nostalgia with fresh, creative flair. And where else will you find a laughing sun or a bunch of screaming grapes? Oh, and don’t forget the explosive Kaboom! effect—because why not? Gameplay: You’re just Kenzu—a regular guy with a killer jump and a mean punch. But in this world, every movement counts. Precision platforming, tight controls, and quick reflexes are your only allies as you leap, punch, and fight your way through absurd challenges. Boss fights? They're epic, over-the-top showdowns that mix intense platforming with wild humor and massive, unforgettable foes. Think you’ve got the skills to beat our toughest boss? Prove it. We dare you.

rows.name: Cookard
rows.short_description: Cookard is a cooking game where you run a restaurant by stacking cards to prepare and serve dishes to customers.
rows.description_html: Wishlist More From Panitia GameDev About the Game Cookard is a cooking game where you run a restaurant by stacking cards to prepare and serve dishes to customers. Prepare Dish Every dish requires a certain set of steps and ingredients, which can typically be completed by dragging ingredient cards (such as Egg, Dough, Honey) to utensil cards (such as Oven, Stove). You can always check the Recipes section if you're at loss. As the game progresses, you'll unlock more recipes to cook! Serve Dish Dragging a 'Customer' card on top of a 'Table' card will reveal their desired dish. Serve them by placing their desired dish on top of them. Customers won't linger for very long, so make sure to deliver their dish in a timely manner! Buy & Trade Every dish requires a set of ingredient cards, and you'll need to stock up on them from time to time. Ingredients can be bought by placing a coins card on top of a store card, such as 'Store' or 'Fruit Stall'. Sometimes you'll find yourselves surrounded by unecessary stuff. It's good idea to sell them in the 'Trade House' to get coins in return. You could also trade various items to get other items, such as an additional Table or Oven, etc. Complete Quests Completing quests earns you rewards, often including new additions to the restaurant, such as new utensils and recipes. Progress! Hire Workers Tired of clicking Water Pump or Hand Crank? Hire workers to help you generate electricity! Put them on Running Wheel to kickstart your machinations! Automate Your Kitchen Who knows moving and sorting cards will be so tiring? Unlock magnet and use it to pull the cards from one place to another! Presskit Download the Press Kit here

rows.name: Tactishia
rows.short_description: Tactical, turn based board game 1v1 with offline mode. chess like strategy game adding more aspects to the board.
rows.description_html: Tactishia Tactical board game with some similarity to chess but uses more tactical aspects to simulate better a battlefield experience. The game has offline option as well as game lobbies for 1 vs 1 multiplayer. The game lets you choose up to 18 pieces of 6 types of units per board, the online session lets each players to re-organize the chosen pieces on each side of his board. The offline session lets any player to freely choose any pieces to use.

rows.name: Tale of the Singing Peaks
rows.short_description: This game is a 2D Pixel Art Narrative Puzzle Platformer created by Quantum Lemon Interactive in cooperation with the talented artists at Xueshu Game Studios. Game Features: 2D Platforming; Single Player Co-op Gameplay; Puzzle-Solving; NPC Interactions;
rows.description_html: Come forward to go on a spiritual journey from base camp to the summit of Mt. Nihara, the mythical snowy peak and the highest mountain in the world! Rely on your companion and solve riddles and challenges across your way as you battle the elements across this tale of courage, loyalty, and redemption in this immersive, handcrafted 2D pixel-art space! Game Features: 2D Platforming; Single Player Co-op Gameplay; Puzzle-Solving; NPC Interactions;

rows.name: Super Sus
rows.short_description: Welcome to join the multiplayer social deduction game - Super Sus! Engage in intense gameplay with global players, as you strategize to safeguard your spaceship from the cunning Impostors determined to sabotage the mission and eliminate everyone aboard!
rows.description_html: EXPERIENCE INTRIGUE AND STRATEGY - Play as a Spacecrew: Achieve victory by completing all tasks or smartly identifying and voting out the impostors. - Play as an Impostor: Execute covert eliminations and deploy strategic sabotages to create discord among the Spacecrew. - Play as a Neutral: Each neutral role comes with unique objectives. Excel in these roles to claim your victory. - Teamwork is Key: Work closely with teammates to complete critical tasks and ensure the safety of your spaceship. Will you maintain trust, or will betrayal lead to chaos? PARTY FOR FUN - Duo and Squad Modes: Perfect for playing alongside friends and family. Team up, strategize, deduce, and enjoy the game together. - Private Rooms with Custom Rules: Take control by setting your own game rules and inviting friends and family to join. DIVERSE MODES: - Colosseum: Fight to be the last one standing in this ultimate survival challenge. - Hide & Seek: Complete tasks and dodge the hunters in this thrilling evasion showdown. - Lover Mode：Stay alive with your lover and navigate challenges together to secure victory. - More: More modes are waiting for you to explore. CUSTOMIZE YOUR GAMEPLAY: - Upgrade Your Role: Enhance your roles with exclusive Emotes, Action Effects, Fashion outfits, and more. Stand out with your unique style! Ready for a journey filled with trust, deception, and tactical gameplay? Download Super Sus now and step into the vastness of space where every match is a new mystery!

rows.name: Splash Dino
rows.short_description: Drag objects (wooden boxes and triangles and other objects) to help the little dino throw the wooden ball into the water. And remember that dino can help you with tips (hints), skips and dino coins. 115 levels.
rows.description_html: Drag objects (wooden boxes and triangles and other objects) to help the little dino throw the wooden ball into the water. And remember that dino can help you with tips (hints as black and red frames), skips and dino coins. At the beginning of the game you have 30 dino coins, 20 tips (hints) and 10 skips. Every second level you receive an additional dino coin. You can use dino coins to increase the number of tips and skips you have. Tips help you complete a level faster, while skips allow you to jump to the next level. Are you ready to test your brain with this colorful, cute and challenging puzzle game? Good luck! 115 levels.

The Zombies going to Stronger. The barrels hurt when they explode. The game have 4 stages, 2 day and 2 night stages. Good luck in Zombie Land.

rows.name: Mortuar
rows.short_description: Mortuar is a 1-4 player Online co-op psychological horror game. Delve deep into Hoia Baciu Forest where eerie sightings and paranormal activity have transpired. Make use of various ghost hunting equipment to first identify the ghost's type, then attempt to banish it back to the afterlife.
rows.description_html: Mortuar is psychological horror game where you and up to three other players are tasked with investigating haunted sites. Upon identifying what type of ghost haunts the area, you must exorcise it in order to finally free the realm of its unearthly presence. Make use of various ghost hunting equipment and closely follow your journal’s instructions in order to perform the ritual. Two locations to choose from Both set in an area resembling the infamous Hoia Baciu Forest, there are two distinct locations to choose from. Explore the old, abandoned church set on a hill, where even the priest who used to serve this godly place left in a hurry, or delve deep into the mysterious mansion that has been left abandoned for a long time for unknown reasons. Equip yourself accordingly Discover a diverse list of equipment that can aid you in identifying the ghost. You will find all the classics, such as EMF readers, flashlights and holy crosses and also other items which will then aid you in your quest to banish the ghost from the mortal realm. Terrifying encounters The ghost is not just an entity that aimlessly roams about, it’s a malevolent spirit who seeks vengeance upon the living. The ghost will start out more passive, manifesting only to drain your sanity at first. However, if you wander time in its territory, it will not hesitate to hunt you down. Watch out, it is always listening to you! Teamwork makes the dream work While you can battle the ghost on your own, your experience can be greatly enhanced by bringing in some friends! Cooperate with your team to identify the ghost faster and then to make the banishing process less dangerous.

rows.name: Cedric & Odious
rows.short_description: Battle through a dark fantasy world as a resurrected warrior king. Once loyal friends, you now serve at the mercy of Odious, a brilliant but corrupt sorcerer. Master tactical combat and magical artifacts in this challenging action RPG.
rows.description_html: Cedric & Odious is a pixel art action RPG set in a dark and treacherous fantasy world. A Bond Torn by Death Take the role of Cedric, a warrior king resurrected by his once-loyal friend, Odious, a brilliant but morally corrupt sorcerer. In life, their camaraderie was legendary. In death, Cedric finds himself bound to Odious's will, forced to carry out the sorcerer’s plans. Haunted by vague memories of their shared past and uneasy about Odious’s intentions, Cedric must decide: obey the man who saved him or face death again and again. Dynamic Combat and Tactical Mastery Challenging Enemies: Confront the harsh realities of a divided world, from the war-torn human realms to the ferocious wildling factions and the relentless forces of the demonic underworld. Adapt your strategies to face enemies that test your skill and resolve at every turn. Environmental Strategy: Utilize floating platforms and diverse landscapes to outmaneuver foes, turning the environment into your greatest ally. Powerful Items and Artifacts: Utilize an arsenal of unique passive and active items, from spell-breaking rings to explosive fire potions, to overcome overwhelming odds. Totally free game.

rows.name: PacaPomo
rows.short_description: PacaPomo is a cozy, Free to Play productivity app where you raise alpacas and cultivate a farm, all driven by the Pomodoro Technique!
rows.description_html: PacaPomo is a cross between a productivity app and a cozy farming game where you raise alpacas and cultivate a farm, all driven by the Pomodoro Technique! Stay focused with a calming and motivating experience for busy students and working professionals. Play while going about your daily routines and responsibilities! Stay Productive with PacaPomo! Set a pomodoro timer customizable to your liking. Focus on an IRL task set to cozy Peruvian inspired music. When you come back, you're rewarded with crops ready to be harvested and Alpacas happy to great you!  Nurture your Garden! Plant various local specialties to feed your alpacas with, or sell them for a bit of extra cash! You can also complete villager orders for a large prize, or cook unique meals with your crops to treat your Alpacas. Adopt and Care for your Alpacas! When you finish a pomodoro, you can take some time to pet your alpacas! Feed, shear, train and bond with your new friends.  Expand your Farm! Open up new terraces to unlock orchards, more alpaca pen space, and garden plots. Main Features Take advantage of the Pomodoro Timer for focus time, allowing you to stick to a schedule and improve concentration. You can customize your timer to your liking - with different times, tags, and long break options. A report card to track your progress on a daily, weekly, and monthly chart. Alongside is a To-Do List that you can fill out to track your goals. Unique, bespoke alpacas with different personalities and stories. These are acquired through adoption at the Alpaca Sanctuary. Every encounter is an exciting new addition to your farm! Customization options for Alpacas - allowing you to dress up your friends with silly hats, glasses, and special effects. Fun short minigames for interacting with your alpacas, including sheering and cooking. An original, calming soundtrack made by Peruvian musicians to chill or lock in to. A selection of unique crops and fruits to grow and harvest. Feed them to your alpacas, use them in food recipes, or complete villager orders. Long term progression through farm expansion - save up to buy terrace plots that will allow you to unlock orchards, more alpaca pen space and farming plots. Cross-platform cloud saves to ensure your progress is never lost! In today's fast-paced world, many struggle to balance work, responsibilities, and leisure time. PacaPomo aims to address this challenge by offering a free, fun and accessible way for people to relax and unwind while also being productive.

rows.name: Ruby Dreams: Immortal Promise
rows.short_description: As a maid in the elegance of a vampire household, use clues from your dreams to earn the love of your masters.
rows.description_html: The day has come for you to serve the Beaumont family at your mother’s request. As you venture into their mansion, you quickly find yourself captivated by the presence of your enigmatic hosts. At night you have dreams unlike any you’ve dreamt before. Guiding you through mysteries and rewarding you with knowledge of secrets that don’t belong to you. Use the secrets you’ve learned to tear down the walls around the Beaumont's hearts and earn your place in their embrace. Or use them to your advantage and learn about your mother’s complicated history with the family. Sebastian is the epitome of diligence and composure. But beneath that cool exterior lies a heart overflowing with care and protection, especially for those he treasures. Falling for him is easy because of his irresistible mix of strength and vulnerability, making every moment with him an adventure of the heart. Roderick has an irresistible charm and allure. He commands attention effortlessly, with his flirtatious demeanor which makes your heart flutter. Beneath that facade lies a complex man, capable of both darkness and tenderness. Alexander embodies arrogance and impulsiveness, yet within him resides a tender heart that he only reveals to those he truly cares for. His love towards someone can transform him from a self-centered to a protective and devoted man. A 2D visual novel story with choices A 3D world that reveals itself to you only in your dreams Three endings, that bringing you closer to one of your three mysterious hosts, and one 'bad' ending Puzzles leading to clues about how to reach the hearts of your masters Love progress bars that track your love with each master Voice acting during 3D dream sequences A gallery with art from all the locations you've visited A music player with all the songs you've heard Ruby Dreams: Immortal Promise was made by the Repulse team in a month, as part of the NaNoRenO 2024 game jam. Due to the nature of game jams and their limited time, we might have missed a bug here and there or overlooked some issues. Let us know if you find any issues and we might come back to fix them. Who knows, if you love the game, we might even expand it.

rows.name: The Aquarians
rows.short_description: A point-and-click playable short where you take the role of an artifact collector, navigating the Aquarian Temple's enigmatic architecture and locating its prized relics.
rows.description_html: The year is 1882, and it’s nearing a peaceful summer in the small American town of Thornsworth, New Hampshire. Meanwhile, the prestigious yet mysterious organization Loci Quaerere has gathered evidence of a long-forgotten temple from a bygone society, the Aquarians. This temple has been determined to be somewhere in the woods surrounding the very same town. In a headline announcement, the organization has sought after a knowledgeable and capable local to perform the tasks of discovery and exploration. That local has turned out to be you. In this playable short, point and click your way through various rooms, puzzles, and your assigned taskbook, to uncover the mysteries of the temple, collect artifacts for sponsors, and fulfill your ultimate purpose.

rows.name: Arena of Trophies
rows.short_description: Join the epic battle in an arena filled with gladiators and test your skills in a game where every move can lead to glory or downfall. Collect achievements, refine your strategies, and become a legend in the endless fight for survival and recognition!
rows.description_html: GAME INFORMATION Master the art of collecting achievements in this new game, designed to satisfy your appetite for challenges and rewards. COLLECT ACHIEVEMENTS Immerse yourself in a world where every step, every decision, and every action contributes to your progress in collecting achievements. From simple tasks for beginners to complex challenges for veterans, this game offers a wide array of achievements waiting to be conquered. GLADIATORS Choose from fifteen different gladiators, each with a unique appearance reflecting their personality and origin. Although all gladiators behave the same in combat, the variety in their visual style gives players the option to choose a character they can identify with or that expresses their aesthetic preferences. From imposing armored titans to agile and lightweight fighters, each gladiator brings their unique presence to the battlefield. TRAPS The arena is not just about strength and combat skills; it's also a place full of dangers and cunning. Use traps scattered throughout the arena to your advantage to surprise your opponents or turn the tide of battle in your favor. LANGUAGES On the home page of our game, we strive to be open about our approach to translations. All language versions in our game are machine-translated, which means we utilize automated technologies to translate texts into various languages. This method allows us to efficiently expand the reach of the game and make it accessible to players worldwide. While we aim for the most accurate translation possible, it's important to realize that machine translation may not always capture the subtleties and nuances of the original text. There can be minor inaccuracies, but these do not alter the overall gaming experience. We are committed to providing quality translations and believe that despite occasional imperfections, players from different linguistic regions can fully experience and enjoy our game. We value feedback from our players and are ready to further improve and update the language versions based on their suggestions.

rows.name: Sime Is Back
rows.short_description: Sime's back, celebrated by locals but tired of exploitation. Join him & his feline friend on a whimsical Adriatic journey. Armed with his fish, Sime confronts enemies, smashes crates & reclaims what's his. Dive into this charming adventure of chaos, camaraderie, & fish-flinging fun!
rows.description_html: Sime Is Back is a delightful 2.5D jumping platformer that transports players to the idyllic Croatian Adriatic coast. In this whimsical tale, players step into the shoes of a fed-up fisherman who's tired of being exploited by greedy locals. Armed with nothing but his fish and accompanied by his faithful feline sidekick, our hero sets out on an epic journey to reclaim what's rightfully his – all while embarking on a quest for justice, revenge, and plenty of fish-flinging fun! - Fish-Flipping Frenzy: Dive into a chaotic adventure as you wield your fish to flip, slap, and smack pesky adversaries into submission across a variety of vibrant levels. - Quirky Enemies and Obstacles: Confront an eclectic cast of adversaries and environmental obstacles, including greedy locals, mischievous critters, perilous cliffs, and cunning traps. - Crate-Smashing Chaos: Immerse yourself in an action-packed adventure as you smash open crates scattered throughout each level, releasing a shower of coins essential for unlocking challenges. - Authentic Croatian Setting: Immerse yourself in the rich culture and scenic beauty of the Croatian Adriatic coast, with authentic landmarks, music, and cultural references woven seamlessly into the game's charming narrative. - Stunning 2.5D Environments: Explore meticulously crafted environments inspired by the breathtaking Croatian Adriatic coast, from quaint seaside villages to lush coastal landscapes and hidden caves. Sime Is Back promises an exhilarating blend of platforming action, coin-collecting madness, and scenic splendor, inviting players of all ages to embark on an unforgettable adventure filled with crate-smashing chaos and feline camaraderie.

rows.name: Interview with the Horny Ghost
rows.short_description: Interview with the Horny Ghost is a super short, super free Adult Visual Novel made for a game jam. In the game you play a single-minded and perverted ghost and learn some lessons along the way.
rows.description_html: A little story about obsession and personal growth. And sex. The Premise Errol is a ghost with one thing on his mind: losing his virginity. rows.description_html: Dive into the heart-pounding action of Zombie Island, an adrenaline-fueled survival game that will push your skills to the limit! Are you ready to face hordes of ravenous undead in a battle for survival? In Zombie Island, you'll find yourself stranded on a desolate island infested with the walking dead. Armed with only your wits and a selection of powerful weapons, you must fight your way through wave after wave of zombies, each more relentless than the last. But beware – these zombies aren't your average shufflers. With our cutting-edge 3D audio technology, you'll hear every groan, every footstep, and every bone-chilling growl as the undead close in from all directions. Stay alert, or risk becoming zombie chow! But be warned: surviving on Zombie Island won't be easy. With each passing wave, the challenges will escalate, testing your reflexes, strategy, and nerve. Do you have what it takes to outlast the undead and emerge victorious? Prepare yourself for the ultimate test of survival. Gather your courage, lock and load your weapons, and get ready to face the zombie apocalypse head-on in Zombie Island – where every shot counts, and every scream could be your last. Join us now on Steam and prepare to experience the thrill of Zombie Island firsthand. The undead await – are you brave enough to face them?

The in game computer also contains a playable version of Sugar Bear which was developed by many of the same students for a game jam in 2023.

rows.name: Combat Cat
rows.short_description: A fast-paced, side-scrolling, bullet hell with an inventory system where a player can upgrade their weapons and player stats to survive as long as possible.
rows.description_html: Combat Cat is a fast-paced, side-scrolling, bullet hell where you fight against an endless horde of angry slimes as a combat ready cat! Shoot, dash and fly your way around the areas as slimes try to stop your journey! After each level the slimes grow in power, but so do you! Upgrade your weapon and cat with the thirty unique items the slimes drop along the way! Use these items for infinite customizability options! Homing shotgun? Super powered sniper? The choice is yours! Face off against four diverse slime types and three different challenging bosses as your journey progresses! If you're ready for a real fight try a higher difficulty or maybe even the truly chaotic slime rain mode! Or have fun and experiment in the creative mode to build the combat cat of your dreams! Go on now! Create your Combat Cat and survive as long as you can! Jump, Dash, and fly around the arena! Upgrade your weapon and cat for infinite combat options! Different game modes including creative mode for experimenting and slime rain for maximum chaos! Ending Stats screen to see how far you have come! Four slime types and three different bosses! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Bullet Rain
rows.short_description: This Game is a classic First Person Shooter. As it is still in development features and weapons will be added step by step. We hope you will enjoy our work!
rows.description_html: Bullet Rain is a competitive shooter where the objective is to capture objectives on the map or eliminate the opposing team. Players can expect thrilling firefights and tactical challenges against other players. In a grim future, the skies unleashed a torrent of destruction as a colossal battleship bombarded the planet, earning its fearsome moniker “Bullet Rain” and alien life forms revealed themselves to humanity. Peaceful negotiations were never an option for them. Even the dragons fought among themselves to acquire resources. Earth became the battlefield of an unprecedented scale. Though the planet had to be evacuated, many remained behind to defend it. Welcome to the year 2102, three decades after the first appearance of dragons, where the face of Earth has forever changed. Humanity confronts the relentless reality that it is not alone in the universe. Dragons and other extraterrestrial species have revealed themselves and claim resources that once belonged exclusively to humans. Earth finds itself in an end-time scenario, marked by destruction and desolation. Cities have crumbled into ruins, once bustling streets now lay deserted and overgrown with vegetation. The remnants of human civilization serve only as a reminder of past grandeur and loss. Despite the apocalyptic landscape, humanity has not given up. With a mix of advanced technology, they wage a desperate battle against the overwhelming invaders. Each day is a struggle for survival, and the boundaries between good and evil blur in this endless conflict for resources and power. Amidst this chaos, clans and factions have formed, fighting for the remaining resources. Loyalty to a group can determine life and death as humanity strives to stand against the looming extinction. Yet even in times of darkness, there are glimmers of hope that keep faith in a better future alive. Welcome to 'Bullet Rain”. In Bullet Rain, all players stand on an equal footing, without any additional abilities or special skills. The focus is entirely on skill, teamwork, and strategic thinking. Each player can contribute their individual skills and experiences to lead the team to victory. With a variety of weapons and equipment at your disposal, there are numerous options to develop your own playstyle and compete in the 5-versus-5 battles. Showcase your shooting skills, collaborate closely with your teammates, and defeat the invaders in this action-packed competition for the fate of humanity.

rows.description_html: Melon Man - A Juicy Platformer Adventure Description: Embark on a deliciously delightful challenge with Melon Man, a charming 2D platformer that will test your platformer skills and tickle your taste buds! Join Melon Man on his quest to collect all his melons in this vibrant and exciting adventure. Features: Juicy Gameplay: Jump and move your way with precision through a variety of levels filled with obstacles and tricky traps. Collect all the melons scattered across each level to unlock new levels. Various Difficulties: Do you have what it takes to play through the game on insane difficulty, or do you prefer extra lives? Highscores: Can you set the time record per level? Challenge your friends to see who's go the inner Melon Man skill! Catchy Tunes: Groove to the beat of different soundtracks that will have you humming along as you navigate each level. Challenging Levels: Test your platforming skills with progressively challenging levels that will keep you on your toes. Each stage introduces new obstacles and mechanics, ensuring every moment is filled with excitement and anticipation. MacOS and Linux support is planned for near future. PLEASE NOTE: The game is designed to be challenging and may have a learning curve.

rows.name: Relict
rows.short_description: Relict is a sci-fi 3rd person action adventure roguelike shooter with a unique tarot twist on player abilities and enemies. Taking the role of the fool, fight your way through three unique planets to save the universe from a great evil.
rows.description_html: Relict promises to be a thrilling fusion of genres, blending elements of third-person shooters, roguelikes, and tarot-based strategy. Set across three distinct planets—Koros, Thorm, and Serun—each characterized by its unique environmental challenges and aesthetic, this game invites players into a richly immersive universe fraught with peril and intrigue. Explore various planetary environments: Koros: Once an oceanic paradise, now desiccated and barren. Fight under the skeletal shadow of the creatures who once inhabited this planet as you encounter various corrupted sea themed life forms. Thorm: A frigid wasteland beneath a perpetually frozen sky. Challenges include traversing icy oasis, treacherous crevasses, and frost-covered ruins of the people who once called this planet home. Serun: Charred remnants of a once-vibrant forest, teeming with burnt and corrupted flora and fauna. Venture through the burning forests as you catch up to the source of the corruption and defeat unique fire themed enemies who once called the forest home. Third-Person Roguelike: Fast-paced and fluid combat emphasizing strategic positioning, reflexes, and resource management. Randomized enemy encounters, and mini bosses add challenge and replayability. Tarot Reading and Ability Acquisition: Collect tarot cards throughout the journey, each representing a unique ability or grace from various Tarot Deities. Perform tarot readings between stages to unlock new abilities, upgrade existing ones. Abilities range from offensive spells and defensive shields to passive enhancements and utility skills, allowing for varied playstyles and strategic depth. Objective: Confronting Nuraxis: With help from the deities, discover clues pointing towards Nuraxis, the true source of the corruption plaguing the planets. Confront Nuraxis in a climactic showdown, battling through waves of minions and treacherous obstacles as you fight to lift the corruption once and for all. Relict promises an immersive and challenging gaming experience, blending visceral combat, strategic depth, and mystical intrigue into a seamless and unforgettable adventure. With its captivating narrative, diverse gameplay mechanics, and stunning visuals, it's sure to captivate players seeking a fresh and compelling gaming experience.

Venture through the burning forests as you catch up to the source of the corruption and defeat unique fire themed enemies who once called the forest home. Third-Person Roguelike: Fast-paced and fluid combat emphasizing strategic positioning, reflexes, and resource management. Randomized enemy encounters, and mini bosses add challenge and replayability. Tarot Reading and Ability Acquisition: Collect tarot cards throughout the journey, each representing a unique ability or grace from various Tarot Deities. Perform tarot readings between stages to unlock new abilities, upgrade existing ones. Abilities range from offensive spells and defensive shields to passive enhancements and utility skills, allowing for varied playstyles and strategic depth. Objective: Confronting Nuraxis: With help from the deities, discover clues pointing towards Nuraxis, the true source of the corruption plaguing the planets. Confront Nuraxis in a climactic showdown, battling through waves of minions and treacherous obstacles as you fight to lift the corruption once and for all. Relict promises an immersive and challenging gaming experience, blending visceral combat, strategic depth, and mystical intrigue into a seamless and unforgettable adventure. With its captivating narrative, diverse gameplay mechanics, and stunning visuals, it's sure to captivate players seeking a fresh and compelling gaming experience.

rows.name: The Netcode Conflict
rows.short_description: The Netcode Conflict is a community-event-driven online multiplayer game. Our goal is to develop and improve the game together with the community. We host regular events where players can win in-game rewards. TNC is still actively in development, and your ideas and feedback help shape its future!
rows.description_html: Welcome to 'The Netcode Conflict' We are working on an community event based futuristic multiplayer game in a big persistent Open world. Let`s start with us our development and create with us the next epic game. This Project, where gaming meets community in an unforgettable experience! We're not just about delivering fun and action-packed gameplay; we're all about tailor-making a game that speaks directly to you, our community. Together, we're crafting something truly special – a game that's not just played, but lived and cherished. Join us on this journey, and let's create gaming history together! Explore a futuristic open world to discover new areas, find items, and improve your defenses against enemies. Be Careful and Loot your Equipment to be Ready for the Battle! Advance through challenges, earn points and become truly epic. Team up or fight solo to take over the control point system. Fight against powerful AI guarding the Obelisks to claim rare Netcode Fragments. Survive to improve your skills and discover special abilities. Be the last man standing and hold the control point system to unlock special features.  Find valuable loot in buildings inside and outside the city. Spice up your character with rare loot you uncover in the world Craft special items like Ammo and Regen Units to be ready for battle. Meet AI-Sy , your trusted ally for locating loot, spotting enemies, and providing healing support. In this post-apocalyptic cyberpunk survival shooter, set in a world devastated by war over the 'Netcode,' you have the choice to go solo or team up with friends. You begin randomly somewhere in the world in a landing pod and start with a unique character (Facade). At first, you start without equipment and must quickly scavenge loot. Explore the world and get into a city to capture the control point and earn points that make you unique. Step into our world, where passion knows no bounds! Here's the kicker – we're doing all of this without a budget, pouring our hearts and souls into this project during our precious free time. Despite the lack of funds, our dedication knows no limits. So buckle up and get ready to embark on an adventure like no other, fueled purely by love for gaming and community spirit!

The game is about a girl (Megan) on an ordinary day, literally the game takes place in a single day. rows.name: Mercapolis
rows.short_description: Build and manage your own supermarket. Place orders for seasonal products, stock them on the shelves, and get ready to survive a workday full of surprises. Hire employees and keep your customers happy in Mercapolis.
rows.description_html: You´ve just been fired from a major supermarket chain.. Now build your own and show them who´s the boss! Organize and build the different structures wherever and however you want. You'll have at your disposal various types of structures, such as shelves or workstations, to expand the range of products in your supermarket, such as quality meat, the freshest fish, or a delicious cheesecake. Manage your time and your product stock daily. The day will pass quickly, and you'll need to ensure that your shelves are always full. To do this, manage the warehouse, expand it with each upgrade, and hire employees to automatically stock products during the day. Use your manager intelligent and hire the best employees. Each employee will be different from the last. You'll need to use your eagle eye to distinguish the best employees for each task, assigning each one a primary and a secondary duty. Oh, and don't forget to pay them their salary! Every day is different in Mercapolis, adapt to each day as if it were the last. Various random events will occur during the day, and you'll need to be prepared as a manager to face them. Robberies, fires, or even health inspectors issuing fines if you're not vigilant enough. Project made for the Espetos Studios in Interactive Product Design degree of U-tad, University of Technology, Arts and Design.

rows.name: CrimeBloc
rows.short_description: Free-to-Play Text-Based Mafia MMO Set in the Eastern Bloc. A gritty text-based MMO where you rise through the ranks of organized crime in the Bloc. For 18 years, players have forged criminal empires, fought brutal turf wars, and survived in a world where betrayal is currency.
rows.description_html: CrimeBloc Free-to-Play Text-Based Crime MMO Set in the Eastern Bloc Step into the shadows of the post-Soviet underworld. CrimeBloc is a gritty text-driven MMO where you rise through the ranks of organized crime in the Eastern Bloc. For over 18 years, thousands of players have forged criminal empires, fought brutal turf wars, and survived in a world where betrayal is currency. Build Your Empire. Enforce Your Will. Eliminate Your Enemies. Classic Text-Based Gameplay with Depth Experience the strategic richness of text-based gaming. Every action matters. Your rise to power depends on smart decisions, alliances, and ruthless efficiency. Persistent Online World Join an active, player-driven underworld where crime families form and fall, cities are contested, and operations span days or weeks. Every choice shapes your legacy. Extensive Criminal Activities Steal rare cars, rob banks, commit heists, or take out your rivals. With dozens of criminal options, from small street hustles to major operations! There are many paths to domination. Player vs Player Combat Challenge other players to fights, assassinate enemies, or raid their assets. Warfare in CrimeBloc is strategic, brutal, and unforgiving. Deep Progression System Train your stats, upgrade equipment, acquire properties, and unlock high-level crimes. Build a unique character to suit your criminal style. Operate Across Eastern Bloc Cities From Moscow to Odessa, each city presents different risks and opportunities. Control them, exploit them, or burn them to the ground. Player-Run Casinos and Gambling Test your luck! CrimeBloc features player-owned casinos where you can wager your in-game cash on games like slots, roulette, blackjack, video poker, and more. Become a high roller, or invest in your own casino to profit from other players' risk. Gambling is fully integrated into the economy and offers both entertainment and strategic opportunities. 100% Free to Play CrimeBloc is free to play and always has been. Success is earned through strategy, persistence, and street smarts. Whether you are a veteran of old-school browser games or a newcomer seeking something different, CrimeBloc offers a deep and uncompromising look into the digital criminal underworld. Form alliances, betray partners, and climb to the top! if you can survive the climb. The Bloc is waiting. Do you have what it takes?

rows.name: Cat Got Your Tongue
rows.short_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a horror point-and-click game where you have to escape from the Home Cat by exploring the darkest corners of the house.
rows.description_html: Cat Got Your Tongue is an old-school horror point-and-click game. And let me tell you, you'll feel what it's like to be in the wrong place at the wrong time. Turn your screen brightness to the fullest... My previous game was 'too bright,' so I decided to make this one the darkest and the gloomiest. No complicated puzzles. There are no intricate puzzles in this game, but there's intricate gameplay where you, as the player, will have to figure things out. The game is built on exploring rooms and memorizing them. Look for items and use them to avoid a deadly fate. Because, you're not alone in the house... There's something bigger and thicker living here, something more evil, and hungry... lurking in the shadows. The House Cat. Playing tag with it, you should run immediately if you don't want to end up in someone's trash.

rows.name: Nightmare Kart
rows.short_description: Zoom through gothic streets in this horror themed vehicular combat racing game!
rows.description_html: You are a beast hunter, conscripted against your will to participate in a most peculiar local custom: a tournament where participants race atop mysterious vehicles comprised of copper and steam. Race through blood-soaked gothic streets atop one of 12 unique vehicles as you seek answers behind the origin of this nightmare. Wield powerful weapons to reduce your opponents to scrap, slaughter beasts to raise your top speed, perform tricks and drifts to generate Æther to boost, and overcome challenging boss encounters to unlock the secrets behind this terrible dream. Start your engines, the first race is about to begin. *Controller required for local multiplayer! *This is a free game, but if you want to donate, you can do so here! Ko-fi.com/lwmedia0554
