rows.description_html: The game consists of finishing several levels, solving by clicking with the mouse or using the keyboard to complete the tasks. Classic - by clicking on a square, the others around it change inversely (cross). Do this until all the squares are 0. Pusher - with the help of the keyboard, press the key indicated on the screen, until the matrix is ​​completely finished. Counter - Click on the square until it reaches 0, every time you click, it decreases by 1, but be careful, if the number is negative, you lose the game.

rows.name: Parts of the Elephant
rows.short_description: Weird things are happening in the Elephant Hotel. It's getting late, you're getting drunk, and moments in the lives of strangers are scattered around you like spilled puzzle pieces. Can you put it all together?
rows.description_html: Parts of the Elephant is a short and moody visual novel where you decide which threads to follow as the world keeps moving around you. Explore the liminal space of a creepy hotel, find interesting strangers, and learn lessons vicariously through the brief glimpses of their lives that you can peer into - or just make an ass out of yourself until you pass out drunk in someone's bed. Tonight is a dark puddle for you to play around in, and no-one's going to care about the mess until the harsh light of tomorrow comes.

rows.name: Bomber Royale
rows.short_description: A retro arcade experience.
rows.description_html: This tiny game provides a short retro arcade experience. Gameplay In each short game that lasts a few minutes, the player picks a character, each with their unique character ability, the goal is to destroy the enemies and become the last one standing! The player is able to place bombs to destroy obstacles and damage their enemies, pick up power-ups to enhance their character and items to hinder their enemies. Control Move - WASD (Keyboard) & Left Joystick (Xbox Controller) Place Bomb - J (Keyboard) & X (Xbox Controller) Push Bomb - K (Keyboard) & A (Xbox Controller) Character Ability - L (Keyboard) & B (Xbox Controller) Use Items - U, I, O (Keyboard) & LB, Y, RB (Xbox Controller) Multiplayer Plug in one Keyboard and one Xbox Controller or two Xbox Controllers to enjoy a local two-player game！

rows.name: The Aching Aversion
rows.short_description: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors or surreal worlds waiting within it, all depending on how you broke into it! 6 different bunkers! 16 unique endings!
rows.description_html: A 3D RPGMaker Horror game about exploring a weird bunker. The bunker will have different horrors or surreal worlds waiting within it, all depending on how you broke into it! 6 different bunkers! 16 unique endings! Collect all of the endings, and explore all of the bunkers to figure out how to reach the final bunker... Atmospheric audio and a unique 3D art style come together to create an experience you will remember! A continuation of The Aching Aversion: Blood Orange Dreams... 'Everyone has seen it at some point, we all have an aversion to it, the bunker has invaded your mind at some point in your life. No one has ever entered it... And if the inside has never been seen, how can one be so sure that the inside really exists. Whether it is a safe room, an armoured bunker, a torture dungeon or just empty space depends on the 'input details' of the entrant. No one can try to enter what they have an aversion to.' 7 Steam achievements to unlock.

rows.name: Spark
rows.short_description: You are Spark, an animated and bright bundle of energy. Through exploring an electronic maze in the depths of a computer, you come to understand your purpose in life of bringing connection, vitality, and exuberance to those around you. Spark: Virtue Through Voltage.
rows.description_html: Spark is an adventure-puzzle game that encourages selflessness and provokes thoughtful problem solving. You are Spark, an animated and bright bundle of energy. Through exploring an electronic maze in the depths of a computer, you come to understand your purpose in life of bringing connection, vitality, and exuberance to those around you. By connecting components, solving puzzles, and powering your world, you find purpose through selfless action and dedication to a larger goal. Spark: Virtue Through Voltage. Plug in conductors to unlock progression throughout the stages! Manipulate switches to power your objectives. Connect batteries to their sockets to unlock new gameplay possibilities. Play through three different levels, along with a tutorial to show you the ropes. Uncover a mysterious story that reveals your greater purpose as Spark.

rows.name: [Nightmare Files] Clap Clap
rows.short_description: Clap Clap is a short indie horror game that puts you in the shoes of a house sitter, experiencing strange occurrences in a seemingly ordinary home.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE NEXT GAME IN THE NIGHTMARE FILES SERIES! About the Game You see a newspaper ad about a house-sitting job. Since you're short on money, you decide to sign up. What awaits you... Did I mention that the house you'll be staying at has the latest home automation systems of the 80s!? Now you know! Simply clap twice in any room in the house to toggle the lights on/off. We sure are lucky that there are no entities around that can take advantage of this. Immerse yourself in the environment with amnesia-like physical interactions, volumetric audio and PS1 style graphics. It ain't much, but it's honest work. I suggest you don't go snooping around too much, it's for your own good.

Immerse yourself in the environment with amnesia-like physical interactions, volumetric audio and PS1 style graphics. It ain't much, but it's honest work. I suggest you don't go snooping around too much, it's for your own good.

rows.short_description: Boneless is an experimental Virtual Reality physics sandbox game built to test the limits of what's possible in VR. The game features unique maps, unique weapons, such as guns and swords and multiple enemies.

rows.name: Lovebugz: An Anthro Insect Dating Sim
rows.short_description: A point and click visual novel about bug girls.
rows.description_html: Don't be afraid. These bug girls aren't here to hurt you (most of them, anyway). You're a human garbage man, but one fateful morning you accidentally ask a giant housefly out on a date. Play through a handful of bite-sized dates in this chapter-based visual novel world with point and click exploration elements. Use point and click mechanics to explore an island, room by room, talking to an assorted cast of different bugs and humans (and crabs). Date a handful of different bug girls, learn how they live their lives, and help them with their problems. Choose from different choices that may determine how the date goes. Play through a chapter-based storyline. New chapters will be released in the future. A cute, cartoony art style. Collectable candies!

rows.name: Among The Dead
rows.short_description: Among the Dead is a turn-based zombie RPG. The player fights against zombies and other enemies and walks around a map from a top-down perspective.
rows.description_html: Among the Dead is a turn-based zombie RPG. Players choose a career and try to survive through a zombie apocalypse. Among the dead allows players to walk from an eagle-eye perspective. Players can interact with objects that launch them into dialogue or battle sequences. The battle sequences are turn based and allow players to use items a special or a regular attack. There are six characters to choose from but only one is available at launch.

rows.name: Roller's Escape
rows.short_description: Roll, flip, and problem-solve your way through this geometric platformer. You play as a cube that can change into a sphere to roll through levels to reach a goal. Overcome obstacles and reach the finish line. Will you rise to the challenge?
rows.description_html: About Roller's Escape is a bite-sized platformer that lets you roll around and take control of a cube that you move towards a goal. Once you reach the goal, the character turns into a sphere, which moves towards another goal by rotating the level to get the sphere to roll. Playstyle Avoid dropping the sphere and find the shortest path to the goal with a limited number of attempts. When flipping the cube, you start over if you run out of attempts, so It's important to think about the shortest path to the goal. Depending on the surface area of the path traversed as a cube, you'll either have an easy or hard time rolling the sphere around the level. More Roller's Escape is a platformer with light puzzle-solving, problem-solving, and pixel graphics. In addition, a level progression system transports you to the next level after reaching the goal. There are over 10 levels to explore, with each one being more challenging than the last. Will you rise to the challenge and beat all the levels?

rows.name: Drewdler
rows.short_description: Drewdler is a puzzle platformer where you launch Drew in their orb of armor. Use the unique ability to draw lines and navigate through levels, collect gravity crystals and get back to the portal. Piece levels back together, and save the world!
rows.description_html: Drewdler is a game about trying to traverse through unique landscapes and obstacles as you launch from portal to portal using Drew's unique ability to doodle up to 5 lines per level. In each level you will collect gravitational crystals scattered across fragmented worlds with each crystal collected bringing you one step closer to piecing together the shattered fragments of Drew's world, unveiling its secrets and restoring balance. Roll into action and help Drew restore harmony to their world!

rows.name: Pyramid Game
rows.short_description: Pyramid Game inspires you to comprehend the real world in the game, hope you find your position in the pyramid early!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Pyramid Game! Maybe you are wondering why you need to play this game? Because pyramids are everywhere in the real world. Pyramidal architecture has been found all over the world in the long and bright history of human civilization. When you enter the game, you will be given a corresponding bank account that will immediately arrive with a sum of money, which will be your initial funds. The bank account will be determined by the level of bank you purchase, with the game itself plus the 5 DLCs totaling 6 different levels of bank accounts, and the initial amount of money arriving being the minimum daily closing balance for that level of bank account. Please note that purchasing the DLC does not add wealth to your existing assets, the 6 bank levels generate 6 separate game archives. Because we are not looking for players to increase their wealth in the game by purchasing the DLC, but rather these 6 initial funds symbolize 6 different classes of birth, we want players to experience if the different classes of birth will affect where they end up. Some of our DLC is very expensive, even though we know that players are fully capable of buying it, but we do not want players to buy it, but as a contrast, our original intention is to let players understand that even if they are born with a low starting point, they can still through their own hard work and wisdom finally arrive at a position that belongs to them, maybe in the end, this position is very high, maybe not so high, but both are the most suitable for them, the most admirable. Similarly, even if you were born with a high starting point, it's not easy to maintain your position all the time. Please remember that you will only have this initial amount of money and we will not add any microtransactions to increase your wealth, as the original purpose of this game was to ensure absolute fairness for all players. You can earn salary through different jobs, the current job is some completely randomly generated math calculations and English words, you can choose different number of questions or words and difficulty range to earn the corresponding salary, regularly do these jobs believe that you will be able to get a great enhancement of your personal ability in reality. When you have enough money, you can go to the casino to grow your wealth. Why only the casino? We have considered making a savings and investment system, but no matter what we did, we eventually realized that more money will always have an advantage over less money, and it's not completely fair. Our casino system is also limited to dice and roulette, or other games controlled by a physics engine that we can think of in the future. Our casino system is absolutely fair to anyone of any wealth, through multiple completely random factors and is controlled entirely through mechanics, with no algorithms behind the scenes interfering with the results. Our purpose is to create the New World of Pyramid Game that is completely fair. Why is it called Pyramid Game? Because your personal asset value in the game will be ranked in real time with players all over the world in the Pyramid Game Global Leaderboard, and your wealth changes will be uploaded every minute, and you can see your global ranking changes synchronously. After accumulating a certain number of players, the system automatically weights the total wealth of all players and the percentage of players in each segment, and divides all players into A to Z levels according to their rankings and wealth. Theoretically, Pyramid Game supports an unlimited number of players online all around the world at the same time, with no delay in uploading data and refreshing the global leaderboard at a frequency of once per minute. We are sure that there will be extremely computer talented players who will play this game and maybe you want to change the value of the total assets by modifying the game data. But if you look carefully at the trailer and the screenshots you should have noticed that every transaction and even every result in our casino is recorded precisely to the second. Even though up to 500 to 1500 history records are displayed in the game, but only for different computer configurations and smooth running of the game, every record of this game from the first time it was run to the last is kept intact. Our wealth value is through these data for multidimensional calculation and verification, wealth value does not exist in any of the values in the game, and even each record has a set of hash value generated by a random hash algorithm, we welcome players can crack the modified data to change the wealth to affect the ranking, because it is a reflection of personal ability, but we do not recommend doing so. Even though there is currently no program added that will clear the data if it detects that it has been modified, it is very probable that the modification error causing the data is incomplete resulting in you have to restart the game. By the way, as a reminder, you can check your bank balance while working or vacationing at the casino, you can even check your bank transaction details while playing at the casino then work in your free time to make the most of every minute you have. Pyramid Game inspires you to comprehend the real world in the game, hope you find your position in the pyramid early!

rows.name: The Walking Dead: No Man's Land
rows.short_description: Step into the dangerous world of The Walking Dead: No Man's Land. Lead survivors in turn-based strategy battles, manage resources, and make tough choices to ensure their survival. Fight walkers, build your base, and face endless dangers.
rows.description_html: The Walking Dead: No Man's Land is a tactical RPG that plunges you into the harsh and unforgiving world overrun by the undead. Your mission is to lead a group of survivors through endless dangers, manage resources, and make tough decisions that will determine their fate. ▸ FORM THE ULTIMATE TEAM Gather your ultimate team of survivors, featuring iconic characters from the show, including Rick, Michonne, Daryl, Maggie, Glenn, Negan, Carl, and so many more! Train and upgrade your team to take on hordes of zombies and relive the most intense scenes from The Walking Dead. ▸ FORGE ALLIANCES In this brutal world, your guild is your strongest shield, guiding you through the apocalypse and pushing you forward. Team up with your friends and join the Guild Wars to battle against real players worldwide. Whose team of survivors will come out on top? ▸ BUILD A SAFE CAMP Build a fortified camp to safeguard your survivors, enhance their arsenal, and tend to their wounds after strategic battles and PVP raids. Keep your camp thriving by managing resources and providing food, ensuring your survivors endure the harsh world of The Walking Dead. ▸ EXPLORE Explore various game modes: Season, Story, Distance, Outpost, and weekly challenges. Gather exclusive resources, gain unique skills, and acquire powerful weapons. Master each mode to keep your team ahead of the undead! ▸ STRATEGIC COMBAT Take on hordes of walkers in iconic locations from The Walking Dead, such as Hilltop and Alexandria! Each new battleground introduces unique enemies designed to challenge your tactics. Your survival hinges on every tactical decision and strategic move you make! Survive the Zombie Apocalypse in the World of The Walking Dead!

rows.name: Miya
rows.short_description: The stunning warrior maiden gracefully dances through the battlefield, slicing through demons with her blade, collecting resources, unlocking stunning outfits, and embracing the ultimate thrill of action!
rows.description_html: Dear Commander Welcome to 'Miya,' a brand new action game filled with futuristic technology and dazzling combat! In this game world full of surprises and challenges, you will play the role of the beautiful warrior Miya, embarking on an exciting adventure and engaging in thrilling battles against various enemies. You will experience the exhilarating action design, excellent sense of impact, and block counter system. At the same time, you can also collect fashion items to give Miya a unique look and make her the focus of the future battlefield. Action Design and Sense of Impact The action design of 'Miya' is rich and diverse, featuring not only gorgeous melee attacks but also powerful ranged weapons and cool skills. The sense of impact in the game has also been carefully polished, making every attack exhilarating. Meanwhile, the game also introduces a block counter system, adding more strategy and challenge to the combat. In the fast-paced battles, you need to observe the enemy's movements, accurately block and counterattack to achieve victory. Fashion Collection In the game world of 'Miya,' the fashion designs are unique, featuring a futuristic technology feel and anime-style beauty. By collecting different fashion items, you can create a unique look for Miya, allowing her to shine with stunning brilliance in battle.

rows.name: Ghost Moon High Noon
rows.short_description: Guide the half-ghost bounty hunter Valentina Sombra through the haunted town of La Enmienda in this western top-down puzzle-shooter. Fire off spectral trick shots and wrangle your environment to put down rowdy spirits and help the grieving townsfolk move on.
rows.description_html: People say that if you ride far enough into the desert, you'll find a town built off the river known as the Rio de Almas. This river ferries the souls of the recently-deceased. Lately, these souls have been overstepping, manifesting in the world of the living each night. Now, people have flocked to this town to avoid saying goodbye to their loved ones, stealing precious time away from death. In La Enmienda, you don't have to say goodbye forever. The ghosts have begun lashing out. When the sun sets and the dead greet the living, they are confused and angry, putting the townsfolk in mortal danger. Bounties have been placed on the rowdy spirits, urging someone to put them to rest. It's the perfect job for a daring opportunist like yourself--the kind of job no one else will take. The moon rises over La Enmienda once more, and you are here to collect. Ghost Moon High Noon is an isometric puzzle shooter. You play as the bounty hunter Valentina Sombra, who barely escaped the deadly clutches of the Rio de Almas and is now set on collecting all of the bounties for herself. The job is simple: armed with your spectral revolver, lasso, and recently-acquired semi-corporeal body, you must put down 12 unique restless spirits that have brought hell to earth. Get to know a large cast of unique townsfolk and ghosts, learning their history and quelling their sorrows, before eventually confronting your own. Blaze your trail through a series of complex environments and puzzles, shooting ricochet trick shots, wrangling your environment with your lasso, and phasing through walls to break through the ghosts' defenses one by one.

rows.name: ChronoClone
rows.short_description: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Chrono Clone is a free to play puzzle platformer with multiple levels.
rows.description_html: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Chrono Clone is a free to play first-person puzzle platformer with multiple levels. Explore the mysterious world of Chrono Clone in this brand-new puzzle-action platformer! A science experiment gone horribly wrong has left you stranded between time and you must find your way back to your own timeline. To do this you must: Push buttons! Move boxes! Solve puzzles! Avoid traps and angry robots! Rewind time to create time clones of yourself! Use clones of your past selves to assist you!

rows.name: Mind The Abyss
rows.short_description: Mind the Abyss is a fast-paced movement shooter that combines fourth-dimensional abilities and ever-evolving weaponry within an alien planet.
rows.description_html: What is Mind the Abyss? The pulse of an alien planet shifts the land itself, and the only ones who can put it back together are the scientists at the center and an underprepared Employee 465 who must use the planet’s hidden powers to survive. Uncover the mystery and plunge into the Abyss to harness the power that lies within. Mind the Abyss is a fast-paced first-person movement shooter combining otherworldly abilities and ever-evolving weaponry within an alien planet. Taking inspiration from games like Titanfall and Ultrakill, players will unravel a deep-rooted mystery while blasting their way through the abyss. Gameplay As Employee 465, your life is at stake in an eldritch crystal cave system. There are only two options: run and shoot. The enemies are relentless, from the planet's native species to invasive scientists who failed to unlock its secrets. Evolution is crucial. Your alien weapon can transform into four forms: shotgun, rocket launcher, sniper rifle, and sub-machine gun, giving you the edge in this fight against planetary horrors. Your fourth-dimensional grappling hook power allows you to perfect your physics-based movement in a complex environment. Use platforms to run across walls, propel yourself into the air, and slide around the map. Time is your greatest adversary as you race to solve the planet's mysteries and save your corrupted comrades before it's too late. Story Summary After years of traveling through space, a millennium ship sent by the Sol Fleet finally arrives at its alien destination, the planet Prometheus. After discovering that the planet has resources that behave in strange ways compared to typical Earth elements, the government sent an initial team to research the alien atmosphere before permanent human relocation. Exploration was unstoppable. Once on the planet’s surface, scientists found incredible organisms—plants and fungi, as well as beautiful rock and crystalline structures deeper within the crust. The problem only began when they drilled too deep. Steel against rock, the ground reverberated a pulse through the caverns, changing the very environments around the explorers—and their biology. Scientists morphed into odd creatures as their minds seemed to attune to the planet’s ecosystem. Other creatures came out of hiding to do the same. Meanwhile, Employee 465 lies just far enough away to feel the pulse, somehow resisting its effects. Roaming the laboratory where they were awakened, they find an experimental weapon that would change everything. This weapon, made from rare elements within the lower layers of the Abyss, binds with Employee 465 to grant them the ability to reach into the fourth dimension. This merging causes them to attune to their weapon and its new properties as they descend into newer, more uncanny facilities within the layers. Succumb to the corruption or rise to the challenge. Can you survive the Abyss?

The enemies are relentless, from the planet's native species to invasive scientists who failed to unlock its secrets. Evolution is crucial. Your alien weapon can transform into four forms: shotgun, rocket launcher, sniper rifle, and sub-machine gun, giving you the edge in this fight against planetary horrors. Your fourth-dimensional grappling hook power allows you to perfect your physics-based movement in a complex environment. Use platforms to run across walls, propel yourself into the air, and slide around the map. Time is your greatest adversary as you race to solve the planet's mysteries and save your corrupted comrades before it's too late. Story Summary After years of traveling through space, a millennium ship sent by the Sol Fleet finally arrives at its alien destination, the planet Prometheus. After discovering that the planet has resources that behave in strange ways compared to typical Earth elements, the government sent an initial team to research the alien atmosphere before permanent human relocation. Exploration was unstoppable. Once on the planet’s surface, scientists found incredible organisms—plants and fungi, as well as beautiful rock and crystalline structures deeper within the crust. The problem only began when they drilled too deep. Steel against rock, the ground reverberated a pulse through the caverns, changing the very environments around the explorers—and their biology. Scientists morphed into odd creatures as their minds seemed to attune to the planet’s ecosystem. Other creatures came out of hiding to do the same. Meanwhile, Employee 465 lies just far enough away to feel the pulse, somehow resisting its effects. Roaming the laboratory where they were awakened, they find an experimental weapon that would change everything. This weapon, made from rare elements within the lower layers of the Abyss, binds with Employee 465 to grant them the ability to reach into the fourth dimension. This merging causes them to attune to their weapon and its new properties as they descend into newer, more uncanny facilities within the layers. Succumb to the corruption or rise to the challenge. Can you survive the Abyss?

rows.name: Iterations
rows.short_description: Help solve a crime.
rows.description_html: Welcome to “Iterations”, a narrative story where you play as Cara. Guide Cara through her mission to uncover the truth behind her friend Amy’s tragic fate. Engage with the world and it’s inhabitants, piecing together clues and uncovering the mystery. Iterations was created over a 26-hour hackathon with 7 people of varying skill levels. The goal of the game was to learn Unreal Engine, but also gauge interest in our core game mechanic. While this is a stand-alone game, we see this as a first chapter or episode in a larger story that we would like to tell if there is enough interest. Give Iterations a try for some side-scrolling action in a small town and a nearby park with several interiors and a handful of characters to interact with. There is a mystery to unravel via a modified Groundhog Day-style narrative structure. Each day Cara learns and discovers things by interacting with the environment. The day ends when she goes to bed. She wakes up confused finding that it is the same day over again, but certain actions have changed the world allowing additional progression. From turning your lights on to helping a friend with writer's block, enjoy interacting with the townfolks through nearly 200 lines of dialog with many branching options.

rows.name: Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Are you ready to start shaping fashion? Start working with Prologue now. Make a brand agreement, order products, fill the aisles, dress the mannequins and start selling. A limited number of products for Prologue are waiting for you.
rows.description_html: See Also About the Game Thanks to the Prologue, you will be able to experience the limited version of 'Clothing Store Simulator'. Don't forget to add to your wishlist and follow us for the full version of the game. Design your dream clothes and start selling. Computer and Store Management In-game Manage your store from the in-game computer. You can make brand agreements, order products, set the selling price of products, order furniture and decoration items from the computer. Brand Agreements Make brand agreements. By signing agreements with brands, you can sell their products in your store. People who care about fashion wear brands. Product Placement Pick up the products you have ordered, arrange them on shelves, place them in aisles, hang them on hangers or stock them in your warehouse. You can also put them on a mannequin for display. Store Design Design your store in a trendy and attractive way. Arrange furniture and decorations. Place shelves, hangers, racks and mannequins. Place products in the relevant aisles. You can present your products to customers by dressing the mannequins. Price Determination To grow your customer base, emphasize customer satisfaction. Customers like a balanced price policy. Follow the market. Products with decreasing prices can be stocked. Don't forget to add the full version of 'Clothing Store Simulator' to your wishlist. 'Clothing Store Simulator' is where the heart of fashion beats. Will you stay a small boutique or will you build a big store that sets the fashion trends of the city? A world of fun awaits you.

rows.name: Deadlands Duel: Time Rift Rumble
rows.short_description: Deadlands Duel is a wave-based zombie defense shooter that takes place throughout all of history via time travel. You will fight hoards of zombies with various weapons and armaments. Choose one of four class types to specialize your gameplay to fit your desired role in this team-play focused arena.
rows.description_html: In the Arena of Deadlands Duel, you will fight for your life in intense wave based defense combat against an undead hoard of anomalous creatures. As your powers increase so do the enemies with each passing round. Collect points to upgrade your character and weapons, as well as activate traps around the map to increase your defenses. Play with your friends in the co-op experience focused on team synergy. Choose one of four character classes that each have unique attributes and abilities to enhance your lethality on the fields on time, and Search for secrets hidden within the maps you explore to unlock the secrets of this world as well as unrivaled weaponry to combat the hoards.

rows.name: REAL CAR Offroad Racing Drift
rows.short_description: Race and drift to gain useful points to unlock and customize more than 100 vehicles! Drive freely around a huge open-world environment inspired by Old Wild stories. Explore and have fun driving your own way!
rows.description_html: Get ready to experience the pure adrenaline of REAL CAR DRIFT RACING, the ultimate racing game that will take you to the wild heart of the Old West! Dominate dusty roads, speed through breathtaking canyons, and conquer the vast prairies in an open world full of adventure and surprises. Key Features: Over 100 unique vehicles: Unlock and collect a wide range of cars, each with unique designs and performances, from sleek racing cars to rugged off-roaders ready for any terrain. Exciting race modes: Test your skills in three different race modes: Drift: Slide through tight corners and rack up points with spectacular drifts. Speed: Push the pedal to the metal and leave everyone behind in high-speed races. Offroad: Tackle rough terrain and environmental challenges in extreme off-road competitions. Spectacular stunts and action-based scoring: Perform incredible stunts and jumps in the middle of the desert, launch off improvised ramps, and boost your score with daring maneuvers. Every action you take, from a perfect drift to a breathtaking jump, earns you valuable points, helping you climb the leaderboards and unlock exclusive rewards. Open and explorable world: Explore a vast and detailed open world inspired by the Old West, full of ghost towns, abandoned mines, and stunning natural landscapes. Discover hidden secrets and unique collectibles that will help you upgrade your vehicles and customize your gaming experience. Progression and customization: As you level up, unlock new charismatic characters and powerful vehicles, along with a wide range of upgrades and customizations to make your driving style truly unique. Multiplayer and online leaderboards: Challenge players from around the world in thrilling multiplayer races and climb the online leaderboards to prove you're the best driver in the West. Or, perfect your skills in single-player mode by facing increasingly challenging AI opponents. Stunning graphics and immersive soundtrack: Enjoy breathtaking visuals and an engaging atmosphere thanks to high-quality graphics and a soundtrack that will transport you directly to the Wild West. Get ready to test your courage and driving skills in an unparalleled racing experience. REAL CAR DRIFT RACING awaits you to write your legend on the roads of the Old West! Are you ready to become the king of racing in the Wild West? Start your engines and begin your adventure today!

rows.name: The Mournmore Killings
rows.short_description: The Mournmore Killings a story-driven, deduction based mystery game where you step into the shoes of a detective trying to solve the enigmatic riddles left behind by a serial killer.
rows.description_html: The Mournmore Killings a story-driven, deduction based mystery game where you step into the shoes of a detective trying to solve the enigmatic riddles left behind by a serial killer. Set in the eerie town of Mournmore, you must navigate through a series of crime scenes, read the notes, identify the victims and find out what they were killed for. Key Features: - Make Deductions: There is no inventory system. No hand-holding. You have to make use of your deductions skills and inspect whatever evidence you can find to solve the riddles left by the killer. - A rich story: As you progress through different cases, you will find out the reason behind the killings. - Atmospheric Setting and Music: Dark ambience music to accompany you on the crime scenes. - Retro Graphics: Pixelated, PS1-like graphics to match the eerie tone of the setting.

rows.name: Two Bad Fellas
rows.short_description: In this first person, horror, casual game, you have to protect your Teddy from the Two Bad Fellas. Find quickly a safe spot to hide your buddy and than move him to the next one. Explore the house and solve riddles but be aware, if you hold your Teddy for too long, you will be in big danger!
rows.description_html: In this first person, horror, casual game, you have to protect your Teddy from the Two Bad Fellas. Find quickly a safe spot to hide your buddy and than move him to the next one. Explore the house and solve riddles but be aware, if you hold your Teddy for too long, you will be in big danger! the dancers The hideout Your Teddy The scientist Salvation In the dark scenario of 'Two Bad Fellas,' immerse yourself in a first-person horror experience where your sole mission is to protect your loyal friend, Teddy, from two mysterious antagonists. Explore a haunted house, solve puzzles, and find safe havens for your precious companion. But beware: if held for too long, your Teddy may attract unimaginable dangers! FEATURES: 1. **Protect Your Furry Companion**: Face horror firsthand as you strive to protect your faithful friend, Teddy, from two wicked antagonists. Quickly find safe hideouts for your companion and move cautiously through the haunted house. 2. **Explore a Maze of Mysteries**: Immerse yourself in an intricate and mysterious house, where every room hides dark secrets and crucial clues for your survival. Solve puzzles and uncover the truth behind the nightmare that surrounds you. 3. **Multiple Difficulty Levels**: Challenge yourself with three distinct difficulty levels, tailoring the gaming experience to your preferences. Whether you're a novice seeking a relaxing adventure or a terror veteran looking for an extreme challenge, 'Two Bad Fellas' offers a personalized experience for every player. 4. **Immersive Thrill Atmosphere**: Dive into an enveloping and tense atmosphere, enriched by an evocative soundtrack and unsettling sound effects. Every step you take, every breath you take, brings you closer to the heart of the horror surrounding you. 5. **A Gripping Story to Uncover**: Follow the journey of a young boy as he delves into a dark dream, searching for his lost mother. Confront your deepest fears and delve into the recesses of the protagonist's mind to uncover the truth behind his troubled reality. Prepare for an unforgettable adventure, where courage and determination will be your only weapons against the forces of evil. Enter the world of 'Two Bad Fellas' and confront terror with every fiber of your being.

rows.name: Roberto el Lagarto
rows.short_description: Take on an exciting stealth mission as Roberto the Lizard, a cunning thief. Use special abilities to avoid enemies while you steal valuable treasures in a museum full of challenges.
rows.description_html: Roberto el Lagarto invites you to experience the exciting life of a lizard thief on an adventurous mission: to plunder a museum full of treasures while using your unique skills to avoid security. In this single-player action and stealth game, each theft is a combination of strategy and skill. 🎮 Key Features ✨ Special Abilities 🏃 Sprint : Run at full speed to escape from tricky situations. 👻 Invisibility : Disappear from the sight of security cameras, guards, and visitors for a limited time. 🍬 Bubble Gum : Throw a bubble gum on the ground that slows down any enemy who steps on it, creating timely escape routes. ⚡ EMP : Stun all guards, visitors, and cameras in the museum, giving you a valuable advantage. This ability has limited uses, adding an element of strategy to its usage. 🎯 Game Objective Steal all the exhibited artworks from the museum, each clearly marked. As you accumulate more items, you must tread carefully and hide to avoid being caught. Use your skills to go across the museum and deposit the loot in the delivery areas. 🔍 Environment Interaction 📦 Throwing Objects : Dispose of your loot or stun enemies by throwing stolen objects. 🗿 Delivery Statues : Find odd statues of Roberto in each museum area to securely deposit your loot. These statues will subtly move to reveal the delivery area. 🚨 Diversity of Enemies and Challenges 👮 Guards and Visitors : Guards patrol every area of the museum and they are looking for any anomalies, while visitors can alert guards if they spot you. Stay aware and use your skills to evade them. 📹 Security Cameras : Avoid cameras that are constantly on alert in the museum. If they detect you, they will alert the guards, adding an extra level of security to that area. 🏛️ Game Environment A unique museum with different areas like: war zone, jewelry zone, abstract zone, painting zone, shop, reception, rest areas, and bathrooms. Dynamic challenges with unpredictable movements of visitors and the presence of guards and cameras, creating an exciting, dynamic, and different gaming experience in each playthrough. 🎨 Graphic Style and Animations Colorful cartoon graphics which make it a charming environment around the museum. Exaggerated and entertaining animations that add a touch of humor and charm to the game. Characters with caricatured proportions that provide a unique style. 👤 Game Modes Single Player: Experience how is the life of Roberto the Lizard, a cunning chameleon on a mission to loot the museum. 📖 Story and Narrative Enjoy an easy going action and funny game. Throughout the game, you'll receive calls from eccentric contractors offering you optional missions. Completing these missions will grant you valuable rewards, improving your skills and giving you additional advantages. 🏆 Challenges and Achievements More than 10 optional missions that add depth, diversity, and more challenges to the adventure. 26 Steam achievements to unlock, showcasing your prowess and completed accomplishments in the game.

rows.name: Family Bible Quest
rows.short_description: Experience the wonders of the Bible in a whole new way! Dive into captivating stories alone or with the whole family. Enjoy mini-games such as charades, quizzes, word searches, singing, painting, memorization, and would-you-rather questions. Read, reflect, and have fun!
rows.description_html: Embark on a guided journey through the timeless stories of the Bible with Family Bible Quest! Dive into 30 captivating stories, carefully crafted to engage players of all ages. Whether you're playing solo or gathering the whole family, up to 8 players can join in the fun together. Start each adventure with a moment of reflection through prayer, setting the tone for the immersive experience ahead. Be greeted by beloved characters from the Bible, who will guide you through the narratives. Then, enjoy a random mini-game tailored to the number of players. From charades to sing-alongs, word searches to quizzes, there's something for everyone to enjoy! With its blend of storytelling, reflection, and interactive gameplay, Family Bible Quest offers a unique way to connect with the scriptures as a family. Embark on this adventure together and create lasting memories while exploring the wonders of the Bible. Family Bible Quest is an SGM Canada resource.

rows.name: Cat Meoir: Feline Detective
rows.short_description: Cat Meoir: Feline Detective is an open world exploration game based in the heart of New York City during the early 1950's. The player must use their cat-like skills to solve puzzles, string together clues, and navigate the city to solve the case of their owners murder.
rows.description_html: Uncover secrets, decipher clues, and lurk in the shadows to solve the case After waking up in an alleyway, you must play as Lucio, a talented writer who has just been murdered... and awoken in the body of his pet cat, Shadow. Using the new gift of Cat Abilities, you must work with unexpected allies and collect clues to find who did this to you, all while avoiding the police patrolling the city. Explore the city, solve puzzles, piece together clues, interview other animals, and accuse the murderer to solve the mystery of your own death so you can finally move on to the afterlife peacefully. Will you be the Hunter, or the Hunted? Mr E. is awaiting your answer... Cat Vision When activated, your heightened senses can be used to discover footprints, scents, and objects that may be in your interest. You move slower, but you are able to see things that may not have been visible before. Not only are potential clues highlighted in a bright color, but a scent trail is visible, leading you around objects and walls to follow the scent, as well as going through objects that can be opened, like vents, doors, or hiding spots. Cat Memory Take mental pictures of important objects or prints to unlock more information. All clues are stored in a 'Journal' which serves as your memory, allowing you to look back and trigger flashbacks of certain scenarios that help you connect the dots, helping find out where to go next in your investigation, and how to track down Mr. E. Each clue also has a description of what you found, making it easier to understand what you're looking at and allowing you to piece together the story. Stealth As a cat, you have the ability to squeeze into smaller places, allowing you to hide from the dozens of police officers around the city, who don't want a cat interfering with their evidence. Hide in trash cans, boxes, and other small spaces to avoid being seen, taking the time to assemble your clues before coming out of hiding and continuing to stalk around. You may also hear secret conversations while in a hiding spot, gaining more information to work with in your journal, which could even end up making or breaking your entire investigation. Distraction Sometimes it's hard to sneak away from foes, but in this new cat body, you find it hard to avoid pushing breakable objects off the table... so use this to your advantage! Drop glasses, plates, and other objects to distract humans and get them to move out of your way, or push around bigger objects like boxes to uncover clues that may have been hiding underneath.

rows.name: DuST: undefined
rows.short_description: Protect the core as long as you can from infinite undefined threats.
rows.description_html: We routinely do the work of defining or distinguishing something without difficulty. In particular, shape and color are the criteria used to recognize and differentiate an object only by its appearance. But if the two features are factors that can change as much as they want, that is, if not specifically defined, it would be considerably confusing. Characteristics of the game - It's a game about destroying four different shapes that come randomly in the order they are close to the core. You should hold on as long as possible, destroying them before they reach the core. - A simple, aesthetic and emotional design has been applied. - Music made by the developer's hard work in his own way is inserted, which adds to the confusion. 2024.03 ~ 2024.06 Devoting my first semester grades as freshman, joversound

rows.name: No Contact
rows.short_description: After being left alone on a delivery ship, you find yourself on a space station that has gone to hell. Navigate through the dark corridors of the station while running and hiding from the dark forces in pursuit. Choose who you can trust, while uncovering the mystery of what happened.
rows.description_html: No Contact is a narrative-driven sci-fi horror game, where the player will find themselves trapped on a space station; with bloodthirsty enemies in pursuit. Run, hide, and navigate through the dark corridors of the station while completing puzzles. Discover the truth of what happened on the station, while making choices that will affect the narrative. - Run and hide from the creatures on the station - Use your flashlight to illuminate dark areas - Make choices that affect the narrative - Complete hacking puzzles

rows.name: Parlor Board 3D
rows.short_description: 3D Board Game with Dice
rows.description_html: It is a German parlor game in which each player has four figures that are moved once around the field to the goal. Everyone must try to get all four figures to the finish first, knocking out opponents along the way so they have to start over. Original Game 'Mensch ärgere Dich nicht', Developed by Josef Friedrich Schmidt in 1907/1908. Rules The game has a very simple set of rules through which players can quickly follow and play the game. Each player has 4 pieces that must move around the 40 steps of the board before reaching their safe destination. Players roll a 6-sided die that determines how many steps they can move a piece each turn. The player must roll a 6 before the piece starts moving around the board. Any time a player rolls a number that means his or her piece lands on top of another player's piece, the opponent's piece is sent to the start of the game. The first player to send all four of his pieces to the end is the winner. Techniques Clean C: Procedural programming language. C/C++: Object oriented programming language. STL: The C++ Standard Template Library. Win32 API: Microsoft Windows API. DirectX: collection of application programming interfaces (APIs) for handling tasks related to multimedia, especially game programming and video, on Microsoft platforms. Classify 3 Dimension - Board with chance game

rows.name: Shattered Void
rows.short_description: Space MMORPG where players can fly on different ships, collecting devices, subsystems and navigations or finding new weapons that will serve in battles. Take part in battles, explore the world, mine ore, trade, fight and build your own clan with a station.
rows.description_html: A game inspired by the style and setting of Space Rangers. Endless dangers of space open up endless opportunities for development: 5 starting factions to choose from Raids, bosses, wars Economics, trade, market manipulation Asteroid mining, smelting, crafting Simple but at the same time complex system of modifications and interconnections of ship sub-systems A lot of systems Hundreds star systems await exploration and colonization. In remote reaches of space, wormholes occasionally open into unknown sectors, where both dangerous enemies and huge loot can be found. Soft PvP You do not lose equipment if you are destroyed by another player or NPC, only items that were in your cargo hold. Thanks to your personal fighting skills, you can overcome even strong opponents. And to prevent constant murders, you will be protected by patrols and military personnel in their systems, while the sectors themselves are divided by strength, preventing strong players from approaching weak ones. Stations Create your own flying fortress. Engage in trade and collect taxes for the use of station space by other players. Factories, shops, mining facilities, warp gates for long-distance flights - dozens of different buildings will make the station even more useful. In addition, stations are necessary for the colonization and terraforming of captured planets or the construction of space megastructures. Modifications of equipment and ships Spaceships are a platform for installing weapons, systems, devices, and drones. Ships are upgraded using collected resources, allowing you to choose your development style. In addition, each race has its own unique pieces of equipment, and their ships have different strengths and weaknesses: shields and energy, speed and repairability, damage and armor, hull and regeneration, and many others. Weapons and systems are easily transferred between ships. Therefore, it always makes sense to strengthen your favorite equipment. Modularity Weapons can have module slots. Hundreds of different effects on modules allow you to make each gun unique and adapt to any battle scenario. This is a way to increase your overall power significantly by quality over quantity Cooperative game Groups of players are needed to coordinate boss battles and clear out certain locations. Many players unite into clans, which simplifies access to stations, storage facilities, hypergates and all other clan property. Customizable appearance You can not only change skin of your ship (to other faction or race, for example) but also modify it look by adding your stickers. Which, in a creative way, quite an opportunity to showcase yourself

rows.name: Idle Grid
rows.short_description: Build and optimize your industrial empire in this grid-based idle game. Place factories, power plants, and research labs strategically to maximize efficiency through adjacency bonuses. Upgrade your buildings, manage power consumption, and watch your profits soar while you're away.
rows.description_html: Idle Grid A minimalist factory-building idle game where efficiency meets strategy. Design, expand, and optimize your industrial empire on a dynamic grid system. Gameplay Build and manage an ever-growing network of factories, power plants, and research facilities in this addictive idle game. Place buildings strategically to maximize their efficiency through proximity bonuses and upgrade paths. Key Features: 🏭 Strategic Building Placement * Position factories next to power plants for maximum efficiency * Create research clusters to boost production * Use compactors to multiply your factory outputs * Every building placement matters with the adjacency bonus system ⚡ Power Management * Balance power production and consumption * Build backup power storage for emergencies * Manage brownouts and blackouts strategically * Upgrade power plants to meet growing demands 📈 Deep Progression System * Three upgrade tiers for every building type * Multiple upgrade strategies:   * Single building upgrades   * Max level upgrades   * Mass upgrade all buildings of the same type * Research facilities provide stackable income bonuses 🏗️ Building Types * Factories - Your primary income generators * Power Plants - Keep your grid running * Research Labs - Boost factory efficiency * Warehouses - Expand storage capacity * Compactors - Multiply factory output 💾 Quality of Life Features * Auto-save system * Export/Import save files * Zoom and pan controls * Keyboard shortcuts for quick actions * Clear visual feedback for all actions Endless Optimization Every decision matters in Idle Grid. Will you focus on maximizing factory output, research efficiency, or power generation? Create your own strategies and watch your industrial empire grow while you're away. Perfect for both active management and idle progression, Idle Grid offers a satisfying blend of strategic depth and incremental growth. [incrementaldb_verification: MightyIdle355]

rows.name: Loving Life
rows.short_description: Originally released in 2012, Loving Life is a non-fictional auto-biographical visual novel about Zhenghua Yang (Z) and the near-fatal incident which led to the founding of Serenity Forge. This is where it all began.
rows.description_html: 'I cried, but not because I wanted to live longer. I cried because I realized how painful it would be for the ones who love me.' Loving Life is a short, non-fictional autobiographical visual novel created in 2012 by Zhenghua Yang (Z), the founder of Serenity Forge, as a reflection on a near-fatal incident that changed his life. Story At age 18, Z was a typical college student: driven by academic performance, struggling with family pressure, and wrestling with the viewpoints of his peers. However, as his first semester of college came to a close, his ordinary life would dissolve... with a 14 hour nosebleed and mere hours left to live. Loving Life is Z's honest reflection of this episode of his life, weaving between prose, dialogue, and dream, as he traverses the deadly space between his present life, his past, and whatever that may come next. Features Loving Life was the first product released under the Serenity Forge label, and it marks an origin for the studio's commitment to emotional honesty, artistic experimentation, and narrative exploration. To commemorate Serenity Forge's 10th anniversary, we remastered and released on Steam with a raft of quality of life enhancements. Now, fans of the studio, new and old, can see where it all began. A Personal Reflection: As an auto-biographical VN, Loving Life tells its story with equal parts poetic recollection and honest conclusions. Read Z's memories, follow his thoughts, and live through his dreams as he navigates this profound episode in his life. Beautiful Visions: All of the game's art is hand-painted, from portraits of Z's friends to the surreal dreamscapes he traversed while in recovery. The Origin Story of Serenity Forge: Experience a story that reveals the cultural foundation of Serenity Forge, and that itself is an example of the studio's experimentation with games as vessels for meaning and emotional impact. Remastered for Modern Platforms: Play with modern conveniences such as font accessibility controls, audio controls, text speed adjustments, and select remastered assets, with corrections to visuals and rendering on modern monitors.

rows.name: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time
rows.short_description: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time is a strategic card game where players harness iconic characters, creatures, and the mystical forces of the One Power from the legendary fantasy world. Build decks, master unique abilities, and outplay opponents in dynamic, lore-rich battles.
rows.description_html: Unleash legendary heroes within Cards of Eternity and dive deep into the world of The Wheel of Time. Perfect strategic combat: collect, trade, and unleash powerful cards to outmaneuver opponents. Take part in journeys across mystical realms, participate in extreme PvP Battles, and summon companions to help your quest. This high-fantasy CCG offers innovative features such as 2v2 play and a unique mode: The Gauntlet. It promises to challenge veterans and newcomers alike with thrilling tactical gameplay in an epic universe created by Robert Jordan.

rows.name: Le Dernier Don
rows.short_description: Following a tragic event in an orphanage caused by horrific human experiments, an orphan tries to find other survivors while danger still lurks.
rows.description_html: In 'LE DERNIER DON', you play as Lucie, a young orphan at the end of the First World War, in France. After disobeying the mistress at the orphanage she resides in, she gets thrown into the broom closet to spend the night, whilst the rest of the children celebrate the end of the war. As she breaks out from isolation, discover what sinister secrets are being held in this scary and stressful environment. You will be navigating through the orphanage, looking for answers in this narrative horror experience. This game was realized as part of our Bachelor degree's graduation project at the School of Digital Arts, Animation and Design (NAD).

rows.name: Carrion Fields
rows.short_description: A completely free online multiplayer text-based RPG game. No pay to win, no pay for perks, COMPLETELY free. Experience roleplay, PvP, PvE, and more in a vast fantasy world with in-depth history. Enjoy 21 races and 17 classes in an ever-evolving world.
rows.description_html: Carrion Fields is one of the longest-running online RPGs in the world, a hardcore, text-based grandfather to games like World of Warcraft and Everquest. It's a cross between a tabletop roleplaying game and an MMORPG. Enter Thera, a dark, fantasy land roiled by eternal wars among mortal factions and gods alike. No one is ever truly safe from monsters, fellow adventurers, or the inexorable ravages of time. Make your mark on Thera using your wits, your weapons, diverse schools of magic, or by drawing power from the gods themselves. Write a story for your character and give them life in a vast world over 30 years in the making, filled to the brim with secrets and mysteries that you can uncover and use to your advantage. Carrion Fields is completely free and run by a staff of dedicated volunteer 'Immortals,' who act as Game Masters and roleplay as the world's gods. Overhead is covered by dedicated players' donations. No pay-to-play. No paying for in-game perks or cosmetic items. We don't care how much money you have - just how fast you can think and how good your story is. - Our world is always growing. Carrion Fields boasts hundreds of PvE quests, puzzles, raids, dungeons, and other areas, with more always in the works. - Carrion Fields features a nuanced and strategic PvP system, including 'cabal' factions' never-ending battles for power. - Players can choose from 21 races, 17 classes, 7 player-run cabals, and numerous unique customization options and opportunities that ensure no two characters need ever be alike. - Necromancers can become undead creatures of great power: Liches, Vampyres, Wights or Mummies. Shapeshifters can learn to transform into powerful or even mythical beasts. Warriors can gain fearsome skills by specializing in weapons and learn incredible abilities from warrior-monks. Thieves can learn to mix poisonous brews and set traps. Rangers can gain mastery over specific terrains, use archery or travel with beast companions. And much more! - Compete with other players to discover or plunder powerful limited and legendary items. - No matter how much power you amass, no one survives Thera. Characters can last for hundreds of hours of gameplay, but all are doomed to die of old age - if they survive that long. - Role-play is required and enforced in Carrion Fields. Everyone you meet in Thera is fighting their own battle, writing their own story, and hoping, just as you are, to come out on top. Ready to join us? Now, all you need to do is decide: By what name do you wish to be mourned? What is Carrion Fields Carrion Fields is a text-based MUD (multi-user dungeon) that was created in 1994. It is an online game with enforced roleplay. Everything is done in-character to maximize the immersive world you'll try to survive in. Founded: January of 1994 Codebase: Rom (19+ years away from Rom 2.3) Theme: RP / PK Areas: 250+ original areas (23k rooms) Helpfiles: 2,000+ Races: 21 (plus a seasonal race!) Classes: 17 Cabals (Clans): 7 Quests: 300+ Absolutely, 100% free - no pay-for-perks Customization: deep class-based specialization Is Carrion Fields really free? Yes. COMPLETELY free . There is no pay-to-play, there is no pay-to-win. You can't buy any in-game benefits. Your success is left up to your skill and dedication. Roleplay Carrion Fields has enforced roleplay. Meaning you play as your character, not yourself. You may be a righteous paladin annihilating wicked souls from the world, or a sly thief attempting to fence stolen goods - but no matter what you will always be in-character . Carrion Fields aims for an immersive experience that includes PvP (player vs. player) and PvE (player vs. environment) while expecting valid roleplay at all times. PvP Want to try your hand at a complex and competitive system? Carrion Fields offers a system of PvP that feels like it is a natural extension of its fantasy world. There are no true safe areas, nobody is completely immune to violence. You might try to stay safe within your class's guildhall, but what if your foe is strong enough to murder the well-trained guild guard? PvE The world in Carrion Fields is vast. You might sit in a tavern and drink, discussing stories and tales with your compatriots. You also might leave the safety of the populated cities and venture into vast subterranean caverns filled with unknown danger, or explore lost vaults with puzzling magic, or try your hand at facing the ancient dragons which defend their lairs with awe-inspiring power. In Carrion Fields grouping up is not unusual, as sometimes it is the only way to survive in dangerous areas. A completely free online multiplayer text-based RPG game. Experience roleplay, PvP, PvE, and more in a vast fantasy world with in-depth history. Enjoy 21 races and 17 classes in an ever-evolving world. Carrion Fields is a unique blend of roleplaying and complex, hardcore PvP combat that has been running continuously, and 100% free, for over 30 years. An unforgiving, text-based world with a supportive community. Join us for a real challenge and real rewards: adrenaline-pumping battles, memorable quests, and stories that will stick with you for a lifetime. Additional Information and Help Carrion Fields is a complex game and the learning curve can feel steep. We recommend you join our discord and read through our site to get an idea of how to maximize your chances of success in this brutal yet fulfilling world. You can also customize your UI and adjust it to whatever suits your tastes by looking through Mudlet's magnificent documentation.

rows.short_description: Magic Farm is a simple and short bullet hell

rows.name: SHOTBALL
rows.short_description: An adrenaline-pumping 3v3 class-based shooter sport game.
rows.description_html: Shotball is fast-paced, team-based shooter sport game where players use shotguns to play football in explosive 3v3 matches, Build your ultimate loadout, use advanced movement to outplay your opponents and smash in goals with style! Forget everything you know about football, in Shotball everything is a target. Combining precise shooting mechanics with competitive sports gameplay, every match is a chaotic dance of passing, blasting and scoring, The shotgun is your tool for offense, defense, and everything in between. Shotball’s arenas are your playground. Chain wall runs, double jumps, slides, and air slides to build unstoppable momentum and outpace your opponents. Every movement skill fuels your speed, letting you set up lightning-fast attacks, daring saves, and jaw-dropping highlights. No two Loadouts fight the same in Shotball. With unique abilities, perks, and ultimates, you can tailor your loadout to match your playstyle, from agile goal-scorers to heavy-hitting enforcers. Adapt your class, counter your rivals, and find your perfect strategy!

rows.name: Fire Magician: Arcana
rows.short_description: 'Fire Magician' is a third-person action shooter game where the player controls a cute magician named Arcana, battling poker enemies. By stacking energy, the player can use cool wind and fire abilities to defeat the Poker King, Suoha, reclaim the Wheel of Fortune, and save their plundered homeland!
rows.description_html: The story follows the homeland of Tarot, the Wheel of Fortune, which has been invaded by mechanical poker cards from the future. Players take on the role of the returning magician, 'Arcana,' who gradually regains their power with the help of the survivor, 'The Fool.' Flame Dash The magician can use flame abilities to dash between enemies. Cards Infused with Wind and Fire Elements Imbue your attacks with wind and fire, striking and piercing through enemies. Epic Mechanical Bosses and Armies About the Team This game was originally a university project. After graduation, we reformed the team, refined and optimized the game, and uploaded it to the Steam platform for those interested to play. If you enjoy the game and would like to contact the development team, feel free to reach out to us via our Facebook fan page. We’re open to chatting or discussing the game content. We will update the game periodically.

rows.name: MeowFall
rows.short_description: MeowFall is a charming 2D platformer in pixel art style. Take control of an adorable cat, overcome obstacles and uncover the secrets. Are you ready for an adventure to find the best hat ever?
rows.description_html: Get ready for an epic journey in search of the ultimate prize: the best hat ever! Think you're up to the challenge? Embark on a journey inspired by classic gaming challenges, where every victory feels like a triumph. Take on the role of an adorable kitten on an epic quest to find the hat of dreams. Navigate through vibrant yet perilous worlds, brimming with cunning traps, cleverly hidden secrets, and bonus levels. Key Features: 🎯 Tough Challenges: This game isn't for the faint-hearted! Every jump and dodge needs to be spot-on to conquer the trials ahead. 🔍 Discover Secrets: Uncover hidden treasures, unlock secret passages, and explore meticulously crafted bonus levels that offer unique challenges and rewards. 🎩 Fabulous Hat Collection: Seek out and collect a variety of fabulous hats scattered throughout the game. 🪤 Crafty Traps: Watch out for the tricky traps lurking around every corner! From sneaky spikes to mind-bending platforms, each level tests your reflexes and smarts. 🎵 Awesome Music: Immerse yourself in the game's world with a charming, energetic soundtrack that sets the perfect mood for your adventure.

rows.name: Battle Against the Acolytes of Science
rows.short_description: A story-driven 2D bullet hell shooter set in the afterlife. An emotional journey of young heroines as they confront the science worshippers known as 'Chemistians' Vibrant pixel art vividly portrays the world and narrative. 'Welcome to 'The Crystal Palace'...'
rows.description_html: Game Overview '...The horizon is still dark. The afterlife has long nights.' ~ Sofia Chemistians 'BAAS' is a story-driven 2D bullet hell shooting game set in the afterlife. The gameplay is a hybrid of side-scrolling action and bullet hell shooting. Control your character to avoid dynamic and diverse high-density attacks unleashed by enemies. Defeat foes using unique attacks with up to 5 levels, shots, and special moves. Story 'I want to choose a future where I won't regret my past.' ~ Shigure Hitofuri The 'afterlife' is neither heaven nor hell—it's a world where spirits of humans who died with lingering attachments to the living world end up. In the 19th century, Shigure Hitofuri, a swordsman who lost her life in the Boshin War, lives in a 'settlement' along the shores of a lake where the dead wash ashore. One day, she becomes involved in a battle with 'Chemistians,' a mysterious organization from the British Empire that has invaded the afterlife. In this dawn of scientific advancement, the British Empire's 'Chemistians,' having pioneered the Industrial Revolution, are armed with overwhelming scientific and military power. Gatling guns, steam-powered aircraft, airborne troops... The Chemistians' assassins unleash an array of cutting-edge weapons. Through battles where various emotions—beliefs, ambitions, loyalty, friendship, admiration, atonement—intersect, Shigure cuts her way through with only her sword. Beyond lies the revelation of the purpose of the 'three' individuals leading the Chemistians. The game vividly portrays its world and story with vibrant pixel art. Characters 'Everyone has things they'd rather forget. Especially those who linger in the afterlife, who inevitably have regrets from their past life' ~ Fumi Hotori The game is set in the afterlife, a place where spirits of the dead with unfinished business wash ashore. Each character carries their own lingering attachments. Through battles with seven bosses appearing throughout the stages, past grudges and wills that remain after death are revealed. Witness each of their personal stories. Aside from the serious storyline, the game features female characters that reflect the creator's preferences. People who like these types of characters might find them particularly appealing: - Carefree yet powerful characters - Tall women - Cute girls with rugged machines - Characters with glasses - Silent assassins - Gun enthusiasts - Shady ladies who have a mysterious aura

rows.name: Memory Quickie
rows.short_description: Embark on a nostalgic journey with Memory Quickie, the classic card-matching game reimagined for the digital era. Test your memory and concentration as you uncover pairs of cards in this timeless pastime.
rows.description_html: Embark on a nostalgic journey with Memory Quickie, the classic card-matching game reimagined for the digital era. Test your memory and concentration as you uncover pairs of cards in this timeless pastime. Key Features: Classic Gameplay: Enjoy the familiar gameplay of the traditional memory game, where you flip cards to find matching pairs. Three Difficulty Levels: Tailor the challenge to your skill level with three difficulty settings: Easy, Medium, and Hard. Each level presents a different size of the board, ensuring fun for players of all ages and expertise. Score-Based Challenges: Race against the clock and aim for the lowest number of flips to earn high scores. Compete with friends and family or challenge yourself to beat your personal best. Engaging Visuals: Immerse yourself in a charming world of colorful cards. The vibrant visuals enhance the gaming experience. Relaxing Soundtrack: Unwind with a soothing soundtrack that accompanies your gameplay. Let the tranquil melodies enhance your concentration as you delve deeper into the world of Memory Quickie.

rows.name: Poetry Pigeon
rows.short_description: Fly frantically between fast-approaching obstacles by typing classic poems! Put your skills of both typing and timing to the test in this new spin on an old favorite! Prefer to fly casual? Try relaxed mode instead and take in the beauty of balladry!
rows.description_html: Fly frantically between fast-approaching obstacles by typing classic poems! Put your skills of both typing and timing to the test in this new spin on an old favorite! Prefer to fly casual? Try relaxed mode instead and take in the beauty of balladry! Every letter you type causes the pigeon to fly! Can you last an entire poem without hitting any obstacles? With 5 poems of varying length and difficulty, there's plenty of aviating action to look forward to. Looking for a more relaxed experience? Turn off obstacles and focus on enjoying the leisure of lyricism! Each level features a beautiful pixel art background based on the level's poem. Too easy? Try doing it backwards! This challenge is only for the bravest of bards — have you got what it takes? Featuring the works of: Emily Dickinson Paul Laurence Dunbar Lola Ridge Oscar Wilde Percy Bysshe Shelley

rows.name: Kilonova
rows.short_description: Embark on a journey of revenge as Sol, a warrior of the celestial cosmos, as she fights to repel the corruption that has shackled the creatures of a fractured world. Wield her cosmic strength to shatter your foes and expunge the malevolent influence of the cosmos most ancient enemy; The Kilonova!
rows.description_html: Embark on a journey of revenge as Sol, a warrior of the celestial cosmos, as she fights to repel the corruption that has shackled the creatures of a fractured world. Wield her cosmic strength to shatter your foes and expunge the malevolent influence of the cosmos most ancient enemy; The Kilonova! Will you avenge your people and free this world, or succumb to the entropy of its eternal power? The fate of the cosmos rests in your hands. Defeat waves of enemies with cosmic powers Luminescent, atmospheric, and impactful sound Striking stylized low-poly visuals with an emphasis on celestial elements contrasted again harsh, jagged golden corruption Beautiful celestial world, sprawling with alien foliage and fractured terrain Deliver melee combos across three levels of increasingly challenging arenas This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: UPUPUP
rows.short_description: UPUPUP is a jumping action game. Go up to the sky with the lonely protagonist. Navigate through multiple obstacles, try not to fall, and reach your destination. To reward your efforts, your jumping power will increase as you jump. It is not saved. Fail, adapt, and try again.
rows.description_html: About This Game UPUPUP is a jumping action game. Go up to the sky with the lonely protagonist. Navigate through multiple obstacles, try not to fall, and reach your destination. To reward your efforts, your jumping power will increase as you jump. It is not saved. Fail, adapt, and try again. Does the level increase every time you jump? In this game, experience points increase each time the character jumps, and when the character reaches 100%, the level increases by 1. As the level increases, your jumping power increases. There is no save, but your effort is rewarded with jumping power. Controls Character movement is done using W, S, A, and D, and jumping is done with the space bar. If you are unable to move because the terrain is stuck, you can reset to the initial position with the R button.

rows.name: FragPunk
rows.short_description: FragPunk is a thrilling 5v5 hero shooter where Shard Cards allow you to break the rules of combat and ensure that no two rounds are ever the same. Get ready to unleash your skills!
rows.description_html: WITCH MOON - CHAPTER 2 About the Game FragPunk is a thrilling 5v5 hero shooter where Shard Cards allow you to break the rules of combat and ensure that no two rounds are ever the same. Get ready to unleash your skills! Break the Rules with Shard Cards Dive into the action of FragPunk and break the rules with countless Shard Cards! Wanna give your allies some 'motivation'? Shoot at them to increase their speed and fire rate! Need some HP? Just crouch, lay an egg and eat it! With Shard Cards, no rule stands in your way. They can also combine and counter each other, adding an exciting tactical layer to the classic bomb-defuse experience. And every Shard Card is completely and forever free for all players—no paywalls in sight! Jump in and unleash endless possibilities in FragPunk! Be Any Lancer You Want to Be Numerous diverse Lancers, each with unique skills, personalities and outrageous dialog and to suit your preference. Blow up your enemies with a rocket launcher, set traps, backstab while invisible, pilot a drone tank and more! The One and Only Duel! In FragPunk, you can be your own Lancer and a team player at the same time. The action reaches its peak when the exhilarating Duel phrase starts after a tie! In this intense 1v1 showdown, it's all about your mastery as players face off in a true test of skills. Jump in and fight! Duel can also be played as an individual mode in the Arcade. Variety that Fuels Replayability Find your favorite guns, many of which have special abilities! Are you a sword, sniper or pistol fan? Explore and develop your personal combat style! Every game lets you slap stickers on the guns. But what about on your name card, or even your Lancer’s head? Sticker-bomb every corner for that extra flair, before you step into the battlefield and showcase your style! Explore Various Modes With so many game modes available, the Arcade offers weekly rotations to keep the action fresh and exciting each time you play! Defend humanity, or turn as many humans as possible into zombies in the 'Outbreak' mode! Or test your weapon skills in a variety of single-weapon-type modes, from melee battles to sniper duels, to pistol showdowns and rocket skirmishes. Immersive Maps & Vibrant Visuals! Maps in FragPunk are designed to immerse players in a vibrant multiverse, offering an array of  different environments to explore. Feast your eyes on bold colors, sharp shapes and dynamic lines to provide you with diverse visual experiences while the bullets fly. Prepare to be captivated by the rich aesthetic and thrilling gameplay that await you in FragPunk!

rows.description_html: 'Scary Horror' is an innovative game in the analog horror genre. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of an abandoned and cordoned off neighborhood!
