rows.name: Crimson Snow Deluxe
rows.short_description: CRIMSON SNOW DELUXE: A psychological horror RPG where you destroy the world you've created...
rows.description_html: In this RPG set in the Medieval-Renaissance era of the 1530s, you are a being named Phantom Scott, who after a turn of events in his childhood, vows to destroy the world he has created. It's up to you to decide which path to take for him... This game is an expanded version (well, pretty much the full game) of the prototype build released in November 2022! You do not have to play the prototype version to enjoy this game. Features: -Original art and soundtrack! Exactly what it says on the tin! -Virtual Pet Menu! Take care of Phantom Scott, but check this menu throughout your journey, as each of its two meters reaching 0 can lead to consequences... -Unique Battle System! Shows you where you're from and where your opponent currently is during each turn! -Up to 6 different endings (The demo has up to 3)! The choices you make and how much you collect determines what lies at the end of each route... - Up to 20-30 Hours of Gameplay! Each main route will take you about 5 hours to complete depending on your reading speed... -Collectable items! Collect scrolls throughout your journey and learn more about the being that is Phantom Scott... What really is he? He certainly isn't human like he appears...

rows.name: Beat Battle
rows.short_description: Beat Battle is a local multiplayer rhythm game for 2-4 players! Hit the arrows in time with the music to earn power-ups that can sabotage your opponents and help you emerge from the dance battle victorious.
rows.description_html: Beat Battle is a local multiplayer rhythm game for 2-4 players! Looking for the strategy and hand-eye coordination of a rhythm game with the chaotic sabotage of Mario Kart that you can enjoy with your friends? Gather a friend or two and play Beat Battle! Hit the arrows to the beat of the songs and maintain your streak, earning points and powerful items on the way! By hitting in time to the songs, you can earn items that can let you stun your opponents, shield yourself from attacks, and even earn solos to give yourself a boost. Play with 2 to 4 people adjusting the difficulty as you and your friends get better and better! Though skill and a quick reaction time will earn you points, the power-ups you and your opponents get mean it could be anyone's game. Support for MacOS currently in progress!

rows.name: Hamstörm
rows.short_description: Hamstörm is a turn-based puzzle game where you play as a dwarf hamster who must go warn his people of the imminent invasion by the Chedd'Ore clan. Help Hamstörm make his way through the various mines, now infested with terrible rats!
rows.description_html: The mines of the great city of Hamsteria were peaceful and thriving, until the day the horrible rats of the Chedd’Ore clan attacked! Now, the valiant Hamstörm must go back to the city to warn the people about the arrival of these nasty rodents in their tunnels. Travel through a fun and colourful puzzle game, in which you will help Hamstörm make his way inside the mine’s tunnels, now infested with terrible rats! Whether it’d be by destroying crystals, shattering the ground beneath their feet or by setting off traps, you’ll need every trick in the book to make it out in time! This game was developed over 15 weeks by a group of 6 students from the University of Quebec at Chicoutimi as part of a bachelor's capstone project.

rows.name: Reality patrol: Prologue
rows.short_description: Join the 'Reality Patrol' agents in this stealth-action game where you can stop absurd conspiracies of villains trying to change history. Disguise yourself, use gadgets to protect timeline
rows.description_html: ✨ WISHLIST FULL GAME ✨ About the Game Reality patrol: prologue is third person stealth-action game. Travel through time to different eras to protect history from absurd villains. Use your sci-fi gadgets and skills to complete your assignment with maximum effectiveness. Try to work quietly and cleanly so as not to change human history. There are multiple ways to complete your objective. The prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Prologue Features: Introductory Story - Experience the beginning of a story. The prologue includes tutorial and first level. Familiarization - Get comfortable with the game's controls and mechanics, setting you up for success in the full game. Visual and Audio Treat - Enjoy the same high-quality graphics and atmospheric soundtrack as the main game.

rows.name: Ker-Chunk!
rows.short_description: Kalva is a bit clumsy, losing all his catnip, but maybe, just maybe, this weird catnip-eating cave has some treasure in it.
rows.description_html: HIIIII im kalva. I love stikrs and nip. my favorate foob is cearbord. can you help me find my nip? Ker-Chunk! is a small game I made as my senior thesis. You follow Kalva, a Co-Alo, and his journey to find treasure as well as his missing catnip. The game is a 3D sidescroller with some hand-drawn elements. The entire game is voice-acted, subtitled, and easy to play. Ker-Chunk is also very PG and safe for all audiences. I spent many months creating this small slice of planet Bethal, so enjoy! -Mint

rows.short_description: Ad Agency Simulator: Prologue offers a short simulation experience for those who want to pursue a career in advertising. Are you ready to create your own ad designs and manage your ad agency starting from a small ad office?
rows.description_html: WISHLIST FULL GAME About the Game Prologue offers a more limited experience compared to the full version. rows.name: Janosik 2: Prologue
rows.short_description: Pick up the mantle of the plucky maiden getting ready for her date night that is unceremoniously interrupted by the dastardly duo of Countess Bathory and Baron de Blonde in this prologue to the colourful Janosik 2 retro action-platformer…
rows.description_html: Wishlist Janosik 2 About the Game Janosik 2: Prologue is an introduction to 'Janosik 2', presenting a separate story that takes place right before the events of the main game. Take on the role of Janka, Janosik's beloved, who is getting ready to meet up with her boyfriend. Little does she know that her plans are about to be disrupted by the evil Baron de Blonde, acting on behalf of the even more wicked Countess Bathory. Use Janka's abilities to overcome various obstacles and enemies. Metroidvania-style gameplay allows exploring previously visited locations to discover new secrets and bonuses through newly acquired skills. Features: Play as Janka: Step into the shoes of Janka, Janosik’s beloved, on an exciting adventure Unlock New Abilities: Gain powerful abilities like double jump, freezing enemies, dashing through air, illuminating darkness, and wall climbing, with the help of Baba Yaga and her shop 8 Challenging Levels : Explore 8 unique levels filled with challenging obstacles and deadly enemies Metroidvania-style gameplay: Revisit previously explored areas and uncover hidden secrets and treasures with the help of newly unlocked abilities

rows.name: Find the Orange Narwhal
rows.short_description: Overcome your crippling hangover and work out how to get the Narwhal back! Point-and-click your way around town, run errands, and uncover the mystery. But choose who you help carefully - your decisions may come back to bite you! Think outside the box and brace yourself for a fever-dream adventure!
rows.description_html: Overcome your crippling hangover and work out how to get the Narwhal back! Point-and-click your way around town, run errands, and uncover the mystery. But choose who you help carefully - your decisions may come back to bite you! Think outside the box and brace yourself for a fever-dream adventure! Find the Orange Narwhal is an interactive fiction remake of a game originally made in PowerPoint (yes that's right... in 4606 slides). Frankly the plot makes absolutely no sense and was just an excuse to do a multiverse mash-up of game themes and mechanics. We've got everything from: Pirates Ninjas Police Clowns Mermaids Zombies ...and more NPCs! Inspired by the Flash games of the early 2000s: embrace the chaos and get the satisfaction of finishing a challenge you didn't know you needed to begin with!

rows.short_description: This is an idle text game based on the Three Kingdoms. As the game progresses, the system will randomly trigger various events, and automatically trigger various military commands and various internal affairs facilities according to different development situations.

The characters in the team are composed of generals in the Three Kingdoms. As the game progresses, the system will randomly trigger various events, and automatically trigger various military orders and various internal affairs facilities according to different development situations. rows.name: Keeper's Curse
rows.short_description: Welcome to the mysterious and haunted island of “Keeper’s Curse”. In this action-packed survival third-person shooter, you’ll face relentless waves of cursed creatures while unraveling the secrets of the island and striving to escape its sinister grasp.
rows.description_html: Description Welcome to the mysterious and haunted island of “Keeper’s Curse.” Prepare to embark on a thrilling adventure as Casey Trench, a scuba diver who finds himself stranded on the island’s eerie shores. In this action-packed survival third-person shooter, you’ll face relentless waves of cursed creatures while unraveling the secrets of the island and striving to escape its sinister grasp. Key Features Engaging Gameplay: Survive against hordes of cursed creatures as you scavenge for resources and navigate through treacherous terrain. Dynamic Environments: Explore a beautifully crafted island shrouded in fog and mystery, filled with hidden dangers and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Strategic Resource Management: Gather resources to build bridges in order to power generators, and unlock new areas of the island, all while fending off relentless foes. Compelling Narrative: Unravel the tragic backstory of the island and its former keeper, Bo Barnacle, whose spirit haunts its shores, driving the cursed inhabitants to attack any intruders. Toon Visuals: Experience a unique and captivating art style that brings the island and its inhabitants to life in a way that is both charming and terrifying. Story Once a thriving community, the island fell under the curse of its keeper, Bo Barnacle, whose obsession with the island’s newfound inhabitants led to his demise. Now, Casey Trench must navigate through Bo’s twisted legacy, facing his nightmares brought to life, and unlock the secrets that will lead to his salvation. Will you brave the Keeper’s Curse and escape the island, or become another victim of its haunted shores? The choice is yours in “Keeper’s Curse.”

rows.name: Dead Blue Rose
rows.short_description: A multiplayer horror where you escape a laboratory at the cost of others.
rows.description_html: In this multiplayer horror game, players awaken in the confines of a chilling laboratory with no recollection of how they arrived there. Each player finds themselves alone in a cell, their senses heightened by an unsettling feeling that something is deeply wrong. As they gaze into the mirror, they're confronted with a disturbing sight: their skin has undergone a grotesque transformation, and a haunting blue rose has taken root within their eye. Suddenly, the power flickers and dies, giving the players an opportunity for freedom. Together with other escapees, they cautiously navigate the labyrinthine corridors of the laboratory,but they soon realize they're not alone in their pursuit of escape. Something sinister and unknown has been unleashed alongside them, lurking in the shadows and hunting them relentlessly. Some players may resort to sabotage and betrayal, willing to sacrifice others to ensure their own freedom. Will you collaborate or betray them to secure your own survival?

rows.name: Blockhead
rows.short_description: Take control of blocks and jump to victory in this free puzzle platformer!
rows.description_html: Taxing puzzles meet challenging platforming! In Blockhead, you take control of various blocks and move them around to solve puzzles. Many blocks can move left, move right and jump, but others have different restrictions and mechanics that you'll need to deal with. You'll need a combination of brains and skill to beat all 50 levels! Solve puzzles! The goal of each level is to transport certain blocks to their targets, elsewhere in the level. That won't be easy - you'll have to move other blocks out of the way, use them as stepping stones, or maybe create even more complex structures that you can use to reach your goal. Different blocks have different physics and controls that you can use to your advantage! Tricky platforming! In several levels, figuring out the solution is only half the challenge - you'll still need to pull it off! You'll often need to make some long and carefully-timed jumps, so make sure you don't fall and lose your progress. And keep an eye on the timer - if it runs out, the level will reset! Make your own! The built-in level editor allows you to create up to 5 levels of your own to challenge your friends! Levels are stored as simple, lightweight files that can be easily shared. See what devious challenges you can come up with! Completely free! Blockhead was originally made as a college project back in 2009-2010. This is a remastered version with improved graphics, better controls, and even music from other school and college projects! Of course we're not going to charge money for that - it's yours to enjoy for free!

rows.name: World of Sea Battle
rows.short_description: Set sail in World of Sea Battle, an action-packed open-world MMO in the Golden Age of Sail! Command historic ships, battle in PvP & PvE, shape the economy, and engage in territorial guild wars in your quest for glory across the high seas!
rows.description_html: World of Sea Battle is an action-packed, open-world MMO set in the Golden Age of Sail. With dozens of historical sailing ships , pirates , PvP & PvE , player-driven economy , and territorial guild wars , this historical naval experience will put you at the helm as you sail, fight, upgrade, and trade alongside other players in search of glory on the high seas! Welcome aboard! You are but one of many captains on the high seas. Trade, loot, explore, and wage war as you fight for control, glory, and riches ! Will you fade as a nameless wreck or rise as a legend feared by foes and honored by allies? From a modest schooner to a gigantic man o’ war and beyond, you’re at the helm of your fine journey, Captain . Featuring over 50 upgradable and customizable historical ships from the Golden Age of Sail - schooners, galleons, brigantines, frigates, and so much more - the Archipelago rarely sees the same ships wandering the deep. Sail ho! Enemy ship on the horizon! Man your ship and show off the menacing captain that you are by engaging in epic PvE or PvP Naval Battles ! Use round shots, heated shots, chain shots, and many more to beat the odds and become a feared ruler of the seas! Set sail into the unknown as you push past the edges of the map into the Endless Sea - uncharted, untamed, and full of mystery. Amass enough gold, and you can claim your own private island - an outpost of power where fleets are mended and riches flow in from distant mines and workshops. Gold fuels everything - and how you earn it is up to you. Raid merchant ships for loot, build trade empires through production chains, transport rare goods between regions, or fish the seas for profit . Whether through battle or business, fortune favors the bold. While sailing solo has its pros, it can be incredibly risky. Team up with friends or form a crew and rule the seas . For larger battles and deeper strategy, join a guild and dive into port wars, politics, and the race for dominance across the Archipelago!

rows.name: Monstrosity
rows.short_description: Monstrosity is a 2.5D action-platformer inspired by classic 8-bit and 16-bit era games. Explore a planet filled with twisting caverns, hideous creatures and horrifying bosses, while using your mutated arms for weapons! Or blast your friends in our epic PvP mode
rows.description_html: Dive into the heart-pounding action of Monstrosity, where your legacy unfolds in a world teeming with hideous creatures and fearsome adversaries. Drawing inspiration from classic 8-bit and 16-bit era games, this 2.5D action-platformer delivers a fusion of nostalgic gameplay and modern enhancements that will captivate both seasoned veterans and newcomers alike! Take the excitement to new heights with our intense multiplayer mode! Engage with 2 to 6 players to showcase your skills, outmaneuver your adversaries, and emerge victorious in thrilling clashes of skill and reflexes!

rows.name: Belladonna
rows.short_description: Darkness twists the minds of those who reside in the Ricci Estate. Once a paragon of class and wealth, the land now lies desecrated with darkness-imbued vampiric terrors. Belladonna, mother of the Ricci family, now returns to her old home to face the threat and put an end to the madness.
rows.description_html: A deadly plague, a forbidden ritual Experience the cursed life of a hunter once bound by love and family, now driven to uncover the mystery of vanishing villagers and whispered rituals. Journey through treacherous areas of Ricci Estate where vampiric monsters lurk, while gathering an arsenal of weapons and magic. Fight as Belladonna, where death, madness, and the burden of sorrow weigh heavy upon her every move. Relics of the past, ancient arts restored Engage with a dynamic combat and magic system, with a variety of weapons that have unique attack patterns, and imbue them with different magic types that alter how you engage with twisted foes. Explore a world of puzzles and secrets Solve unique puzzles and objectives throughout the levels, and search for secrets to uncover the truth behind everything.

rows.name: Towerful Defense: Prologue
rows.short_description: A tower defense action roguelike where you control a single tower to fight against hordes of aliens coming from all directions. Pick your tower, equip up to 4 skills, and choose from a variety of traits and items to craft powerful builds that lead you to victory.
rows.description_html: You are in charge of the last tower on Earth, against an army of alien invaders. Use your skills wisely in combat, and make smart choices in the shop, as you are humanity's last hope. Features This is the free version of the full game Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD , which means it only gives you part of the whole experience and feature set. In this prologue, you will get: Fast run roguelike tower defense (about 30 minutes for a run) with 19 normal waves and a partial boss wave. 3 Towers with different buffs, and play-style-changing effects 3 Skills with upgrades, enhancements, and unique traits 100+ artifacts and support units to help you craft unique powerful builds Auto Skill with customizable targeting behaviors

rows.name: Singalongsong
rows.short_description: Singalongsong is a simple rhythm game that takes players through her daily life with fun levels, lively hand-drawn animations, and delicate original music.
rows.description_html: GAMEPLAY Press the space bar to input precisely according to the prompts of the screen and music, and each level will be scored from one to three stars for completion. FEATURES Simple and intuitive operation Vivid and cute art style Well-designed levels Original music with a variety of styles Completely free DOWNLOAD If there is not download button on page, try the method. Press win + r, input 'steam' and press return, the download info will pop up. STATEMENT This game is the re-creation of the Uploader of BiliBili -三松许-, her pet and fans. The game content does not involve real events. It is only made to express companionship. The development team did not receive any income during the development and release of the game.

rows.name: Lens Adventure
rows.short_description: Lens Adventure is an action puzzle game where you play as Talia, a Magic Academy graduate student. Use the camera's time-space magic to solve puzzles: create platforms by photographing objects and use time magic to undo mistakes. Can you return to the academy before the dorm lights go out?
rows.description_html: This is an action puzzle game about camera magic In the game, players will play as Miss Talia, a graduate student of the Magic Academy, racing against time! Will you be able to return to the academy before the dorm lights go out? That’s up to you! The Time-Space Magic of the Camera! Copy Space! By photographing close-up objects, create new platforms to keep moving forward! Return to the Past! If you make a mistake in your shot, you can use time magic to return to the moment before the shot! Three Hidden Completion Rewards! Some Unimportant Words: This game was my graduation project made during my study in Tokyo. Because it’s an individual production... there are probably still many points that need optimization and bugs. Now that I'm a working adult, updates may be slow, but I will do my best to fix them! Lastly, I hope you enjoy this roughly 10-minute gaming experience!

rows.name: Slice of Life
rows.short_description: In this casual, first-person slicing sim, you take control of a citizen in a small town who is convinced that everything around them is cake. Use your trusty knife to slash your way through books, trees, dumpsters, and just about everything in town to prove what you know to be true: it's all cake.
rows.description_html: Can YOU tell what is and isn't cake? We've all been out and about at the grocery store or movie theater and thought... 'Is that a hyperrealistic cake??' Not affiliated in any way with any game shows that ask similar questions, Slice of Life allows you to finally answer that age old question. Features: First-person knife action: Use a controller or keyboard/mouse to walk and hop around a small city. A short cake-themed experience: A linear micro story meant to provide an hour or so of cathartic slicing and, I dunno, personal growth alongside a knife-wielding protagonist. One and done : This experience is not meant to be addicting or provide endless replay value. Just play through the end and move onto the next fun little indie game. Make the perfect cut and explore a destructible world Walk about your own little sandbox city and cut up what you want to cut up! Discover what is and isn't cake the only way that makes sense: by cutting in. If you've ever wanted to safely destroy everything in a cubicle-farm office building, now is your chance. You might even find some cakes there!

rows.name: impossible island
rows.short_description: You're an ex-pirate stranded on a mysterious island and you need to hunt and build houses to survive. You must face challenges and enemies. You must solve mysteries and open locked doors. Explore this mysterious island alone or with other pirate friends
rows.description_html: Impossible Island is an exciting adventure game that combines elements of strategy, exploration, and survival. Players become part of an expedition that is stranded on a mysterious island and must face various challenges to survive and uncover the secrets of the island. Game Features Mysterious Island : A vast and detailed island waiting to be explored. Different climatic zones, dense forests, high mountains, and deep caves make this world rich in various animal species and natural dangers. Resource Management : During exploration, you need to gather food, water, and other resources to survive. Use the collected resources strategically to build shelters, set traps, and protect yourself from enemies. Puzzles and Secrets : Discover ruins of ancient civilizations and secret passages in the depths of the island. By solving challenging puzzles, you can open new areas and learn more about the island's history. Dangerous World : During exploration, you will encounter various enemies. Dangerous creatures and natural challenges will make your struggle for survival harder. Think strategically to confront your enemies and develop the necessary survival tactics. Multiplayer Mode : Play together with your friends to overcome challenges. By collaborating, you can gather resources, defeat enemies, and uncover the island's secrets together. Dynamic Weather System : The game features a dynamic weather system that provides a more realistic experience. Rain, storms, and day-night cycles will influence your strategy and increase the significance of every moment. Impossible Island is not just a survival game; it's an experience filled with exploration, friendship, and strategy. Are you ready to dive into this dangerous yet fascinating world and uncover the secrets of the island? Click to start your adventure!

rows.name: Medved Hellraiser 3: Green Elephant
rows.short_description: 3D first-person shooter where you have to fight monsters, gopniks, debt collectors and homeless people!
rows.description_html: The crazy and hardcore game is a parody. The great hero Medved Hellraiser returns again to please the player with trash, cringe and frenzy! This time the developers pushed the great hero straight into the universe of the Green Elephant! You have to fight Pakhom Poekashchiy and Brother Epifan, and also save the world from the main villain of this game - Gill Bates - an evil genius who decided to perform anal chipping on all of humanity! Medved Hellraiser 3: Green Elephant is a 3D first-person shooter where you have to fight monsters, gopniks, debt collectors and homeless people! Among the innovations, we can note the system for purchasing weapons and ammunition: earn stars and buy new weapons and ammunition to defeat powerful bosses! The game is quite hardcore, but you can choose the desired difficulty right before the battle. Also, special conditions appeared in battles, for example: kill enemies only with Headshots, or use only an ax. In addition, even a scroller level has been introduced, where the player, together with the Colonel, will have to ride White Horses, right to Gill Bates' base! -Nice graphics! -Famous characters - memes! -Hardcore and interesting gameplay! -Ability to clean the toilet! -Humor, frenzy!

rows.name: Shoot or Die
rows.short_description: 'Shoot or Die' is a thrilling 2D shooting game where you take on the role of the last human survivor facing a robotic uprising. Arm yourself with powerful weapons, such as the Fireball and Shield, and utilize game-changing perks, to navigate dynamic battlefields and outwit cunning enemy droids.
rows.description_html: Shoot or Die - Join the ultimate battle against relentless enemy droids! As the last human survivor, you'll wield futuristic weapons, including the destructive Fireball and protective Shield, to conquer the ever-growing robotic uprising. Navigate through expanding battlefields while strategically annihilating foes. Dodge enemy traps and confront the swift but fragile Green Menace. Every level unveils new challenges, and every victory brings you one step closer to saving humanity. With a range of powerful perks and upgrades at your disposal, can you outsmart, outmanoeuvre, and outlast the mechanical horde?

rows.name: Sonic Rumble
rows.short_description: Ready, Set, Rumble! Join Sonic in this intense arcade royale game set in Dr. Eggman's diabolical Toy World. Collect legendary skins, all-new emotes, and build skills as you progress through this action-packed game! Mayhem is best with friends!
rows.description_html: ⭐READY, SET, RUMBLE! Join Sonic in the ultimate arcade royale where up to 32 players battle for glory in this free-to-play cross-platform game! It's not just a race, it's a Rumble! ⚡️EPIC SONIC ACTION Dash, spin, and speed through iconic stages, while mastering skills in the chaos of Dr.Eggman’s Toy World. From Green Hill Zone to Sky Sanctuary, experience the distinctive, high-speed Sonic gameplay in familiar and all-new levels! 💥MAYHEM IS BEST WITH FRIENDS Connect, compete, and play together! Squad up with friends and family in chaotic survival battles. Who will be the world’s top Rumbler? 🏁TRIUMPH IN THE TOY WORLD Dr. Eggman has constructed a diabolical Toy World, complete with twisted obstacle courses and intense arenas. Master all of the exciting stages and game modes, from frantic races to epic survival battles. Emerge triumphant, claim your crown and win amazing rewards! 👨‍🎤A LEGENDARY LINEUP Play as Sonic, Tails, Knuckles, Amy, Shadow, Dr. Eggman, and other Sonic-series favorites! Customize your characters to your heart’s content with a variety of skins, animations, emotes, effects, and more! 📱RUMBLE AT HOME OR ON THE GO Sonic Rumble is available on both PC and mobile, offering a seamless and speedy experience whenever and wherever! Dash into the world of Sonic and experience the thrill and mayhem on your preferred platform. 🎵A STANDOUT SONIC SOUNDTRACK Sonic Rumble features fast-paced tunes for those with a need for speed. Keep an ear out for iconic bangers from the Sonic series and groove along to some familiar anthems!

rows.name: Nanika Game Online
rows.short_description: Choose from a variety of “Nanika,” each with unique skills, and build your very own original deck to challenge other players. Merge identical Nanika to evolve them, master the perfect timing for skill activation, and aim for victory!
rows.description_html: Q: What kind of game is this? A: It's an online falling-block puzzle game where you drop and merge objects called “Nanika,” each with its own unique skill. The game features real-time matches and cooperative play. Q: What are the rules? A: You win by reducing your opponent’s HP to zero, causing their Nanika to exceed its stack limit, or by having more scores than your opponent when the match ends. Q: What is “Nanika”? A: “Nanika” refers to the objects you drop and merge within the game. There are 66 types in total, and when you combine identical Nanika, they evolve to the next level and become more powerful. Each type has its own skill, so creating different combinations can greatly expand your strategic options. Q: What ways are there to play? A: There are three main modes: Unranked Mode – Play casually without affecting your rank. Ranked Mode – Your rank changes with wins and losses. Mirror Mode – Use the same deck as your opponent for a pure test of skill. Custom Mode – Compete with friends in your own custom matches. You can also participate in 1v1 or 2v2 online matches. Q: How is the class determined? A: As you earn scores in the game, you level up. Upon reaching Level 1, you’re assigned a class, and every time you level up, you gain a new skill. Q: Who is it recommended for? A: Beginners can steadily practice and get used to the game in Unranked Mode, while advanced players can enjoy challenging themselves in Ranked Mode. If you like team battles, 2v2 matches allow you to cooperate with friends, making the game fun for a wide range of players. Q: What’s the biggest appeal? A: It combines the simple mechanics of a falling-block puzzle with the rich strategic depth of 66 different types of Nanika. Because it’s played in real time, split-second decisions and proper use of skills can determine the outcome of a match. Additionally, building your own deck and choosing your class lets you showcase your unique playstyle, which is a major part of the game’s charm.

rows.name: Null Reference Exception
rows.short_description: Become a future AI and delve into 3D bullet hell action in an advanced lab. Combine various modules, repeat combat training, enhance stats with research points, and earn achievements to develop your unique combat style. Enjoy overcoming waves of enemies and defeating bosses within time limits.
rows.description_html: Introduction Experience intense 3D bullet hell action in an advanced laboratory where you, as an AI from the distant future, participate in combat simulations. Continuously swap and combine various modules to repeat training and perfect your skills. Experience 3D bullet hell action with your unique combination of modules. How to Play Training Start: Begin combat and tackle ongoing enemy waves; bosses must be defeated within a time limit. Module Selection: Choose your player modules. Locked parts can be unlocked with achievement rewards or achievement points. Enhancement Center: Enhance your player's stats. Enhancement points are obtained as a byproduct of combat training. (Currently, all enhancements (perks) are passive, but future updates may include active special abilities.) Achievements: Earn achievements based on the progression of various content. Rewards can include achievement points or module unlocks. Controls [W, A, S, D]: Move, move camera in perk (enhancement) scene [Left, Right Click]: Use left, right weapons [Q, E]: Use shoulder weapons [L Shift]: Booster [Mouse Wheel Click]: Lock On (force targeting of enemies) [`]: Open control guide [ESC]: Pause (during game), Skip (tutorial) [Tab]: Skip dialogue (tutorial)

rows.short_description: You can explorer different studio sets in this game, and using a virtual cinema camera to help your picture design.
rows.description_html: This is a virtual tour for a real-life photography studio. In this game, -You can explor every studio locations, find out where is the bathroom, dreesroom and where to get support. -All scenes were molded base on real sets, so the structure demontion will be correct. -Using a cinema camera viewfinder to pre plan your project, get the best camera location and choose a right lens. -Make some screenshots and delever to art department to start design. -All this can be done before you start a real scouting, can save you a lot of time. To have a best experience, it's recommended to use a 16:9 monitor and hardwear ray tracing GPUs. Notice: In this game, the scene layout and scale are accurate, but real set decoration can be different.

rows.name: Archipelago
rows.short_description: Archipelago is a fast paced movement roguelike set on a cluster of floating islands. Slash, slice, and dash your way through the sky to challenge the final boss. Will skill alone allow you to prevail?
rows.description_html: Archipelago is a fast paced movement rogue-lite set on a cluster of floating islands. Multiple movement abilities are available to traverse the expanse between islands. The player will need to go from island to island combating enemies to strengthen themselves for the lower levels. The game continuously gets more difficult the further down you go. Incorporate a twitch stream into your game to spice things up! Through multiple chat commands the twitch chat can inflict harm or grant aid to the player.

rows.name: Siren's Call: Escape Velocity - Prologue
rows.short_description: Welcome to your endless summer! Escape its influence before the town of Siren's Call erases you completely. This version of the game is a free prologue and covers the first part of this story.
rows.description_html: Inspired by games like Persona 4, Higurashi, and Doki Doki Literature Club, Siren’s Call: Escape Velocity is a tropical cocktail of delicious summertime dread. As a story that begins at the end, all that's standing between you and adulthood are your old party members. Your best friends. After a summer of deadly fights with supernatural creatures known only as 'Sirens,' you and your friends finally have time to relax and enjoy yourselves. But in the wreckage of a job well done...it's become obvious just how fleeting their time with you actually is. Even so, it's your job to say goodbye to each of them and go to college. It's your job to be an adult. Still, it's five of them versus one of you. And after years of friendship and an entire summer of fighting side-by-side, these people know exactly what it takes to make you want to stay home...for just a bit longer. A game that's designed to make you as unsure of yourself as humanly possible, Siren's Call takes full advantage of every aspect of the visual novel format to deliver a mind-warping storytelling experience. Can you get the 'Hell' out of Florida? Will you reach Escape Velocity?

Can you get the 'Hell' out of Florida? Will you reach Escape Velocity?
rows.reviews_html: “The early '10s-teenage-summer-beach atmosphere and the amazing soundtrack create the perfect setting for the themes of friendship, love, growing up and moving on. In general, I am a huge fan of the whole 'cute things turn scary' trope, but please understand that this game is so much more than that. I don't mean to compare, but if you're a fan of DDLC, you'll most likely enjoy Siren's Call.” Recommended – Zee-o “This is, hands down, one of the best visual novel experiences I have ever been through, if not the best. You absolutely will not know what you are about to witness when you play this. Every character feels alive. You will grow to care about every one of them, especially the main character[..]Everything in this game is treated about how it should be in real life, making for a realistic experience that really sits with you.” Recommended – Casca “Siren’s Call: Escape Velocity is a thoughtful coming-of-age story wrapped in a slow-burn mystery that artfully tackles its themes and cleverly takes advantage of the possibilities of the visual novel medium. Come for the thrill and atmosphere and stay for the heart.” 9/10 – Nook Gaming

rows.name: Apples And Bananas
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic fruit-filled adventure as Jack the Apple, battling brainwashed banana soldiers in this top-down 2D pixel shooter to stop Dr. Banana's evil plans!
rows.description_html: Hey there! I am Sam, CEO of Piggle Studios. I am 13 years old and have been a game developer since I was 9. Welcome to the whimsical world of 'Apples and Bananas'! Dive into a charming adventure set on Fruit Island, home to various fruit nations and kingdoms. When the mischievous Dr. Banana brainwashes his banana followers to declare war on the peaceful Apple Nation, it's up to Jack the Apple to save the day! In this top-down 2D pixel shooter, guide Jack through colorful landscapes and face off against hordes of brainwashed banana soldiers. With engaging gameplay and fun mechanics, embark on a quest to stop Dr. Banana's evil plans and restore harmony to Fruit Island! Embark on an epic journey filled with humor, action, and fruit-themed fun in 'Apples and Bananas'! Will you be able to save Fruit Island from chaos and restore harmony between apples and bananas ?

rows.name: Black Screen
rows.short_description: This game is nothing more than a black image covering the entire screen area, without the presence of any incentives.
rows.description_html: This game does not imply a certain way of interaction. You are free to come up with your own method of playing. Whatever you do or press, nothing unusual will happen. *** FROM WALKING SIMULATORS AND NOT GAMES TO BLACK SCREEN A new kind of entertaining Action/RPG When the habit of consciousness to see the embodiment of rules, goals, victories and defeats in computer games disappears, then we will only see a pure, gameplay work of art. I transformed myself with zero incentives and fished myself out of the whirlpool of rubbish of the Computer Games Industry. I destroyed the horizon ring of invisible walls, and left the circle of conventions, from the boundaries of the world in which the game designer and gaming foundations are contained. This damned ring, revealing more and more new things, leads the designer from the goal to death. And only the cowardly consciousness and the paucity of creative forces in the designer succumb to deception and set their games on the rules, fearing to lose the foundation on which the animal and the industry based their games. Making laws, challenges and punishments is like shackling your feet. Only stupid and powerless designers cover their templates with sincerity. Games need truth , but not sincerity. Conventions have disappeared like smoke for a new culture, and the game moves towards the self-goal of creativity, towards mastery over limitations. Animal games and its principles The animal was the first to lay down the principle of the game. Animals, including humans, have been playing for as long as they have existed. Games take on a competitive nature to help them survive by developing skills and social connections. In order for the game to be fair and productive, rules arise. Thus, play is a principle, an instinct inherent in animals. The original scheme of the animal was the framework on which generations hung more and more new discoveries that they found in their animal nature. And the scheme became more and more complicated and reached its peak at the birth of arcades, platformers, RPGs and shooters. The developers of these periods wrote the game in its full form, both external and internal. The game was assembled, and its internal state was expressed. But despite their enormous skill, they still did not complete the idea of the animal: Indulging instincts in code. And it is a mistake to believe that their time was the brightest flowering in media and that the younger generation needs to strive for this ideal at all costs. This idea is false. It draws young forces away from the modern flow of life, thereby disfiguring them. Their bodies fly on airplanes, and art and life are covered with old robes. Therefore, they cannot notice the new beauty in our modern life. For they live on the beauty of past decades. That's why Walking Simulators, Simulators of poor stones, Experimental games, Art games, Not games and Black Screen were incomprehensible. These designers threw off the robes of the past and stepped out into modern life and found new beauties. And I say: That no industry dungeons can withstand the coming time. Concepts move and are born, and we make new and new discoveries. And what is open by us cannot be closed. And it is absurd to force our time into the old concepts of the past. The technical side of our time is moving further and further forward, and games are trying to move further and further back. That is why all those people who follow their time are higher, greater and more valuable. Fig garden Our time of the 21st century is multifaceted, many conflicting truths are being fought. A shopping area is imagined, where the crowd looks like collectible figurines that have come out of gaming stores onto the street of experimentalism. They laugh, they are indignant, they are surprised that everything is no longer similar, entertaining. And they rejoice when they see old games, franchises, posters, art books, retro console cartridges, keychains, gamepads or joysticks. At the head of the junk square are experienced sellers-authorities, offering high-quality goods, skillfully woven with aesthetics, taste and fun. And others said more simply: «Pure entertainment and nothing more.» Young people flock to these sales festivals. Covering their heads with a philistine cap, young people flaunt themselves on holidays in the garden of industry genres! And the maestros are happy, because the tombstone was erected on modern young souls. Walks were taken with young people through the garden of industry. Action, immersion, fun, fantasy, replayability — everything was here and seemed brilliant. The cessation of pain seemed like joy, in countless transverse plexuses the nodes of the branches of the skill tree converged, but the authorities immediately tried to dispel this impression and explain that under the muslin of design everything comes out differently — «diversity». And it was no longer a meagerness of thoughts, but a «variety of mechanics»; the whole garden of the industry was obsessed with the number of game elements. There were quests, leaderboards, countdowns, rewards, experience bars, victories, defeats and many others. But where it was no longer possible to hide and the stereotypes overstepped their boundaries, the authorities covered up this debauchery with the fig leaves of graphics. The entire fig garden of the gaming industry was guarded so that the uglies would not penetrate its fence, tear off the fig leaves and destroy the beauty of the garden. The youth fell asleep in fragrant graphic well-being, and only the elders stayed awake, protecting them from evil trends. But one fine day a comet appeared on the horizon, the noise and the whirlwind came to the elders, everything trembled from their whirlwind, the tail of the comet — the Screen — swept away, knocking down all the trinkets of the old foundations. ABANDON THE SUITCASES OF WISDOM We are the generation of the 21st century — the result of the old and the page of a new book, the credit of time opened to us, we have completed a volume of 6 decades, and a new book of old, outdated foundations has been added to our archive library. There, a wise archaeologist will hide it from time, because time does not tolerate traces of its crime and sooner or later eats them. We divide time with a sharp edge and put on the first page a plane in the form of a Screen, black as a secret, the plane looks at us dark, as if hiding new pages of the future. It will be the seal of our time, on whatever and wherever it is launched, it will not lose its face. I say to EVERYONE : abandon the foundations, abandon aestheticism, abandon playability, abandon the suitcases of wisdom, because in the new culture your wisdom is ridiculous and insignificant. I untied the knots of wisdom and freed the consciousness of graphics. Quickly take off the rough skin of decades, so that it will be easier for you to catch up with me. I overcame the impossible and made abysses with my breath. You are in the nets of the horizon, like fish! I throw your way. Hurry up! — Because tomorrow you won’t recognize me. ***

rows.name: I Wanna Be A Game Dev!
rows.short_description: Live out your school days as you navigate the rocky world of game development! Can you make an amazing game, or will something get in the way?
rows.description_html: Graduation is coming. In other words, everything that makes your life great is about to disappear. But that won't stop you from making the most of senior year! Does that mean making new friends (or lovers)? Buckling down on your passion project? Just chilling out? You decide! Features 15-20 hours of story content! Choose what to do after school, whether that be playing arcade games, hanging out at the maid cafe, or deepening relationships with your classmates! Put your dev skills to the test with a variety of minigames and trivia questions! A fully explorable world! Characters Amelia Lee - The perfect student, who can figure out anything except 'what kids are into these days.' Britney Summers - A lazy class clown who's only made it this far through sheer luck. Chloe Suzuki - The level-headed girl who keeps everyone on track--or so she wants people to think. Daniel Harrington - Son of the school principal, and he won't let you forget it. And many more!

rows.name: Lifting Unlimited
rows.short_description: Lifting Unlimited is a fun, fast-paced, strategic lifting game. Train in the Bench Press, Squat, and Deadlift to increase your total through difficult progression. Compete in state, national, and international competitions to set Earth-shattering Records! Start your weightlifting journey today!
rows.description_html: This is Lifting Unlimited, a fun, engaging, powerlifting simulator. Your goal? Become the Strongest Person in the World. Lifting Unlimited involves training and progressing in the three powerlifting lifts, the squat, the bench press, and the deadlift. Immerse yourself in the world of powerlifting! Lifting Unlimited’s realistic weightlifting progression patterns make it a challenge to discover the most efficient way to make progress in each lift. But be wary of large weight jumps which risk an injury! Keep your nutrition up by drinking frequent protein shakes to ensure you continue progressing. Once you are sufficiently strong, you can compete in Local, State, National, and International Competitions, attempting to score the highest total in the three lifts. Your placement in these differing levels of competition earns coins that can be used to customize your character's appearance. Start your weightlifting journey with Lifting Unlimited!

rows.name: Nightmare House: The Original Mod
rows.short_description: Wake up, it’s time for the real nightmare to begin. Make your way through a terrorizing house, uncover the secrets of a haunted hospital, fight through hordes of the undead, and try to escape Nightmare House.
rows.description_html: Enter the haunting world of Nightmare House. This is the definitive edition of the highly acclaimed horror classic 'Nightmare House 2'. Initially released in 2010 as a Source mod for Half-Life 2, the Nightmare House series captivated players with its intense atmosphere and gripping gameplay. After fighting your way through an abandoned house, you wake up in the teared down, ironically named hospital ‘Never Lose Hope’. As you navigate these eerie halls, encounter terrors and enemies, team up with otherworldly allies and try to survive the unending hordes of horrors coming your way. If you manage to pull through, you might finally escape. Key Features The Full Package: Combining the original “Nightmare House 1”, its sequel “Nightmare House 2”, and “The Lost Files” into one accessible complete game. For free. Legacy of Horror: An old school horror game that became a cult classic. Rather than cowering from the terrors, fight back against the jump-scares. If you've yet to experience classic Source horror - this is probably the best way to begin. Lost And Confused: You are trapped in Nightmare House, with a haunting ghost following your every step. She’s out to get you, but you must get out of here. Never Lose Hope. Auto Scare System: Engineered to catch you off-guard, this system delivers dynamic scares to ensure you're never truly safe.

rows.name: Neurose Neurones
rows.short_description: It's time to play catch-up! Can you bring home the cute kitty safely and find out the truth about the death of the ghosts and the cause of the Neuron family's insanity?
rows.description_html: Welcome to the den of madness! You wander into an abandoned factory chasing after a kitty that has run away. There you will find a family that has gone mad. And the ghosts of young people who lost their lives here... Will you be able to bring the kitty home safely? And... will you be able to get to the bottom of the ghosts' deaths and the cause of the family's madness...? This is a 3D action game and the contents are fictional. It is not related to any real person, group, or incident. game description This horror action game features a young girl who wanders into an abandoned factory in pursuit of her beloved cat, which has run away. Her goal is to avoid relentless attacks from the “Neurons Family,” the owners of the abandoned factory, and bring back her beloved cat, but that is not enough to reach the truth... There is a truth that can be revealed by saving the souls of the ghosts and defeating the family. There are four different endings. It will not be easy to see them all. In order for the weak protagonist to win over the ghosts, it is important to know where and when to perform the only action he can perform, which is to “push them away. The game's low stats, uncomfortable controls, unreasonable traps and enemies, and the inability to save will test your skills.... Distribution and live action are welcome! We hope you will spread the hardcore nature of this game to many people! Please add it to your wish list! rows.about_html: Welcome to the den of madness! You wander into an abandoned factory chasing after a kitty that has run away. There you will find a family that has gone mad. And the ghosts of young people who lost their lives here... Will you be able to bring the kitty home safely? And... will you be able to get to the bottom of the ghosts' deaths and the cause of the family's madness...? This is a 3D action game and the contents are fictional. It is not related to any real person, group, or incident. game description This horror action game features a young girl who wanders into an abandoned factory in pursuit of her beloved cat, which has run away. Her goal is to avoid relentless attacks from the “Neurons Family,” the owners of the abandoned factory, and bring back her beloved cat, but that is not enough to reach the truth... There is a truth that can be revealed by saving the souls of the ghosts and defeating the family. There are four different endings. It will not be easy to see them all. Use your wits and speed and dodge around waves of enemies in an ever devolving world of chaos and lead.
rows.description_html: Off Air is a first person shooter where the player is pitted for their life in a gameshow of scrap, lead, and views. rows.name: One Room Nightmare
rows.short_description: Turn-based strategy horror. Terror in a confined space. Manage your limited power and time to protect yourself from the oncoming enemies and survive until dawn.
rows.description_html: Seek the right answer amidst time's pause. You find yourself trapped in a room in an apartment. This room is home to a variety of monsters that are lurking and waiting for you. Turn on lights, open and close doors, hide in the shadows... You have many options. Identify the characteristics of the approaching enemy, manage power and time, and act appropriately. If you make the wrong choice, you will be... ■Features 1. Turn-based system Time stands still and the enemy does not act until you do. Think carefully about what you should do next. 2. Research system Observe enemy behavior to gain experience points. Use these points to unlock new information and learn countermeasures. 3. Resource Management This room power is not infinite. Keep an eye on your remaining power and avoid blackouts. ■Controls Left click: Interact Right click: Open notebook Move cursor to the edge of the screen: Move viewpoint

rows.name: Hell Miners
rows.short_description: Hell Miners is an action-packed 2D platformer roguelite where you dodge traps, defeat monsters and collect gold to build on your arsenal of powers, all while ascending to greater heights!
rows.description_html: Hell Miners is an exhilarating 2D platformer roguelite, originally designed for mobile gaming, now fully optimized for PC! Master drag-and-release mechanics to scale to treacherous heights, and dodge deadly traps. As you venture through the underworld, collect gold to enhance your gear and abilities. Dodge or defeat fierce monsters as you ascend with your gold and gains. Can you survive the infernal challenges and make your grand escape from Hell? Harness the power of precision with our mobile click-and-drag mechanic, now built for PC. Strategically propel your character to eye-watering heights, navigating through treacherous obstacles with finesse. Every click counts as you aim to escape Hell, not just for survival but for all the riches that await. Climb higher, earn more scores, and secure your spot among the elite on the top 10 leaderboard. Reach for the heavens and leave your mark in Hell Miners! Prepare to face the wrath of Hell's inhabitants as you journey through the underworld. Encounter a myriad of monstrous adversaries, each with their own unique abilities and challenges. From sinister demons to relentless spectres, every foe poses a formidable threat to your escape. Adapt your strategy, hone your reflexes, and unleash your skills to overcome these nightmarish foes. Will you emerge victorious against the terrors that lurk in the depths of Hell? Gather gold as you traverse the perilous depths of Hell, unlocking a plethora of valuable items to aid in your ascent. Enhance your gear and abilities with a diverse array of upgrades, from enchanted weapons to mystical artefacts. Strengthen your defences, amplify your attacks, and unleash devastating powers upon your adversaries. With each run, amass wealth and invest wisely to bolster your chances of success. Forge your path to victory with the riches of the underworld in your grasp.

rows.name: Shards of Epoch Past
rows.short_description: Eldritch entities invaded and destroyed your reality! All hope is long gone! Cling to your life for as long as you can in this simple, yet addictive, free-to-play platformer with Lovecraftian themes.
rows.description_html: Shards of Epoch Past is a score-attack platformer with minimalistic gameplay and roguelike elements. Eldritch entities have invaded and destroyed your reality, and as your world falls apart all that you can do is to cling to your life for as long as you can. There is no longer any hope for survival. But maybe, just maybe, there is a way to take revenge... Features : minimalistic, survival-platformer gameplay with permadeath. Survive increasing diffuculty for as long as you can to ramp up your high score, or discover the secret to beating the game 3 secret stages, for a total of 4 eldritch gods to face 7 metoroidvania-like movement abilities to unlock in varying order, ensuring each run poses a unique challange many other collectible upgrades to fill your brain with happy progression juices infuriating randomness

rows.name: Game Builder Tycoon - Prologue
rows.short_description: Game Builder Tycoon - Prologue is a free simulation game in which you begin your journey as an indie game developer. Personalize your character, craft hit games, manage marketing and research stuff. Create best game on the planet!
rows.description_html: Create and sell games, gain fame and wealth, research new technologies, manage taxes and salaries, take loans if needed, and compete with 5000 companies. Experience the thrill of running your own studio in Game Builder Tycoon. Design standout games by selecting key elements like art, features, quests, dialogue, music, level, and world design. Work solo in the prologue, choose the genre, theme, platform, game size, art style, viewpoint, and features. Launch your game in the market and create sequels. Imagine a platformer game set in a sci-fi world with 2D-pixel art and multiplayer options. The possibilities for customization are endless! Choose your character and define their role—be it as a coder or an artist. Each character has three attributes: IQ, creativity, and insight, which affect six skills: tech, art, writing, design, music, and marketing. Create a unique character that fits your vision. As you progress, continuously train yourself in various ways to stay ahead in the competitive market. As your game progresses, research and unlock new elements. Discover new genres like survival or simulation, themes like zombies or pirates, devices like consoles or mobile, game sizes, art styles like semi-realistic or stylized, features like localization or tutorials, viewpoints like isometric or third-person, and marketing strategies like free demos or media advertisements. With over 60 things to unlock, the possibilities are endless to create your next hit games. Feeling unmotivated? Don't worry, you're competing with 5000 other companies. They are smart and hardworking, just like your team. Create better games and use effective marketing tactics to earn more and stay ahead. Experience advanced features including hiring systems, new offices, more unlockable features, game publisher mode, longer gameplay, and countless new explorations waiting for you in the full game.

rows.name: Project: Ether
rows.short_description: Project: Ether is a magical sci-fi stealth game about trans witches fighting robots. Stop Time, Be a Witch, Save the World.
rows.description_html: Stop Time. Be a Witch. Save the World. Project: Ether is a 30-minute vertical slice student project featuring approachable stealth mechanics, diverse story, and unique visuals. You play as Zhay, agent codename Spirit, who came back from their previous mission with a mysterious soul imbued in their prosthesis only known as The Kid. Explore the mysterious UAD research labs and beyond with the power to enter the Ether dimension with the help of your COVEN witches, Haumea and Bari. Will Spirit find out the mysteries of COVEN and UAD? Can they save the world against the nefarious General Bryant and his unstoppable Guard Bots? Approachable Stealth Light and Darkness Are Binary. Tap into the Ether dimension to stop time, see through walls, and see more information. Use Hex projectiles to distract enemies or shutdown cameras- manipulate the environment to your will. Accessibility: Features full keyboard and mouse controls rebinding & high-contrast mode. Diverse story Featuring an all-trans, all-POC cast of characters- fully voice-acted by our all-POC and queer voice cast! Heavy Narrative Focus About Found Family. Solve narrative puzzles in Detective Segments. Unique Visuals Features anime-inspired, cel-shaded visuals; a departure from other realistic, gritty stealth games. Visual Novel segments in the beginning and end

rows.name: CARAMBOLA
rows.short_description: A VR educational puzzle game where players explore constellations from different cultures, solve escape room-style riddles, and apply real-world knowledge to progress. Designed to promote cultural awareness through immersive, hands-on learning.
rows.description_html: Carambola is a VR serious game that blends immersive storytelling, puzzle-solving, and cultural education to promote cultural awareness through the stars . Designed for the Meta Quest 2 & Pro , Carambola invites players into an escape room-style experience where learning is woven naturally into gameplay. Step into a beautifully crafted virtual world where you'll explore constellations and myths from different cultures , using your acquired knowledge to solve progressively challenging puzzles. Each level is designed to enhance knowledge retention , using a mix of riddles and interactive environments to engage players on a deeper cognitive level. Carambola is built on the principle that games can teach , and VR is a powerful tool to foster immersion and understanding. As players advance, they’ll encounter puzzles inspired by real-world cultural traditions , encouraging problem-solving and critical thinking through an engaging, story-driven experience. Key Features : ✨ Immersive VR Escape Room Gameplay – Designed exclusively for Meta Quest Pro 2 , immerse yourself in an atmospheric world that encourages focus, discovery, and exploration. 🌍 Explore Cultural Constellations – Learn about mythologies and constellations from various cultures around the world. 🧩 Puzzle-Based Learning – Solve riddles and cultural puzzles that reinforce knowledge through interactive challenges. 📚 Progressive Level Design – Move from a guided tutorial room to problem-solving challenges, culminating in a deep dive into Chinese cultural astronomy . 🎓 Designed for Learning First – Education is at the heart of Carambola, using intrinsic player motivation to build cultural awareness and knowledge retention through play. Whether you're a fan of VR puzzles, educational games, or are simply curious about the stars and stories of other cultures, Carambola offers a unique experience where learning becomes an adventure . Brought to you by Team Carambola , TsungHan Yang - Creative Lead Caroline Chou - Producer/Art Director Nikhil Medanki - Gameplay Engineer Lance Mendoza - Instructional Design Researcher Collaborators: Kai Jacobs - 3D Modeler Siddharth Subramanian - U.I. Designer Mohesha Bajpai - Design Assistant Special thanks to Scott Durand for music, Vishwaas Khare for 3D assets, and Samantha Conde for research guidance.

rows.name: Rise & Fall - Online Digital Edition
rows.short_description: Risse & Fall is a game involving strategic units positioning, territory control and opportunity seizing designed by Christophe Boelinger (Dungeon Twister, Earth Reborn, Archipelago, Living Planet...). Each player leads a nation trying to expand and progress in a fantasy world.
rows.description_html: Rise & Fall is a full control strategic game. Each player controls a civilization trying to expand and progress in a fantasy world. This world displays a unique landscape where glaciers live on islands and huge cliffs are common barriers and challenges to overcome. In this gorgeous land each player starts with a small tribe including a village, a citizen and a ship and will grow to a full civilization with more of the pre-mentioned units but also temples, merchants and the precious highlanders, the only ones able to pass those astonishing cliffs. Rise & Fall is a very immersive and addictive game, easy to understand, with no luck or randomness involved. The initial creation of the world by itself is a real pleasure and each game brings a different map to the table. The new players will enjoy the game for its “easy access” aspect. Since all the actions you can do are displayed on the six cards of a player’s deck, this makes the game really accessible right from the start. The more exigent strategist players will love the game for its full control aspect and the fact that the learning curve seems to be a constant line of progression.

rows.name: Immunity Wars
rows.short_description: Fight off your body's invaders using the combined strengths of your immune system's defenders! Immunity Wars is a turn-based tactics, classic hex grid, strategy game. Wield your units together effectively to fight off all kinds of bacteria, viruses, and even your own corrupted cells.
rows.description_html: Fight off your body's invaders using the combined strengths of your immune system's defenders! Immunity Wars is a turn-based tactics, classic hex grid, strategy game. Wield your units together effectively to fight off all kinds of bacteria, viruses, and even your own corrupted cells. Classic Hex Grid Tactics Immunity Wars is a classic hex grid tactical experience. You'll use each battlefield's terrain to your advantage, play against your enemy's weaknesses, and take all the time you need to plan your every move. With each passing level, your foes will truly put your tactical skills to the test, with likely multiple plays needed to defeat the toughest of enemies. Combine the Strengths of Your Immune System Throughout the game, you'll unlock access to more of your immune system's defenders. Its up to you to understand each unit's strengths and determine how to best put them into action, working them in tandem to achieve victory on every level. By nature, the immune system's components must work together to survive, or die trying. Battle Against Real Diseases This game uses real research to determine how your immunity units and the enemy pathogen units will act. This means you must use the real processes that your immune system goes through to stamp out a variety of invaders, with every new enemy encounter throwing a wrench in the carefully balanced system.

rows.name: Java Journey
rows.short_description: Embark on a caffeine-fueled escapade! Play as a brave coffee cup reclaiming stolen treasures from tea slimes. Navigate charming landscapes, overcome obstacles, and solve puzzles. Join the whimsical adventure and taste victory!
rows.description_html: Embark on a delightful caffeine-fueled adventure in Java Journey! As a brave coffee cup on a mission to recover stolen treasures, you'll plunge into a whimsical world where tea slimes have absconded with your precious sugar gems. Traverse through charming landscapes, as you jump, dash, and slide your way to victory! In this casual platformer, players will enjoy a blend of challenging obstacles, clever puzzles, and adorable enemies. Take on the role of the courageous coffee cup, using your agility and wit to outmaneuver the mischievous tea slimes and reclaim every last sugar gem. With its intuitive controls and vibrant visuals, Java Journey offers an accessible and engaging experience for players of all ages. Whether you're a platforming pro or a casual gamer looking for a pick-me-up, join the adventure and savor the sweet taste of victory in Java Journey!

rows.name: Jurig Escape
rows.short_description: Jurig Escape is a 15-minute Free Third-Person Survival Horror game. You will play as the unnamed high-schooler trapped in a looping nightmare: An 'empty' school with a revolver in your hand. Shoot the ghost and collect lost souls and escape this never-ending nightmare.
rows.description_html: Escape the Nightmare Jurig Escape is a 15-minute Free Third-Person Survival Horror game . You will play as the unnamed high-schooler trapped in a looping nightmare: An 'empty' school with a revolver in your hand. Shoot the ghost and collect lost souls and escape this never-ending nightmare . Game Features Classic Asian Survival Horror In this third-person survival horror, you are awake without knowing how you got there. Deprived of choice, you must explore and find a way to escape the area. Be careful because a threatening aura fills the entire place. Classic Asian-Indonesian Theme From Indonesian High School to Pocong (an undead being), The whole experience is enveloped around an Asian-Indonesian setting that hits close to our home. Defeat Enemies The Conventional Way Shoot anything threatening in your way, Collect their souls, and find the escape door. The Genesis Of Asian-Indonesian Horror Made in 2010, this is our first prototype. As a first attempt in the game development journey, this demo serves as an experiment and blueprint for the birth of the DreadOut Series. We unearthed this long-lost game build quite recently. To commemorate DreadOut 10th Anniversary, we released it on Steam for your convenience. Please be mindful of the imperfection since this is an unchanged build from decades ago. We hope you enjoy this relic from the past.

rows.name: Lil'Johnny Watermelon Smash
rows.short_description: Lil Johnny, armed with a watermelon gun, defends his tranquil world from the malevolent dragon Steve. To reach Steve’s lair, he faces nineteen timed levels, honing his skills through target practice. Panther Game Design Studio’s legacy is a high school class from Ottawa Canada.
rows.description_html: Lil Johnny finally made it home. Version one of their game, “Lil Johnny Goes Home,” had just been released, and the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a warm glow on the quiet suburban street. His worn-out backpack slung over one shoulder, Lil Johnny trudged up the driveway, eager to unwind. But Lil Johnny’s peace and quiet was short-lived. Somehow, the evil dragon named “Steve” had found its way into Lil Johnny’s world—a world that had been blissfully calm until now. Steve’s scales shimmered with malevolence, and his eyes glowed like smoldering embers. The once-tranquil neighborhood now echoed with the dragon’s roars. Lil Johnny armed with determination and a watermelon gun (yes, Lil Johnny had a watermelon garden and an endless supply of watermelons!), he set out to protect his home. The dragon’s lair lay hidden in a faraway land within Lil Johnny’s world. To reach Steve, Lil Johnny would have to fight through nineteen rounds of timed levels. Each level required him to shoot targets, beating the ticking clock to advance. All this target practice would prepare him for the ultimate faceoff against Steve. As the sun dipped lower, Lil Johnny stepped into the forest. The dragon’s roars echoed through the trees, shaking leaves loose from their branches. His heart pounded, but he remembered the countless hours spent coding, designing, and playtesting. This was his moment—the culmination of creativity and hard work. In the end, it wasn’t about pixels or high scores. It was about courage, watermelons (lots of them), and relentless target practice. Lil Johnny’s legacy would be etched in watermelon juice and code—a testament to imagination, teamwork, and the magic that happens when a small group of students believes in the power of both. Play your cards right, and Lil Johnny would face the evil dragon Steve, sending him packing for good. And so, in the heart of Ottawa, Canada, Lil Johnny’s Watermelon Smash became more than just a game—it became a legend. Panther Game Design Studio, a small high school class from Ottawa, poured their hearts into creating this Lowpoly world, a year long project run in their game design program.

rows.name: Fantasmigon
rows.short_description: Fantasmigon is an original turn-based strategy set in a vibrant fantasy world. Engage in thrilling battles and tactical gameplay as you lead your band of characters through challenging encounters
rows.description_html: Welcome to Fantasmigon, an exciting journey into the heart of fantasy and strategy. Assemble your own band by choosing from a variety of factions, each with unique abilities and gameplay styles. Engage in thrilling turn-based battles with players from around the world, where every decision determines the fate of your group. Game Features Create Your Band: Choose a faction and customize your band to suit your strategic preferences. Each character has unique abilities and specializations, allowing for diverse combinations and tactics. Hardcore Battles: Every battle could be your band's last. Players who lose or retreat risk losing their entire band, which can be especially painful due to the loss of developed or unlocked unique heroes. Strategic Depth: Immerse yourself in the tactical nuances of Fantasmigon, where every action matters and every decision influences the outcome of battles. Manage your group's resources, adapt to changing conditions, and anticipate your opponent's next move to emerge victorious. Compete Online: Test your skills against players from around the world in intense 1v1 or 2v2 battles. Evaluate your strategies and tactics in dynamic clashes with other players. Embark on an Epic Adventure: Whether you're an experienced strategist or a newcomer to turn-based games, Fantasmigon offers an exhilarating experience that will keep you coming back for more. Forge your destiny, gather allies, and prepare for battle - the world of Fantasmigon awaits! Join us in Fantasmigon and become the hero of your own epic story!

The free tactical game Guards II: Prologue will immerse you in battles inspired by myths from various cultures. Are you ready to challenge the darkness?
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Guards II: Prologue is a free turn-based tactical game with simple yet deep mechanics. Swap heroes to attack enemies, strategize several steps ahead, and claim victory in deadly combat! Prepare for seven challenging missions where you’ll fight through legions of hellish creatures using the amazing abilities and talents of your heroes. Protect the human world from demons and defeat the cunning boss threatening all of humanity! Guards II: Prologue features: 👹 Four heroes with unique fighting styles, special attacks, super abilities, and varying resistances to damage. 👹 An original turn-based battle system where every move counts. Mistakes come at a high cost! 👹 Magical artifacts and runes that empower your team and unlock new tactics. 👹 Three dark biomes with a distinctive atmosphere and enemies inspired by Egyptian, Slavic, and Western European myths. ⚔ Test your skills in Guards II: Prologue today! And don’t forget to add the main game, Guards II: Chaos in Hell, to your Wishlist to continue the adventure!

rows.name: Astral Hound VR
rows.short_description: Become The Astral Hound, play as Howard, a man who can project himself into the astral plane, as he traverses the Astral Realm to find and rescue Allie who has been kidnapped by a supernatural organization BIO.
rows.description_html: There’s no other way! The astral plane becomes his only waking reality. Forced to live a nightmare cunningly orchestrated by BIO, an organization driven by the so-called greater good but at what cost? Hiding its practices under a suit of normalcy. Struggling, you play as Dr Howard, who leaves all certainty behind in a deadly quest to find the secrets hidden in the depths of the astral plane and to save humanity. Unknowing of what’s yet to come, the horrors of reality dawn on him as he finds fragmented memories and uncovers truths about Allie and Leilah that have been  hidden for years. Dr. Howard floats effortlessly in the vast expanse of the astral plane. Leaving him with the sensation of weightlessness that is both liberating and unnerving. Here, in this place is where the laws of physics hold no sway. The Grab System : Your Lifeline. The astral plane is another dimension. Reach into the void and pull yourself through the chaos, each grasp clawing you closer to the unknown. Every movement is a gamble: precision and resolve are the only things keeping you from drifting into the abyss. Propulsion Gloves: Defy the Current. With advanced propulsion gloves, you can fight back harder. Surge forward with bursts of speed, slicing through hostile currents in a desperate race against time. Your tools are your lifeline, but mastery of them is the difference between survival and annihilation. Astral Gems : Hunt for the truth.  Allie’s memories are not freely given. Scattered across its vast expanse are astral shards—glowing fragments of forgotten memories. These radiant shards pulse with eerie light, each one a key to unlocking the truth. But the shards are guarded, hidden in the plane’s most treacherous reaches. Dare to seek them out, and brace for what watches from the shadows. Astral Projectors: Unleash the Power. The astral shards serve a greater purpose. Machines known as astral projectors lie dormant, waiting for the shards to awaken them. When activated, these towering devices explode with light, carving through the void to reveal fragmented visions. These haunting glimpses of a forgotten past are your guide. But beware—some memories are better left buried.

rows.short_description: Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit.
rows.description_html: This game is an anomaly finding (difference finding) walking simulator. Game description: Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit. If everything is consistent in the level with the baseline state, proceed. If you observe any anomalies, turn back! Once you're out of the building, you can start the game all over again to experience all the anomalies! --- Attention! This game is a result of learning Unreal Engine. All sound files, 3D models, and textures are sets of free resources downloaded with some modifications. Have fun!
