rows.name: Esports Godfather: The Legend Begins
rows.short_description: E-sports Godfather is a Deck-building game simulating MOBA e-sports. You will play a role as team coach and build your team. You need to train players and make strategies in various game versions, beat other teams and finally, take the Champion of the World. Be nobody, or lead your team to dominate!
rows.description_html: Official version About the Game 'Esport Godfather' is a management simulation card game that revolves around the theme of MOBA esports. In this game, you will play a role of a coach in an esports club and personally build your own team! Starting from scratch, what kind of playstyle will you devise for your team? In a constantly evolving meta, can you derive a unique understanding of what it takes to win? What style of play will you devise for the team? Trident or 1-carry? Is the main focus on the top lane 1v1 battle, or the ultimate coordination between Mid laner and Jungler? In the ever-changing version environment, can you come up with a unique understanding of victory and lead the team to success? How will you inspire those outstanding athletes you carefully selected and mold them into superstars? And finally, can you overcome countless obstacles, lift the championship trophy, and write your own esports legend? Create your team logo You can not only customize your team's name but also create a unique team logo using the tools provided in the game (you can also import local images). Then you can see the flag with your logo waving on the battlefield, in the community, and in the most liked team vote each month! Build your hero draft The match has already begun before 00:00! Engage in a BP game with your opponents, picking your draft from over 50 heroes. Based on the version and your players' proficiency, choose a lineup that crushes your opponents and makes victory inevitable! Card Command your players through cards: your jungler is ready to initiate a team fight, send him to the bottom lane to ambush the opponents. Or if the enemy heroes are supporting elsewhere, take advantage and push... Command your players towards victory based on your hand and the situation on the field. Player Development As a coach, you need to create training plans for players based on their traits, arrange hero pools reasonably, and build tactic card decks to guide them to become superstars! rows.name: Union of Gnomes: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue of the Union of Gnomes awaits your daring and brave gaze. Twisted and broken, it stands — a reflection of what was never meant to be. The threads of destiny fray, and reality splinters like a shattered mirror.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Is this just the beginning or the end? The boundary blurs and the tale unfolds like an old map, its edges worn by time. But what is happening? The question echoes through the caverns of forgotten lore. In the basement’s darkness, where cobwebs cling to to wooden beams like the memory of a lost loved one, dreams and truths entwine. The world lies far, far away — its secrets veiled. What has happened to it? Or perhaps, what would have happened? This dream, a fragile tapestry, unravels against the cosmic loom of life. All is weird The Master’s will, an iron decree, governs the broken kingdom of Gnomes. A dark mission, veiled in shadows, beckons only in the Prologue’s hallowed pages. The ink smells of ancient forests, and the parchment cradles forgotten oaths. See what the Kingdom will become, should you falter. The Gnomes’ destiny rests upon your trembling hands — their hopes, sorrows, their whispered lullabies. And there, amidst the gnarled roots, a voice in your head murmurs cryptic riddles. Is it memory or prophecy? Listen closely. Escape from the nightmare, dear wanderer. Traverse the labyrinth of ink, blood, and imagination. Finish the prologue, and perhaps — just perhaps — you’ll glimpse something else: a door ajar, a glimmer of forgotten magic, a path diverging into the unknown.

rows.short_description: Engage in intense warfare like never before in 'War Sniper' the ultimate war game. Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping action of a battlefield where snipers, tanks, and drones are your tools of destruction.
rows.description_html: Engage in intense warfare like never before in 'War Sniper' the ultimate war game. Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-pumping action of a battlefield where snipers, tanks, and drones are your tools of destruction. 'War Sniper' is an exciting and realistic war combat game with a massive campaign mode that can be played offline and a real-time multiplayer PvP combat mode. Are you ready to take the shot and lead your squad to victory? Key Features: • Sniper Showdown: Become the deadliest sniper on the battlefield and eliminate enemy targets with precision. Take your shots from hidden vantage points and make each bullet count. • Tank Warfare: Command powerful tanks and unleash devastation on the battlefield. Roll over enemy lines and dominate the warzone with heavy firepower. • Powerful Drones: Pilot a variety of deadly drones, each equipped with a unique arsenal of weapons. Upgrade your drones for maximum devastation and precision shooting. Target enemies with pinpoint accuracy as you unleash a hail of bullets and missiles. • Realistic Campaign Battlefields: Immerse yourself in stunning 3D environments that capture the chaos and intensity of modern warfare. From urban warfare to desert landscapes, each map presents unique challenges. • Competitive PvP: Climb the ranks and prove your skills in intense PvP battles. Earn rewards and prestige as you become a renowned war hero. • Rank Up: Climb the ranks and earn rewards as you prove your skills on the battlefield. • Stunning Graphics: Experience the chaos of war with stunning visuals, realistic sound effects, and immersive gameplay. • Prepare for war, commander! The battlefield is calling, and only the best snipers, tank commanders, and drone operators will emerge victorious. Download 'War Sniper' and step into the heart of modern warfare today!

rows.name: Trilingual
rows.short_description: Welcome to the planet, Triangulus. Can you solve the hidden mysteries of each island and escape with your brain intact? Scan these ancient runes to decode a new alien language. Use this alien language to grow plants, move trains, and even save the Trilings of the planet.
rows.description_html: Trilingual is a single player puzzle experience in space. After crash landing on the planet Triangulus, you must decode the native language of the Trilings to escape. Travel across unique islands to reach the center and board a spaceship to safety. Alter your environment, save Trilings, and find hidden secrets with this new alien language.

rows.name: Brutal Bible Bloodbaths
rows.short_description: Based on a profound Bible passage, use weapons like your magic laser sword to cleanse the promised land with optional body chopping and blood splatter.
rows.description_html: Brutal Bible Bloodbaths is a controversial first-person physics-based game. It involves a few sandbox levels that you can play around in. These levels include things mentioned in the Bible passage, such as fruit trees that God says not to chop. Cleanse the promised land Based on Deuteronomy 20:16-20 from the Bible, you have to kill everything that breathes and you can order soldiers to help you. Your victims include animals, children, babies, and sexual worship assistants. The Bible justifies this by explaining that God hates the way the people worship their gods. The End Times In a level it's the future and things have changed. The soldiers initially disobey your cleansing command and say 'Jesus will come and judge the world'. They also quote Psalm 11:5 which says 'God hates people who love violence'. With or without blood and gore In the initial warning screen you can choose whether you want blood and gore or not. This allows you to change the game mode to 'Unbrutal Bible Bubblebaths'. Fully dynamic chopping Using your magic laser sword, you can chop people, animals, and many other objects however you like, until they are in tiny pieces. Precision chopping quest An optional quest gets you to chop people and animals in specific ways such as chopping their leg, arm, or tail. When finished you can return to the box to see how obedient you were. The Sinful Temple In a level you can explore a temple containing things God hates like child sacrifice and sexual worship assistants. You can worship the god/goddess idols in the temple but this will cause the soldiers to target you as well. Tidy up the bodies A level has you tidying up the clutter in the promised land after cleansing by pushing chopped up bodies into a pit. Chase and chop In a level you have to chop people who are hiding and running for their lives and try to get a low enough cleansing time. The Body Hacker This weapon allows you to hack the matrix in the game to make the targeted body part break into pieces. Holy Hand Grenades Blow all of the people and animals to kingdom come in slow motion. Other things in the game You can also ride horses, get drunk on fermented fruit, build ladders to get over city walls, and chop just about everything including flowers and talking robots from the future.

rows.name: Magic Lantern Festival
rows.short_description: Magic Lantern Festival is a hyper multitask 2D bullet hell. Players are required to recreate their brain in order to dodge all the magic bullets and answer random quizzes simultaneously.
rows.description_html: ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~【Invitation】~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Dear high witchness, The Lanternville is glad to inform you that the next Magic Lantern Festival will soon be held. Everything you need to participate is thirst for wisdom and a nice little familiar. Under the name of The Great Witch, let us praise every single drop of knowledge! Sincerely yours, Magic Lantern Festival Committee ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ To newborn witches, the Magic Lantern Festival is a feast held in Lanternville every time the committee feels motivated. This time, the rule is very simple; let your familiar survive a bullet hell of magic for a certain period of time. Each witch you encounter in Lanternville will continuously emit magic while giving random quizzes on their field of specialty. Not answering or making mistakes on the given quiz will result in tough penalty... Don't think about doing so on purpose! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- On a pixel-designed 2D stage, you will have to survive a bullet hell for a certain time period. Not only that... you also need to answer quizzes simultaneously in order not to let the bullet hell become more and more dense. During the Early Access, players can access to 9 genres of quizzes, each of them with an Easy mode and Hard mode. There is also a practice mode where you can only practice solving the quizzes (without the bullet hell).

rows.name: Royal Quest Online
rows.short_description: Fantasy comes alive in this vast yet cozy free-to-play MMORPG! Choose between 4 classes and 8 subclasses, explore hundreds of locations, thousands of quests, dive into varied PvE and PvP modes, enter the unique vibrant world, and trade with other players. Play, explore, fight and be victorious!
rows.description_html: Royal Quest Online is a free-to-play MMORPG that seamlessly combines elements of captivating fantasy and futuristic technology. Begin a crusade against the forces of evil! Defend your kingdom, earn titles, hoard riches and conquer castles ! THE CHOICE IS YOURS Imagine a team consisting of a sniper armed with support cannon, a mage casting defensive shields, a mercenary assassin throwing poison bombs, and a crusader spreading the holy light while riding an armored wolf! Royal Quest Online offers these and hundreds of other roles for you to fulfill. Discover a world full of goblins, werewolves, vampires, orcs and even dragons. Visit enchanted living forests, dungeons full of deadly traps, magnificent palaces, hulking fortresses, forlorn laboratories and even islands in the sky. Get to know this magic world and then conquer it ! Lands of Elenia truly are a sight to behold and they’re just made for adventure! Join magic orders and clandestine organizations, meet the native inhabitants of Elenia and dig through the echoes of past civilizations, ravaged by the horrendous cataclysms. All that and more leads to thousands of quests replete with valuable rewards. YOUR PATH TO GLORY There’s no single right way to the top. Play, aim big , and never stop, until you get what you want! Become a wandering monster hunter or a mercenary doing regular jobs. Sign up for Royal service or make a fortune selling rarities. Vanquish competition in the arena and wrest yourself a castle. Go as far as your imagination allows you! GUILD CLASHES You live in the kingdom — you follow its laws. Become a member of an existing guild or create your very own to then fight other guilds over massive fortresses . Owning a castle is not only honorable, but also highly profitable, as castles generate regular income. Start with one castle and keep expanding your holdings!

Use your trusty lasso and spaceship horse to travel to the Orange Biker and Blueberry Pirate planets and save the universe from the Evil King!

However, your tyrannical twin brother has taken control of the fruit worlds with his evil blender, and it is up to you to liberate the universe. Save your scattered people from the Orange Bikers and Blueberry Pirates using your trusty lasso! Swing Your Way Through Use your trusty lasso to swing on different objects ranging from soda cans and bottles! Explore Fruit Worlds You will make your way through 5 fruit themed planets, the Prickly Pear Cowboys, the Orange Bikers, the Blueberry Pirates, the Strawberry Mafia, and the Banana Kingdom!

rows.name: Manludo
rows.short_description: Play rock, paper, scissors to get off an alien space station. Esperanto: Vi devas ludi papero, tondilo, ŝtono por forlasi eksterteran kosmostacion.
rows.description_html: You wake up on an alien space station. To leave, you need to win at manludo/hand game (rock, paper, scissors) against three aliens. You can leave your fate up to chance, exploit your opponent's weakness, or bluff your way to victory. Be careful with bluffing, the more you bluff the more likely you are to lose everyone's trust: making bluffing more difficult in the future. Gameplay: Use mouse or touchscreen. Click or touch the blue arrow ➡️ to move forward in dialog. When making a decision click on the text you would like to do. During the hand game click on the hands, either rock, paper, scissors, or bluff. Icons show the number of wins you have in a match 🏆, the number of coins you have 💰, and your trust score ⚖️ (how much people trust you). The higher your trust score the more likely you are to successfully bluff. If you lose turn you get an option to talk to your opponent 🗣️, you might find a weakness you can exploit. The game can be completed in about 5 minutes. --- Esperanto --- Vi vekiĝas sur ekstertera kosmostacio. Por forlasi la stacion, vi devas venki tri eksterteranojn en ludo de roko, papero, tondilo. Vi povas lasi vian sorton en la manoj de la hazardo, ekspluati la malfortecon de via kontraŭulo, aŭ blufi por venki. Estu singarda pri blufado; ju pli vi blufas, des pli probable vi perdos la fidon de ĉiuj: tio igas blufadon pli malfacila estontece. Uzu muson aŭ tuŝekranon. Klaku aŭ tuŝu la bluan sagon ➡️ por antaŭeniri en dialogo. Kiam vi faras decidon, klaku sur la tekston, kiun vi volas elekti. Dum la manludo, klaku sur la manojn por ŝtono, papero, tondilo, aŭ blufi. Ikonetoj montras la nombron de viaj venkoj en matĉo 🏆, la kvanton de viaj moneroj 💰, kaj vian fidindecon ⚖️ (kiom multe homoj fidas vin). Ju pli alta via fido-poentaro, des pli verŝajne vi sukcesos blufi. Se vi perdas vicon, vi ricevas opcion paroli kun via kontraŭulo 🗣️; vi eble malkovros malfortecon, kiun vi povas ekspluati. La ludo povas esti finita en ĉirkaŭ 5 minutoj.
rows.about_html: You wake up on an alien space station. To leave, you need to win at manludo/hand game (rock, paper, scissors) against three aliens. You can leave your fate up to chance, exploit your opponent's weakness, or bluff your way to victory. Be careful with bluffing, the more you bluff the more likely you are to lose everyone's trust: making bluffing more difficult in the future. Gameplay: Use mouse or touchscreen. Click or touch the blue arrow ➡️ to move forward in dialog. When making a decision click on the text you would like to do. During the hand game click on the hands, either rock, paper, scissors, or bluff. Icons show the number of wins you have in a match 🏆, the number of coins you have 💰, and your trust score ⚖️ (how much people trust you). The higher your trust score the more likely you are to successfully bluff. If you lose turn you get an option to talk to your opponent 🗣️, you might find a weakness you can exploit. The game can be completed in about 5 minutes. --- Esperanto --- Vi vekiĝas sur ekstertera kosmostacio. Por forlasi la stacion, vi devas venki tri eksterteranojn en ludo de roko, papero, tondilo. Vi povas lasi vian sorton en la manoj de la hazardo, ekspluati la malfortecon de via kontraŭulo, aŭ blufi por venki. Estu singarda pri blufado; ju pli vi blufas, des pli probable vi perdos la fidon de ĉiuj: tio igas blufadon pli malfacila estontece. Uzu muson aŭ tuŝekranon. Klaku aŭ tuŝu la bluan sagon ➡️ por antaŭeniri en dialogo. Kiam vi faras decidon, klaku sur la tekston, kiun vi volas elekti. Dum la manludo, klaku sur la manojn por ŝtono, papero, tondilo, aŭ blufi. Ikonetoj montras la nombron de viaj venkoj en matĉo 🏆, la kvanton de viaj moneroj 💰, kaj vian fidindecon ⚖️ (kiom multe homoj fidas vin). Ju pli alta via fido-poentaro, des pli verŝajne vi sukcesos blufi. Se vi perdas vicon, vi ricevas opcion paroli kun via kontraŭulo 🗣️; vi eble malkovros malfortecon, kiun vi povas ekspluati. La ludo povas esti finita en ĉirkaŭ 5 minutoj.

rows.name: Fluffquake Fury
rows.short_description: A light-hearted, fun, simple RPG where you play as bedroom hero Pippa Pillowfeather and try and beat lights out by using her Pillow to defeat any monsters in the bedroom! Use new pillow attack abilities as she progresses to different bedroom scenes.
rows.description_html: Join Pippa Pillowfeather in her bid to escape the Fluffquake Fury before Bedtime! She must use her pillow to whack, spin and jump her way through various bedroom skirmishes before the lights go out! This is the debut release from novice developer JustAlexGames! Play as Pippa Pillowfeather, the cute and feisty young pillow whacking girl who's dressed ready for bed - but has no intention of closing the curtains until she's defeated all the baddies in the bedroom! Lights are out soon, so she has to use her pillow to whack 'em fast before its too late! She starts off in her own bedroom and once the Mousey is defeated a new room will be unlocked. The challenges get tougher and tougher as she unlocks more rooms until the corridor is complete and she's granted with a new Pillow Spin ability! The next world is her Mum and Dad's room - she really shouldn't be in there but there's many, many new baddies to conquer first! Next is a hotel - with some really tricky situations in the rooms and corridor! There's even a lift you can use to explore the basement, stock up on health and strength and escape from the nasty green smoke that comes when you throw one of your new poison pillows! If you survive all that, then there's one final boss to conquer! He is armed with devastating exploding pillows and is weaving in and out of falling beds as he runs to the finish line! Enjoy playing this simple, quick, light hearted game - the debut game from JustAlexGames. Music composed by the developer - I challenge you to keep the theme out of your head!

rows.description_html: [New Season: Adventure Begins - Version Update Content] - New Gameplay - Treasure Cave: In this season's Abyssal Rift, commanders will venture into a new rift zone where the ocean and land coexist. In this dangerous yet treasure-filled area, embark on a new journey alongside your clubmates! - Gameplay Upgrade - Joint Operation Abyss Mode: In the new season of Joint Operation - Abyss Mode, commanders will head to the newly introduced Morden Army Base. rows.name: Anna: The Magic of Words
rows.short_description: It’s a challenging 1980s like platformer game with a serious story. For the Nintendo Entertainment System® and Famicom.
rows.description_html: It’s a challenging 1980s like platformer game with a serious story. For the Nintendo Entertainment System® and Famicom. Game in active development. Demo download below. The story of the game The magic of words gave you everything and suddenly took everything from you. A little sad and disappointed you make your way through a dangerous world. Embark on the difficult journey through dangerous caves, deep forest and icy landscapes. Collect scrolls and combine their words, face your fear and the ticking clock. But whatever happens, never forget your most important goal: find Anna. The deeper meaning of the story The game is more than a typical 1980s platformer. The game itself is just a shell. The shell for a process of self-discovery, healing, motivation and the strong will not to give up. The character embarks on an arduous journey and search for Anna. Even if you’ve already guessed it, Anna doesn’t have to be human or animal. Anna can just as well be representative of a favourite place, a feeling, family, being at home, feeling good or the satisfaction of a completed task or with yourself, but of course also a single person. There is no right or wrong answer to the meaning of the game title. You decide. You are also welcome to simply ignore the psychological aspect and concentrate fully on playing this challenging platforming title. Just pay attention to the little hearts and the ticking clock. ;-P Game controls After the first game start, there is a standard keyboard layout configured already: D-Pad: W-A-S-D Select button: K Start button: L B button: , A button: . You can configure your keyboard or gamepad directly via Settings > Controls menu.

rows.name: Blue Land
rows.short_description: Craft, fight, explore! In this Open-World experience, you can do that all! The choice is yours...
rows.description_html: To summarize, Blue Land is a 2D, Open World game, with a more chemistry-based twist on the survival genre. PLOT You find yourself in a world full of dangerous entities distilled from the periodic elements of our universe, brewed up by the essence of pure evil. Like tumors, your world is filled with little biomes, with elemental entities, ready to take your life. These entities may be harvested for elements of the periodic table, and may be crafted into fierce weapons, to aid you in facing harder and harder entities until you are finally ready for the final challenge; THE ELEMENTAL KING ... In Blue Land, you can fight the clock to try to get your fastest time , or you can explore and inquire ins and outs of the Blue Land World in this survival game. In any case, you can - Craft - Fight - Explore The choice is yours... Credits and Special Thanks to: -Xiaoyi 'Ethan' Pan (Ethanbaby66) - Artist -FishUser - Musician

rows.name: Raid On Rift
rows.short_description: Be prepared to defend your Ore in this multiplayer turn-based strategy game! Take control of the Imperial Navy or the dreaded Space Pirates, and use a variety of crewmates to take your opponent's Ore before they take yours!
rows.description_html: Early Beta Access This game is in early access, full game release is coming soon! About the Game Raid On Rift is a video game featuring a turn-based strategy system with customizable teams made of unique characters. Our game centers on the fearsome and rugged Space Pirates as they face off against the militant and legendary Galactic Navy, fighting on an alien mining outpost to fight over a coveted and extremely valuable source of ore. Our game also includes lan multiplayer capabilities so that players can play with their friends across separate devices. Furthermore explore the legend of the characters and learn their unique move sets within our games tutorial, story, and helpful UI features. Raid on Rift features an extremely dynamic playstyle, as their is draft phases, placement phases, and neutral zone phases before the game even begins. Challenge your friends and learn new strategies and army's to master your playstyle! Whether your interested in the lore or the infinite strategy variants and opportunities, our game has something to offer to gaming enthusiasts alike.

rows.name: Miner Tower Defense
rows.short_description: This is a game that combines mining and tower defense elements. Players need to build defense towers by digging and gathering minerals underground to resist a constant stream of monsters!
rows.description_html: Background Story When the miners were digging underground, they accidentally opened some channels, inside which a continuous stream of monsters that would attack the precious energy crystals emerged. Fortunately, the miners have mastered a technique of using ore to synthesize defense towers. In order to resist the monster's attack, an adventure journey of mining and building defense towers begins! Gameplay Features 1.The combination of mining and tower defense You need to plant defense towers by mining and gathering minerals to resist monsters' attacks. I believe this innovative game mode that combines mining and tower defense can give you a different experience. Mining: Place defense towers to resist monsters: 2.Learn to utilize terrain There are intricate underground channels, and by modifying these channels to create favorable terrain, you can pass the levels more smoothly! 3.Rich gameplay This game includes 42 regular levels, 9 unique entertainment levels, 3 boss levels, and 3 endless mode levels. In addition, you will gain various tools and talismans on your adventure journey, which will make you even stronger! In short, the rich gameplay makes mining never boring! Unknown Minesweeper Mode: Powerful BOSS: Hope you enjoy this indie game!

rows.short_description: 誘拐犯 Kidnappers is a horror game where you aim to escape without being caught by mysterious visitors while retrieving the game you lent to your friend.
rows.description_html: *ding-dong* You're playing at your friend's house when you hear the doorbell ring. His parents are coming home late today, so your friend has to go look. ■About the Game This is a horror game where you must escape while avoiding the enemy and collecting specified items. There are elements of being chased, but no jump scares (sudden loud noises or scary images). The expected playtime is around 15 to 20 minutes. There are 3 endings: BAD (Game Over), NORMAL, and TRUE. The game does not feature a progress-saving function (only mouse sensitivity and volume settings are saved). ■Controls WASD: Move L Shift: Sprint E: Interact Esc: Menu ■Regarding Video Streaming Streaming and Let's Play videos are permitted without requiring permission. If possible, please include the game's name in the title of your stream or video, and include a link to the Steam page in the description.

rows.name: Impostor Online
rows.short_description: Inspired by party games like Werewolf and Mafia, Impostor Online is a 6-16 player online game of murder, deception, and infection. Join friends and play as a Civilian, Impostor, Zombie, Nurse, Jester, or other unique characters to strategize your way to victory!
rows.description_html: Impostor Online is a murder mystery and social deduction game inspired by classics like Werewolf and Town of Salem . In each match, players are assigned random roles within three competing factions: Civilians (good guys), Impostors (bad guys), and Zombies (infection). Civilians win by eliminating all Impostors and Zombies, Impostors win by outnumbering Civilians, and Zombies win if they're the last faction standing. Impostors are the main murderers. Each night, they can see and communicate with one another and select one player to eliminate. Ghost Investigators play a crucial role on the Civilians team. Each night, they can communicate and choose one player to investigate, revealing their role and guiding the team's strategy. Jester  can either vote to kill a player each night or hide to conceal their identity from investigators. Nurse  can inject players each night. Their injections heal players targeted by Impostors, but will kill any player after two non-consecutive treatments. Nurse can instantly eliminate Zombies with a single injection. Zombies can infect one player each night to convert them to their team. However, they can't identify fellow Zombies, and accidentally targeting another Zombie results in that Zombie's death. During the day, all players gather to debate who they believe is guilty. Through voting, they can lynch a suspect. Civilians must collaborate with Investigators to eliminate the Impostors and Zombies to secure their victory. FEATURES: Multiplayer : Play online with 6 to 16 players. You can play with your friends or join other players. Written and vocal chat : Communication is key in Impostor Online, as you have to either accuse suspicious players or defend yourself against their accusations! Multiple unique roles : Special roles and abilities across three competing factions – Civilians, Impostors, and Zombies. Customization : Personalize your character from head to foot. Progression and statistics : Earn experience points and rewards from every game you win. As you level up, unlock new titles and cosmetic items to showcase your rank and style.

rows.name: Fruity Friendz Adventurez
rows.short_description: Are you ready to help free Peter Pear, creator of the Fruity Friendz, who is locked up in a castle, by defeating Villainz and annoying Crumbleez, face many challenges and collect coins and fruit to earn one of a kind items?
rows.description_html: Fruity Friendz Adventurez is a cool FREE TO PLAY casual game with action, adventure, educational features and humor. It's all taking place in a beautiful environment including forest, rivers, lakes, mountains. The story is about Peter Pear, paint artist and creator father of the Fruity Friend Benny Banana, is kidnapped by the Villainz and taken hostage into the Villainz castle.  Benny will have to explore the big world and face many challenges like trap holes , pendulums and mazes. In the entire world annoying Crumbleez (cookie crumble creatures)  appear from everywhere and challenge Benny to battle them, that will decrease his energy life bar, but can be filled up by collecting fruit.  On his quest to find Peter and free him, he has to defeat the end boss Keki. But only with enough collected coins and defeated Crumbleez.

rows.name: Vribyss Refuge™ The Escape
rows.short_description: While fleeing from the Kexxrans, Isla falls deep into a cave. As she searches for a way out, she encounters mysterious beings trapped there that may be able to help her get out. Discover the mysteries of Vribyss in this short-action role-playing story-driven game!
rows.description_html: A rare breed of starfish with healing properties known as 'Vribyss' was recently discovered and exploited by the Kexxrans. This created the greatest refugee crisis the world has ever seen. While fleeing from the Kexxrans, Isla falls deep into a cave. As she searches for a way out, she encounters mysterious beings trapped there that may be able to help her get out. Features: • Short story-driven game • Dynamic Difficulty Adjustment (DDA) based on one or more factors: current health, enemies (if any) defeated, and time to complete specific tasks. • 1st/3rd person perspective • Strafing mode • Downloadable PDF strategy guide • Downloadable documentation for 'Non-Official PS5 DualSense Support' • Alternate ending if the player pursues a mysterious object during a 'time-sensitive' situation.

rows.description_html: Mouse Killer is a 100% Free to play bullet hell game. This game is a pure Mouse only game! Use the mouse to move, left button is for shooting, right button is for aiming. Evade and destroy waves of vegetables. Collect magic symbols to get stronger or faster, but be aware - some magics may hurt you. Kill and avoid any tomato, paper, carrot or onion that you see on the screen. Enjoy a free game with fast pace and random magic that might help you finish the game.

rows.name: May's Journey
rows.short_description: May’s Journey is a 2.5D puzzle game where players use pseudo code to solve environmental mazes and learn programming basics, guiding protagonist May to restore balance in a fractured, fictional world.
rows.description_html: Embark on an engaging adventure with 'May’s Journey', a 2.5D puzzle game that seamlessly integrates programming concepts into its gameplay. Navigate through a maze-like environment and employ the game’s intuitive pseudo code to manipulate various objects and overcome challenges. Designed as an interactive learning experience, 'May’s Journey' immerses players in the fundamentals of programming, emphasizing logical thinking and object-oriented abstractions. Set in a crafted fictional world thrown into disarray, players assume the role of the guide and helper of May, the determined protagonist on a quest to restore balance and uncover the enigma behind her world's fracture.

rows.name: Volcanewt
rows.short_description: Volcanewt is an action city destruction game where the goal is annihilation. Destroy the city, defeat the WWDF and their creations, and save? the Hawiwi Archipelago.
rows.description_html: Mass destruction and newt goodness awaits you in Volcanewt ! Play as the Volcanewt, a volcanic salamander ready to destroy the World Wide Defense Force(WWDF) for leeching off his volcanic energy. In this action packed city destruction game, you go across the 3 Hawiwi Islands, a tropical archipelago that on any other day would be a tropical paradise to visit. These three islands are Beginners Bay, a tourist hotspot where our newt makes their humble beginnings, to Hawiwi Resort, a beautiful resort with a more mustered militia to defend against the Volcanewt, to Mamba Metropolis, a metropolis that also acts as the WWDF's main headquarters. In Volcanewt , to complete each level you must fill out your destruction meter, a tool to determine how much of the city you have annihilated, and claim back your thermal energy from the clusters of the WWDF in the form of destroying powerplants. Doing so will further unlock the Volcanewt's dormant powers. These powers consist of a thermally powered charge, a fireball projectile, and a beam for destruction on a massive scale. The WWDF won't allow their cities to be destroyed that easily though, as they droves of soldiers to fend you off, and the creations of General Hugh Gexplosion to further halt the Volcanewt's Advance. Play as the massive Volcanewt, destroy the cities to progress, and unlock abilities that will aid in the total destruction of the WWDF!

rows.name: Summoned By Accident
rows.short_description: Summoned by Accident is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos.
rows.description_html: Summoned by Accident is a text based rpg focused mainly on m/m content with character driven plot. In it, you explore and run into inhabitants of the world. Some friendly, some foe. Inspired by other text based games and some videos. You play as a visitor to the world who's trapped here till you can get a way back home. Luckily, your first encounter is with a short blue fox that seems to have the hook up. Able to get you a place to stay and even a new job as you wait. This, much like the inhabitants of the world, is something more than what first comes to eye. As you meet new people and learn what exactly you're being set up for, you'll be forced to choose who's allegiance you stand for. Even if that is mainly for one other person than group. At first, you'll be restricted on what you can do. Exploring and finding about the little part of the city you stay at, but as you progress further in the story, so too does your freedom along with others. What starts out as you learning about the world and meeting new people, will evolve into you changing yourself to fit the occasion. Whether it's changing your looks for the right guy to be interested in you or people to give you the time of day. The way you fight so you can stand a chance against something you're dragged in to. Or just to do it so you can see that something special only a certain few can, you won't be leaving this world the same way you came into it.

rows.name: Light Reforged
rows.short_description: Light Reforged features Baldr, the god of wisdom and light, as he travels the Nine Realms to rid the world of technology that was designed by Loki and is slowly bewitching the realms. Exploring vibrant and technological worlds while defeating a variety of opponents.
rows.description_html: Loki, the god of trickery, is up to his grandest scheme yet and to see it to fruition, Baldr, the god of wisdom and light, must be out of the way. Slain by Loki, Baldr is cast to the underworld. Loki uses this opportunity to his advantage to introduce intoxicating technology to the Aesir and dwarves, which the dwarves embed into the world causing an imbalance. Reborn by Hel, Baldr must restore balance to the world and regain godhood. Over Light Reforged, the player travels between four of the realms of Norse mythology. These include Helheim, the home of the dead; Asgard, the home of the Aesir; Vanaheim, the home of the Vanir; and Svartalfheim, the home of the Dwarves. The Realms: Vanaheim - realm of the Vanir and nature – is the last stand between Ivaldi and his goal of technological takeover. As such, it’s the most naturalistic and least steampunk in visual design. Asgard - Asgard is more technologically advanced than Vanaheim. The Asgard arena is a sacred battleground, but small glimpses of technology can be seen around the outer rim of the arena. Svartalfheim is home of the Dwarves and ruled by the Sons of Ivaldi. The city is the most corrupted realm, void of any lush nature. The water and sky are stained red from use of the magic cores. Roads, sidewalks, and large buildings are dirtied by the smog that persists through the city. Located in the city are three cores that power the city. Throughout the game, the player has multiple combat mechanics at their disposal for fighting different enemies throughout the levels: a dash, a melee attack, projectile weapons, the Prismatic Light Meter, and special actions. Use The Elements To Fight: As you fight you increase your Prismatic Light Meter. Prismatic Light allows you to use the elements to the advantage. There are three elements that can be chosen from. Fire, Ice, and Wind. Each of these elements has three tiers. Each elements offer a variety of offensive and defensive capabilities. You can get burn damage on your enemy over time, freeze them in place, or blow away large groups of enemies. Hack N Slash Your Way Through: Light Reforged focuses on hacking and slashing your enemies. Use fluid combat to strategically dodge enemies and gain the advantage on your foes. Challenge bosses and a variety of enemies throughout the realm that require you to think before you jump. If you feel overwhelmed, use your cannon to clear waves of enemies. Use your dash to mow through hordes and slash enemies as they try to surround you.

rows.name: terminal connection
rows.short_description: terminal connection is an experimental art game about doomscrolling. You fly a plane.
rows.description_html: terminal connection is a metaphor for doomscrolling. You fly a plane. Stay close to surfaces to keep your engine running as hyperreal landscapes flood your senses. You find yourself in a cozy airplane hanger, seated in a cockpit. As you attempt to start your flight, a glowing cave fades in around you. You go through the standard flight checks, testing your controls, and begin to glitch through overwhelming and disorienting spaces. Terms and conditions fly by you, the love you've never had is advertised – demanded – of you, your interests are weaponized in your workplace, and you're forced to see visceral vulnerability. Finally, space seems to collapse onto itself, threatening to overpower you, but you find yourself flying into a never-ending void. Will you end your terminal connection? terminal connection is an observation of the resting state of capitalist-hyperreality. Capitalist-hyperreality is a phenomenon brought about by the exponential growth of hyperreal influences within a capitalistic structure. Hyperreality is – the abstracted and self-referential understanding of reality that comes about as a result of human communication and, more relevantly, mass media. It identifies the distance we have created between our subjective realities and objective reality as a result of our construction of experienced reality based on the subjectivity of others rather than what actually might be real. If a rare flower were to be found in the modern day, a hyperreal construct of the flower would be created through language, videos, images, songs, artworks, and poems of said flower. The average person’s understanding of the flower would almost certainly be based on the hyperreal construct of the flower, and more hyperreal constructs would be created based on the existing hyperreal constructs. This perpetuating web of abstraction extends until the real flower itself is nearly forgotten. Only a minute few would have ever actually seen the real flower. terminal connection diagnoses the consequences of when hyperreal abstraction is driven by monetary incentives. This game is a metaphor for doomscrolling and expects to simulate the emotions brought forth by ever invasive social media, in a critical space. We hope to accentuate the adverse consequences of capital incentives on the otherwise natural processes of abstraction spreading throughout mass media. We've attempted to depict some of the relational cycles of oppression/oppressing present in capital driven social media and provide the player with the first step out of the cycle - the moment you choose to leave. Extensive writing about terminal connection and the process of creating it can be found on our blog, .

rows.name: Priest With a Gun
rows.short_description: A late-night vending machine run is cut short when a demonic outbreak occurs in the park. Little do the demons know, Father Garcia is never unarmed.
rows.description_html: Defeat a Demonic Outbreak A retro wave-based shooter where you and your foes become increasingly more powerful. Battle your way through hordes of demons using the power of whatever weird and magical drinks your local vending machine has to offer. Explore Your Local Park While fighting off the horde, be sure to check out everything this park has to offer! You can rescue a stray dog, get scammed by talking with strangers, support a local imp union, visit the bar, raise a pet leech, take trips to exotic demonic realms, fix teleporters to bend space and time, or make deals with a sentient piano! Keep the Fight Going After beating the game you can enter Endless mode, where enemies get exponentially more powerful with each new wave. How long can you last against the onslaught? Flex Your Expertise With 50+ achievements to get, you can show just how much of a vending machine enthusiast you are! And those who unlock all achievements get a special Completionist achievement (which soon will get your name/nickname on an in-game leader board). Get Involved As a first-time solo developer, I am still learning lots about game-making. Reach out if you encounter any bugs or if you have your own ideas about things to add to the game. Any idea submissions added to future updates will be credited to you, so be sure to include a name or pseudonym for accreditation!

rows.name: Vanakatu
rows.short_description: A surreal story-driven game that uses puzzle-solving, turn based battling, and open world navigation to help Van Cat track down his evil uncle and put an end to his nefarious plans!
rows.description_html: This is an open-world story about VAN CAT (that's his name, no affiliations with vehicles), a duduk player from a regular family, who tracks down his CULT-LEADING UNCLE through spacetime to talk him out of creating a WORLDWIDE DICTATORSHIP!!! Explore three surreal, immersive worlds swirling with music, light and color, inspired by the Ottoman Empire, Soviet Armenia and modern day Armenia to rescue your best friend, talk some sense to your weird, weird uncle, and destroy his time machine. This Game Includes: Unique visuals by the developer herself Beautiful music Sunlight and other cute lighting to make it feel like you're actually outside and touching grass Battling mechanics Puzzle solving, using pattern recognition to unlock doors and find hidden keys... Open world exploration, I don't want to control you :D

rows.name: Xi-Portal
rows.short_description: Unravel the Mystery of Xi-Portal You'll have the chance to join a diverse community of students and explore the exciting world of Xi-Portal alongside captivating characters such as Schneider, Hikari, Ayako, Ai, and KakaMigu.
rows.description_html: Unravel the Mystery of Xi-Portal Xi-Portal is a horror game where the player transfers to a new school and tries to make friends. And then things unexpectedly take a dark turn as the player has to uncover hidden secrets and face terrifying consequences.  The game features multiple storylines and choices, making each playthrough unique. The player must navigate intricate puzzles and solve riddles to uncover the truth behind the enigmatic Xi-Portal, adding an extra layer of suspense and fear.  In addition, the player must understand that every decision has no return.  Genre: Visual novel, Horror Platform: Windows, Android. Engine:  Ren'Py Languages: English, Arabic 61,000+ words Nameable MC Five characters are available. Maybe? Map feature: You can go anywhere you want. Reading time: 4 hours and 8 minutes Estimated gameplay time: +8 hours for new players Challenging puzzles 11 different endings (4 true endings  | 1 good ending | 1 normal ending | 3 bad endings  | 2 worst endings ) Point of no return game. WARNING:  This game contains flashing lights, scary images, loud sounds, and jumpscares; it's not recommended for people who suffer from any kind of phobia. (Especially those who have a weak heart.) You can contact the developer via the email:   kakamigu@gmail.com .

rows.name: Cardian
rows.short_description: CARDIAN is the prototype of a fast-paced micro dungeon crawler, set in a colorful tabletop world of adventuring animals.
rows.description_html: NOTE: This is an early prototype that was released to the public. Please consider this as you play. CARDIAN is a fast-paced micro dungeon crawler, set in a colorful tabletop world of adventuring animals. FEATURES A card-combining battle system inspired by the old-school ATB (Active Time Battle) JRPG combat and physical card games such as Star Realms. Three varied regions to master, each with their own enemies, cards and trinkets to find! Beautiful card artwork filled with colorful animals. Pocket-sized adventure with a playtime of around 2 hours.

rows.name: Phantom Watcher
rows.short_description: Phantom Watcher is a chilling horror-strategy game. Survive the haunted hospital’s mysteries, navigating ghostly behaviors in a unique CRT aesthetic. Each playthrough is a new eerie challenge. Dare to uncover the secrets?
rows.description_html: Experience Realistic Immersion Delve into a realm of lifelike visuals and sounds with a clean user interface, guaranteeing an immersive experience that will keep you entertained. Encounter Distinctive Spirits Discover 10 distinct types of ghosts, each with unique characteristics, personalities, and capabilities, ensuring every investigation presents a fresh challenge. Manage Your Power Managing and overseeing the power distribution within the building is pivotal for survival. Operate the fuse box to control the power supply, which only sustains one room at a time. Maintain Your Sanity Prolonged exposure to darkness and encounters with the supernatural can overwhelm your sanity. Witnessing or hearing eerie phenomena can drive you to the brink of madness. A significant loss of sanity may prove fatal. Journey into the Haunted Depths Embark on a journey through the haunted St. Valentine's location, filled with unique twists, secret hiding spots, and intricate layouts. Modes for Every Player With four challenging difficulty levels and assorted trials, there are plenty of ways to test your skills, each mode offering distinctive rewards. Unearth the Archives Progress through the game to unlock historical archives, unravel the tales of lore, and delve into the mysteries of the past. Become the Phantom Watcher Every ghost you conquer is a step forward. The experience points you earn allow you to progress through various ranks, each more prestigious than the last. Your journey culminates in the ultimate achievement: the esteemed rank of “Phantom Watcher.'

rows.name: Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure
rows.short_description: A teddy bear alone in a dungeon, his only hope for escape is... kitchen implements? A zany roguelike adventure with 100+ unique items, 9 bosses, 15+ weapons with upgrades, potion and scroll crafting and random dungeons. Explore, fight collect loot and use pineapples to help Mr Snuggles escape.
rows.description_html: A quirky take on a roguelike dungeon crawler, Mr Snuggles the teddy bear is trapped in an outlandish dungeon and needs to escape using whatever he can find along the way. Slightly humorous, quite strange and hopefully a lot of fun, Mr Snuggles Dungeon Adventure is a challenging roguelike game with RPG elements and unique gameplay. NEED HELP? The game is difficult in the beginning & might be confusing so here are some hints... Collect scrap by destroying crates Hit switches & collect purple crystals though beware as some switches are traps Find a teleporter once you have a purple crystal & teleport to camp At camp unlock the storeroom - top left building / Use XP at the book to unlock more items that will drop from crates Once the storeroom is unlocked any items you put into chests will be automatically stored if you complete the current level If you die anything in the storeroom will be saved Collect as much as you can & in the beginning of the game scrap it in the inventory menu to allow you to use the weapon stand Use the weapon stand in camp to get a random weapon each run, some weapons are better than others Unlock teleporter crystals, full health potions & drill (makes destroying crates easier) in the book first & stockpile in storeroom Remember the quick slots are keys 1234 & the up/down/left/right arrows on gamepad FEATURES 100+ Items to unlock with ability stacking 15+ Weapons - All upgradeable 9 Bosses each with a unique item Craft Scrolls & Potions Player stats to upgrade Collected items can be stored for next run with persistent storeroom Collected items can transported to storeroom via chests in level Procedural (random) dungeons means every play is different Permadeath - no character save, only items in the store room are saved

Collect scrap by destroying crates Hit switches & collect purple crystals though beware as some switches are traps Find a teleporter once you have a purple crystal & teleport to camp At camp unlock the storeroom - top left building / Use XP at the book to unlock more items that will drop from crates Once the storeroom is unlocked any items you put into chests will be automatically stored if you complete the current level If you die anything in the storeroom will be saved Collect as much as you can & in the beginning of the game scrap it in the inventory menu to allow you to use the weapon stand Use the weapon stand in camp to get a random weapon each run, some weapons are better than others Unlock teleporter crystals, full health potions & drill (makes destroying crates easier) in the book first & stockpile in storeroom Remember the quick slots are keys 1234 & the up/down/left/right arrows on gamepad FEATURES 100+ Items to unlock with ability stacking 15+ Weapons - All upgradeable 9 Bosses each with a unique item Craft Scrolls & Potions Player stats to upgrade Collected items can be stored for next run with persistent storeroom Collected items can transported to storeroom via chests in level Procedural (random) dungeons means every play is different Permadeath - no character save, only items in the store room are saved

rows.name: Stellar Larceny
rows.short_description: Embark on a cosmic heist in this zero-gravity adventure! Maneuver the galaxy as a sentient robot armed with a magnet, jetpack, and gravity boots. Your mission? Infiltrate facilities, find parts, and return life to your friend - while running from a mysterious company intent on shutting you down.
rows.description_html: Embark on a cosmic heist in this zero-gravity adventure! Maneuver the galaxy as a sentient robot armed with a magnet, jetpack, and gravity boots. Your mission? Infiltrate facilities, find parts, and return life to your friend - while running from a mysterious company intent on shutting you down. Stellar Larceny is a zero-gravity puzzle-platformer where players take the role of Enness, a sentient robot under the control of the mysterious GAUSS Systems. After an unknown program frees them from GAUSS' influence, they must escape the facility and help save their friend from the brink of deactivation. Six Degrees of Freedom In these zero-gravity environments, you must use all of the movement tools available to you to deftly navigate through each facility's security systems. Use your grappling hook to cross distances quickly, your gravity boots to walk on walls and ceilings, and your jetpack to make smaller rotations and adjustments. Puzzle-Solving Use gears strewn about the facility to power on doors and deactivate traps, but take care! You might have to get creative to power on the devices in the right sequence.

rows.name: SDIES
rows.short_description: Explore a surreal world full of contrasts: black and white, friends and enemies, serenity and agitation. When the time comes, what we resist will persist, what we accept will transform, and through self transformation, we will discover the spectrum in between.
rows.description_html: SDIES is an interactive animation that explores the duality of black-and-white thinking and contrasting emotional extremes. This visual metaphor, and the evolving gameplay which embodies themes of self-transformation and finding balance, offers a short yet impactful journey in a visually, aurally, and emotionally polarized world. Tactile point & click gameplay Monochromatic animation art style Adaptive jazz music This experience is designed to empower players to overcome mental health issues and trauma which often push people to emotional extremes. How much of our experience delving into frighteningly dark and destructively joyful places is guided by outside forces? What happens if, instead of submitting to a hostile environment which consumes and changes us, we enact the change we want to see within ourselves?

rows.name: Steel Century Groove: Midnight
rows.short_description: Pilot mecha in rhythm-RPG dance battles in this free standalone adventure from the world of Steel Century Groove. Assemble a squad of colossal dancers and groove your way through a neon city where it's always night.
rows.description_html: Thousands of years ago, humanity built colossal war machines to stop the apocalypse. Now they just use them for dance battles.  Groove your way across a neon city of perpetual night, build an online following, and discover the secrets hidden in an abandoned arcade. This is a free standalone story set in the world of Steel Century Groove , and can be enjoyed entirely on its own. It features exclusive content not found in the full game: unique levels, new characters, and a fully separate narrative. Additional Features: Collect and upgrade: Level up your mechs, equip them with mods, and pair them with backup dancers. Unique gameplay kits:  Each mech has their own set of abilities, mechanics, and resources. A simple starter mech builds and spends energy, while later mechs have you maintaining an army of drones or swapping between cards in a mini deck builder. Flexible rhythm combat:  Steel Century Groove: Midnight doesn't demand a specific button press for each note. Instead, pick from your mech's kit of battle abilities. No playing the metronome: Challenge yourself against interesting melodies, even when playing with your own music. You’ll never just be endlessly tapping out the beat. No accessories required: Built from the start for gamepad or mouse & keyboard.

rows.name: Shepherds
rows.short_description: Shepherds is a 3D, two-player co-op musical adventure game in which players control unlikely partners - a shepherd girl named Zoe and a magic wolf named Kin. Players must cleverly combining their unique mastery of musical melodies and distinctive movement styles to solve puzzles.
rows.description_html: Here are some debug tools in case you encounter an undesirable situation: R + = : Restart the current Level R + 'numbers': Jump the a different sequence within the current level Shepherds is a 3D co-op action-adventure game that blends musical puzzle-solving gameplay. Players control the shepherd girl Zoe and the magical wolf Kin, cleverly using their individual mastery of musical melodies and unique movement styles to solve puzzles across various adventure levels. Ultimately, they will delve into a shepherd's temple at the heart of an active volcano to find a way to prevent the vengeful spirit, Black Dragon, from laying their island to waste. Interested in teaming up with family and friends for a cooperative adventure and experiencing the thrill of puzzle-solving in a game world? Join 'Song of the Shepherds' and enjoy the fun of human-animal teamwork! Tower of the Dragon The Black Dragon awakens, and the volcano erupts. By a twist of fate, shepherd Zoe and the magical wolf Kin find themselves in the ancient shepherd's temple where the Black Dragon is sealed. Despite their natural enmity, they must collaborate to venture deep into the heart of the volcano to the Tower of the Dragon, find a way to save their island, and make their escape. Spirit of Sound Within the ancient shepherd's temple, many mythical creatures dwell. Some assist Zoe and Kin on their journey, while others cunningly obstruct their path. Observing these creatures' traits and cleverly using their own abilities, players will experience an adventure of musical puzzle-solving and platform jumping. Song of the Shepherds In the temple, shepherd Zoe inherits the legacy of ancient musical magic, and the magical wolf Kin awakens the power of frost. Combining their abilities, they perform the Songs of the Shepherds, rescuing trapped music spirits, purifying the ancient shepherd's temple, and ultimately unveiling the sealed truths. Shepherds is a thesis project from the University of Southern California, developed collaboratively by Haoyun and the Team Sheep. USC Games has been known for its professionalism, diversity, and strong student teams, having produced several outstanding games. 'Shepherds' aims to be among these successful projects. Both USC Games and Shepherds share a passionate commitment to creating innovative gaming products and continuing to enrich the gaming industry. Join us for a new experience in the gaming world!

rows.name: Thunder Age
rows.short_description: In the flooded future world, mankind has built floating islands where electricity is harnessed during the raging thunderstorms. This unstable energy is crucial for survival, but also poses the greatest risk in this Tower Defense game.
rows.description_html: Thunder Age is a post-apocalyptic, science-based tower defense game that empowers players to dictate enemy paths. Harness electricity to fortify defenses and fend off adversaries. The campaign mode provides five scenarios with increasing difficulty. To beat them all, you must think fast and evolve your strategy according to the scenario specific new features, such as available building types and layout of the map. In the custom game mode, you can unwind at your own pace or seek a greater challenge in survival mode. The game boasts a unique art style within the genre, imbuing a captivating atmosphere complemented by a powerful soundtrack.

rows.name: Monstro Maestro
rows.short_description: Play as a conductor trapped in a haunted and crazy mansion! As a concert begins, a jealous ghost appears and takes possession of your orchestra. To free them, you must explore every corner of the mansion, complete musical challenges, and rebuild your troupe.
rows.description_html: Set your own pace : Play as Maestro, a conductor and his traveling troupe who must perform in a mysterious mansion. Explore these places filled with melodious rhythms in search of your musicians who have been captured by the mansion's owner, MONSTRO. Prepare to battle various ghostly monsters that inhabit these grounds and unravel the curse that hangs over this mansion. Monstro Maestro is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by the Megaman X franchise, the rhythmic mechanics of BPM, and platform/adventure games such as Celeste and Hollow Knight. Game features : Discover a mansion populated by monsters, passing through its gardens and exploring its various rooms. Explore diverse biomes, each with unique movement abilities and powers. Face off against the five enemies that live in these places. Flying, jumping, or stationary, you will have to choose the best method to eliminate them. Defeat 5 formidable bosses! Face off against the disciples and the master of the domain in unique battles where the fate of your musicians hangs in the balance. Take on the Kaiso board challenge! After collecting all the bells in the mansion, put your movement and navigation skills to the test in a whole new gaming experience. Enjoy a unique musical experience thanks to the different types of music that emanate from the location and gameplay. Original soundtrack composed specifically for the game. Fight using your wand by casting various powerful projectiles that can be imbued with the rhythm of the surroundings. Background : Monstro Maestro is a project created by second-year Game Development students. The main development of the game took place over a period of nine weeks, during which a team of 12 programming students and 11 graphic design students designed and produced the entire game. It was presented as a second-year final project in June 2025. Following this presentation, a proposal to publish on the Blacknut platform was made by its CEO. Part of the team continued development during the summer of 2025, making adjustments, fixes, and adding new content with an entire new biome. The final phase of production was completed in December 2025. On the technical side, Monstro Maestro uses a custom engine developed by programming students during the year. This game engine, called T.E.DD (Technical Engine 2D), is based on SFML, ImGui, SDL3, and C++. It is based on an Entity-Component model. This engine was developed over a period of three months.

rows.name: The Littlest Fry
rows.short_description: You are a small goldfish who has to protect a youngling while discovering how unforgiving the ponds in the wilderness are. Your objective is to defend a baby fish from predators while out maneuvering them while evading other obstacles that may be in your way while searching for safer waters.
rows.description_html: Description Littlest Fry is a 2D casual, adventure game. You will play as a small fish and your job is to protect a small baby fish from various dangers . You will be swimming around in bright and colorful Finnish ponds and using various methods to pass hazards and move between ponds. Features You will be using nets to trap enemies, hideouts to conceal your presence and caves to pass predators. You will be expertly swimming around polluted patches of water to avoid an untimely doom. You will be leaping out of water to jump to another pond.

rows.name: HANEHOLO!
rows.short_description: A jump-action game where you control Hololive members and aim for the goal!! With simple controls, just keep climbing higher and higher! Play the entire story for free in the free version!
rows.description_html: Overview A jump-action game where you control Hololive members and aim for the goal! All platform objects are based on Hololive members’ episodes — over 250 in total! Use the gliding action with mascot balloons skillfully to reach the goal! Includes a massive main stage and short stages for each generation. Updates will continually add new stages and objects based on the latest episodes. The free version lets you play through the entire long main stage including the story! ※ To unlock the features restricted in the free version, you need to purchase the “Standard Edition Upgrade DLC.” The options available in the free version are as follows. Selectable Holomem: Pekora Usada, Moona Hoshinova, Shion Murasaki Selectable mascot balloons: Nousagi, Moonabito, Shiokko Selectable stage: Main Stage Selectable difficulty: Normal ※ The 3D models of Holomen are official models used with permission. In the Standard Edition Upgrade DLC, you can select a total of 35 player characters, mainly JP talents. For other details and added features, please refer to the “Standard Edition Upgrade DLC.” Main Stage Story The Usada Construction duo — Pekora Usada and Moona Hoshinova — had planned an off-collaboration. When Moona was taking too long to arrive, a flustered Pekora decided to go all the way to the moon to fetch her!? Climb the under-construction New Pekora Tower , serving as an orbital elevator, to reach the moon! Hurry, Peko-chan! Go pick up Moona before the stream starts! The rabbit can only leap toward the moon! Collect “Memories” By obtaining items, you can unlock the gallery and learn the stories behind the platform objects. By the time you’ve climbed to the top, you’ll be a Hololive expert! Make the Most of   Mascot Balloons By obtaining mascot balloons placed throughout the stage, you’ll be able to use the gliding action. Gliding can be used both for progression and to prevent falling, but the number of balloons is limited — timing is everything! Ranking Compete with players around the world for the fastest clear time! There are countless route combinations — find the one that works best for you! Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed. ※1. About CCMC Corp. rows.name: It Takes Many
rows.short_description: You've got a Tindermatch! Sadly she lives very far away so you decide to fly to her and take your friends with you! Plays like Super Mario, but you only have a limited amount of restarts. Play with up to 7 people. Reach the End to win the game
rows.description_html: Play online with up to 7 players and help Claudio, the protagonist of the story, to find the love of his life. Solve increasingly difficult tasks together with your fellow players. The more players you have, the more difficult the game becomes. You can't die in this game, but if you jump in the wrong place at the wrong time, the group leader has to restart the level and there are only a limited number of restarts. When all the restarts have been used up, you have to start all over again. It all starts quite simply, but becomes increasingly difficult over time. You can't complete the game on your own: You need a good team, communication and coordination to make it. Movement in the game is relatively simple: WASD and Space, but timing is key. The game is a bit like an escape room. You and your team have to find out what you have to do in each level and each level has new tasks. Once everyone knows what they have to do, it becomes relatively easy, then it's all about timing and skill. There are currently 2 starter worlds, after which players can decide which main world they want to enter. There are 4 main worlds and 1 secret world for those who seek a special challenge. The main world is also the end world. Each end world has a different ending, each end world has different mechanics and tasks to solve. The tasks vary in difficulty, but are all relatively simple once you know what you have to do. The big difficulty is that nobody can make a major mistake, otherwise you have to restart the level, and as soon as all the restarts have been used up, you have lost. The game is aimed more at hardcore players who are looking for a special challenge and are underchallenged with conventional 2D sidescrollers. The difficulty is not in the difficult jumps that have to be made in a short time, but in the fact that if one of the existing players makes a mistake, you lose a restart.

rows.name: Prologue: Fish idle 2
rows.short_description: Dive into the most fun idle fishing arcade game! Manage your Fish Kingdoms with automated fishing, upgrade your boat and gear, invest in passive income, and outsmart the market. Become the ultimate fish tycoon!
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Prologue: Fish idle 2 is a free introduction version to Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery! Crush in your rainboots and hop into your boat! We are going fishing in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery, a unique idle fishing arcade featuring smooth graphics and intuitive mechanics. We have no time to swing a fishing rod, so let’s streamline the process! SIMPLE AND EASY FISHING Let’s start with the basics. It’s all about automation: fish start biting as soon as you approach them, and resource indicators keep you informed while you focus on managing your Fish Kingdom effectively. The game offers advantageous upgrades to enhance your idle fishing abilities, helping you become a true fish tycoon. You’ll still need to steer your boat to chase fish schools and avoid obstacles, so don’t get too distracted by your economic prowess! UPGRADE YOUR FISH KINGDOM Once your hull is full, it’s time to get upgraded! Improvements in fishing speed let you catch more and rarer species, while increased storage capacity allows you to hold more catches in your boat. Boost your boat’s speed and defense for impact protection, and enhance your fishing rods to cast multiple lines at once. It’s all about maximizing your gains in the most efficient way, so you’ll have to use your head to figure out the best way to success! MAKE IT BIG Just like in real life, becoming a fish tycoon involves various ways to profit from your catches. The Idle Fish Farm allows you to invest and get passive income, while the Black Market lets you upgrade your Fish Kingdoms beyond OSHA standards. The Bots Shop enables you to hire hunter, fisher, and cargo ships to fish and deliver catch for you, boosting your income. If day trading is your thing, there is a Currency Exchange that has some special benefits. Tax fraud is not a crime, it’s an obligation if you want to make it big. NOW GO FISH Get ready to dive into the Fish Kingdoms and become the ultimate fish tycoon in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery!

We are going fishing in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery, a unique idle fishing arcade featuring smooth graphics and intuitive mechanics. We have no time to swing a fishing rod, so let’s streamline the process! SIMPLE AND EASY FISHING Let’s start with the basics. It’s all about automation: fish start biting as soon as you approach them, and resource indicators keep you informed while you focus on managing your Fish Kingdom effectively. The game offers advantageous upgrades to enhance your idle fishing abilities, helping you become a true fish tycoon. You’ll still need to steer your boat to chase fish schools and avoid obstacles, so don’t get too distracted by your economic prowess! UPGRADE YOUR FISH KINGDOM Once your hull is full, it’s time to get upgraded! Improvements in fishing speed let you catch more and rarer species, while increased storage capacity allows you to hold more catches in your boat. Boost your boat’s speed and defense for impact protection, and enhance your fishing rods to cast multiple lines at once. It’s all about maximizing your gains in the most efficient way, so you’ll have to use your head to figure out the best way to success! MAKE IT BIG Just like in real life, becoming a fish tycoon involves various ways to profit from your catches. The Idle Fish Farm allows you to invest and get passive income, while the Black Market lets you upgrade your Fish Kingdoms beyond OSHA standards. The Bots Shop enables you to hire hunter, fisher, and cargo ships to fish and deliver catch for you, boosting your income. If day trading is your thing, there is a Currency Exchange that has some special benefits. Tax fraud is not a crime, it’s an obligation if you want to make it big. NOW GO FISH Get ready to dive into the Fish Kingdoms and become the ultimate fish tycoon in Fish Idle 2: Underwater Mystery!

rows.name: The Ethernal Spiral
rows.short_description: The Eternal Spiral is an immersive fantasy action RPG that blends intense combat, with an interesting time loop mechanic that ensures that every time playing feels unique.
rows.description_html: The Eternal Spiral features challenging combat reminiscent of the Dark Souls series, emphasizing precise timing and strategic decision-making . Players must survive three intense waves of enemies, each culminating in a unique and formidable miniboss. Upon victory, the player progresses to the next level and gains a minor buff for the time being. The game’s innovative time loop mechanic ensures that each reset brings both familiarity and new challenges. The player retains the skills and experiences gained from previous cycles, allowing players to adapt their playstyle and unlock new abilities. However, The Big Boss becomes increasingly cunning, introducing unpredictable elements to each encounter.

rows.name: KEABE free
rows.short_description: TPS, PVP, Online Multiplayer and Single Player with cute stuffed animal characters and Big Guns. Colorful cyberpunk map with hologram surfaces and Red Matrix.
rows.description_html: KEABE: Kill ’Em All - Bunny Edition is TPS, PvP, Online Multiplayer, and Single Player game with cute stuffed animal characters and Big Guns. KEABE – Backstory Summary KEABE is a candy-colored battleground suspended in deep space—a cluster of ancient alien arenas built from Earth’s fractured memories. Pyramids, Aztec temples, WW1 trenches, neon towers, and spaceports collide in a surreal mix of history, myth, and simulation. Created by a vanished alien race known as the Enchiladas , the arenas were once elite training grounds, populated by obedient bots and toy-like animal combatants. The bots still serve. The toys evolved. Now, five sentient plush warriors remain: a cat , a techno-cat , a mouse , a unicorn , and a bunny . They clash in three rounds of heavy machine gun fire, thunderous explosions, and bubble- and glitter-filled combat. In the final minute, the forcefields drop around the neon pyramid— King of the Hill decides everything. General Info: This is KEABE Free —a free-to-play game, version0.61D that includes the first two stages from the full game, which will be launched later. Some of the screenshots are from the full version. KEABE is an arena shooter set in a psychedelic, colorful cyberpunk world with glitching hologram surfaces and a strong dose of Red Matrix. The single-player mode with bots offers a good practice ground. You can also connect with friends or other players online via Photon. The easiest way to play with friends is by using social media to share and join rooms together. In online multiplayer, any empty player slots are automatically filled with bots. The maximum room capacity is currently 12 players. The gameplay is fast-paced and vertical, with multiple floors, jump- and warp platforms, secret pathways, hidden rooms, and lots of firepower and explosions. You can mine the map with proximity mines, take down opponents with high-powered machine guns, or fry them with a flamethrower. Prefer sniping? Settle into a good spot with a sniper rifle and wait for the perfect shot—one clean hit is all it takes. If mines are your thing, place them near item spawns or spawn points for easy remote kills, while you cause chaos with the “catling gun” and its 200-round belt—more than enough to dominate the scoreboard. Or throw in a   few sticks of dynamite— t hat’s   fun. The winner is the player with the most kills at the end of each round. In the final minute of the third round, the King of the Hill zone activates on the top floor. Game soundtrack varies from Heavy metal to Dark ambient to Retro Disco and more. Happy trails!

Try to find a way out of The Gap

rows.name: HFH
rows.short_description: Jump, dodge and flap yourself out of danger. See what distance your penguin can reach while dodging various objects as well as sharks, birds and UFOs!
rows.description_html: Jump, dodge and flap yourself out of danger. See what distance your penguin can reach while dodging various objects as well as sharks, birds and UFOs! The aim of the game is to see what distance you can reach in metres. This requires jumping platforms and dodging obstacles and enemies such as trees, snowmen, birds, sharks etc. Collecting fish allows you to flap while airborne to facilitate dodging. Hitting an obstacle or enemy, falling into the shark infested water or getting abducted by an UFO means game over. The game is a randomly procedurally generated infinite runner so never repeats platform, obstacle/enemy positions or movement. More features coming soon.

Battling to save blockout city from enemy incursion, the player must coordinate action-packed combat with the complex controls of their mech. Players alternate between shooter combat and task minigames, trying to juggle the needs of the mech with the onslaught of evil robots. Fight off hordes of enemies in action-packed FPS combat! Repair the mech from within, putting out fires and maintaining your weapons!

rows.name: Five Nights at Roner's 2
rows.short_description: Searching for fast money, you stumble upon an ad for a paranormal investigation. Upgrade your office, maintain your systems, and above all else: don't let them get to you. It's easy work, right...?
rows.description_html: Tyrone Watermelon is dead. Killed by his own hubris. You are to take his place. In this absolutely RIVETING sequel to Five Nights at Roner's, you are tasked once again with ensuring the safety of the haunted house you are assigned to. Manage your power, ensure safe function of components, upgrade your systems, and make it out alive. Repeat 5 times, and the paycheck is yours. But, of course, there's a catch... Monitor the ghosts and maintain your systems with your handy dandy GooberOS security system! With only one flimsy wooden door, you'll have to make do. You're lucky there's a bed to hide under... The clock is your greatest friend, and worst enemy. Hold out as long as you can, and hope the time expires before you do... Can you survive, for the second time... FIVE NIGHTS AT RONER'S?
