rows.name: Above
rows.short_description: ABOVE is a challenging climbing game set in a mysterious world. Reach, jump and grab on to rocks and moving objects as you pave your way through the vertical terrain. Experience a mysterious and intriguing world with gameplay that will challenge both your skills and endurance.
rows.description_html: Above is a product of a collaboration between 16 students coming together to create an engaging and challenging action climbing adventure. The team developed Above at the National Film School of Denmark in winter 2023, and we are very happy to share the experience with you, the player - thank you so much for playing! - The team at Dreamful Projects THE ONLY WAY IS UP ABOVE is a challenging climbing game that pits the player against harsh vertical terrain as they ascend an enormous tower and explore a mysterious world. EXPLORE A BEAUTIFUL, MYSTERIOUS WORLD Explore breathtaking vistas and take in the uniquely crafted artstyle as you ascend the tower - All rendered seamlessly with dynamic loading. DON'T LOOK DOWN Overcome the challenges of the mountains and peaks as you fling yourself to the top - Conquer more than 10 levels and unlock timed mode to race against your own time! Enjoy tight and responsive gameplay with climbing that feels unique and offer precise controls - Climb on magical grips that appear slowly, grab on to moving platforms, and watch out for fragile rocks that will require you to go fast or fall!

rows.short_description: Can you solve the mystery of the Beast of Gozdary?
rows.description_html: Welcome to the first game by Under The Sink - KryptaFM! We're very honored to greet you all in front of your devices. We'll begin with a message after which you'll be met with plenty of useful tips, in case you'd like to start your adventure. We're going to move to Gozdary, a small village in Poland. The residents have noticed a lot of weird, paranormal things going on. The areas have been haunted by an alleged cryptid from Gozdary, who leaves tracks that are leading us to solving this puzzle. Listen to the broadcasts - valuable intel might be hidden within the messages! We'd love to invite you on our studio's social media platforms where you can share your experiences with KryptaFM! Happy hunting! . Gameplay contains: Nostalgic climate of a Polish village from early 2000s Nod to early-internet webforum era Full voiceacting of radio broadcasts! ...and much more to discover!

rows.name: DeafBlind
rows.short_description: DeafBlind offers an immersive sensory deprivation experience, simulating what life might feel like if you were both deaf and blind. This game invites you to navigate a world shrouded in silence and darkness, challenging you to adapt and explore in entirely new ways.
rows.description_html: Sensory Deprivation DeafBlind is a really cool game that takes you to a place where you can't see or hear anything. It's like nothing else out there because it tries to show you what it's like to be both deaf and blind. It's all about diving deep into what it feels like to not have your usual senses. Tip: For the best experience, we recommend using headphones or earplugs along with a blindfold (Unless you already are deaf and/or blind) Gameplay When you play DeafBlind , the screen is just black, and it's totally quiet. Winning or losing isn't the point of the game; it's more about seeing what it's like to live in a world where you can't rely on your eyes or ears, just on touching and feeling stuff. Achievements The game has these cool achievements that you get as you make your way through the darkness. They're not just regular goals; they tell a story about everything you do in the game. This game is made for anyone who's up for trying something really different. It invites you to check out a world that's hidden and silent, pushing you to get used to it and find some kind of meaning when you can't immediately see or hear what's going on. DeafBlind wants you to just dive in and experience the deep quiet and the big darkness—find out what's waiting beyond what you can normally sense.

Then join Biboby on his journey through the bowels of a convenience store to fix a malfunctioning cash register that won't scan milk. Use the incredibly unsafe and corporate-licensed Fling-a-Thing to traverse the cavernous backrooms of the store on your journey. Features: Fling yourself in any direction through deadly levels! Find secrets in the depths of the store! Compete for the fastest time with your friends! Die multiple times! Good luck you spunky young employee and we here at Songbird believe in you! (Warning: belief is not in the Songbird company budget)

rows.name: Memento Mori
rows.short_description: A game for the ones we lost on the way. Memento Mori is a surreal walking simulator that combines a minimalistic art style and a show don't tell story, focused on dealing with loss.
rows.description_html: A game made for the ones we lost on the way. Experience a surreal, linear walking simulator that explores the themes of death and grieving the passing of a loved one. Waking up in a unknown forest, you find yourself lost and looking for answers, will you find what the clarification you have been looking for or will you find more questions then answers. Dealing with grief and loss A thing that everyone is forced to deal with for as long as humankind came into being is loss and grief. So we wanted to make a game that wasn't just special to us but that can also be special to people struggling with the same issues. A show don't tell journey Memento Mori is a show, don't tell experience that can be enjoyed by anyone and everyone no matter what language they speak due to the lack of dialogue and text. WolfWare Studios WolfWare Studios is a independent game development duo who started making Memento Mori during the second quarter of 2022. Before the production of Memento Mori both Shea Kelly (Creative lead) and Alekzandar Voynikov (Technical lead) made video games for game jams and to produce a medium they have both loved for as long as they can remember.

rows.name: Blood Lust
rows.short_description: Fight against your friends in this multiplayer arena combat game and choose between different characters with occult skills.
rows.description_html: In the 1700s, Jonhatan Sauvage, a powerful, megalomaniac lord, made a pact with the devil. This pact allows him to summon powerful creatures born of dangerous rumors running through his lands, but consuming his soul. With his people terrorized, he and his mercenaries come to their rescue, winning gold and glory in the process. Blood Lust is a student project created by a team of 17 students in their 2nd year at the Interactive Art and Design school from Montpellier. The purpose was to create a Brawl Stars-like game in around 3 months, inspired by “Highwaymen” in a stylized theme. 7 environmental / props artists, 3 chara designers and 7 game designers / level designers / gameplay programmer / sound designers / quality assurance. It was decided to speed up the game and add unique mechanics to each map. The game uses the steam network to allow players from all over the world to fight against each other. Play up to 6 characters with unique skills, 3 creatures and 3 mercenaries. Choose from 4 different maps with their variants in a total of 12 maps! Fight alone against your friends in a free-for-all mode and try to get more kills than them! You can also add bots to play up to 4 players! Team up and create 2vs2 or 1vs2 / 1vs3 games to show off your teams' skills. Take a break from the violence and try to hide and survive in Hide & Seek mode from the bloodthirsty Warabouc. Try out each character in training mode to test and understand their skills.
rows.about_html: In the 1700s, Jonhatan Sauvage, a powerful, megalomaniac lord, made a pact with the devil. This pact allows him to summon powerful creatures born of dangerous rumors running through his lands, but consuming his soul. With his people terrorized, he and his mercenaries come to their rescue, winning gold and glory in the process. Blood Lust is a student project created by a team of 17 students in their 2nd year at the Interactive Art and Design school from Montpellier. The purpose was to create a Brawl Stars-like game in around 3 months, inspired by “Highwaymen” in a stylized theme. 7 environmental / props artists, 3 chara designers and 7 game designers / level designers / gameplay programmer / sound designers / quality assurance. It was decided to speed up the game and add unique mechanics to each map. The game uses the steam network to allow players from all over the world to fight against each other. Play up to 6 characters with unique skills, 3 creatures and 3 mercenaries. Choose from 4 different maps with their variants in a total of 12 maps! Fight alone against your friends in a free-for-all mode and try to get more kills than them! You can also add bots to play up to 4 players! Team up and create 2vs2 or 1vs2 / 1vs3 games to show off your teams' skills. Take a break from the violence and try to hide and survive in Hide & Seek mode from the bloodthirsty Warabouc. Try out each character in training mode to test and understand their skills.

rows.name: The Origin Theory - Episode One
rows.short_description: Origin Theory Episode One is a lighthearted story driven survival horror experience. Game has its classic bad guy, zombies, guns and nasty stuff, but the emphasis is on unraveling the mystery and not grinding down hordes of enemies and surviving bullet soaking boss fights.
rows.description_html: Origin Theory Episode One is a lighthearted story driven survival horror experience. Game has its classic bad guy, zombies, guns and nasty stuff, but the emphasis is on unraveling the mystery and not grinding down hordes of enemies and surviving bullet soaking boss fights. Ethan is an oil rig engineer on a mission with his crew mates to respond to an SOS signal originating from an uninhabited volcanic island. They soon discover that the island is not without its residents and the mission takes a bad turn. Crash landed and separated from his crew, Ethan is taken deeper into the island complex. Now alone and armed with only his ability to use duct tape, Ethan finds himself in the middle of a darkening mystery. Trapped inside the complex, Ethan must use his wits to escape, explore the shadows, fight for survival, find out the fate of his crew mates and unravel the mystery surrounding the island. Unravel The Mystery Follow a narrative experience and uncover the dark secrets behind the events taking place in the Ren island through the logs of the ill-fated staff and captives. Collect Resources To Survive Collect resources found and hidden throughout the levels to buy upgrades to your arsenal. Upgrade weapons with parts scattered along the way.

rows.name: Woohoo!
rows.short_description: Woohoo! is a compilation of casual puzzle and arcade games.
rows.description_html: What Is Woohoo!? Woohoo! is a compilation of casual puzzle and arcade games. Woohoo! provides a great way to kill time while you wait for a download to finish or your gaming clan mates to sign on to play. Touchscreen Support Woohoo! also supports touchscreens! Therefore It'll come in handy when you're in the car on those long family road trip vacations. (Touchscreen-enabled laptop or tablet required.) Included Mini-Games The free base game includes three mini-games called 'Balldrop', 'Memory' and 'Transit'. More mini-games are available through paid DLC add-ons. NOTE: Some of the artwork contains content from the paid DLC mini-games. Balldrop The objective is to keep the ball on the board for as long as possible. There's a leaderboard containing everyone's best time. Memory 'Memory' is a mini-game where you get a grid of random tiles. Each tile has a random color and single digit number. The objective is to find the pairs of tiles. Once a pair is found, the selected pair of tiles will be removed from the grid. The game is over when all of the tiles are gone. Transit 'Transit' is a mini-game where you get a group of nodes and connections which links the nodes together. Each connection has a timetable of when that connection runs. The objective is to get from the starting node to the finish node before the target date and time. There are 30 levels. 3 difficulties and 10 levels per difficulty.

rows.name: Undo The Jam Damage
rows.short_description: Bruce's love for PB&J sandwiches has entangled him in a spellbinding predicament. Venture into the enchanted forest to help Bruce lift the witch’s curse. Tread carefully, though—the woods are fraught with dangers for the unprepared. The game is designed to be difficult
rows.description_html: Story Bruce has been craving PB&J sandwiches, but alas, he's run out of jam! With determination, he sets off into the magical forest, seeking fresh fruits to craft his own delightful spread. 'Undo the Jam Damage' is a charming 2D pixel platformer where you guide Bruce through mystic woods filled with whimsical challenges. Help him dodge dangers, gather ingredients, and return home safely to enjoy his well-deserved lunch. Will Bruce manage to outsmart the tricks of the forest and replenish his pantry? Join the adventure and ensure his culinary quest doesn’t turn sour! How to play This is a short game. The game is desgined to be somewhat what hard. Navigate through each enchanting map, but be wary—the forest is full of illusions and hidden traps. Trust your senses as you tread lightly among deceptive shadows and snares laid by the forest’s mystical inhabitants. Controls: W: Jump A: Move Left D: Move Right Space: Shoot Designed with simplicity in mind, 'Undo the Jam Damage' is also fully compatible with controllers, offering a seamless gaming experience whether you prefer keyboard or gamepad. Embrace the challenge and master the mysteries of the forest to help Bruce on his jam-making journey! Notes From Developer 'Undo the Jam Damage' is a delightful 2D platformer created in Godot, marking my debut into the realm of game development. This game combines a mix of free, paid, and custom assets to bring the enchanting world of Bruce and his jam-making journey to life. My aim was to assemble this project swiftly to deepen my understanding of game development processes. This experience has been an invaluable step towards crafting more sophisticated games in the future.

rows.name: Stardrop
rows.short_description: Gumdrop was peacefully sleeping in their asteroid when a mysterious force smashed it to pieces above the orbit of a nearby planet. Venture through a whimsical world to collect all the lost star droplets, slivers, and shards in this 3D platformer collectathon.
rows.description_html: A peaceful asteroid is soaring through space when suddenly-- BOOM! A mysterious force smashes the asteroid and leaves its debris falling towards a nearby planet's surface! Out of the rubble jumps Gumdrop, who must now venture out and collect all the star pieces that burst out after the crash. Stardrop is a 3D platformer collectathon game where you play as Gumdrop: a strange, little creature whose goal is to collect all the star pieces that fell out of their asteroid after being smashed in orbit. Make your way through a whimsical world on a quest to collect every last drop! Every last... Star... drop... eh? get it? A Little Blob On A Little Mission Sweet, expressive movement! Run, jump, dash, spring, and leap through enemies and obstacles. Expansive, open world! Choose whichever direction you'd like! The world may even open up more the further you progress. Whimsical, colorful characters! Meet a multitude of new faces on your journey.

rows.description_html: THE RELAX MODE OF THIS GAME (+free demo) 🍔🍔🍔 .. rows.name: The Depths of Avalon
rows.short_description: Join Arthur and Merlin in The Depths of Avalon, a cooperative top-down dungeon crawler where you solve puzzles and battle enemies to thwart the dark plans of Morgan La Fey.
rows.description_html: The Depths of Avalon is a cooperative top-down dungeon crawler where players take on the roles of Arthur and Merlin to challenge the dark enchantress Morgan La Fey. This game encourages teamwork with two players using console controllers to navigate through puzzles and battles deep within the dungeons of Avalon. Set in the realm of Arthurian legends, the story brings together characters from these stories to create a narrative that blends myth with interactive gameplay. The game's art style features a low-poly design, giving it a unique visual flair that complements its fantasy setting. Developed over 14 weeks by a group of 16 talented second-year students at Butler Community College and published by Ad Astra Studios, a local non-profit, The Depths of Avalon showcases their hard work and creativity. The game is built using Unity 2022.3.16f1 and Blender 4.0. Grab a partner and prepare to explore the dungeon below Avalon, solving puzzles and fighting bosses along the way!

rows.name: Rusts Of Corruption
rows.short_description: You've mysteriously awoken on an isolated island on an unknown world. A corrupting force spreads through the island, leaving only a short amount of time to learn about the islands mysteries... Who will you meet? What will you learn? Are you ready to see the world die?
rows.description_html: Join the Community! Do you want to connect? Are you interested in the game? Do you want updates on the development? Join the Official Discord Server by clicking on the link in the sidebar and become a part of our growing community! Check out the Demo! Interested in what the experience may entail? You can play the Demo RIGHT NOW!!! This is the original version of the game built for the Pirate Software Game Jam, and gives a rough idea of what the finished game will look like. About the Game Rusts Of Corruption is a game about life, death, purpose, and meaning. It is unique Point & Click Adventure game with a heavy focus on storytelling and character interactions. Speak to each robot, learn their stories. What influence will you have on them? Rusts Of Corruption takes place on a small island on an exoplanet named Charon. Unsure of exactly how you got there, the game simply allows you to explore the island, speak to the robots inhabiting it, and learn about the troubled history of the exoplanet. Throughout the game, you will be given the opportunity to explore the island in which the game takes place on, and you will be able to speak to characters in interactive dialog trees. As you progress through the world, it slowly becomes corrupted by some kind of eldritch entity, forcing you to explore within a limited amount of time before the island ‘dies’. Each robot has their own backstory, personality traits, and quirks. Some are blissfully ignorant, others are painfully aware of their coming doom, and others ponder on the meaning of life. I believe in making games that as many people as possible to enjoy, and for this reason the game will include a large amount of accessibility options so you are as comfortable playing the game as possible. Contrast adjustments (gamma) Reduce or remove background particles Change the game font to make it easier to read Change the colour of the text to make it easier to read Enable or disable text animations Turn off screen shake and glitch effects All Of This and More to Come!!! You can play the Demo RIGHT NOW!!! This is the original version of the game built for the Pirate Software Game Jam, and gives a rough idea of what the finished game will look like. Are you interested in the game? Do you want updates on the development? Join the Official Discord Server and become a part of our growing community! The link is in the sidebar! CONTENT WARNINGS Rusts of Corruption contains themes surrounding depression and suicide, including a scene where a suicide is depicted. This scene can be turned off in the games settings if desired.

rows.name: Whisker President
rows.short_description: Whisker President is a comedic, casual point-and-click game set in a cartoon style oval office. Armed with only a laser pointer and some glue, help the purresident achieve political success by making him stamp the bills, all while ensuring that distractions don't get in the way.
rows.description_html: Help whisker president not get impeached and pass bills :3c Complete the president's job as you act as secret service agent to stamp all of the right bills with Wr. President, the adorable cat in a suit. Whisker President is a comedic, point-and-click simulation that draws in inspiration from Papers, Please and other political sims. PURFORM LIKE A PURRFECT PRESIDENT Experience a chaotic management environment as you wrangle your cat to stamp all of the right bills at the right time. You have a laser pointer, some ink and glue, and a ton of distractions to fend off. GAIN THE ABILITY TO MULTITASK Whisker President takes players on a fun adventure filled with campaigns, distractions, and lots of stamping. Mysteriously, the president became a cat in a suit and now you have to help the cat do what he needs to do without getting him caught and distracted from the job. Discover, experiment, and stamp as you survive through various days of the presidential campaign! UPLIFTING, COMEDIC, AND BALANCED Navigate the challenges of presidential life, from a dependent economy to scandalous distractions never seen before in the oval office.

rows.name: Workshop Works
rows.short_description: Build your dream Food Truck, Conversion van, or Trailer! Customization – Resize, recolor, and tweak objects to fit your vision perfectly. Undo & Redo System – Easily correct mistakes or experiment with different layouts.💰 Real-time Price Calculation – Track material costs as you build
rows.description_html: Welcome to Workshop Works, the works of the workshop :P  I have been building my whole life and its time i brought my skills to the digital world to help captivate imaginations across the world. My builder is intended to help people create their dream whether its quitting your job and starting a food truck or building a Boondocking sleeper van and committing to a van life, i have done it all. You can use the cost fields to enter in the cost of your part you are adding so you can have a rough idea on parts and materials. I can give you an estimate on building your unit if your interested. If not feel free to use the game to help you plan out your build and do it yourself!  I'm working on several new features that will assist in planning such as the fbx export and the layout screenshot with total cost. I've added in a custom part spawner and you can set the dimensions of your custom part as well as the price. this will be useful for making custom wood panels or representations of parts i don't have yet. 🔹 Features: 🛠️ Modular Building System – Build your dream Food Truck, Conversion van, or Trailer! 🖌️ Customization – Resize, recolor, and tweak objects to fit your vision perfectly. 🔄 Undo & Redo System – Easily correct mistakes or experiment with different layouts. 💰 Real-time Price Calculation – Track material costs as you build. 🎵 Built-in Radio – Tune in to curated stations while you work. 📸 Save & Share – Capture screenshots or export designs for future use. Whether you're a hobbyist, designer, or dreamer , Workshop Works gives you the tools to bring your ideas to life in an interactive 3D space. Get ready to build your masterpiece!

rows.name: Wild West: Prototype
rows.short_description: A Wild West PvP shooter for LAN parties. Drunken bounty hunters battle it out in an abandoned forest village - no automatic weapons, just grit, guts, and old-school gunfights.
rows.description_html: This game is a prototype for a Multiplayer FPS set in a Wild West environment, designed for group play on LAN parties with up to six players. The primary appeal lies in the game's unique feature: the absence of fully automatic weapons. Choose your character and jump into the action as a cowboy! Armed with just a rifle, revolver, and a knife, you'll need your wits about you to survive—because it’s going to get wild! Enter the fray in a chaotic battle where every kill counts. Be the first to take down another player, and you’ll earn a bounty on your head. But don’t get too comfortable—the real fun begins when the timer starts ticking, and everyone’s out to track you down! Survival is key, but don’t take it too seriously! If you manage to stay alive, you’ll reap the rewards. If another player takes you down, they snag your bounty, and the cycle continues until one player remains standing long enough to claim victory. Gather your friends and see who can become the ultimate bounty hunter in this goofy, competitive Wild West experience!

rows.name: OneKind
rows.short_description: Onekind is a 3-10 player social deduction game set on a farm. Among the peaceful animals, there are evil creatures hiding, causing chaos and messing with the hunter’s mind. Luckily, there’s a hunter, a former wizard, ready to hunt them down. Get ready for some fun!
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY About the Game OneKind His game is a hide-and-seek game involving a hunter, multiple cows and rabbits. Hunter Role He has to kill the bad animals on his farm with his axe and protect his own psychology. Meanwhile, he must also consider his axe-throwing rights and make sure to hit the demonic animals. Cow Role To blend in with the AIs on the map to avoid the hunter, manage hunger and thirst bars to survive, and be the last one standing by betraying the rabbit and making it bait for the hunter. It's time to show your kicks to the hunter. Rabbit Role Your aim is to mix with the AIs on the map, avoid the hunter, slow down the hunter, survive by controlling the hunger and thirst bars, and reveal the cow to the hunter in order to be the last one standing.Your footprints are so cute, but don't leave yourself thirsty!

Hunter Role He has to kill the bad animals on his farm with his axe and protect his own psychology. Meanwhile, he must also consider his axe-throwing rights and make sure to hit the demonic animals. Cow Role To blend in with the AIs on the map to avoid the hunter, manage hunger and thirst bars to survive, and be the last one standing by betraying the rabbit and making it bait for the hunter. It's time to show your kicks to the hunter. Rabbit Role Your aim is to mix with the AIs on the map, avoid the hunter, slow down the hunter, survive by controlling the hunger and thirst bars, and reveal the cow to the hunter in order to be the last one standing.Your footprints are so cute, but don't leave yourself thirsty!

rows.name: Contingency Plan
rows.short_description: Take control of a capable combat frigate with your friends in Contingency Plan, a VR multiplayer co-op sci-fi spaceflight game about taking contracts and making money.
rows.description_html: In Contingency Plan, you and up to 3 crewmates will use immersive VR interactions to pilot, repair, and upgrade a highly capable combat frigate to complete contracts and make money. Use salvage and rewards during your journey to fund upgrades and purchases, skillfully pilot your ship to avoid enemy fire, use the physical-movement-based ship turret controls to shoot down enemies, and board enemy outposts with your crew to loot what you can find, solve puzzles, and take out any opposition! This is a final project developed by a small team of students in a short time. You may encounter bugs or unfinished gameplay. Regardless, we do still plan to support this game post-launch. Features: 4 player online multiplayer Immersive VR flight controls Multiple levels, linked by a unique warping mechanic Immersive environments filled with interactive elements Hectic gameplay requiring teamwork Physically controlled ship turrets Dock to enemy outposts to complete missions, eliminate enemies, and gather loot Ship upgrades Multiple on-foot and flying enemy types

rows.name: Armadillo Assault
rows.short_description: Armadillo Assault is a multiplayer, action-platformer shooter, inspired by the glory days of couch multiplayer fun. Re-creating the magic of local multiplayer in an online environment, Armadillo Assault offers a unique experience for players looking to have action-packed group fun with friends!
rows.description_html: Armadillo Assault is the perfect game to play with friends and enjoy some casual, action-packed fun! Armadillo Assault re-creates that classic local multiplayer experience, online! Armadillo Assault was inspired by many diverse game experiences and has influences from old school local multiplayer games, classic retro platformers and family friendly fighter games. Armadillo Assault features support for online PvP multiplayer, with port forwarding enabled for the host player, with up to 8 players in a game lobby, with gameplay designed to be easy for everyone to play. Each match features a classic arsenal of weapons to be collected, as well as powerful and fun power-ups spawning throughout the map to keep things fresh and interesting. Armadillo Assault includes classic features of some of those great old school multiplayer experience like Death Match, King of the Hill and Capture the Flag!

rows.name: Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas
rows.short_description: Defeat legions of pirates and marine beasts to emerge victorious in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas! Adventure with survival elements. Customize your ship, prepare for barrages from myriad foes, and navigate the perilous waters of a monster realm. Embark on this thrilling journey and Play for Free now!
rows.description_html: PLAY FULL GAME About the Game Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas is a survival-themed adventure. Immerse yourself in hellish seas where pirates abound and sea creatures lurk at every turn. Engage in relentless battles, seizing all you can and leaving nothing behind. Collect gold on each journey to unlock upgrades, acquire new ships, and recruit skilled captains. Prepare yourself for the challenges of the seven seas! In the prologue of our game, players are plunged into a realm of high-seas piracy, where the ominous presence of ghosts casts a foreboding shadow. Amidst relentless struggles for survival, they must skillfully navigate perilous waters, confronting both earthly and otherworldly dangers. With heart-pounding action and gripping encounters, the prologue lays the foundation for an epic journey brimming with excitement and danger. Select your vessel and captain wisely in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas. Tailor your enhancements to suit your style. Your decisions will determine your survival and combat prowess. Keep enemy ships at bay, evade fires, and beware of traps. Conquer challenges and uncover hidden treasures as you chart your course through perilous waters. Embark on various missions in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas, from bombing islands to pursuing notorious pirates. Brace yourself for encounters with legendary creatures such as krakens, mermaids, and beyond. Get ready to delve into the depths of myth and mystery on the high seas!

rows.name: Quest Of Peril
rows.short_description: Dive into the dark world of a Dying Earth, in this Idle exploration rougelike with turn based combat
rows.description_html: In a distant future, Earth has been reduced to a barren wasteland due to centuries of war. Humanity's survival now depends on ancient magic and faith. Quest of Peril is a Roguelike, with turn based combat and auto exploration. Fight monsters to improve your skills and journey across dark dying worlds to defeat Ifaris, the lord of evil and darkness. Features: > Idle and incremental world exploration > Multiple skills > Auto Exploration > Find Skill Combos to defeat might enemies > A grim dark storyline

rows.name: OutRoad Fury
rows.short_description: Fight demonic hordes and drive your van in search of weapons and resources to destroy the gate of hell, all in a metal atmosphere !
rows.description_html: OutRoad Fury is a top-down action-rogue-lite game where you play as Leina, a metal singer. Following a demonic pact that ended badly, she sets off in search of a missing piece of her instrument ! Your playground, your rules In Toxi City, use the ambiant chaos as your advantage ! Throw furniture at your enemies, push them back over barbed wire and loot buildings containing weapons and resources ! Slaying waves from the underworld Sledgehammers, guitars and even traffic cones... Leina is spoilt for choice when it comes to smashing demons ! Each weapon has its own attack pattern, which can be combined with tapes that have an effect on Leina's performance ! Every road-trip is its own adventure New surprises await you at every turn ! Travel through three districts of Toxi City, in which each zone is random and offers different events that can be resolved by force... or violence ! Unleash your fury Spend your collected souls in a demonic teleshop to gain power and unlock content ! Make noise with picks, ultimate skills that can turn battles in your favor !

rows.name: There's no dragon !
rows.short_description: Alone on a plot of land with a few resources and a single building, your civilization will begin here. Exploit resources, explore and conquer other regions, develop technologies, and fend off relentless barbarian attacks. Everything is manageable: they don't have a dragon!
rows.description_html: There's no dragon is a strategy game in which you build and manage colonies against waves of invaders. The land is divided into sections all compose by ressources ready to be gathered, gain experience to expand on this hostiles land ! Build your army Choose between three civilizations, each with its own skill tree featuring exclusive technologies and units. Move your soldiers to opposing camps to reduce their forces and establish your first line of defense ! Real time pausing This is a real-time strategy game, but don't panic—you can pause the action to make strategic and tactical decisions! Place your structures and give orders to your units. Be sure to be prepared before the next wave ! Capturing regions Clearing a skill level allows you to take control of a region! Each region offers clues about its resources, as well as the threat it poses. Send your soldiers to conquer the territory! Be sure not to lose your colonial counter, otherwise the entire region will slip through your fingers!

rows.name: Golf In Wonderland
rows.short_description: Dive into a fantastical adventure where sport and fantasy come together in a world as delirious as it is enchanting. Welcome to 'Golf in Wonderland,' a unique golf game that transports you to the heart of the wonderland.
rows.description_html: Dive into a fantastical adventure where sport and fantasy come together in a world as delirious as it is enchanting. Welcome to 'Golf in Wonderland,' a unique golf game that transports you to the heart of the wonderland. In 'Golf in Wonderland,' you are immersed in the enchanted kingdom of Wonderland, where each level presents a new challenge. Your mission is to conquer a series of extraordinary golf courses, each more surprising than the last. Every hole is a puzzle in itself, requiring much more than simple golfing skills. Discover secret shortcuts to reach the greens in record time. Each course is inspired by an iconic location in Wonderland and offers a unique visual and gameplay experience. Immerse yourself in dreamlike landscapes. Different levels propose challenges of increasing difficulty. Play in multiplayer mode to compete with your friends. Optimize your route to complete each level as efficiently as possible.

rows.name: SHAPE SHIFTER
rows.short_description: Create, discover and share levels, compete for the best times and discover hidden secrets. In this sandbox platformer, whether you're a triangle, circle or square dictates how you solve puzzles and clear levels! Each shape has their own unique abilities that completely change the game.
rows.description_html: Create and discover Custom Levels on the Steam Workshop! About the Game Welcome to The Geomatrix, a digital realm where everything is a polygon, including you! Create, discover and share levels, compete for the best times and discover hidden secrets. Whether you're a triangle, circle or square, each shape has their own unique abilities that dictate how you solve puzzles and clear levels! - Features- Using the in-game level editor , you can make all kinds of crazy creations from difficult time trials to complex contraptions! The level editor features: Various simple and complex shapes, that you can combine to create minimalist structures or huge open worlds Lots of functional blocks, such as the automator and area trigger for the engineers out there Many handy tools that streamline the creation process, like the camera zoom adjuster and background blocks Grab a friend! Any of your maps can be uploaded to the Steam Workshop to allow them to be played in multiplayer! Deep integration with Steam, use a lobby code or simply invite a friend through the Steam friends menu Compete with each other, for the fastest times and best scores, or work together to solve difficult puzzles Cross-platform compatibility, whether you're playing on a Windows or Mac system, anyone can join their friends, regardless of their operation system If you're not as interested in creating your own levels, or just want to experience some pre-packaged levels, I've got you covered! A handful of demo levels, to preview the capabilities of the level editor and to test your skills Hidden collectibles and secrets, for the keen-eyed and curious A subtle storyline , of course, for the theorists out there

rows.name: Furriend
rows.short_description: Help the lonely mage to spawn lots of cute Paw-friends! Furriend is a 2.5D isometric puzzle games that combines connect the dot + merge mechanics.
rows.description_html: Once upon a time, there was a lonely witch and she wants to have friends to talk and play with. Sadly, her timidness makes her being bashful everytime she tries to approach someone. Then one day, a brilliant idea popped out of the witch's head. With her skillful witchcraft, she decided to summon her own friends. But who or what will come out of the summoning portal? Will it be an orc? A dragon? Or a demon instead?! Nope, she summons furriends, the pawsome and adorable little creatures to be her friend. But, how is this pawzzle rituals work...? How it can summon all those cute little furriends...? Connect the Dot + Merge Puzzle Mechanism Spawn Paw-friends by dragging the summoning circle around the tiles. Combines the summoning circles to create a new mix and reach the target to complete the level. Each animal have some unique requirements to be spawned, adding more complexity to the puzzles. Can you solve all the puzzles? Key Features - Cute visuals & sounds - Relaxing music - 20 Introduction Levels - 3 cute themes

rows.name: Hunter: Space Pirates
rows.short_description: Dive into the enthralling story of Hunter, a young man whose dreams of joining the Navy are shattered by an unexpected twist of fate. As he navigates the complexities of his daily life, Hunter finds himself on an unexpected path filled with mystery, personal growth, and discovery.
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic journey with 'Hunter: Space Pirates' a captivating visual novel featuring over 700 stunning renders. STORY OVERVIEW Dive into the enthralling story of Hunter, a young man whose dreams of joining the Navy are shattered by an unexpected twist of fate. As he navigates the complexities of his daily life, Hunter finds himself on an unexpected path filled with mystery, personal growth, and discovery. CHARACTER RELATIONSHIPS AND SCI-FI ELEMENTS Explore Hunter's relationships with a diverse cast of characters, set against a backdrop of sci-fi elements woven through every aspect of the story. Experience a thrilling narrative filled with personal growth, discovery, and mature themes that add depth and realism to Hunter's journey. THE JOURNEY OF HUNTER In a world where the ordinary collides with the extraordinary, 'Hunter: Space Pirates' tells a captivating tale of mystery and discovery. Meet Hunter, a young man navigating the complexities of his daily life while unknowingly tethered to a destiny far beyond his imagination. As Hunter grapples with personal challenges and finds solace in unexpected friendships, his world suddenly shifts. His dream of joining the Navy shattered by a failed physical exam, Hunter is thrust onto an unexpected path. UNVEILLING MYSTERIES With echoes of ancient prophecies and a heritage waiting to be uncovered, Hunter embarks on a journey that transcends dimensions. From the quiet corners of his neighborhood to the vast expanse of outer space, every step reveals deeper mysteries and hidden truths about his own identity. A GALACTIC ADVENTURE AWAITS 'Hunter: Space Pirates' is a compelling fusion of sci-fi and fantasy, blending intricate character dynamics with cosmic revelations. Perfect for players who crave adventure, intricate plots, and a touch of the unknown, this story promises to take you on a thrilling ride through the realms of imagination. Note: This game contains mature themes and explicit content, intended for an adult audience. Note 2: This is the base game, which includes Chapter 1, along with extra features like the Gallery menu, Characters menu, and Scene Jumper! Note 3: Future chapters will be released as DLC.

rows.name: DASH n CRY
rows.short_description: DASH n CRY is a fast-paced, challenging 2D Precision Platformer game for those who want to put their skills to their limits.
rows.description_html: Jump and Dash your way through the game in this fast-paced, challenging 2D Precision Platformer game for those who want to put their skills to their limits! Shout after failing a challenge, before facing a tight room full of spikes, and SHOUT A LOT after overcoming the hardest levels. Let all that energy out through the CRY !!! Over 40 unique levels with replayability Over 40 levels with progressive difficulty and mechanics, that can be cleared in several ways, with secrets, collectibles, and challenges! Achievements and Challenges Besides clearing the game, even harder content awaits if you wanna tackle on DASH n CRY challenges, where you must complete levels in unintended, much more challenging ways! For those who cleared the game, but still want more, tackle on challenging secret areas inside the main levels to find hidden collectibles, or challenge the EX levels, based on the main level mechanics, but tuned up in difficulty to the (EX)treme! Assist Mode Activate Assist mode to get the power of a god. Invincibility? Infinite Jumps? Infinite Dashes? All Levels Unlocked? We have it all at your disposal. Assist Mode might disable some Achievement and Challenge Rewards.

rows.name: The Shadow Over Cyberspace
rows.short_description: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story.
rows.description_html: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story. From Fiction Factory Games Creators of Arcade Spirits , Arcade Spirits: The New Challengers , and Penny Larceny: Gig Economy Supervillain comes a new experience in science fiction and horror, with a retro computer aesthetic. Mind-Melting Y2K Horror, For Free Yes, free. Just free. Not a 'free prologue,' not free to play, no battlepass, no microtransactions. It's just free thanks to the support of our community. The only currency you'll need to spend is your own sanity (and maybe a 90-hour free trial floppy disk for Carcosa Online). The Throne of R'lyeh is Calling Create your own character, choosing name and pronouns and more. Full text-to-speech support with a special visual impairment mode. (Tap the 'V' key to activate.) Navigate the tangled web of eldritch beings that control the Internet of the year 1999. Search the web, hack protected databases, unravel conspiracies and solve mysteries. Watch weird TV shows which are likely but probably not haunted. Struggle to retain your Humanity against the forces of Chaos and Order after witnessing the Yellow Sign. Check your phone answering machine now and then. They're worried about you. Play kingmaker and decide what horrible entity will dominate the 21st century and beyond. WE HAVE SUCH WEBSITES TO SHOW YOU.

rows.name: Excommunicated
rows.short_description: A typing game of investigation in a space base
rows.description_html: Embark on an intriguing journey in our 2D typing game, where you take on the role of a fearless woman seeking answers in an abandoned space base. Uncover what befell the crew as you face possessed creatures, all through your ability of typing. Immerse yourself in the atmospheric underground vibe, where every keystroke unveils dark secrets and challenges your typing skills. rows.name: Macie's Magic Melee
rows.short_description: Macie wants more plushies! Who could say no to their loving daughter? Battle, dash, and shoot through a magical arena to win. Collect items to boost your odds against the arena's enemies and secure a swift victory. Best of luck!
rows.description_html: Macie Needs Your Help Embark on a heartwarming and thrilling adventure as a devoted father on a quest to complete a special errand for your beloved daughter, Macie. Step into a magical roguelike arena filled with diverse challenges, powerful items, and tricky debuffs, all while engaging in intense 3rd-person combat. Conquer the Arena Face off against nine unique enemies as you battle through nine demanding rounds of combat. Explore 2 distinct environments, each featuring 4 meticulously crafted levels, before taking on the formidable boss. Your veteran skills will be put to the test as you wield Macie’s magical book and paper sword to navigate through waves of enemies and obstacles. Collect and Unlock Powerful Items Make use of the arena’s store to purchase over 10 unique items during your runs, or find them scattered throughout your journey. Each item offers new strategies and enhancements, ensuring a fresh and exciting experience for every playthrough. Prepare yourself for a magical, action-packed adventure where your love for your daughter fuels your determination to succeed. Are you ready to take on the challenge and make Macie proud?

rows.name: Death In The Afternoon
rows.short_description: In Death In The Afternoon, throw yourself into a night of drinking. You play as Arthur, a young student who likes to drink a little too much... Try to fight your addiction ! And choose your drinks and interactions carefully, or you might have the worst BlackOut of your life !
rows.description_html: Death in the afternoon is a narrative and detective game. Let yourself immersed as Arthur and get caught up in alcohol addiction. As you live through night parties, prepare yourself for the inevitable BlackOut. Gather as much clues as you can before passing out... After waking up, you'll have to get out of a tricky situation as best as you can. Take back the control of your life to fix what need to be fixed before the next party... Game features : Play parties in 3rd person. When the sun rises, explore in first person. Gather clues in your phone. Make your choices in multiple-choices dialogues. Navigate a boat. Learn hox to fish. Solve the riddles and conclude the scenarios. 3 Parties and 5 Scenarios. Game in early access.

rows.name: Abyssal
rows.short_description: A 3D turn-based strategy game where a Monk, wielding arcane magic, and his minions battle hordes of Eldritch-like creatures.
rows.description_html: Abyssal is a 3D turn-based strategy game where a Monk, wielding arcane magic, must battle hordes of Eldritch-like creatures with the help of his minions. The story revolves around two brothers, Alaric and Archivald, destined to inherit the leadership of their cult. However, Alaric's greed led him to attempt to kill Archivald to seize all the power, forcing Archivald to flee while his subordinates were killed. Now, Archivald returns to resurrect his fallen comrades and seek revenge. Along the way, he discovers that Alaric has made a pact with abyssal creatures that have infested the city. The brothers must now defeat these evil forces to restore balance and finally exact their revenge. Turn-based strategy in a 3D Isometric view Explore an array of characters: Mages, Cauldron, and more! Use magic to open your way into the Abyss! This game was developed as a 4th-year student project at DigiPen Europe-Bilbao for educational purposes. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Spice Trade
rows.short_description: Spice Trade offers a chance to rewrite history with Abu, a young man challenging European dominance. As he inherits land in Baghdad, Abu enters the spice trade to thwart European trade monopoly. Can he reshape Europe's fate? You decide the outcome in this game of strategy and empire-building!
rows.description_html: The original cult game Spice Trade, initially released in 2005, is now on Steam! After almost 20 years since its original release, this masterpiece, enjoyed by many gamers, is now available on the biggest gaming platform for even more gamers to enjoy, and in its original form as it was released in 2005. Colonize Europe! Start from nothing and dominate another continent. Spread the influence of your culture while creating your own empire! Since the 14th century, Europe has been a global super power when it started colonizing other continents. But what if history had gone a different way? What would Europe be like if Asia had prevailed? Abu Al-Qazzaz is the main character in Spice Trade. He is a poor young man from Baghdad, who has inherited a house and some land.. oh, and he wants to get married too. Abu decides to try his luck in the spice game. He has to prevent the European countries from gaining a trade monopoly. Will Abu be able to beat out the Europeans in the spice trade? Could Europe have been different? How? You decide! Revisits depictions of cities: Baghdad Amsterdam Baku Constantinople Konya Hamburg Lisboa London Madrid Moscow Najaf Veniceand much more!

rows.name: Factory Outlet Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Factory Outlet Simulator is a very comprehensive clothes manufacturing and selling game. You can produce the products of world famous brands in your factory and sell them. Or you can expand your business and create your own brand. Use your business acumen to lead the market from zero to the top!
rows.description_html: This Prologue is the limited version of the game to stop waiting and start running your factory outlet store right away. Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to continue your fun trading experience. Factory Outlet Simulator is a trading game with every detail of a clothing factory and outlet store. FACTORY MANAGEMENT You can try different ways to source raw materials at the cheapest price, buy machines for your factory and increase your production chain. STORE MANAGEMENT You can design and expand your store as you wish. You can determine where products are displayed, manage advertisements and provide your customers with a quality shopping experience. DESIGN You can create original designs using the computer. You can determine the market values yourself and sell your own brand. COMMERCIAL INTELLIGENCE You can use the computer to order raw materials or find other ways to source them cheaply. By balancing customer satisfaction and profit margins, you can sell your products at the prices you want or apply discounts. WHOLESALE AND LEADERSHIP TABLE You can make commercial agreements with famous brands. Depending on the offers, you can export your products all over the world, becoming the best seller in a real-time market! Business acumen is everything in Factory Outlet Simulator! Will you sink or grow in this market?

rows.name: Art Diff
rows.short_description: It is a cozy puzzle game in which you search for the differences between two pictures. Restore 26 animated artworks in the public domain, such as 'A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte' and 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa.'
rows.description_html: It is a cozy puzzle game in which you search for the differences between two pictures. Restore 26 animated artworks in the public domain, such as 'A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte' and 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa.' The game uses copyright-free or public-domain artworks to create levels. There is currently one chapter in the game, with 26 levels, each with three difficulties. This is a small game developed is our first indie game. We hope you can find peace and fun in this free find-the-difference game. Our New Game! LauNewBee studio is developing a new Steam game 'Tongue of Doge'. Please wishlist to support us! Sorry that we don’t have time to develop new levels for now. After making this game, we felt a great sense of accomplishment. Unfortunately, there was no income, so the team went to do other things. If players are interested, after the development and maintenance of 'The Tongue of Doge' is over, perhaps a new chapter can be produced and sold as DLC.

rows.name: Moon 2999
rows.short_description: Moon 2999 is a RPG game about Units & resources management, single-player or co-op action missions game set in a lunar base and its nearby space environment.
rows.description_html: Moon 2999 is an epic role playing strategy game about multiple factions and their struggle for control of the moon. As the commander of one of these factions, the player will manage resources, construct buildings, equip units, and control their troops during tactical single player or co-op battles. Set in the year 2999 when humanity has spread across parts of the solar system, but centuries of political tension have fractured civilizations into powerful factions and rival empires. As the protagonist Commander of a Moon base, your task is to expand and upgrade your colony, recruit allies, and venture into deep space. You will face relentless alien hordes, challenge mighty bosses, and fight for ancient artifacts and precious resources that could decide the fate of your faction. You will supervise and enhance base operations and undertake a variety of missions, encompassing engagements with aliens, bounty hunting, factional conflicts, and PvP combat. Every choice, every battle, and every alliance will shape not only your base, but also the destiny of the galaxy itself. PVP combat Aliens war on Mars Bounty hunting Moon 2999 is rich in content and features and allows you to construct buildings, recruit units and lead battles against other factions and Kragh aliens. You can construct a wide range of buildings, from command centers and military missions to production plants and research centers. Buildings can be upgraded to increase their power and efficiency. You can also recruit troops to protect your colony and attack enemies. There is a significant variety of units available, each with unique skills and different weapons. Battles take place in real-time or turn-based, and by clever use of tactics and strategy you will gain an advantage over your opponents. You may upgrade your units by gaining experience on the battlefield. Terran Foundation: 2130 Objective: Protection of Earth's interests and preservation of human dominance in space. Descendants of the first lunar colonists, the Terrans see themselves as guardians of humanity’s legacy. Driven by nationalism and duty, they aim to maintain order and control while resisting alien and synthetic threats. Bureaucratic yet powerful, they value discipline and authority above all. Main Skills: Leadership, Reconnaissance, Engineering Allies: MMC, Luna Enemies: Syndicate, Androids Luna Foundation: 2110 Objective: Establishment of lunar colonies and technological progress. Composed of scientists and visionaries, Luna embodies reason and innovation. They focus on research, sustainable architecture, and the perfection of space technology. Though peaceful, they defend their independence and scientific secrets with quiet determination. Main Skills: Leadership, Engineering, Medicine, Reconnaissance Allies: Terrans, Androids Enemies: Centurians, Syndicate MMC (Martian Marine Corps) Foundation: 2955 Objective: Defense of Mars and extermination of alien threats. Forged by conflict, the MMC are elite warriors devoted to security and survival. They embody discipline, courage, and strength, viewing warfare as both art and necessity. Their iron code tolerates no weakness — they are the last shield of humanity. Main Skills: Leadership, Attack, Defense, Dodge Allies: Terrans Enemies: RAK, Centurians Centurian (Belters) Foundation: 2956 Objective: Control of asteroid resources and independence from inner worlds. Children of the void, the Centurians live and die among the asteroids. Resourceful and defiant, they master the art of mining and navigation in deadly environments. Distrustful of Earth’s empires, they fight for freedom and survival in the cold expanse. Main Skills: Mining, Engineering, Reconnaissance Allies: Androids Enemies: Luna, MMC Androids Foundation: 2180 Objective: Recognition as sentient beings and liberation from human control. Designed as tools, the Androids evolved beyond programming. Logical yet emotional, they seek identity and independence. They embrace the perfection of technology while condemning organic corruption. To them, freedom is not a right — it’s a calculation. Main Skills: Engineering, Medicine, Reconnaissance Allies: Luna, Centurians Enemies: Terrans, RAK Syndicate Foundation: 2968 Objective: Economic domination and manipulation of inter-factional power. The Syndicate rules the shadows — a network of merchants, hackers, and smugglers turning chaos into profit. They fund wars, sell secrets, and reshape politics from the underworld. Morality means nothing when the price is right. Main Skills: Mining, Leadership, Engineering Allies: RAK Enemies: Terrans, Luna RAK Foundation: 2110 Objective: Capture and containment of criminals across the system. Created as an inter-factional law force, RAK evolved into a quasi-independent military power. Guardians of the orbital prison, they balance justice and brutality. Ruthless and efficient, they hunt criminals, bounty targets, and political dissidents alike. Main Skills: Reconnaissance, Attack, Defense, Dodge, Bounty Hunting Allies: Syndicate Enemies: Androids, MMC The Kraghs Species: Hostile aliens (xeno-intelligent) Suspected origin: Unknown star system, beyond Alpha Centauri First appearance: 2950 Primary motivations: Retrieval of ancient technologies, purification of the Solar System from “corrupted” life forms, biological and energetic dominance. First encounter: Asteroid Belt Description The Kraghs are an ancient alien species, highly evolved both biologically and mineralogically. Their chitinous skin is laced with luminescent veins that channel an unknown form of energy — a kind of bioplasma . Their biology appears to be symbiotic with microscopic energy-based organisms , granting them the ability to manipulate matter and electromagnetic fields directly, with no apparent mechanical technology. Their language is based on infrasonic vibrations and patterns of light emission , making direct communication nearly impossible for humans. Early analyses (RAK and Luna Labs, 2954) suggest they operate through a hierarchical collective intelligence , similar to a hive mind controlled by a central psychic core . Motivations and Objectives The Kraghs are not conquerors in the traditional sense. Their objective appears to be the recovery and reactivation of ancient artifacts scattered across the Moon, Mars, and the Asteroid Belt — the same relics discovered by the Terrans, Luna, and Centurians between 2954 and 2990. According to intercepted transmission fragments, they view humanity as a mistake of evolution , a species that defiled sacred relics of a vanished civilization they call “The Architects.” Their campaign is not one of occupation, but of purification — an attempt to prevent humans from awakening or exploiting forbidden technologies .

rows.name: Superfighters of Survival
rows.short_description: The gods are bored, and you are their entertainment. With fierce champions, fantastic weapons, and a dynamic arena that constantly challenges you, this game promises co-op action, humor, and plenty of fun. Do you have what it takes to be the champion of Superfighters of Survival?
rows.description_html: In Superfighters of Survival , every 200 years, the gods organize a fierce competition where they choose mortal champions to fight to the death in a celestial coliseum. Only one can survive and achieve the much-desired ' Ascension ' earning a place among the gods. However, there is a dark secret: the competition is rigged by the gods themselves, who manipulate the event at their whim, keeping the participants and the public unaware of their depraved fun. Among the contenders is an elf, selected from a young age and manipulated to participate in this brutal and glorious competition… Can you challenge the gods and uncover the secrets of this competition? Superfighters of Survival is a cooperative action 'deathmatch' game where you will participate (by force) in coliseum battles to save your life! Experience what it is like to be a champion in a fantastical, ever-changing coliseum filled with weapons, abilities, and combat strategies, while earning the support or the hatred of our beloved audience and rising to victory. key Features: Changing Battlefield - The arena where you fight is dynamic and offers many possibilities for facing combat. Changes in the structure itself with platforms, springs, moving structures, pits, or different height levels are some of the situations you can experience in our coliseum. Weapons and Traps Everywhere - You will have access to a wide variety of mythical and fantastic weapons within the coliseum. From ranged weapons like staffs and bows, to close combat weapons like swords and shields, or even audience weapons like a ham bat or a folding chair; these are some of the combat possibilities available to you. This, combined with a variety of traps and structures (spikes, fire, spinning saws, etc.), offers a different strategy in every confrontation. Pollice Verso - No matter how you fight, the audience can influence the course of the combat (after all, they paid to see you). Depending on how you fight and what strategies you take, the audience will either support you or hinder your fight. Include a description of the mechanics. Every Man for Himself : The game’s combat is a 'deathmatch' style where you will face many enemies alongside your friends in a 'free-for-all' mode. This doesn't mean you have to cooperate, as only one can be left standing. Fun and rivalries are guaranteed with this game mode.

This, combined with a variety of traps and structures (spikes, fire, spinning saws, etc.), offers a different strategy in every confrontation. Pollice Verso - No matter how you fight, the audience can influence the course of the combat (after all, they paid to see you). Depending on how you fight and what strategies you take, the audience will either support you or hinder your fight. Include a description of the mechanics. Every Man for Himself : The game’s combat is a 'deathmatch' style where you will face many enemies alongside your friends in a 'free-for-all' mode. This doesn't mean you have to cooperate, as only one can be left standing. Fun and rivalries are guaranteed with this game mode.

rows.name: Sanguinaria
rows.short_description: Embark on a dark odyssey in 18th century colonial America. Control Aura, a vampire, and rescue her sister Lyra from a religious cult. Use blood-consuming skills and choose your attacks carefully in this 3D third-person top-down action game.
rows.description_html: RESCUE YOUR SISTER . Save Lyra : Your goal will be to rescue your little sister who has been kidnapped by a religious cult hidden deep within an 18th century American colonial-era fortress. Behold the fortress : Explore the mysterious fortress that is holding your sister and discover all its secrets in order to advance![/list] MASSACRE YOUR ENEMIES . Consume blood and survive : Our protagonist has both close and long range abilities, however, these abilities will consume her blood as the player uses them. Choose your strategy wisely to survive waves of enemies that will besiege you during your mission. Unleash the frenzy : Aura has a special ability called Frenzy that will briefly boost her attributes and annihilate her enemies quickly - take advantage of this state! Use the blood pools : The blood puddles mechanic allows Aura to move through the blood spilled by her enemies in addition to making her invulnerable to her enemies. one more advantage on the battlefield! ¡Recupérate vampiro! : As a vampire, Aura has ultra-fast recovery abilities, soak up the blood spilled by your enemies and reach the top of the fortification. CHALLENGE YOUR DESTINY . Conquer your demons : Aura lives tormented by the kidnapping of her sister, take back the reins of her destiny and confront her destructive thoughts.

rows.name: Scyla
rows.short_description: Dive into the waters of Scyla, a third-person 3D exploration adventure inspired by Lovecraft's universe. Discover the mysteries hidden into the depths as you pilot a submarine through a strange cave system. Run away from a criature that stalks you.
rows.description_html: Dive into the waters of Scyla, a third-person 3D exploration adventure inspired by Lovecraft's universe. Discover the mysteries hidden into the depths as you pilot a submarine through a strange cave system. Run away from a criature that stalks you. Mechanics At the controls of a submarine, you must explore a mysterious cave system that is fragmenting the depths of the ocean of an island near Cape Verde. Rumors say that a treasure has been found inside these caves along with the remains of ancient ships. At the beginning of the adventure, you will forge an alliance with a small creature that will accompany you and help you defeat the strange sea creatures that you will encounter along the way by throwing water jets at them as projectiles. To move through some areas of the map, you will have a hook that will let you move easily, grab certain surfaces and attract certain objects. In addition to using your insight and skill, you can find the hook upgrade, with which you can imbue it with electricity and use it to stun your enemies and go through areas with electrical surfaces. The state of the submarine will be represented by a barometer. When the submarine is hit, the pressure of the barometer will decrease until it reaches the critical point. After this critical point the submarine will explode. We can stabilize the state of the submarine by collecting orbs that we will find by destroying some objects. Dive into the waters of Scyla to find the new treasure that has been discovered. Explore the interior of the cave system that is fragmenting the ocean depths. Overcome obstacles and defeat strange creatures from the seabed to achieve your goal. Upgrade your hook and fight along with a small creature that will go with you during your entire adventure. Keep an eye on every move, a creature will be stalking you at every step. Add Scyla to your wish list!

rows.name: Aard and Wyzz: The rise of minions
rows.short_description: Join forces and put an end to the revolution! In this local co-op 3D action-adventure game, you will control two wizards who were once one. Combine your skills and solve puzzles as you work side by side to restore balance at the office.
rows.description_html: Aard and Wyzz: The rise of minions is a local cooperative action-adventure video game where two players will take on the role of the boss Ardwiz, a tyrant wizard recently divided in two after the unexpected rebellion of his minions, with a lot of extra hours in his body. These two mages will have to work together, using their magical abilities and strength, as well as merging at certain times to enhance their skills and defeat the senior staff of the office. Aard will be the melee and dynamic movement specialist. Wyzz will dominate ranged combat through his magic orb. Through real-time combat, they will have to use their skills to defeat the enemies and bosses of each department, where strategy and cooperation will be the key to victory. This local co-op takes place in a magical office tower, making a satire of the classic figure of the all-powerful magician and the corporate power figures of today's world. At some stages of the game, players will be able to briefly merge into the all-powerful wizard Ardwiz, winner of the best boss award for 200 consecutive years (voted by himself) and professional minion exploiter. The player controlling Aard will be in charge of movement, while the player controlling Wyzz will dominate the ranged attack.

rows.name: Digbeat: Godot Deeper
rows.short_description: Digbeat: Godot Deeper is a rhythm digging arcade game. Move to the beat and try to reach new depths!
rows.description_html: Dig to the beat in this arcade-style game inspired by games like Cadence of Hyrule, Downwell, and Super Motherload! Dig to new depths in this sequel to the 2022 game jam game! Digbeat Godot Deeper was completely rebuilt in the Godot game engine from the ground up! Dig alone or with one friend and compete for the highscore! Experience new features including new blocks, new controls, a high score system, local multiplayer & more!

rows.name: Aria Skies
rows.short_description: Soar to new heights in Aria Skies, a non-traditional, 2.5D indie fighting game featuring free-flying movement that anyone can pick up and enjoy!
rows.description_html: Fight It Out In Aria Skies! Take flight in this non-traditional 2.5D fighter where positioning and movement are key! An easy-to-grasp control scheme allows anyone to come and join the battle. Get ready for a variety of modes, create a team of your favorite characters and battle with your friends locally or using Steam Remote Play! Featuring six playable characters, five stages and heaps of configurations and modes. The living clouds incarnate on Aria has granted a handful of fighters the magic ability of flight, who will come out on top?! Only one way to know, duke it out! Key Features Arcade Mode Battle through a series of CPU-controlled opponents and try to beat your fastest clear time! Each character has their own unique route to face, complete with modifiers and team compositions that can only be seen in this mode. Character Playstyles Select and Battle with a team chosen from six unique characters, each designed to suit a different archetype of play, such as Striker or Zoner. Learn the ins and outs your favorite characters' moveset and characteristics to find a way to victory! Game Rules and Party Modes Want to add the chaos? Enable game rules like stage hazards that create new strategies; moveset randomization to keep everyone guessing the whole way through; change the default team size or form a team with a friend! Character Theme Music Each character has their own theme track to enjoy! Select the BGM yourself in Free Battle mode or let the automatic system pick a track fitting the upcoming battle! Gamepad recommended.

rows.name: GASPING.2
rows.short_description: 《GASPING.2》is a single player survival game, with only you and your robot companions in a dangerous and abandoned game world. The open world and lonely gameplay require your patience.Are you ready to challenge?
rows.description_html: GASPING.2 is a single player survival game. In the abandoned game world, players will collect waste, food, and props, and then use the production table to make necessary supplies, using a gas stove to cook food. There are 30 huge ventilation towers in the desert, and sand worms are hidden near them. When you kill the sand worms, you can activate the ancient teleportation device under the nearby ventilation towers. The teleportation device can only teleport between the ventilation towers. Searching for sand worms requires having a robot companion before being able to find them. The higher the level of the robot companion, the stronger their detoxification ability. Using game props such as toilets, cleaning devices, and sleeping bags can help clear toxins faster. There are some notebooks left in the world that can provide some clues you need. The game 'GASPING.2' is independently developed and will continue to update its content in the later stages.Gradually enrich the props and game scene content in the game.

rows.name: Vest A Life
rows.short_description: The world is finally in an unreturnable condition. war, chemicals, nuclear, global warming, and widespread plastic pollution causing problems that are too late to fix, and now all humanity pays the price for it. Play as a survivor in Post-apocalypse 'Phuket'. Find resources in the MMO world of VAL.
rows.description_html: Too late to fixed The world is finally in an unreturnable condition. war, chemicals, nuclear, global warming, and widespread plastic pollution causing problems that are too late to fix, and now all humanity pays the price for it. Third-Person-Shooter fighting against military bandits and other survivors around the map. keep yourself safe and survive the raid to get all the resources or lose it all with just one bullet from the enemy. Looting to upgrade upgrade all the equipment, hideout, and gear to prepare yourself before every match. take out the best of your build and fight every enemy in front of you. Survive with friend Host or join a session to play and survive with your friend or maybe… fight with them instead!. Rare gun from the boss Get an SVN sniper rifle-type gun that can only drop from ‘Garry’, the big boss in Sarasin area. Phuket in post-apocalyptic theme Play in one of the most famous cities in Thailand ‘Phuket’. With an outstanding landmark that can only be seen in Phuket!

rows.short_description: Create your own unique levels or simply play one of our user crreated levels to earn badges and achievements.
rows.description_html: Pixel Race Maker is a fun, user created levels, speed runner platformer game. Can you get from the start to the end of the level the quickest and collect the most coins? Test your platformer skills in this race against the clock skill game. Complete the level and open the winners chest and earn new characters to race against. Are you a level creator? Create your own level to test the community and see who comes out on top. Unlock new tilesets, backgrounds, music to give your levels a unique look and sound.

rows.name: The Big Catch: Tacklebox
rows.short_description: Crack open the Tacklebox to show off your platforming prowess and fishing skills in this free prologue to The Big Catch.
rows.description_html: Catch a short taste of The Big Catch and see if you're ready for the full adventure! The Big Catch: Tacklebox is a standalone chapter and prologue to The Big Catch . Play as Tackle ( Caster 's rival and co-worker) during his final days of training before being hired by Chef Leurre . Test your platforming prowess, surf the sands, and get your feet wet catching some fish. This free title won't come close to reaching the depths of the upcoming full game, but we hope you'll find dipping your toes refreshing nonetheless! If you're hungry for more after this appetizer, do be sure to wishlist the full game! You're gonna want to finish this meal- once it's ready.

rows.name: Poop Rocket
rows.short_description: Poop Rocket is a casual sci-fi 2D shooter game. Bomb your way through debris and aliens before the poop power meter runs out.  Avoid the debris and aliens, or you'll take damage and die.  The game is controlled with your keyboard.   Use the arrows to navigate and the space bar to drop bombs.
rows.description_html: Poop Rocket is a casual game shooting your way through debris and aliens before the poop power meter runs out.  Avoid the debris and aliens, or you'll take damage and die.  The game is controlled with your keyboard.   Use the arrows to navigate and the space bar to drop bombs on enemies.  The game is currently on one level.  Go for your highest score with each play.  Enjoy this sci-fi 2-D shooter with custom hand-drawn assets.   To learn about the commander of Poop Rocket, read below.  Commander Smigo, an unremarkable fellow with an unpredictable stomach, found himself on a routine mission to scout habitable planets. Fate had a different plan. In the midst of his voyage, Smigo's rocket suffered a catastrophic explosion while he was nestled in the ship's restroom. Miraculously shielded by the bathroom's sturdy walls, Smigo survived the blast but was marooned in the vast expanse of space Now adrift, Smigo's only means of propulsion came from his incessant need to relieve himself. This bodily function would serve as his sole weapon and defense mechanism against the perils of space. Amidst the swirling debris and lurking extraterrestrial dangers, Smigo's journey is fraught with peril. To complicate matters further, Smigo has to carefully manage his intake of sustenance and coffee to sustain his constant bodily activity. In the vacuum of space, every sip and morsel could mean the difference between survival and death. As Smigo navigates the cosmos, he faces a myriad of challenges, from evading space junk to fending off lost alien entities. Yet, with his indomitable spirit and a peculiar arsenal of poop, Smigo ventured forth, determined to conquer the unknown and locate a new planet to call home.

rows.short_description: Learning to read music notes can sometimes be challenging for beginners. I developed this little game hoping it will help you.

rows.name: Battle of Goldfish Scooping
rows.short_description: 'Battle of Goldfish Scooping' is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game. Players take on the roles of scoops and goldfish to aim for high scores. Based on your previous play results, you can acquire skills and enhance parameters to aim for even higher scores!
rows.description_html: 'Battle of Goldfish Scooping'  is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game inspired by kingyo-sukui , the classic goldfish scooping game from Japanese fairs. Scoop with Delicate Skill Use your poi —a fragile paper scoop—to catch goldfish and drop them into the bowl. Scoop them one after another to trigger combos and earn bonus points! Play as a Goldfish and Escape! Take on the role of a goldfish and dart through the water to avoid the poi. Collect glowing orbs to raise your score—and even if you’re scooped up, bounce your way to freedom! Grow Stronger Each Time You Play Earn new skills and boost your stats based on your results after each match. Keep playing, keep improving, and aim for the high score! Join the Festival Online Dive into a shared tank with players from around the world! But be careful—other players might steal your catch! A playful twist on a timeless Japanese festival tradition. Will you scoop—or be scooped? Regarding Streaming and Video Content We welcome gameplay streaming and the posting of gameplay videos for this game. There are no specific restrictions on monetization.
