rows.name: Animal Adventure
rows.short_description: Animal Adventure is a party game that uses familiar animal characters to help you overcome obstacles to reach your destination. It combines PVE elements through various obstacles and PVP elements through competition between players.
rows.description_html: Game Description [Animal Adventure] is a platformer party game where you combine various animal characters and spirits to jump over obstacles. You can enjoy the game with your friends or alone! Choose a cute animal character and use your skills to disrupt your opponents! Each animal has a different skill. Lead your team to victory by blowing away or disrupting opponents who come near you. Choose two spirits of your choice for your animal characters and play with strategy! Each spirit has a different skill that can be used for each spirit, just like the character. Create your own skill set and use it in battle. The key may be to make good use of each character's ultimate skill! Each character's unique ultimate skill makes a big difference as a strategic element in the game. Experience successful play by reading and predicting your opponent's strategy when using the ultimate skill. Enjoy easy play with easy controls! The controls are very simple. Move with the W, A, S, D keys and jump with the space key. General skills are used with the left and right mouse buttons. And the ultimate skill that can change the game's course can be used with the Left-Shift key.

rows.name: From Them
rows.short_description: A short first person wave defense surrounding mutant creatures invading your town. Collect materials and fire power from the hardware and gun store, build traps to defend yourself, and survive 6 nights. Comes with Unreal Engine 5 project files.
rows.description_html: Fight Back Against the Nightmare Your quiet town has been overrun by horrifying creatures from another dimension. With nowhere else to turn, you'll need to use your wits and scavenged supplies to survive. Raid the local hardware store to build defenses and traps. Gear up at the gun shop to unleash firepower on the encroaching horde. Find notes left by residents to learn more about the invasion. Six Nights of Terror For six terrifying nights, you'll need to strategize, build, and fight your way through relentless waves of increasingly monstrous enemies. Each night brings a new challenge, pushing your ammo count and defenses to the limit. From Them also features an infinite mode, letting you test your mettle against a never-ending onslaught of creatures. Can you survive the endless horde? Learn by Doing (and Seeing!) From Them comes with the full Unreal Engine 5 project files, giving you a unique opportunity to see exactly how it was built. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone who likes to poke around, From Them provides valuable insights into the Unreal Engine development process. Are you ready to defend your town... From Them?
rows.about_html: Fight Back Against the Nightmare Your quiet town has been overrun by horrifying creatures from another dimension. With nowhere else to turn, you'll need to use your wits and scavenged supplies to survive. Raid the local hardware store to build defenses and traps. Gear up at the gun shop to unleash firepower on the encroaching horde. Find notes left by residents to learn more about the invasion. Six Nights of Terror For six terrifying nights, you'll need to strategize, build, and fight your way through relentless waves of increasingly monstrous enemies. Each night brings a new challenge, pushing your ammo count and defenses to the limit. From Them also features an infinite mode, letting you test your mettle against a never-ending onslaught of creatures. Can you survive the endless horde? Learn by Doing (and Seeing!) From Them comes with the full Unreal Engine 5 project files, giving you a unique opportunity to see exactly how it was built. Whether you're a complete beginner or someone who likes to poke around, From Them provides valuable insights into the Unreal Engine development process. Are you ready to defend your town... From Them?

rows.name: Horatio: Connector 13
rows.short_description: Akio's accidental encounter with 'Horatio’s Life' leads to a mysterious journey intertwining his past with a parallel world. Unravel secrets, confront otherworldly threats, and uncover the truth in this atmospheric adventure.
rows.description_html: Experience Chapter 1 for FREE! 'Horatio’s Life' thrusts players into an extraordinary journey that transcends reality, following the unexpected encounter of Akio, a young university student, with a visually stunning visual novel game. By a twist of fate at a game convention, Akio inadvertently purchases 'Horatio’s Life' instead of the fighting game recommended by his friend Daniel. What begins as a simple mistake transforms into a gripping adventure as Akio delves into the depths of the game's narrative. As Akio navigates the game's prompts, he unlocks hidden truths about his past and his mother's enigmatic legacy. A chance discovery of a hidden achievement, ominously titled 'THE LOSER,' sets in motion a series of events that intertwine Akio's fate with that of Renna, the daughter of Rolando, the game's creator. Together, they embark on a quest to save Rolando from a mysterious illness, guided by cryptic clues and the echoes of Akio's mother's wisdom. With stunning visuals, compelling storytelling, and immersive gameplay, 'Horatio’s Life' offers an unforgettable gaming experience that challenges perceptions and sparks the imagination. Prepare to embark on a journey beyond imagination, where every decision shapes the destiny of two worlds in this captivating visual novel adventure.

rows.name: Emerald Dreams: Sanity -  Platformer Quest
rows.short_description: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings.
rows.description_html: Game Description Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds filled with puzzles to solve and treacherous monsters to defeat. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings (Multiple Endings). Key Features • Multi-layered gameplay and unique puzzles: Expect not just in-game challenges but also puzzles that extend beyond the game itself, encouraging you to seek answers outside the traditional game environment. Explore dark corners and unlock hidden areas in classic Metroidvania style. • Sanity system: Immerse yourself in the psychological state of your character, which influences their perception of the world and unlocks new possibilities and storylines. Every step in your Exploration alters your perspective on the unfolding events. • Free game with community support: Emerald Dreams: Sanity is available for free to ensure everyone can enjoy our project. Support us by purchasing an exclusive art book or making a small voluntary contribution, and your name will be credited in the game. The game has an Indie vibe, showcasing a unique approach to world-building. • Interactive elements beyond the game: Experience a game that extends beyond the screen, where interacting with external files and websites is crucial to your progress. • Psychological horror: Immerse yourself in a psychological horror that blurs the lines between game and reality, keeping you on edge even after you turn off your computer. • Rich narrative and multiple endings: Explore a rich narrative with multiple endings, driven by your choices and the ever-shifting state of your character's mind. • Atmospheric world and intricate mechanics: Uncover a beautifully crafted pixel world filled with eerie locations and haunting music, designed to pull you deeper into its dark fantasy setting. Why Early Access? We chose the early access model to allow players to immerse themselves in our world and help us improve it. Your feedback and support will help us create the best possible gaming experience, adding new exciting elements like levels and characters. Dive into the game's atmosphere and uncover its mysteries. Current Development Stage The game already has a main storyline and unique game mechanics, but we need to fine-tune the balance and add new levels and characters. We are actively working to make the game as engaging and full of surprises as possible. Journey through dark kingdoms, meet strange creatures, and navigate complex platforming levels. How Long Will Early Access Last? We plan to stay in early access for about a year to gather feedback and make all necessary improvements. Your support will help us create the best final product, which will include new action and gameplay possibilities. What Will Be Different in the Full Version? The full version of the game will include more levels, new characters, expanded storylines, and additional game modes. We also plan to add localization for several languages and port the game to consoles. Test your skills in challenging trials and face mighty bosses. How Do You Plan to Involve the Community? We actively engage with players through Steam forums and social media. Everyone who supports us financially will be credited in the game and will have a say in the project's development. Join our community and help us make the game better. Experience the intensity of the psychological challenges that lie ahead. Monetization Model The game will be free for all users. We offer two ways to support the development: 1. Purchase the art book: Support the project by buying an art book, which will allow you to enjoy unique illustrations and concept art. Appreciate the high quality of hand-drawn animation and unique style. 2. Voluntary donation : Support us with a small contribution and get your name in the game credits.

rows.name: JosPlays' Escape - GameJam April 2024
rows.short_description: ESCAPE! Collect the 5 tools and escape from this creepy attic. Keep the score high by avoiding ghosts and collecting the ghost diamonds, but keep in mind with every diamond you collect, more ghosts will appear and they will become harder to avoid.
rows.description_html: ScoreSpace Jam #29 This game was made for ScoreSpace Jam #29 and was created within one weekend. The theme of this game jam was ESCAPE . Which you have to in the game by collecting all 5 tools and make it to the exit. An extra requirement was to have a highscore system, this game will save the top 3 highscores and are calculated as followed: You start with 600 points, every tick a point is removed from your score. When you get attacked by a ghost you will lose points (so try to avoid them). Collecting the tools will increase your points. Also the ghost diamonds will increase your points. With every diamond you collect a new one will spawn, but be aware. With every diamond a new ghost will spawn and the follow range of the ghosts will increase. Changes The only changes made after the Jam are Steam changes. For example I have added achievements to make the game more enjoyable to play for people. And when bugs are found you can let me know in the discussions and I will try to fix it as well.

rows.name: Madoka Magica Magia Exedra
rows.short_description: Characters from the hit anime series 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica' come together! Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of Gekidan Inu Curry (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG!
rows.description_html: Characters from the anime series 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica' come together! Featuring an all-new story setting and characters from the original ideas of gekidan INU CURRY (Doroinu), experience the action alongside Magical Girl memories in this battle RPG! 'Now go. Unveil the memories of these Magical Girls.' ◆ Puella Magi Madoka Magica Magia Exedra Features - Dive into the 3D world of Madoka Magica! Magical Girls from throughout the series will appear as you relive their various stories from 'Puella Magi Madoka Magica', 'Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story', and more. - Powerful special attacks performed by series all-stars! Form a team of Magical Girls from throughout the series to take on powerful Witches lurking in Labyrinth lairs. - Explore Witch Labyrinths and relive Magical Girl memories! Dive deep into Witch Labyrinths that recreate the series' worldscapes for a fully immersive experience. ◆ Enter a Realm of Magical Memories! ◆ A place where the memories of Magical Girls illuminate the dark... The Lighthouse. Now a girl who's lost everything has wandered into its sanctum. Who am I...? How did I get here...? She will relive key moments of countless Magical Girls by opening windows into their memories... Trusting she'll one day find her own lost light of remembrance. ◆ Staff ◆ Planning and Distribution: Aniplex Inc. Development: Pokelabo, Inc. / f4samurai, Inc. Management: Pokelabo, Inc. ◆ Voice Cast ◆ Akari Komiyama, Ayana Taketatsu, Aoi Yuki, Chiwa Saito, Kaori Mizuhashi, Eri Kitamura, Ai Nonaka, Emiri Kato, Momo Asakura, Sora Amamiya, Shiina Natsukawa, Ayane Sakura, Yui Ogura, Manaka Iwami... ...and many more!

rows.name: Rock the Islands
rows.short_description: Team up with friends and dive into adventure! Rescue dwellers, let them work for you so they farm resources and protect you from enemies. Upgrade your equipment, explore new lands, complete quests and fight evil with glory!
rows.description_html: Rock the Islands - a cozy Idle Arcade game with grind elements and 5-player co-op. Team up with friends to explore mysterious islands: mine resources, rescue dwellers from the goblins, gather a gang of powerful bald men to fight back against your enemies! MINE THE ORE You need coins in order to buy anything here! Mine resources and gems, make profit by selling your loot to various traders, so you can afford upgrades, new pickaxe and unexplored lands. RESCUE THE DWELLERS Rescue dwellers from captivity so they can work for you! Make them mine resources in your base, or take them along so they protect you and mine resources with you! UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT Upgrade your pickaxe, unlock new skills and get a better armor. Also don’t forget to upgrade your dwellers so they make profit for you and be well protected! DEFEND THE SETTLEMENT Goblins can raid your village! They use ships and boats to deliver reinforcements! Don’t let them land on your territory, as they can rob you! CO-OP You can play singleplayer, or team up with up to 5 players. It’s more fun to mine resources together! Share responsibilities and distribute the gathered resources for a common goal. MINIGAMES Engage in minigames hosted by strangers. Challenge bosses or be rewarded for killing waves of enemies on arena! FAQ Why is the game free-to-play? This is our first game. As of now our priority is to learn to work with Steam platform and receive feedback from our audience. How will you update the game? We are planning to release new patches to iterate our game and bring the best experience for users. But nothing serious. We are already preparing for our next big game! What does buying chips give? For chips, you can spin the roulette to acquire new skills. Keep in mind your ability to obtain chips for free by completing daily quests and risk it all by each spin on roulette. Purchasing chips or soundtrack is a great way to support us! Are you planning to add cards, items for the Points Shop? We are not sure of the criterias for such a game and it would be great to add trading cards and items for Point Shop in the upcoming future.

rows.name: Croquettes Gang
rows.short_description: Keep an eye on your master, steal his kibble and achieve your dream!
rows.description_html: In Croquettes Gang, you play as Sneak & Snack, two pets whose goal is to steal as many kibbles as possible from your master's apartment to resell them to the local mouse gang, with a view to buying the legendary Golden Croquette. But the task will not be as easy as it seems! During the night your master is struck by a chaotic sleepwalking attack which will often endanger the plans of our two little animals. Your role: Steal as many kibbles as possible before the end of the night, while doing everything in your power to protect your master's sleep. Because if he wakes up, he will confiscate part of your loot from the night. In this online cooperative party game, you will have to organize with your partner to collect the most loot at night while monitoring the sleepwalkers' dreams which can impact the environment. Fire, floods, storms, you will have to manage these changes and many others by moving objects and making them interact together. Between each night, you will have the opportunity to spend your hard-earned kibble to obtain bonuses or unlock new rooms. Gang de Croquette was developed as part of the Ubisoft 2024 university competition and received 4 nominations (Best Art Direction, Technical Award, Theme Integration and Jury Prize)

rows.name: Temple of Shadows
rows.short_description: Join Sebastian Harrington, an archeology student, on a quest to find his missing professor. Explore ancient temple ruins, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets in the Temple of Shadows.
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic adventure as Sebastian Harrington, a passionate archeology grad student turned explorer, in search of his missing professor. Six weeks ago, Dr. Albert J. Montgomery III announced the discovery of a hidden temple, but he never returned. Now, Sebastian must dive into ancient temple ruins, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets. Will you reveal the mysteries within the Temple of Shadows? STORY AND GAMEPLAY Navigate the enigmatic Temple Ruins and unlock the secrets of the Temple Gate. Venture into the labyrinthine caves beyond, a realm filled with ancient mysteries and hidden dangers. Your mission: uncover the truth and track down the elusive Dr. Montgomery. Embark on this thrilling adventure and face challenges that will test your courage and wits at every turn. Can you reveal the secrets that lie within? PUZZLES AND SECRESTS Prepare to engage your mind with intricate puzzles that will challenge your every move. Manipulate buttons, doors, and moving panels to unlock pathways and reveal hidden secrets. Harness the power of light machines and light collectors to illuminate your path. BEWARE OF DANGERS Along the way, discover hidden passages and collect rare artifacts, each holding secrets that could aid you on your quest—or uncover a deeper mystery. But tread carefully. The temple is alive with dangers: shifting walls, treacherous traps, and ominous shadows waiting to ensnare the unwary. Every step forward could be your last. Will you brave the unknown, or will the temple claim you as its next victim? CHALLENGE YOUR MIND AND UNCOVER THE SECRETS Each puzzle is a test of your ingenuity, designed to challenge your wits and reward your determination. Hidden within the temple's depths are secrets and collectibles waiting to be uncovered by those clever and persistent enough to seek them out. Solve ancient puzzles, unlock forbidden chambers, and piece together the story of the shadows. Will you rise to the challenge and unravel the temple’s mysteries, or will its secrets remain buried forever? COLLECTABLES AND SPEED-RUN MODE Uncover the mysteries of Temple of Shadows by collecting hidden relics, including ancient Drawings, Gold Statues, and the Professor's personal belongings. Each item reveals a deeper layer of the story and the madness lurking within the temple. For the ultimate challenge, test your skills in Speedrun challenge—perfect your path, solve puzzles with precision, and race against the clock to set your best time. Can you conquer the shadows faster than anyone else?  EXPLORE AND DISCOVER Look for new pathways to uncover hidden areas and unlock the temple's most guarded secrets. Every step off the beaten path could lead to rare and valuable items, rewarding the bold and curious. Will you uncover treasures long forgotten, or leave them hidden in the shadows? The choice is yours. A TEST OF WITS AND SANITY Temple of Shadows will push your ingenuity to its limits while keeping you on edge at every turn. The uncertainty of what lies ahead—be it danger, mystery, or madness—might unravel your resolve before you ever find your way out. Do you have the strength to face the unknown, or will the shadows claim your mind?

rows.short_description: Embark on a cosmic adventure as a duo of two robot crabs stranded in the vastness of space. See the world from a different angle and utilize the power of gravity to escape the space station and return back to Earth!
rows.description_html: A 2.5D co-op puzzle platformer where the players control a small robot crab attempting to return back home to Earth. Unbeknownst to them, they are the sole survivors from a dilapidated space station. One robot crab harnesses the power of gravity manipulation, bending the laws of physics as they please. The other harnesses control over the space station, rotating the orientation to their liking. With these gifts, you must shift the world around you and explore every avenue if there is any hope of escape.

rows.name: Who is the Defendant: Deliberately Rough
rows.short_description: 'Who is the Defendant' is a mystery genre visual novel. Players take on the role of a prosecutor, investigating a case involving 'a game with rudimentary art published on STEAM.'
rows.description_html: 'Who is the Defendant' is a spin-off of 'The Real Faces of VTuber,' a demo we presented at a gaming expo before announcing the main theme. It introduces 'The Real Faces of VTuber' in a humorous and light-hearted manner, showcasing the same courtroom gameplay. The playtime is 15 minutes. Game Features Players will act as a prosecutor. Some unscrupulous game developers have released a game on STEAM with rudimentary art. Players will work with prosecution witnesses in court to obtain favorable testimony through proper questioning. Facing defense witnesses, they will present evidence in hand to point out inconsistencies in the testimonies. The goal is to win the trial and uphold justice for the public. Through this free game, we collect player feedback, conduct localization testing, and promote our new work 'The Real Faces of VTuber.' If it brings a smile to your face, that would be our honor!

rows.name: Puzzle Garden
rows.short_description: A short, casual puzzle game where you utilize unique land layouts and crop abilities to maximize your profit.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Puzzle Garden, your very own virtual farm! Relax, turn up the music, and immerse yourself in the casual world of farming and puzzle-solving. Puzzle Garden features 8 casual puzzles for you to play through. Each one is hand-crafted to have you strategizing and planning to make the most amount of money before the end of the season. Try and collect all 24 stars! Explore: Dive into unique garden layouts with distinct challenges, and discover the optimal layout that balances beauty and bounty! Strategize: Maximize your profits by using each plot of land to its fullest potential! Plant Fun Crops: Utilize each crop's unique ability to earn all 3 stars per level! Make Beautiful Gardens: Enjoy the fruits (or vegetables) of your labor and see your garden fully realized! Relax: Chill out to a custom soundtrack and simple visuals to unwind after a long day. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: POOBO
rows.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where you play as a tiny and adorable poop fighting off bacteria. Upgrade your weapons and items to escape the toilet and claim victory!
rows.description_html: Are you ready to become the hero of cleanliness? In the POOBO universe, you are a tiny and cute poop trying to escape the toilet and survive! Fight against hundreds, even thousands of bacteria while creating the ultimate weapon combinations to claim victory. Choose Your Character! Equip Your First Weapon! At the start of the game, you’ll need to make an important decision: choose your first weapon! Each weapon has unique abilities—some are great for close combat, while others help you defeat enemies from a distance. You can carry up to 6 weapons, so plan strategically and pick your first weapon to begin your adventure. Level Up! Upgrade Your Abilities. You’ve leveled up! Each level gives you the chance to make your character even stronger. Choose a card to enhance your stats! If you don’t get the abilities you’re looking for, you can reshuffle the cards and try again. Equip New Weapons! You can equip up to 6 weapons and 6 items at the same time. Each round gives you a chance to renew and upgrade your arsenal. Make the right choices to boost your power and dominate your enemies! Upgrade Your Weapons! Enhance your weapons and items in your inventory to increase your strength. To do this, you’ll need at least 2 of the same weapon or item. With each upgrade, you’ll grow stronger and gain an edge against your enemies!

rows.name: Pocket Waifu: Desktop Pet
rows.short_description: Elevate your desktop experience by adopting a desktop waifu! Similar to a tamagotchi, she will keep you company on your desktop while you work or play other games! Pat her head, feed her snacks, give her plushies, or go fishing. Bring a little joy and cozy vibes to your daily routine!
rows.description_html: Want a cute little friend to keep you company during those long work or gaming sessions? Pocket Waifu is your new adorable 3D chibi desktop companion! She'll hang out on your other monitor while you're working, or entertain you while you play other games! Adopt little Silvy and interact with her in various ways while she hangs out on your desktop. Features: • Achievements! • Simple and easy to use UI • Gorgeous 3D model and physics interactions • Many settings options to customize your experience and performance optimizations. • Over 80 unique animations and a variety of expressions, custom props, and foods. • Compatible with all other games, software, and live wallpapers Pat her head, boop her nose, or yeet her across your screen when she gets in your way! Play video games, ride a roomba across your screen, or dance to keep her entertained! Stream, clean the screen, catch bugs and mine minerals to earn money for food, gifts and upgrades! Come back everyday, pet her head, and make her discover new food to increase her affection for you! When she loves you enough, she'll draw you a cute sketch and you'll unlock a gorgeous new background and new fun interactions! Planned Features: • CHAOS MODE (she will be very disruptive in very fun ways!) • More interactions • More gaming and work activities • Accessories, outfits, and customizations earned through gameplay • To Do list and Pomodoro timer • Other language translations

rows.name: Up Down All-a-Round
rows.short_description: Control your player's gravity up and down and all a round! Master your gravity manipulating abilites to outwit your opponents and win the game!
rows.description_html: Up Down All-a-Round is a fast paced online pvp first person shooter, where you control your player's gravity up and down and all a round! Master your gravity manipulating abilites to outwit your opponents and win the game! At the moment Up Down All-a-Round features 4 game modes, Forever Free For All, Free For All, 4v4s and 2v2s with one more gamemode being worked on! Oh there is also a training room to practice your gravity manipulating abilites! *Please note customization options shown in this gif are not available in the base game* HOW TO PLAY Speaking of gravity manipulating abilites how do you use them? Great question, Up Down All-a-Round's controls are relaltivly simple but are hard to master. You use WASD to move around and the mouse to look around, R to reload and space to jump but they are other controls to take into a count! You control your gravity left and right with the shift left and right buttons which are set to Q and E by default, and control your gravity going up and down with the shift up/down button which is set to the left shift button by default. If you are shifting your gravity left or right and find yourself stuck to a wall, you need to press the stop button which is defaulted to tab. To stop shifting your gravity left or right. Master the gravity manipulating abilites and you will have a great time!

rows.name: RAGE: Anger Management
rows.short_description: Step into the exhilarating world of *Rage*, where you smash everything in sight and gather heaps of gold coins and treasures. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or taking a break from intense gaming, Rage offers satisfying gameplay that lets you release pent-up energy in a fun-filled adventure!
rows.description_html: The Realm of Rage was a secret place, hidden from the eyes of mortals and gods alike. It was created by an ancient wizard, whose name was lost to time, as a sanctuary for himself and his fellow adventures. There, they could unleash their anger and frustration on anything they desired, without fear of consequences or death. RAGE was a paradise for those who sought to vent their emotions and test their skills. They could smash, burn, freeze, or destroy anything they wanted, without harming anyone or anything in the real world. They could not die in the realm, as the wizard’s magic would heal them and restore them to life. However, they could still feel pain, and lose their items or memories, if they were not careful. RAGE was also a source of mystery and adventure, as the wizard had hidden many secrets and challenges in it. That rewarded the clever and the brave. There were also rare and powerful items, spells, and creatures, that could only be found or obtained in the realm of RAGE. Some of these were gifts from the wizard, while others were stolen or borrowed from other worlds. RAGE was a wonder and a danger, as the wizard was not always benevolent or sane. The realm of Rage, is the ultimate playground for the anyone looking to unleash your anger and relieve stress and experience destruction with out consequences. Features: - Rage does away with frustration and goes back to basics with 4 devastating attacks for each character. - Collect coins, gems, and more by smashing everything in sight. - Unlock new characters and upgrades by visiting the shop. - Unique gameplay in that there is no health bar, beat levels by reducing your rage bar in order to summon and defeat the bosses!

Dive into a world where precision, speed, and agility are your greatest allies. Master advanced techniques such as strafing, BHOP (bunny hopping), and surfing.

Dive into a world where precision, speed, and agility are your greatest allies. Master advanced techniques such as strafing, BHOP (bunny hopping), and surfing to navigate challenging environments and outmaneuver your enemies. Featuring stunning animations and cutting-edge visual effects, THOKO delivers an immersive gaming experience like no other. rows.name: Survive the Squids
rows.short_description: The Squids are here - but your soldiers are ready. Grow your squad up to 4 members by rescuing survivors. Obtain the best weapons, support, and equipment you can by gathering Squid Samples. Become a force to be reckoned with, one the Squids will fear for generations to come.
rows.description_html: Nobody knows where they came from. But they are here, and they want every one of us. Survivors must band together to survive - and maybe even banish the squid menace altogether. Though the Planetary Emergency Force is too busy striking the enemy where it hurts to protect everyone, they can supply us with Weapons and Support in return for Squid Samples. All that's left is to slay the enemy and save as many as we can, before it's too late. Survive the Squids is a survivors-like focused on building a squad of survivors. Start with one survivor, and as the game progresses pick up more to add to the squad. Squad members can be armed with a variety of weapons (5 in total!). As the player kills Squids, they will drop Squid Samples - when enough of these have been collected it will trigger a level up, allowing the player to select a variety of upgrades such as Shotgun Shells, Chain-Fed Ammo, and more. Survive as long as you can to get the best high score! Recruit up to 4 squad members Collect Squid Samples to earn new gear Equip your squad they way you'd like Simple, action-packed gameplay that still scratches that squad-based, army-building itch

This nostalgic yet dynamic visual aesthetic, reminiscent of early 20th-century cartoons, gives the game a unique charm that sets it apart from other casual shooters. With its simple yet engaging mechanics, Hyperchannal aims to bring players pure, unadulterated fun in a bite-sized package. Designed as a perfect time-killer , Hyperchannal is ideal for those short moments when you're waiting for other games to load, downloads to finish, or simply looking for a quick escape. Each round promises fast-paced action, intuitive controls, and endless opportunities to hone your skills and beat your previous high score.

rows.name: The Heavens
rows.short_description: Ascend to the Heavens and find out if you're pure enough to be reborn on the Earth.
rows.description_html: This kinetic visual novel is a short story that will brighten your evening and perhaps make you think. Description: Not many know that angels—the young souls—live up in the clouds. There, they await their turn to be reborn into the world. Yet that fate is only reserved for the purest among them, and the corrupted angels fall to the ground with the rain. One day, Luke decides to take a peek at what's down there, on the earth, and his cloud descends. Having done that, he disturbed the peace of his brothers and sisters, and it's getting more and more difficult to keep grace in the Heavens. Will he be able to return things to normal? Game features: Short, but breath-taking story that will immerse you in a unique world Pastel-colored graphics, supplemented with animations, that will make you float in the heavens along with the game's characters An original soundtrack permeated with grace

rows.name: For Whom the Stars Shine
rows.short_description: 'Some stories are best told to none,' she whispered. Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall how he bent heaven's ear. However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there.
rows.description_html: 'Some stories are best told to none,' she whispered. Long ago, the stars disappeared. Then, a man returned them. Few would believe such a thing; fewer still can recall his name or how he bent the heavens' ears. It's a story of romance and tragedy that the stars themselves testify of to this day. However, you won't find the tale in books or archives—only in the hearts of those who were there. For Whom the Stars Shine is a short kinetic visual novel—a story without choices or branching paths created by New Dialog and cowritten by Pony with a Pen. Character sprites were drawn by Ruvik, and all background art was created by GoodDay.

rows.name: GMU Blastmaster Battle
rows.short_description: Blast your way to master status in this Bomberman-style game!
rows.description_html: GMU Blastmaster Battle by Studio 410 is a colorful reimagining of the classic Bomberman formula with a healthy dose of GMU spirit. Play as one of four GMU-themed characters and blast your way to victory using a multitude of powerups over three beautiful stages! Here are some features to expect from Blastmaster Battle: - Fight Your Friends: Up to four players can play via keyboard or controller in local PvP or virtually through a third party such as Parsec. Only XBOX or similar controllers are supported; button 1 is A, button 2 is B. Back is the Start button. - Gamemodes: The major gameplay change that's being implemented in v1.1 is the addition of optional gamemodes. They can do many things, from changing small stuff like what drops when to big things like starting a match with no blocks or even changing bomb types every couple seconds! They can be disabled in settings for the classic Blastmaster experience. - Tutorials: We've completely overhauled the tutorial screen, adding looping instructional videos introducing the bomb types, powerups, and general ways to play. - Win Tracking: For everyone doing those sick all-night Blastmaster LAN parties, the game tracks who has won the most games with a nifty little crown floating above their character. Now you'll know exactly who to gang up on in the next match! And more!

rows.name: SHADOWBOX: Mausoleum of Natural History
rows.short_description: Experience the story of life on Earth like never before with SHADOWBOX: Mausoleum of Natural History, a virtual, interactive, and free-to-play museum featuring 3D scans of real fossils.
rows.description_html: Experience the story of life on Earth like never before with SHADOWBOX: Mausoleum of Natural History , a virtual, interactive, and free-to-play museum. Explore exhibits that detail the life, death, anatomy, and ecology of extinct species containing photogrammetric scans of real fossils. Examine fossils up close, and learn how to identify long-lost species in real life. Scan QR codes to read more about the science behind SHADOWBOX . Collect songs and audio logs to listen to as you explore. Run, jump, and climb on the exhibits, if you please! As of the current version, Beta 1.5 , the following exhibits are open to visitors: Burgess Shale (Cambrian Period) Martin Formation (Devonian Period) Silica Formation (Devonian Period) Naco Formation (Carboniferous Period) Kaibab Limestone (Permian Period) Coconino Sandstone (Permian Period) Moenkopi Formation (Triassic Period) Thaynes Group (Triassic Period) Chinle Formation (Triassic Period) Blue Lias (Jurassic Period) Turney Ranch Formation (Cretaceous Period) Moreno Hill Formation (Cretaceous Period) Menefee Formation (Cretaceous Period) Green River Formation (Eocene Epoch) The Geological Eras Tour Real, False, & Phony Fossils Your input will help the SHADOWBOX development team create the most accessible, informative, and engaging experience possible. If you have suggestions, feedback, or would like to report a bug, head on over to the Steam forums.

rows.name: Puck
rows.short_description: Fast-paced physics-based hockey simulation where precision, strategy, and chaos collide. Control every move, pass, and shot with realistic puck physics, dynamic player movement, and thrilling gameplay. Master the rink with friends or team up with other Puck players for ultimate hockey dominance!
rows.description_html: Get ready to hit the ice in a fast-paced, physics-driven hockey simulation that puts you in complete control. Every pass, shot, and body check is powered by realistic physics, making each game unpredictable, skill-based, and endlessly replayable. Whether you're a die-hard hockey fan or just looking for a fun and competitive sports experience, this game delivers high-intensity action with fluid gameplay and dynamic mechanics. Skill-Based Controls The stick controls are designed to offer a high level of precision and depth, allowing you to execute skillful plays, react to dynamic puck physics, and outmaneuver your opponents with finesse. Team Play Puck isn’t just about skill - it’s about working together to create game-changing moments. Whether you're threading a perfect pass through defenders, setting up a teammate for a one-timer, or executing a seamless give-and-go, teamwork is at the heart of every unforgettable play. Pick Your Role Every great hockey team needs both fearless skaters and rock-solid goaltenders. Whether you thrive on the rush as a forward, dominate the blue line as a defenseman, or guard the net as a last line of defense, your role on the ice is yours to define.

rows.name: Sarah's Adventure: Time Travel
rows.short_description: This game unearths the essence of adventure by combining elements of exploration and puzzle-solving. The game’s appeal lies in its interactive gameplay mechanics, where your choices dictate the progression of the story.
rows.description_html: Step into 'Sarah's Adventure: Time Travel', an enchanting game that sends players on a captivating journey through space and time. This game unearths the essence of adventure by combining elements of exploration and puzzle-solving. As players navigate through various locations around the globe, they are tasked with clearing obstacles and unraveling challenges, truly engaging the player's wit and strategy. The game’s appeal lies in its interactive gameplay mechanics, where your choices dictate the progression of the story. Dive into a meticulously crafted world, build and manage resources effectively, and restore historical artifacts to their former glory. 'Sarah's Adventure' is not just a game; it's a chronicle of thrilling escapades and the celebration of human curiosity, designed to intrigue, delight, and immerse audiences in its narrative richness. Immerse yourself in the engaging tale of Sarah, a young professional from a world-class museum, who finds herself suddenly transported to the nineteenth century. Can you survive the sands of time and help Sarah find her way back?

rows.name: Turbo Live
rows.short_description: Turbo Live is the ultimate party game to play with your community on stream. Save the pedestrians or crush them via chat. In co-op or versus. Grow your audience, have fun, and create connections during chaotic and unforgettable sessions!
rows.description_html: Turbo Live is a party game where you must survive in a world where drivers don’t respect anything. The concept of the game is simple: you need to guide a group of pedestrians who are a bit dumb and clumsy through traffic without getting them run over. Turbo Live can be played solo like an arcade game, or live with your community like a party game. It’s up to you. 🚶‍♂️ Save or crush the pedestrians 🚗 Send cars onto the road or from the skies to run over the pedestrians 🔔 Interact with your community or your favorite streamers, regardless of the streaming platform 💥 Combine commands and come up with the most twisted strategies to cause chaos! Are you a streamer and want to play with your community? Turbo Live is the ultimate party game to spice up your streams. Save the pedestrians or crush them via the chat, in co-op or versus mode. Grow your audience, have fun, and create connections during chaotic and unforgettable sessions! GO, GO, GO, TURBOOOOOOO LIVE!!! 🎮 Tons of Game Modes In Turbo Live, the goal is to either crush or save the pedestrians. So far, nothing too complicated. But the game modes add a twist, a challenge, and can even completely turn the experience upside down. Imagine playing street soccer in the middle of a traffic jam. Scoring goals while avoiding getting hit won't be easy. Of course, you'll have access to several different game modes (survival, zero crash, soccer, etc.), and more are coming soon (werewolf, zombie, etc.). 🎲 Embrace the Chaos Can you imagine giving full control to your community? Via the chat , viewers can use tons of commands to play, react, help, sabotage, troll, and support you if they're nice. And as if that wasn't enough, we've also planned random events combined with unpredictable physics to surprise you and create completely absurd situations. But don't worry! You have access to settings to customize your experience and ensure everything runs the way you want it to. ✨ Simple and accessible Have you ever tried to play with your community but gave up because you had to explain the game rules fifty thousand times? Relax! We’ve got you covered. Turbo Live is designed so that anyone (even your grandma) can join the game midway without needing any explanations. The rules and commands are always visible on screen, making everything super accessible. And to top it off, we’ve programmed a Twitch bot that gives tips to viewers without cluttering up the chat. The main goal is to have fun. Or to make sure your stream goes smoothly and stays dynamic. Clearly, we prefer to avoid the situation where you get lost in incomprehensible menus and endless settings. We offer two ways to play with your community: 🖥 Twitch option for a quick connection to your account and straight into the game 🔌 Keyboard option to assign chat commands to keyboard keys (a third-party tool is required) ⚙ Feel free to check our streamer guide in the announcements for more information (it’s right above) And don’t worry, you don’t need to be a pro gamer or a streamer with 1,000,000 followers. You just need a mouse, a decent computer (preferably not from the 80s), and you can even play solo if you want! 💬 A Message from the Developers We are a small indie team of two passionate people , determined to offer you a fun and chaotic gaming experience , perfect for solo play or sharing live. We don't claim to offer you a 100-hour blockbuster with endless side quests. Instead, we offer you Turbo Live, a game with a unique experience that suits you. Turbo Live is free (and always will be) and offers extensive customization thanks to DLCs. You have the freedom to install the DLCs that interest you to enrich your experience. Additionally, we are committed to continuously adding free and paid content , taking your feedback into account to improve the game over time. 💖Did you enjoy Turbo Live or want to follow the project? 💌 You can provide feedback on our Discord to improve the game 👉 You can join our social networks or share it with your friends
